docstring:
A space has the Baire property iff the countable union of closed nowhere dense sets has empty
interior.
name: baireSpace_iff_interior_iUnion_eq_empty
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : BaireSpace X ↔ ∀ (f : ℕ → Set X), (∀ (n : ℕ), IsClosed (f n)) → (∀ (n : ℕ), IsNowhereDense (f n)) → Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := Set X) (interior (⋃ n, f n)) ∅

docstring:
If `f` is any function and `g` is analytic without zero at `z₀`, then `f` is meromorphic in normal
form at `z₀` iff `g * f` is meromorphic in normal form at `z₀`.
name: meromorphicNFAt_mul_iff_right
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (h₁g : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x) (h₂g : g x ≠ 0) : MeromorphicNFAt (g * f) x ↔ MeromorphicNFAt f x

docstring: A function is `C^(n+1)` iff it has a `C^n` derivative.
name: contDiff_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F} {n : ℕ} : ContDiff 𝕜 (↑n + 1) f ↔ ∃ f', ContDiff 𝕜 (↑n) f' ∧ ∀ (x : E), HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x

docstring:
A cocone is colimit iff it becomes limit after the
application of `yoneda.obj X` for all `X : C`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.isColimitYonedaEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {J : Type w} [CategoryTheory.Category.{t, w} J] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{t, v, w, u} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c ≃ ((X : C) → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (F := F.op.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.yoneda X)) (CategoryTheory.Functor.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.yoneda X) c.op))

docstring:
A CW complex has weak topology, i.e. a set `A` in `X` is closed iff its intersection with
every closed cell and `D` is closed. Use `RelCWComplex.closed` instead.
name: Topology.RelCWComplex.closed'
statement_text: {X : Type u} : ∀ {inst : TopologicalSpace X} {C : Set X} {D : outParam (Set X)} [self : Topology.RelCWComplex C D], ∀ A ⊆ C, (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : @Topology.RelCWComplex.cell _ inst C _ _ n), IsClosed (A ∩ ↑(Topology.RelCWComplex.map n j) '' Metric.closedBall 0 1)) ∧ IsClosed (A ∩ D) → IsClosed A

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(a, +∞)` if and only if it contains an interval `(a, u]`
with `a < u`.
name: mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioc_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Ioi a, Set.Ioc a u ⊆ s

docstring:
An `R`-algebra `S` has the going down property if and only if generalizations lift
along `Spec S → Spec R`.
name: Algebra.HasGoingDown.iff_generalizingMap_primeSpectrumComap
statement_text: {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] : Algebra.HasGoingDown R S ↔ GeneralizingMap (X := PrimeSpectrum S) (Y := PrimeSpectrum R) (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S))

docstring:
If `f` is any function and `g` is analytic without zero in `U`, then `f` is meromorphic in normal
form on `U` iff `g * f` is meromorphic in normal form on `U`.
name: meromorphicNFOn_mul_iff_right_of_analyticOnNhd
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {U : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (h₁g : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g U) (h₂g : ∀ u ∈ U, g u ≠ 0) : MeromorphicNFOn (g * f) U ↔ MeromorphicNFOn f U

docstring:
A vector space has dimension at most `1` if and only if there is a
single vector of which all vectors are multiples.
name: rank_le_one_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Ring K] [StrongRankCondition K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] [Module.Free K V] : Module.rank K V ≤ 1 ↔ ∃ v₀, ∀ (v : V), ∃ r, r • v₀ = v

docstring:
One subspace is less than or equal to another if and only if all its points are in the second
subspace.
name: AffineSubspace.le_def'
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (s₁ : AffineSubspace k P) (s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : s₁ ≤ s₂ ↔ ∀ p ∈ s₁, p ∈ s₂

docstring: A point is centroid if and only if the sum of vectors from the point to all vertices is zero.
name: Affine.Simplex.eq_centroid_iff_sum_vsub_eq_zero
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {n : ℕ} [CharZero k] {s : Affine.Simplex k P n} {p : P} : p = s.centroid ↔ ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (s.points i -ᵥ p) = 0

docstring: An element `a` is `M`-regular if and only if a positive multiple of `a` is `M`-regular.
name: IsVAddRegular.nsmul_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {a : R} [AddMonoid R] [AddAction R M] {n : ℕ} (n0 : 0 < n) : IsVAddRegular M (n • a) ↔ IsVAddRegular M a

docstring:
Given an idempotent linear operator `p`, we have
`x ∈ range p` if and only if `p(x) = x` for all `x`.
name: LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.mem_range_iff
statement_text: {S : Type u_5} [Semiring S] {M : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module S M] {p : M →ₗ[S] M} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) {x : M} : x ∈ p.range ↔ p x = x

docstring:
A point in a projective space is contained in the span of a set of points if and only if the
point is contained in all subspaces of the projective space which contain the set of points.
name: Projectivization.Subspace.mem_span
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {S : Set (Projectivization K V)} (u : Projectivization K V) : u ∈ Projectivization.Subspace.span S ↔ ∀ (W : Projectivization.Subspace K V), S ⊆ ↑W → u ∈ W

docstring: A simple graph has no `card β`-cliques iff it does not contain `⊤ : SimpleGraph β`.
name: SimpleGraph.cliqueFree_card_iff_free_top
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph α} {β : Type u_3} [Fintype β] : G.CliqueFree (Fintype.card β) ↔ SimpleGraph.Free.{u_1, u_3} (W := β) ⊤ G

docstring:
If `f` is meromorphic at `x`, then `f - g` is meromorphic at `x` if and only if `g` is meromorphic
at `x`.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicAt_fun_sub_iff_meromorphicAt₁
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : MeromorphicAt.{u_1, u_3} (E := E) (fun z => f z - g z) x ↔ MeromorphicAt g x

docstring:
Dirac delta measures at two points are different if and only if the two points are different,
assuming the measurable space separates points.
name: MeasureTheory.dirac_ne_dirac_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace.SeparatesPoints α] {x : α} {y : α} : Ne (α := MeasureTheory.Measure α) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac y) ↔ x ≠ y

docstring:
A set `s` is discrete iff for every `y ∈ s` there is an open `u` with `u ∩ s = {y}`.
See `isDiscrete_iff_forall_subset_exists_isOpen'` for a related version of this with subsets.
name: isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen
statement_text: {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set Y} : IsDiscrete s ↔ ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ u, IsOpen u ∧ u ∩ s = {y}

docstring:
An operator `T` on an inner product space is symmetric if and only if it is
`LinearMap.IsSelfAdjoint` with respect to the sesquilinear form given by the inner product.
name: LinearMap.isSymmetric_iff_sesqForm
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) : T.IsSymmetric ↔ LinearMap.IsSelfAdjoint (M := E) (LinearMap.flip (innerₛₗ 𝕜)) ⇑T

docstring: The `p`-adic norm of an integer `m` is one iff `p` doesn't divide `m`.
name: padicNorm.int_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (m : ℤ) : padicNorm p ↑m = 1 ↔ ¬↑p ∣ m

docstring:
If `R →+* A` is injective, then `R` is of characteristic `p` if and only if `A` is also of
characteristic `p`. Similar to `RingHom.charZero_iff`.
name: RingHom.charP_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [NonAssocSemiring R] [NonAssocSemiring A] (f : R →+* A) (H : Function.Injective.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} (α := R) (β := A) ⇑f) (p : ℕ) : CharP R p ↔ CharP A p

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is strictly above the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f c b < slope f a c`.
name: lineMap_lt_map_iff_slope_lt_slope
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (hab : a < b) (h₀ : 0 < r) (h₁ : r < 1) : (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r < f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ↔ slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b < slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r)

docstring:
Given `x, y : E ⊗ (F ⊗ G)`, `x = y` iff `⟪a ⊗ₜ (b ⊗ₜ c), x⟫ = ⟪a ⊗ₜ (b ⊗ₜ c), y⟫` for all
`a, b, c`.

See also `ext_iff_inner_left_threefold` for when `x, y : E ⊗ F ⊗ G`.
name: TensorProduct.ext_iff_inner_left_threefold'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {G : Type u_4} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G] {x : TensorProduct 𝕜 E (TensorProduct 𝕜 F G)} {y : TensorProduct 𝕜 E (TensorProduct 𝕜 F G)} : x = y ↔ ∀ (a : E) (b : F) (c : G), inner 𝕜 (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (b ⊗ₜ[𝕜] c)) x = inner 𝕜 (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (b ⊗ₜ[𝕜] c)) y

docstring: Given an equivalence of diagrams `e`, `s` is a colimit cocone iff `s.whisker e.functor` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.whiskerEquivalenceEquiv
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {K : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} K] {C : Type u₃} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} J C} {s : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F} (e : CategoryTheory.Equivalence.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} K J) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit s ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.whisker e.functor s)

docstring:
The preimage of a connected component is preconnected if the function has connected fibers
and a subset is closed iff the preimage is.
name: Topology.IsCoinducing.isConnected_preimage_of_isClosed
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β} (connected_fibers : ∀ (t : β), IsConnected (f ⁻¹' {t})) (hcl : Topology.IsCoinducing f) {t : Set β} (ht : IsClosed t) (ht' : IsConnected t) : IsConnected (f ⁻¹' t)

docstring:
If two continuous linear maps `u, v : E → F` agree on a subspace `A` of `E` with finite
codimension, then `u` is strict with closed range if and only if `v` is strict with closed range.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isStrictMap_isClosed_range_iff_of_eqOn
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace E] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 F] [T2Space F] (u : E →L[𝕜] F) (v : E →L[𝕜] F) (A : Submodule 𝕜 E) [A.CoFG] (h_eqOn : Set.EqOn.{u_2, u_3} (β := F) ⇑u ⇑v ↑A) : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := E) (Y := F) ⇑u ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑u).range ↔ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := E) (Y := F) ⇑v ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑v).range

docstring: The map of an empty cone is a limit iff the mapped object is terminal.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitMapConeEmptyConeEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) (X : C) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (G.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Limits.asEmptyCone X)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v₂, u₂} (G.obj X)

docstring: If `R` is a Dedekind domain then an `R`-module is flat iff it has no torsion.
name: IsDedekindDomain.flat_iff_torsion_eq_bot
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [IsDedekindDomain R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ Eq (α := Submodule R M) (Submodule.torsion R M) ⊥

docstring:
A monotone function is continuous at a point if and only if its left and right limits
coincide.
name: Monotone.continuousAt_iff_leftLim_eq_rightLim
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] {f : α → β} (hf : Monotone f) {x : α} [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] : ContinuousAt f x ↔ Function.leftLim f x = Function.rightLim f x

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which antivary together on `s`, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f ∘ σ` and `g`
antivary together on `s`. Stated by permuting the entries of `f`.
name: AntivaryOn.sum_comp_perm_mul_eq_sum_mul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} (hfg : AntivaryOn f g ↑s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i ∈ s, f (σ i) * g i) (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ↔ AntivaryOn (f ∘ ⇑σ) g ↑s

docstring: A map is a homeomorphism iff it is a surjective embedding.
name: isHomeomorph_iff_isEmbedding_surjective
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsHomeomorph f ↔ Topology.IsEmbedding f ∧ Function.Surjective f

docstring: A nonzero vector equals a rotation of that vector if and only if the angle is zero.
name: Orientation.eq_rotation_self_iff_angle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (θ : Real.Angle) : x = (o.rotation θ) x ↔ θ = 0

docstring: Euler's Criterion: A unit `x` of `ZMod p` is a square if and only if `x ^ (p / 2) = 1`.
name: ZMod.euler_criterion_units
statement_text: (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (x : (ZMod p)ˣ) : (∃ y, y ^ 2 = x) ↔ x ^ (p / 2) = 1

docstring:
An antitone function is continuous to the right at a point if and only if its right
limit coincides with the value of the function.
name: Antitone.continuousWithinAt_Ioi_iff_rightLim_eq
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f) {x : α} [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] : ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Ioi x) x ↔ Function.rightLim f x = f x

docstring:
Two vectors `x y` in a real normed space are on the ray if and only if one of them is zero or
the unit vectors `‖x‖⁻¹ • x` and `‖y‖⁻¹ • y` are equal.
name: sameRay_iff_inv_norm_smul_eq
statement_text: {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {x : F} {y : F} : SameRay ℝ x y ↔ x = 0 ∨ y = 0 ∨ ‖x‖⁻¹ • x = ‖y‖⁻¹ • y

docstring: If two functions agree in a neighborhood of `x`, then one is harmonic at `x` iff so is the other.
name: InnerProductSpace.harmonicAt_congr_nhds
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f₁ : E → F} {f₂ : E → F} {x : E} (h : f₁ =ᶠ[nhds x] f₂) : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicAt f₁ x ↔ InnerProductSpace.HarmonicAt f₂ x

docstring:
`p` is in the image of `Spec S → Spec R` if and only if `p` extended to `S` and
restricted back to `R` is `p`.
name: PrimeSpectrum.mem_range_comap_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) {p : PrimeSpectrum R} : p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap f) ↔ Ideal.comap f (Ideal.map f p.asIdeal) = p.asIdeal

docstring:
A point lies in the interior of a 1-simplex if and only if it lies strictly between its
vertices.
name: Affine.Simplex.mem_interior_iff_sbtw
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_4} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module R V] [AddTorsor V P] [IsOrderedRing R] [IsDomain R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R V] {s : Affine.Simplex R P 1} {p : P} : p ∈ s.interior ↔ Sbtw R (s.points 0) p (s.points 1)

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c`, the point `(c, f c)` is non-strictly above the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a b ≤ slope f a c`.
name: lineMap_le_map_iff_slope_le_slope_left
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < r * (b - a)) : (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ≤ f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ↔ slope f a b ≤ slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r)

docstring: The `weightedTotalDegree'` of a polynomial `p` is `⊥` if and only if `p = 0`.
name: MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree'_eq_bot_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid M] [SemilatticeSup M] (w : σ → M) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree' w p = ⊥ ↔ p = 0

docstring:
A subgroup of an additive commutative group is maximal (a coatom in the subgroup
lattice) iff the quotient by it is simple. Additive group analogue of
`isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom`.
name: AddCommGroup.isSimpleAddGroup_iff_isCoatom
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup G] {M : AddSubgroup G} : IsSimpleAddGroup.{u_1} (G ⧸ M) ↔ IsCoatom M

docstring: The L-series of the Möbius function converges absolutely at `s` if and only if `re s > 1`.
name: ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_moebius_iff
statement_text: {s : ℂ} : LSeriesSummable (fun n => ↑(ArithmeticFunction.moebius n)) s ↔ 1 < s.re

docstring:
For `D ≡ 0, 1 mod 4`, a quadratic algebra over `ℤ` is isomorphic to the canonical
representative `QuadraticAlgebra ℤ (D / 4) (D % 4)` iff its discriminant is `D`.
name: QuadraticAlgebra.nonempty_algEquiv_int_iff_discr_eq
statement_text: {a : ℤ} {b : ℤ} {D : ℤ} (hD : D % 4 = 0 ∨ D % 4 = 1) : Nonempty (QuadraticAlgebra ℤ a b ≃ₐ[ℤ] QuadraticAlgebra ℤ (D / 4) (D % 4)) ↔ QuadraticAlgebra.discr a b = D

docstring: In a field `F`, `X ^ n - 1` is separable iff `↑n ≠ 0`.
name: Polynomial.X_pow_sub_one_separable_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} [Field F] {n : ℕ} : (HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial F) Polynomial.X n - 1).Separable ↔ ↑n ≠ 0

docstring:
A (positive) natural number `n` is a sum of two squares if and only if the exponent of
every prime `q` such that `q % 4 = 3` in the prime factorization of `n` is even.
name: Nat.eq_sq_add_sq_iff
statement_text: {n : ℕ} : (∃ x y, n = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ↔ ∀ q ∈ n.primeFactors, q % 4 = 3 → Even (padicValNat q n)

docstring:
The prime spectrum of a commutative semiring has discrete Zariski topology iff it is finite and
the semiring has Krull dimension zero or is trivial.
name: PrimeSpectrum.discreteTopology_iff_finite_and_krullDimLE_zero
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] : DiscreteTopology.{u} (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ Finite.{u + 1} (PrimeSpectrum R) ∧ Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R

docstring:
Simple graphs contain a copy of a `completeEquipartiteGraph (r + 1) t` iff there exists
`s : Finset V` of size `#s = t` and `K : G.CompleteEquipartiteSubgraph r t` such that the
vertices in `s` are adjacent to the vertices in `K`.
name: SimpleGraph.completeEquipartiteGraph_succ_isContained_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r : ℕ} {t : ℕ} : SimpleGraph.IsContained (W := Fin (r + 1) × Fin t) (SimpleGraph.completeEquipartiteGraph (r + 1) t) G ↔ ∃ K s, s.card = t ∧ ∀ p ∈ K.parts, G.IsCompleteBetween ↑p ↑s

docstring:
`Real.exp (f x)` is bounded away from zero along a filter if and only if this filter is bounded
from below under `f`.
name: Real.isBigO_one_exp_comp
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {l : Filter α} {f : α → ℝ} : (Asymptotics.IsBigO (E := ℝ) (F := ℝ) l (fun x => 1) fun x => Real.exp (f x)) ↔ Filter.IsBoundedUnder (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≥ x2) l f

docstring:
The defining property of the weak operator topology: a function `f` tends to
`A : E →WOT[𝕜] F` along filter `l` iff `y (f a x)` tends to `y (A x)` along the same filter.
name: ContinuousLinearMapWOT.tendsto_iff_forall_dual_apply_tendsto
statement_text: {𝕜₁ : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} [NormedField 𝕜₁] [NormedField 𝕜₂] {σ : 𝕜₁ →+* 𝕜₂} {E : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup E] [TopologicalSpace E] [_root_.Module 𝕜₁ E] [AddCommGroup F] [TopologicalSpace F] [_root_.Module 𝕜₂ F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [ContinuousConstSMul 𝕜₂ F] {α : Type u_5} {l : Filter α} {f : α → E →SWOT[σ] F} {A : E →SWOT[σ] F} : Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds A) ↔ ∀ (x : E) (y : StrongDual 𝕜₂ F), Filter.Tendsto.{u_5, u_2} (β := 𝕜₂) (fun (a : α) => (y ((f a) x : F) : 𝕜₂)) l (nhds (y (A x : F)) : Filter 𝕜₂)

docstring:
A correspondence `f : α → Set β` has open lower sections if and only if its *upper inverse*
(i.e., `b : β ↦ f ⁻¹' (Iic {b}ᶜ) = {x | b ∉ f x}`) sends every point to a closed set.
name: hasOpenLowerSections_iff_isClosed_preimage_Iic
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] {f : α → Set β} : HasOpenLowerSections f ↔ ∀ (b : β), IsClosed (f ⁻¹' Set.Iic {b}ᶜ)

docstring: A block of a group action is invariant iff it is fixed.
name: MulAction.isInvariantBlock_iff_isFixedBlock
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {X : Type u_2} [MulAction G X] {B : Set X} : MulAction.IsInvariantBlock G B ↔ MulAction.IsFixedBlock G B

docstring:
A countably generated structure is ultrahomogeneous if and only if any equivalence between
finitely generated substructures can be extended to any element in the domain.
name: FirstOrder.Language.isUltrahomogeneous_iff_IsExtensionPair
statement_text: {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (M_CG : FirstOrder.Language.Structure.CG L M) : L.IsUltrahomogeneous M ↔ L.IsExtensionPair M M

docstring: A continuous linear map is a star projection iff it is idempotent and normal.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isStarProjection_iff_isIdempotentElem_and_isStarNormal
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {T : E →L[𝕜] E} [CompleteSpace E] : IsStarProjection T ↔ IsIdempotentElem T ∧ IsStarNormal T

docstring:
Let `L / K` be a field extension. If `x` is a separable element over `K` and the minimal polynomial
of `x` splits in `L`, then `x` is not in `K` if and only if there exists a conjugate
root of `x` over `K` in `L` which is not equal to `x` itself.
name: notMem_iff_exists_ne_and_isConjRoot
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] {x : L} (h : IsSeparable K x) (sp : Polynomial.Splits (Polynomial.map (algebraMap K L) (minpoly K x))) : x ∉ ⊥ ↔ ∃ y, x ≠ y ∧ IsConjRoot K x y

docstring: An oriented angle is not zero and `π` if and only if the three points are not collinear.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_ne_zero_and_ne_pi_iff_not_collinear
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ 0 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ↑Real.pi ↔ ¬Collinear ℝ (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃}

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `[a, +∞)` if and only if it contains an interval `[a, u)`
with `a < u < u'`, provided `a` is not a top element.
name: mem_nhdsGE_iff_exists_Ico_subset'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] {a : α} {u' : α} {s : Set α} (hu' : a < u') : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ici a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Ioi a, Set.Ico a u ⊆ s

docstring:
An additive group homomorphism is strict if and only if its `rangeRestrict` is an
open quotient map.
name: AddMonoidHom.isStrictMap_iff_isOpenQuotientMap_rangeRestrict
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddGroup H] {f : G →+ H} [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := H) ⇑f ↔ IsOpenQuotientMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := ↥f.range) ⇑f.rangeRestrict

docstring:
An `AddMonoid A` is `α`-divisible iff `n • x = a` has a solution for all `n ≠ 0 ∈ α` and `a ∈ A`.
Here we adopt a constructive approach where we ask an explicit `div : A → α → A` function such that
* `div a 0 = 0` for all `a ∈ A`
* `n • div a n = a` for all `n ≠ 0 ∈ α` and `a ∈ A`.
name: DivisibleBy
statement_text: (A : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [AddMonoid A] [SMul α A] [Zero α] : Type (max u_1 u_2)

docstring:
A `Monoid A` is `α`-rootable iff the `pow _ n` function is surjective, i.e. the constructive version
implies the textbook approach.
name: rootableByOfPowLeftSurj
statement_text: (A : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [Monoid A] [Pow A α] [Zero α] (H : ∀ {n : α}, n ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (β := A) fun (a : A) => a ^ n) : RootableBy A α

docstring: The multiples of a number `a` are dense on a circle of length `p` iff `a / p` is irrational.
name: AddCircle.denseRange_zsmul_coe_iff
statement_text: {a : ℝ} {p : ℝ} : (DenseRange (X := HasQuotient.Quotient ℝ (B := AddSubgroup ℝ) (AddSubgroup.zmultiples p)) fun (x : ℤ) => HSMul.hSMul (β := HasQuotient.Quotient ℝ (B := AddSubgroup ℝ) (AddSubgroup.zmultiples p)) x ↑a) ↔ Irrational (a / p)

docstring: On pseudometric spaces, a map is an isometry if and only if it preserves distances.
name: isometry_iff_dist_eq
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PseudoMetricSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β] {f : α → β} : Isometry f ↔ ∀ (x y : α), dist (f x) (f y) = dist x y

docstring: `f □ g` lifts against `X ⟶ ⋆` if and only if `g` lifts against `B ⟹ X ⟶ A ⟹ X`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_mk_isTerminal_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] {A : C} {B : C} {K : C} {L : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {f : A ⟶ B} {g : K ⟶ L} (t : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v, u} Y) : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk f)).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk g)).hom (t.from X) ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty (X := B ⟹ X) (Y := A ⟹ X) g (CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app (CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.pre f) X)

docstring:
The oriented angle between two vectors is zero if and only if the angle with the vectors
swapped is zero.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_zero_iff_oangle_rev_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y = 0 ↔ o.oangle y x = 0

docstring: A ring is algebraic over the ring `A` iff it is algebraic over the field of fractions of `A`.
name: IsFractionRing.comap_isAlgebraic_iff
statement_text: {A : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} {C : Type u_5} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Algebra K C] [IsScalarTower A K C] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic A C ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic K C

docstring: Two elements are equal iff their coordinates are equal.
name: Module.Basis.ext_elem_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {x : M} {y : M} : x = y ↔ ∀ (i : ι), Eq.{u_8 + 1} (α := R) ((b.repr x : ι →₀ R) i : R) ((b.repr y : ι →₀ R) i : R)

docstring:
If `C` is a small finitely cocomplete category and `A : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u` is a presheaf, then
`CostructuredArrow yoneda A` is filtered if and only if `A` preserves finite limits.

Proposition 3.3.13 of [Kashiwara2006].
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isFiltered_costructuredArrow_yoneda_iff_nonempty_preservesFiniteLimits
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.SmallCategory C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteColimits C] (A : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type u)) : CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.{u, u} (CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow CategoryTheory.yoneda A) ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits A

docstring:
An additive subgroup `H` has index two if and only if there exists `a ∉ H` such
that for all `b`, one of `b + a` and `b` belongs to `H`.
name: AddSubgroup.index_eq_two_iff_exists_notMem_and
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} : H.index = 2 ↔ ∃ a ∉ H, ∀ (b : G), b + a ∈ H ∨ b ∈ H

docstring: A module is Noetherian iff every increasing chain of submodules stabilizes.
name: monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] : (∀ (f : ℕ →o Submodule R M), ∃ n, ∀ (m : ℕ), n ≤ m → Eq (α := Submodule R M) (f n : Submodule R M) (f m : Submodule R M)) ↔ IsNoetherian R M

docstring:
A cocone `t` of `K : J ⥤ Under X` is a colimit if and only if the corresponding cocone
`coconeLift t` of `liftFromUnder.obj K : WithInitial K ⥤ C` is a colimit.
name: CategoryTheory.WithInitial.isColimitEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {J : Type w} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w', w} J] {X : C} {K : CategoryTheory.Functor J (CategoryTheory.Under.{v₁, u₁} X)} {t : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone K} : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Equivalence.functor CategoryTheory.WithInitial.coconeEquiv) t) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit t

docstring:
An operator is positive iff it is symmetric and `0 ≤ ⟪T x, x⟫`.

For the version with `IsSelfAdjoint` instead of `IsSymmetric`, see
`ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff'`.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (T : E →L[𝕜] E) : T.IsPositive ↔ LinearMap.IsSymmetric.{u_1, u_2} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) ↑T ∧ ∀ (x : E), 0 ≤ inner 𝕜 (T x) x

docstring: An unbounded operator is closable iff the closure of its graph is a graph.
name: LinearPMap.IsClosable
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module R E] [_root_.Module R F] [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace F] [ContinuousAdd E] [ContinuousAdd F] [TopologicalSpace R] [ContinuousSMul R E] [ContinuousSMul R F] (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) : Prop

docstring: A face is a subset of another one iff its vertices are.
name: Geometry.SimplicialComplex.face_subset_face_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Ring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] {K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex 𝕜 E} {s : Finset E} {t : Finset E} (hs : s ∈ K.faces) (ht : t ∈ K.faces) : ((convexHull 𝕜) ↑s : Set E) ⊆ ((convexHull 𝕜) ↑t : Set E) ↔ s ⊆ t

docstring:
A pullback cone `c` in the category of types is limit iff the
map `c.toPullbackObj : c.pt → Types.PullbackObj f g` is a bijection.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.isLimitEquivBijective
statement_text: {X : Type v} {Y : Type v} {S : Type v} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : Y ⟶ S} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone f g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ Function.Bijective c.toPullbackObj

docstring: **Vieta's formula** for quadratics as an iff (`Field` version).
name: Polynomial.roots_quadratic_eq_pair_iff_of_ne_zero'
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {a : R} {b : R} {c : R} {x1 : R} {x2 : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) : (HAdd.hAdd (β := Polynomial R) (HMul.hMul (α := Polynomial R) (Polynomial.C a : Polynomial R) (HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial R) Polynomial.X 2) + HMul.hMul (α := Polynomial R) (β := Polynomial R) (Polynomial.C b : Polynomial R) Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.C c : Polynomial R)).roots = {x1, x2} ↔ x1 + x2 = -b / a ∧ x1 * x2 = c / a

docstring:
A functor `F : J ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u}` has a limit iff `(F ⋙ forget CommGrpCat).sections` is
`u`-small.
name: CommGrpCat.hasLimit_iff_small_sections
statement_text: {J : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{w, u, v, u + 1} J CommGrpCat) : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimit F ↔ Small.{u, max u v} ↑(F.comp (CategoryTheory.forget CommGrpCat (FC := fun x1 x2 => ↑x1 →* ↑x2) (CC := CommGrpCat.carrier))).sections

docstring: If `a` is even, then `n` is odd iff `n % a` is odd.
name: Odd.mod_even_iff
statement_text: {n : ℕ} {a : ℕ} (ha : Even a) : Odd (n % a) ↔ Odd n

docstring: The distance to a point's orthogonal projection is 0 iff it lies in the subspace.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_orthogonalProjection_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace 𝕜 P} [Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} ↥s] [s.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] {p : P} : dist p ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s) p) = 0 ↔ p ∈ s

docstring:
A product of spaces is locally path-connected iff it is empty, or every factor is locally
path-connected and all but finitely many factors are path-connected.
name: Pi.locallyPathConnectedSpace_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_3} {Z : ι → Type u_4} [(i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (Z i)] : LocallyPathConnectedSpace ((i : ι) → Z i) ↔ IsEmpty ((i : ι) → Z i) ∨ (∀ (i : ι), LocallyPathConnectedSpace.{u_4} (Z i)) ∧ Set.Finite.{u_3} (α := ι) {i | ¬PathConnectedSpace.{u_4} (Z i)}

docstring:
If two linear maps `u, v : E → F` differ by a finite rank linear map (recall that this is
denoted `u.toLinearMap ≈ v.toLinearMap` in scope `LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid`), then `u` is
strict with closed range if and only if `v` is strict with closed range.

This is [N. Bourbaki, *Théories Spectrales*, Chapitre III, § 3, n° 1, Cor. 1][bourbaki2023].
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isStrictMap_isClosed_range_iff_of_finiteRangeSetoid
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace E] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 F] [T2Space F] (u : E →L[𝕜] F) (v : E →L[𝕜] F) (h_equiv : ↑u ≈ ↑v) : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := E) (Y := F) ⇑u ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑u).range ↔ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := E) (Y := F) ⇑v ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑v).range

docstring:
The order of a formal power series is at least `n` if and only if its coefficients below `n`
vanish.
name: PowerSeries.nat_le_order_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {φ : PowerSeries R} {n : ℕ} : ↑n ≤ φ.order ↔ ∀ i < n, (PowerSeries.coeff i) φ = 0

docstring:
A point is exposed with respect to `A` iff there exists a hyperplane whose intersection with
`A` is exactly that point.
name: Set.exposedPoints
statement_text: (𝕜 : Type u_1) {E : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace 𝕜] [Ring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [TopologicalSpace E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] (A : Set E) : Set E

docstring:
A nontrivial monoid has prime exponent `p` if and only if every non-identity element has
order `p`.
name: Monoid.exponent_eq_prime_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Monoid G] [Nontrivial G] {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) : Monoid.exponent G = p ↔ ∀ (g : G), g ≠ 1 → orderOf g = p

docstring: The restrictions of `x` and `y` to `n` are equal if and only if `x m = y m` for all `m < n`.
name: PiNat.res_eq_res
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} {x : ℕ → α} {y : ℕ → α} {n : ℕ} : PiNat.res x n = PiNat.res y n ↔ ∀ ⦃m : ℕ⦄, m < n → x m = y m

docstring:
If `p` and `q` are distinct primes that are both congruent to `3` mod `4`, then `q` is
a square mod `p` iff `p` is a nonsquare mod `q`.
name: ZMod.exists_sq_eq_prime_iff_of_mod_four_eq_three
statement_text: {p : ℕ} {q : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [Fact (Nat.Prime q)] (hp3 : p % 4 = 3) (hq3 : q % 4 = 3) (hpq : p ≠ q) : IsSquare (α := ZMod p) ↑q ↔ ¬IsSquare (α := ZMod q) ↑p

docstring: Two linear maps are equal on `Submodule.span s` iff they are equal on `s`.
name: LinearMap.eqOn_span_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {R₂ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {M₂ : Type u_5} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Semiring R₂] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [_root_.Module R₂ M₂] {σ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} {s : Set M} {f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂} {g : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂} : Set.EqOn.{u_4, u_5} (β := M₂) ⇑f ⇑g ↑(Submodule.span R s) ↔ Set.EqOn.{u_4, u_5} (β := M₂) (⇑f) (⇑g) s

docstring: Complement of a set belongs to `coclosedCompact` if and only if its closure is compact.
name: Filter.compl_mem_coclosedCompact
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : sᶜ ∈ Filter.coclosedCompact X ↔ IsCompact (closure s)

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise scalar multiplication of `f` and
`g`, which antivary together on `s`, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ`
antivary together on `s`. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: AntivaryOn.sum_smul_comp_perm_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddCommMonoid β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β} (hfg : AntivaryOn f g ↑s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := β) (∑ i ∈ s, f i • g (σ i)) (∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i) ↔ AntivaryOn f (g ∘ ⇑σ) ↑s

docstring:
Two linear maps `S` and `T` are equal, if and only if the identity `⟪S x, x⟫_ℂ = ⟪T x, x⟫_ℂ` holds
for all `x`.
name: ext_inner_map
statement_text: {V : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ V] (S : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) : (∀ (x : V), inner ℂ (S x) x = inner ℂ (T x) x) ↔ S = T

docstring: For a nonempty set, the affine span is `⊤` iff its vector span is `⊤`.
name: AffineSubspace.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_vectorSpan_eq_top_of_nonempty
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) (P : Type u_3) [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} (hs : s.Nonempty) : Eq (α := AffineSubspace k P) (affineSpan k s) ⊤ ↔ Eq (α := Submodule k V) (vectorSpan k s) ⊤

docstring:
A monoid if finitely generated if and only if there exists a surjective homomorphism from a
`FreeMonoid` on an arbitrary finite type `α` to the monoid.
name: Monoid.fg_iff_exists_freeGroup_hom_surjective_finite
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Monoid M] : Monoid.FG M ↔ ∃ α, ∃ (_ : Finite α), ∃ φ, Function.Surjective (α := FreeMonoid α) (β := M) ⇑φ

docstring: Given that the top square is a pushout, the pasted square is a pushout iff the bottom square is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.pasteVertIsPushoutEquiv

docstring:
A preadditive category `C` with an additive shift, and a class of "distinguished triangles"
relative to that shift is called pretriangulated if the following hold:
* Any triangle that is isomorphic to a distinguished triangle is also distinguished.
* Any triangle of the form `(X,X,0,id,0,0)` is distinguished.
* For any morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` there exists a distinguished triangle of the form `(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)`.
* The triangle `(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)` is distinguished if and only if `(Y,Z,X⟦1⟧,g,h,-f⟦1⟧)` is.
* Given a diagram:
  ```
        f       g       h
    X  ───> Y  ───> Z  ───> X⟦1⟧
    │       │                │
    │a      │b               │a⟦1⟧'
    V       V                V
    X' ───> Y' ───> Z' ───> X'⟦1⟧
        f'      g'      h'
  ```
  where the left square commutes, and whose rows are distinguished triangles,
  there exists a morphism `c : Z ⟶ Z'` such that `(a,b,c)` is a triangle morphism.
name: CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated
statement_text: (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.HasShift.{v, u, 0} C ℤ] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v, u} C] [∀ (n : ℤ), CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive.{v, u, v, u} (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor C n)] : Type (max u v)

docstring:
`mulForbidden F` is the set of configurations that avoid every pattern in `F`.

Formally: `x ∈ mulForbidden F` if and only if for every pattern `p ∈ F` and every
monoid element `g : G`, the pattern `p` does not occur in `x` at position `g`.

Intuitively, `mulForbidden F` is the shift space defined by declaring the finite set
(or family) of patterns `F` to be *forbidden*. A configuration belongs to the subshift if and only
it avoids all the forbidden patterns.
name: SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.mulForbidden
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [Inhabited A] [Monoid G] (F : Set (SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.Pattern A G)) : Set (G → A)

statement_text: {X : Type u} : ∀ {inst : TopologicalSpace X} {C : Set X} [self : Topology.CWComplex C], ∀ A ⊆ C, (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : @Topology.CWComplex.cell _ inst C _ n), IsClosed (A ∩ ↑(Topology.CWComplex.map n j) '' Metric.closedBall 0 1)) → IsClosed A

docstring: If two functions agree on a punctured neighborhood, then one is meromorphic iff the other is so.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicAt_congr
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (h : f =ᶠ[nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ] g) : MeromorphicAt f x ↔ MeromorphicAt g x

docstring:
For an adjoint triple `F ⊣ G ⊣ H` where `G` is fully faithful, the natural transformation
`H ⟶ F` is epic at `X` iff the image of the unit of the adjunction `F ⊣ G` under `H` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple.epi_rightToLeft_app_iff_epi_map_adj₁_unit_app
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {H : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} (t : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple F G H) [G.Full] [G.Faithful] {X : C} : CategoryTheory.Epi (t.rightToLeft.app X) ↔ CategoryTheory.Epi (H.map (t.adj₁.unit.app X))

docstring: A p-group is simple iff it has cardinality `p`.
name: IsPGroup.isSimpleGroup_iff_card_eq
statement_text: {p : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [Group G] (hG : IsPGroup p G) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [Finite G] : IsSimpleGroup G ↔ Nat.card G = p

docstring:
In an Archimedean linearly ordered group (with the order topology), a subgroup is
discrete iff it is cyclic.
name: Subgroup.isCyclic_iff_discreteTopology
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [CommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] [TopologicalSpace G] [OrderTopology G] [MulArchimedean G] {H : Subgroup G} : IsCyclic.{u_1} ↥H ↔ DiscreteTopology.{u_1} ↥H

docstring:
The oriented angle between two vectors is zero or `π` if and only if those two vectors are
not linearly independent.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_zero_or_eq_pi_iff_not_linearIndependent
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y = 0 ∨ o.oangle x y = ↑Real.pi ↔ ¬LinearIndependent ℝ ![x, y]

docstring:
If two left extensions `E` and `E'` are isomorphic, `E` is a pointwise
left Kan extension at `Y` iff `E'` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.LeftExtension.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionAtEquivOfIso
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} {H : Type u_4} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_4, u_4} H] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_4, u_1, u_4} C H} {E : L.LeftExtension F} {E' : L.LeftExtension F} (e : E ≅ E') (Y : D) : E.IsPointwiseLeftKanExtensionAt Y ≃ E'.IsPointwiseLeftKanExtensionAt Y

docstring:
`p` is a Taylor series of `f` up to `n+1` if and only if `p.shift` is a Taylor series up to `n`
for `p 1`, which is a derivative of `f`. Version for `n : ℕ`.
name: hasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn_succ_nat_iff_right
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} {n : ℕ} : HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn (↑(n + 1)) f p s ↔ (∀ x ∈ s, (p x 0).curry0 = f x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivWithinAt (fun y => p y 0) ((p x 1).curryLeft (Ei := fun _i => E)) s x) ∧ HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn (𝕜 := 𝕜) (F := E →L[𝕜] F) (↑n) (fun x => (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 𝕜 E F) (p x 1)) (fun x => (p x).shift) s

docstring:
A family `v : α → V` is generating `V` iff every element `(x : V)`
can be written as sum `∑ cᵢ • vᵢ = x`.
name: Submodule.top_le_span_range_iff_forall_exists_fun
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_3) [Fintype α] [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {v : α → M} : LE.le (α := Submodule R M) ⊤ (Submodule.span R (Set.range v)) ↔ ∀ (x : M), ∃ c, ∑ i : α, c i • v i = x

docstring: Two vectors are equal if and only if they have equal norms and zero angle between them.
name: Orientation.eq_iff_norm_eq_and_oangle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) (x : V) (y : V) : x = y ↔ ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ ∧ o.oangle x y = 0

docstring:
For an adjoint quadruple `L ⊣ F ⊣ G ⊣ R` where `F` (and hence also `R`) is fully faithful and
its domain / codomain has all pushouts resp. pullbacks, the natural transformation `G ⟶ L` is an
epimorphism iff the natural transformation `F ⟶ R` is a monomorphism.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple.epi_leftTriple_rightToLeft_iff_mono_rightTriple_leftToRight
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} (q : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple L F G R) [F.Full] [F.Faithful] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v₂, u₂} D] : CategoryTheory.Epi q.leftTriple.rightToLeft ↔ CategoryTheory.Mono q.rightTriple.leftToRight

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `𝟙 M ⊗ f` is injective whenever `f` is an injective linear map
in a universe that `R` fits in.
name: Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMapₛ
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Small.{v', u} R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' : Type v'⦄ [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_5 : AddCommMonoid N'] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), Function.Injective (α := N) (β := N') ⇑f → Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R M N) (β := TensorProduct R M N') ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f)

docstring:
Given a collinear set of points, and two distinct points `p₂` and `p₃` in it, a point `p₁` is
collinear with the set if and only if it is collinear with `p₂` and `p₃`.
name: Collinear.collinear_insert_iff_of_ne
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} (h : Collinear k s) {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ s) (hp₃ : p₃ ∈ s) (hp₂p₃ : p₂ ≠ p₃) : Collinear k (insert p₁ s) ↔ Collinear k (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃}

docstring:
A family is affinely independent if and only if the differences
from a base point in that family are linearly independent.
name: affineIndependent_iff_linearIndependent_vsub
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} (p : ι → P) (i1 : ι) : AffineIndependent k p ↔ LinearIndependent.{u_4, u_1, u_2} k (M := V) fun (i : { x : ι // x ≠ i1 }) => p ↑i -ᵥ p i1

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which antivary together on `s`, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ`
antivary together on `s`. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: AntivaryOn.sum_mul_eq_sum_mul_comp_perm_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} (hfg : AntivaryOn f g ↑s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g (σ i)) (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ↔ AntivaryOn f (g ∘ ⇑σ) ↑s

docstring:
A function is analytic at a point iff it is analytic after scalar
multiplication with a non-vanishing analytic function.
name: analyticAt_iff_analytic_fun_smul
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {𝕝 : Type u_8} [NormedDivisionRing 𝕝] [NormedAlgebra 𝕜 𝕝] [_root_.Module 𝕝 F] [IsBoundedSMul 𝕝 F] [IsScalarTower 𝕜 𝕝 F] {f : E → 𝕝} {g : E → F} {z : E} (h₁f : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z) (h₂f : f z ≠ 0) : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z ↔ AnalyticAt.{u_2, u_3, u_4} 𝕜 (F := F) (fun z => f z • g z) z

docstring: Two closed sets are at zero Hausdorff edistance if and only if they coincide.
name: IsClosed.hausdorffEDist_zero_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] {s : Set α} {t : Set α} (hs : IsClosed s) (ht : IsClosed t) : Metric.hausdorffEDist s t = 0 ↔ s = t

docstring: `x` is an extreme point to `A` iff `{x}` is an extreme set of `A`.
name: isExtreme_singleton
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [SMul 𝕜 E] {A : Set E} {x : E} : IsExtreme 𝕜 A {x} ↔ x ∈ Set.extremePoints 𝕜 A

docstring:
**British flag theorem**, if-and-only-if form: for a parallelogram `a b c d` and any point
`p`, the British flag identity holds if and only if the angle at `a` is a right angle.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {a : P} {b : P} {c : P} {d : P} (h : midpoint ℝ a c = midpoint ℝ b d) (p : P) : dist p a ^ 2 + dist p c ^ 2 = dist p b ^ 2 + dist p d ^ 2 ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle b a d = Real.pi / 2

docstring:
A fork is a limit cone in `Cᵒᵖ` if and only if the corresponding cofork in `C` is
a colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitEquivIsColimitUnop
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : Cᵒᵖ} {Y : Cᵒᵖ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.{v₁, u₁} (C := Cᵒᵖ) (X := X) (Y := Y) f g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c.unop

docstring: Given a linear map `f : N → P`, `f ⊗ M` is surjective if and only if `M ⊗ f` is surjective.
name: LinearMap.lTensor_surj_iff_rTensor_surj
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (M : Type u_4) {N : Type u_5} {P : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R N] [_root_.Module R P] (f : N →ₗ[R] P) : Function.Surjective (α := TensorProduct R M N) (β := TensorProduct R M P) ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f) ↔ Function.Surjective (α := TensorProduct R N M) (β := TensorProduct R P M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f)

docstring:
An element `x` is transcendental over `R` if and only if the kernel of the ring homomorphism
`Polynomial.aeval x` is the zero ideal. This is similar to `algebraicIndependent_iff_ker_eq_bot`.
name: transcendental_iff_ker_eq_bot
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {x : A} : Transcendental R x ↔ Eq (α := Ideal (Polynomial R)) (RingHom.ker (F := Polynomial R →ₐ[R] A) (Polynomial.aeval x)) ⊥

docstring:
`F(S) / F` is a separable extension if and only if all elements of `S` are
separable elements.
name: IntermediateField.isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {S : Set E} : Algebra.IsSeparable.{u, v} F ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin F S) ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, IsSeparable F x

docstring:
The product of a finite number of elements in the commutative semiring `R` lies in the
prime ideal `p` if and only if at least one of those elements is in `p`.
name: Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} {ι : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {s : Finset ι} {x : ι → R} {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] : ∏ i ∈ s, x i ∈ p ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, x i ∈ p

docstring:
If `E / F` is a field extension and `E` is algebraically closed, then the algebraic closure
of `F` in `E` is equal to `F` if and only if `F` is algebraically closed.
name: IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [IsAlgClosed E] : Eq (α := IntermediateField F E) (algebraicClosure F E) ⊥ ↔ IsAlgClosed F

docstring:
Let `u : E → F` be a continuous linear map, and `A` a closed subspace of `E` of finite
codimension. Then `u` is strict with closed range if and only if its restriction
`u.domRestrict A : A → F` is strict with closed range.

This is [N. Bourbaki, *Théories Spectrales*, Chapitre III, § 3, n° 1, Prop. 1][bourbaki2023].
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isStrictMap_isClosed_range_iff_restrict
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace E] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 F] (u : E →L[𝕜] F) (A : Submodule 𝕜 E) (A_closed : IsClosed ↑A) [A.CoFG] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := E) (Y := F) ⇑u ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑u).range ↔ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := ↥A) (Y := F) ⇑(u.domRestrict A) ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑(u.domRestrict A)).range

docstring: The power of a point is positive if and only if the point lies outside the sphere.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.power_pos_iff_radius_lt_dist_center
statement_text: {P : Type u_2} [MetricSpace P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p : P} (hr : 0 ≤ s.radius) : 0 < s.power p ↔ s.radius < dist p s.center

docstring:
If a discrete group acts on a T2 space `X` such that `X × X` is compactly
coherent, and if the action is continuous in the second variable, then the action is properly
discontinuous if and only if it is proper. This is in particular true if `X` is first-countable or
weakly locally compact.
name: properlyDiscontinuousSMul_iff_properSMul
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MulAction G X] [CompactlyCoherentSpace.{u_2} (X × X)] [T2Space X] [DiscreteTopology G] [ContinuousConstSMul G X] : ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul G X ↔ ProperSMul G X

docstring:
The angle between two nonzero vectors is `θ` if and only if the second vector is the first
rotated by `θ` and scaled by the ratio of the norms.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_iff_eq_norm_div_norm_smul_rotation_of_ne_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (θ : Real.Angle) : o.oangle x y = θ ↔ y = HSMul.hSMul (β := V) (‖y‖ / ‖x‖) ((o.rotation θ) x : V)

docstring: A functor has a limit iff there exists a glb.
name: Preorder.hasLimit_iff_hasGLB
statement_text: {C : Type u} [Preorder C] {J : Type u'} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u'} J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, u, u', u} J C) : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimit F ↔ ∃ x, IsGLB (Set.range F.obj) x

docstring:
Congruence holds if and only if all extended distances between points with different
indices are the same.
name: congruent_iff_pairwise_edist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoEMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoEMetricSpace P₂] : Congruent v₁ v₂ ↔ Pairwise fun (i₁ : ι) i₂ => edist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = edist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
Congruence holds if and only if all non-negative distances between points with different
indices are the same.
name: congruent_iff_pairwise_dist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Congruent v₁ v₂ ↔ Pairwise fun (i₁ : ι) i₂ => dist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = dist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → β → α` is uniformly equicontinuous iff the function `swap 𝓕 : β → ι → α` is
uniformly continuous *when `ι → α` is equipped with the uniform structure of uniform convergence*.
This is very useful for developing the equicontinuity API, but it should not be used directly
for other purposes.
name: uniformEquicontinuous_iff_uniformContinuous
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → β → α} : UniformEquicontinuous F ↔ UniformContinuous (β := UniformFun ι α) (⇑UniformFun.ofFun ∘ Function.swap (φ := fun a a_1 => α) F)

docstring:
An additive group homomorphism is strict if and only if its
`QuotientAddGroup.kerLift` is an embedding.
name: AddMonoidHom.isStrictMap_iff_isEmbedding_kerLift
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddGroup H] {f : G →+ H} [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := H) ⇑f ↔ Topology.IsEmbedding.{u_1, u_2} (X := G ⧸ f.ker) (Y := H) ⇑(QuotientAddGroup.kerLift f)

docstring:
The norm of the image of `m : M` in the quotient by `S` is zero if and only if `m` belongs
to the closure of `S`.
name: QuotientGroup.norm_mk_eq_zero_iff_mem_closure
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [SeminormedCommGroup M] {S : Subgroup M} {m : M} : norm (E := M ⧸ S) ↑m = 0 ↔ m ∈ closure ↑S

docstring:
A sequence of functions `Fₙ` converges uniformly to a limiting function `f` w.r.t.
filter `p` iff the function `(n, x) ↦ (f x, Fₙ x)` converges along `p ×ˢ ⊤` to the uniformity.
In other words: one knows nothing about the behavior of `x` in this limit.
name: tendstoUniformly_iff_tendsto
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_4} [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → α → β} {f : α → β} {p : Filter ι} : TendstoUniformly F f p ↔ Filter.Tendsto (fun q => (f q.2, F q.1 q.2)) (SProd.sprod (β := Filter α) p ⊤) (uniformity β)

docstring:
If `C` is filtered, then `F : C ⥤ D` is final if and only if `StructuredArrow d F` is filtered
for all `d : D`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.final_iff_isFiltered_structuredArrow
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) [CategoryTheory.IsFilteredOrEmpty.{v₁, u₁} C] : F.Final ↔ ∀ (d : D), CategoryTheory.IsFiltered (CategoryTheory.StructuredArrow d F)

docstring:
A set of points is collinear if and only if they can all be
expressed as multiples of the same vector, added to the same base
point.
name: collinear_iff_exists_forall_eq_smul_vadd
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (s : Set P) : Collinear k s ↔ ∃ p₀ v, ∀ p ∈ s, ∃ r, p = r • v +ᵥ p₀

docstring:
A natural number `n` is smaller than `FloorSemiring.floor a` iff its coercion to `α` is
smaller than `a`.
name: FloorSemiring.gc_floor
statement_text: {α : Type u_3} : ∀ {inst : Semiring α} {inst_1 : PartialOrder α} [self : FloorSemiring α] {a : α} {n : ℕ}, 0 ≤ a → (n ≤ @FloorSemiring.floor _ inst inst_1 _ a ↔ ↑n ≤ a)

docstring:
An additive group homomorphism is strict if and only if the canonical isomorphism
`G ⧸ f.ker ≃ f.range` is a homeomorphism.
name: AddMonoidHom.isStrictMap_iff_isHomeomorph_quotientKerEquivRange
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddGroup H] {f : G →+ H} [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := H) ⇑f ↔ IsHomeomorph.{u_1, u_2} (X := G ⧸ f.ker) (Y := ↥f.range) ⇑(QuotientAddGroup.quotientKerEquivRange f)

docstring: `a + b` is idempotent if and only if `a` and `b` anti-commute.
name: IsIdempotentElem.add_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] [IsCancelAdd R] {a : R} {b : R} (ha : IsIdempotentElem a) (hb : IsIdempotentElem b) : IsIdempotentElem (a + b) ↔ a * b + b * a = 0

docstring:
In a finite-rank free module over a stably finite semiring, linear maps are inverse to
each other on one side if and only if they are inverse to each other on the other side.
name: LinearMap.comp_eq_id_comm
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) (M : Type u_2) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [IsStablyFiniteRing R] {f : M →ₗ[R] M} {g : M →ₗ[R] M} : f ∘ₗ g = LinearMap.id ↔ g ∘ₗ f = LinearMap.id

docstring:
If `a` is a radical element, then `a` divides the radical of `b` if and only if it divides `b`.
Note the forward implication holds without the `b ≠ 0` assumption via `radical_dvd_self`.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_radical_iff
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [NormalizationMonoid M] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid M] {a : M} {b : M} (ha : IsRadical a) (hb₀ : b ≠ 0) : a ∣ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical b ↔ a ∣ b

docstring:
A map between emetric spaces is a uniform embedding if and only if the edistance between `f x`
and `f y` is controlled in terms of the distance between `x` and `y` and conversely.
name: EMetric.isUniformEmbedding_iff'
statement_text: {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} [EMetricSpace γ] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] {f : γ → β} : IsUniformEmbedding f ↔ (∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ {a b : γ}, edist a b < δ → edist (f a) (f b) < ε) ∧ ∀ δ > 0, ∃ ε > 0, ∀ {a b : γ}, edist (f a) (f b) < ε → edist a b < δ

docstring:
If the signs of two nondegenerate oriented angles between points are equal, the oriented
angles are equal if and only if the unoriented angles are equal.
name: EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_iff_oangle_eq_of_sign_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} {p₄ : P} {p₅ : P} {p₆ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ≠ p₂) (hp₃ : p₃ ≠ p₂) (hp₄ : p₄ ≠ p₅) (hp₆ : p₆ ≠ p₅) (hs : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃).sign = (EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₄ p₅ p₆).sign) : EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = EuclideanGeometry.angle p₄ p₅ p₆ ↔ EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₄ p₅ p₆

docstring:
**Equational criterion for vanishing**
[A. Altman and S. Kleiman, *A term of commutative algebra* (Lemma 8.16)][altman2021term],
generalization.

Assume that the submodule $M' \subseteq M$ generated by the $m_i$ satisfies the
property that the map $M' \otimes N \to M \otimes N$ is injective. Then the expression
$\sum_i m_i \otimes n_i$ vanishes trivially if and only if it vanishes.
name: TensorProduct.vanishesTrivially_iff_sum_tmul_eq_zero_of_rTensor_injective
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R N] {ι : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] {m : ι → M} {n : ι → N} (hm : Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct.{u_1, u_2, u_3} R (↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range m))) N) (β := TensorProduct R M N) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor N (Submodule.subtype (Submodule.span R (Set.range m))))) : TensorProduct.VanishesTrivially R m n ↔ ∑ i : ι, m i ⊗ₜ[R] n i = 0

docstring: An oriented angle has a sign zero if and only if the three points are collinear.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃).sign = 0 ↔ Collinear ℝ (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃}

docstring:
If `R →+* A` is injective, then `R` is of exponential characteristic `p` if and only if `A` is
also of exponential characteristic `p`. Similar to `RingHom.charZero_iff`.
name: RingHom.expChar_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [NonAssocSemiring R] [NonAssocSemiring A] (f : R →+* A) (H : Function.Injective.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} (α := R) (β := A) ⇑f) (p : ℕ) : ExpChar R p ↔ ExpChar A p

docstring: A polynomial has non-zero separable degree if and only if it is non-constant.
name: Polynomial.natSepDegree_ne_zero_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} [Field F] (f : Polynomial F) : f.natSepDegree ≠ 0 ↔ f.natDegree ≠ 0

docstring:
A measure on a countable space is sigma-finite iff it gives finite mass to every singleton.

See `measure_singleton_lt_top` for the forward direction without the countability assumption.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.sigmaFinite_iff_measure_singleton_lt_top
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [Countable α] : MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ ↔ ∀ (a : α), LT.lt (α := ENNReal) (μ {a} : ENNReal) (⊤ : ENNReal)

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(-∞, a]` if and only if it contains an interval
`(u, a]` with `u.< a`.
name: mem_nhdsLE_iff_exists_Ioc_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMinOrder α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Iic a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Iio a, Set.Ioc u a ⊆ s

docstring:
The tripartite-from-triangles graph. Two vertices are related iff there exists a triangle index
containing them both.
name: SimpleGraph.TripartiteFromTriangles.graph
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} (t : Finset (α × β × γ)) : SimpleGraph (α ⊕ β ⊕ γ)

docstring: Two group isomorphisms `G ≃* G'` are equal if and only if they agree on a generator of `G`.
name: MulEquiv.eq_iff_eq_on_generator
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} {G' : Type u_3} [Group G] [Group G'] {g : G} (hg : ∀ (x : G), Membership.mem (γ := Subgroup G) (Subgroup.zpowers g) x) (f₁ : G ≃* G') (f₂ : G ≃* G') : f₁ = f₂ ↔ Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := G') (f₁ g : G') (f₂ g : G')

docstring:
In a commutative monoid, an element `a` divides an element `b` iff all
left associates of `a` divide `b`.
name: Units.mul_left_dvd
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [CommMonoid α] {a : α} {b : α} {u : αˣ} : ↑u * a ∣ b ↔ a ∣ b

docstring:
An indexed set of vectors is linearly dependent iff there are two distinct
`Finsupp.LinearCombination`s of the vectors with the same value.
name: linearDepOn_iff'ₛ
statement_text: {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {s : Set ι} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] : ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∃ f g, Membership.mem (γ := Submodule R (ι →₀ R)) (Finsupp.supported R R s) f ∧ Membership.mem (γ := Submodule R (ι →₀ R)) (Finsupp.supported R R s) g ∧ Eq.{u_4 + 1} (α := M) ((Finsupp.linearCombination R v) f : M) ((Finsupp.linearCombination R v) g : M) ∧ f ≠ g

docstring: If `h : X → Y` is a homeomorphism, `h⁻¹(s)` is path-connected iff `s` is.
name: Homeomorph.isPathConnected_preimage
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set Y} (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : IsPathConnected.{u_1} (X := X) (⇑h ⁻¹' s) ↔ IsPathConnected s

docstring:
`Real.exp (f x)` is bounded away from zero along a filter if and only if this filter is bounded
from below under `f`.
name: Real.isBigO_exp_comp_one
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {l : Filter α} {f : α → ℝ} : (Asymptotics.IsBigO (E := ℝ) (F := ℝ) l (fun x => Real.exp (f x)) fun x => 1) ↔ Filter.IsBoundedUnder (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) l f

docstring:
A bicone over a pair is a colimit cocone if and only if the corresponding binary bicone is a
colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Bicone.toBinaryBiconeIsColimit
statement_text: {C : Type uC} [CategoryTheory.Category.{uC', uC} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{uC', uC} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (b : CategoryTheory.Limits.Bicone.{0, uC', uC} (CategoryTheory.Limits.pairFunction X Y)) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit b.toBinaryBicone.toCocone ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit b.toCocone

docstring:
`HasAffineProperty P Q` is a type class asserting that `P` is local at the target, and over affine
schemes, it is equivalent to `Q : AffineTargetMorphismProperty`.
To make the proofs easier, we state it instead as
1. `Q` is local at the target
2. `P f` if and only if `∀ U, Q (f ∣_ U)` ranging over all affine opens of the target of `f`.

See `HasAffineProperty.iff`.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.HasAffineProperty
statement_text: (P : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) (Q : outParam AlgebraicGeometry.AffineTargetMorphismProperty) : Prop

docstring: A submodule over a division ring is an atom of the submodule lattice iff it has `finrank` 1.
name: Submodule.isAtom_iff_finrank_eq_one
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {S : Submodule K V} : IsAtom S ↔ Module.finrank.{u, v} K ↥S = 1

docstring: On a finite-dimensional space, a linear map is injective if and only if it is surjective.
name: LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] {f : V →ₗ[K] V} : Function.Injective (α := V) (β := V) ⇑f ↔ Function.Surjective (α := V) (β := V) ⇑f

docstring: A semisimple endomorphism is triangularizable if and only if it is diagonalizable.
name: Module.End.IsSemisimple.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {f : Module.End R M} (hf : f.IsSemisimple) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := Submodule R M) (⨆ μ, f.maxGenEigenspace μ) ⊤ ↔ Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := Submodule R M) (⨆ μ, f.eigenspace μ) ⊤

docstring:
An equivalent definition for prime powers: `n` is a prime power iff there is a prime `p` and a
natural `k` such that `n` can be written as `p^(k+1)`.
name: isPrimePow_iff_pow_succ
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero R] (n : R) : IsPrimePow n ↔ ∃ p k, Prime p ∧ p ^ (k + 1) = n

docstring: A group element has finite additive order iff its order is positive.
name: addOrderOf_pos_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddMonoid G] {x : G} : 0 < addOrderOf x ↔ IsOfFinAddOrder x

docstring:
The main theorem of this file: Given a coverage `K` on `C`,
a `Type*`-valued presheaf on `C` is a sheaf for `K` if and only if it is a sheaf for
the associated Grothendieck topology.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.isSheaf_coverage
statement_text: {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_2} C] (K : CategoryTheory.Coverage.{v_1, u_2} C) (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, u_1, u_2, u_1 + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type u_1)) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf K.toGrothendieck P ↔ ∀ {X : C}, ∀ R ∈ K.coverings X, CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor P R

docstring: A prime power divides `n!` iff it is at most the sum of the quotients `n / p ^ i`.
name: Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_factorial_iff
statement_text: {p : ℕ} {n : ℕ} {r : ℕ} {b : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hbn : Nat.log p n < b) : p ^ r ∣ n.factorial ↔ r ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i

docstring:
Two compositions (possibly of different integers) coincide if and only if they have the
same sequence of blocks.
name: Composition.sigma_eq_iff_blocks_eq
statement_text: {c : (n : ℕ) × Composition n} {c' : (n : ℕ) × Composition n} : c = c' ↔ c.snd (β := fun n => Composition n).blocks = c'.snd (β := fun n => Composition n).blocks

docstring:
An additive subgroup has index dividing 2 if and only if there exists `a` such
that for all `b`, at least one of `a + b` and `b` belongs to `H`.
name: AddSubgroup.index_dvd_two_iff'
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} : H.index ∣ 2 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : G), a + b ∈ H ∨ b ∈ H

docstring:
The `LSeries` of `f` is zero for large real arguments if and only if either `f n = 0`
for all `n ≠ 0` or the L-series converges nowhere.
name: LSeries_eventually_eq_zero_iff'
statement_text: {f : ℕ → ℂ} : (fun x => LSeries f ↑x) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] 0 ↔ (∀ (n : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → f n = 0) ∨ LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f = ⊤

docstring: Given a linear map `f : N → P`, `f ⊗ M` is injective if and only if `M ⊗ f` is injective.
name: LinearMap.lTensor_inj_iff_rTensor_inj
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (M : Type u_4) {N : Type u_5} {P : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R N] [_root_.Module R P] (f : N →ₗ[R] P) : Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R M N) (β := TensorProduct R M P) ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f) ↔ Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R N M) (β := TensorProduct R P M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f)

docstring:
A point `x` is in the support of measure `μ` iff every neighborhood of `x` has positive
measure.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.mem_support_iff_forall
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} (x : X) : x ∈ μ.support ↔ ∀ U ∈ nhds x, 0 < μ U

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which monovary together on `s`, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ`
monovary together on `s`. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: MonovaryOn.sum_mul_comp_perm_eq_sum_mul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} (hfg : MonovaryOn f g ↑s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g (σ i)) (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ↔ MonovaryOn f (g ∘ ⇑σ) ↑s

docstring:
The minimal polynomial of an element `x` of `E / F` of exponential characteristic `q` has
separable degree one if and only if `x ^ (q ^ n) ∈ F` for some `n : ℕ`.
name: minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_pow_mem
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Ring E] [IsDomain E] [Algebra F E] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] {x : E} : Polynomial.natSepDegree (minpoly F x) = 1 ↔ ∃ n, Membership.mem (γ := Subring E) (RingHom.range.{u, v} (R := F) (algebraMap F E)) (x ^ q ^ n)

docstring:
A linearly-ordered abelian group is cyclic iff it is isomorphic to `Multiplicative ℤ` as an
ordered monoid.
name: LinearOrderedCommGroup.isCyclic_iff_nonempty_equiv_int
statement_text: {G : Type u_4} [CommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] [Nontrivial G] : IsCyclic G ↔ Nonempty.{max 1 (u_4 + 1)} (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ)

docstring:
A group if finitely generated if and only if there exists a surjective homomorphism from a
`FreeGroup` on an arbitrary finite type `α` to the group.
name: Group.fg_iff_exists_freeGroup_hom_surjective_finite
statement_text: {G : Type u_3} [Group G] : Group.FG G ↔ ∃ α, ∃ (_ : Finite α), ∃ φ, Function.Surjective (α := FreeGroup α) (β := G) ⇑φ

docstring:
A pullback cone is a limit cone if and only if the corresponding pushout cocone
in the opposite category is a colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.isLimitEquivIsColimitOp
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Z} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone f g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c.op

docstring: A filter is disjoint from the cocompact filter if and only if it contains a compact set.
name: Filter.disjoint_cocompact_left
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : Filter X) : Disjoint (Filter.cocompact X) f ↔ ∃ K ∈ f, IsCompact K

docstring:
For an adjoint triple `F ⊣ G ⊣ H` where `F` and `H` are fully faithful, the natural
transformation `F ⟶ H` is componentwise monic iff the natural transformation `G ⋙ F ⟶ G ⋙ H`
obtained from the units and counits of the adjunctions is.
Note that unlike `epi_rightToLeft_app_iff`, this equivalence does not make sense
on a per-object basis because the components of the two natural transformations are indexed by
different categories.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple.mono_leftToRight_app_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {H : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} (t : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple F G H) [F.Full] [F.Faithful] : (∀ (X : C), CategoryTheory.Mono (t.leftToRight.app X)) ↔ ∀ (X : D), CategoryTheory.Mono (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (t.adj₁.counit.app X) (t.adj₂.unit.app X))

docstring:
`Fork.ofι ι w` is a limit cone if and only if `Cofork.ofπ ι'.op w'` in the opposite
category is a colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitOfιEquivIsColimitOp
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {P : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} (ι : P ⟶ X) (ι' : P ⟶ X) (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ι f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ι g) (w' : Eq.{v₁ + 1} (α := Opposite.op Y ⟶ Opposite.op P) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f.op ι'.op) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g.op ι'.op)) (h : ι = ι') : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι ι w) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.{0, v₁, 0, u₁} (C := Cᵒᵖ) (F := CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair f.op g.op) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.ofπ ι'.op w')

docstring: The determinant of a map vanishes iff the map is not injective.
name: LinearMap.det_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [IsDomain R] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] {f : M →ₗ[R] M} : LinearMap.det f = 0 ↔ f.ker ≠ ⊥

docstring:
A number satisfies the Liouville condition with any exponent if and only if it is a Liouville
number.
name: forall_liouvilleWith_iff
statement_text: {x : ℝ} : (∀ (p : ℝ), LiouvilleWith p x) ↔ Liouville x

docstring:
A pushout cone is a colimit cocone if and only if the corresponding pullback cone
in the opposite category is a limit cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.PushoutCocone.isColimitEquivIsLimitOp
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Z} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.PushoutCocone f g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c.op

docstring:
A bicone over a pair is a bilimit bicone if and only if the corresponding binary bicone is a
bilimit.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Bicone.toBinaryBiconeIsBilimit
statement_text: {C : Type uC} [CategoryTheory.Category.{uC', uC} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{uC', uC} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (b : CategoryTheory.Limits.Bicone.{0, uC', uC} (CategoryTheory.Limits.pairFunction X Y)) : b.toBinaryBicone.IsBilimit ≃ b.IsBilimit

docstring:
A set of points, whose `vectorSpan` is finite-dimensional, is coplanar if and only if their
`vectorSpan` has dimension at most `2`.
name: coplanar_iff_finrank_le_two
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k ↥(vectorSpan k s)] : Coplanar k s ↔ Module.finrank.{u_1, u_2} k ↥(vectorSpan k s) ≤ 2

docstring: Similarity holds if and only if all extended distances are proportional.
name: similar_iff_exists_edist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoEMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoEMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (i₁ i₂ : ι), edist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = ↑r * edist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring: The cosine of the angle between three points is -1 if and only if the angle is π.
name: EuclideanGeometry.cos_eq_neg_one_iff_angle_eq_pi
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃) = -1 ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi

docstring: An operator is zero iff its norm vanishes.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} {F : Type u_6} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₂] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedSpace 𝕜₂ F] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} (f : E →SL[σ₁₂] F) [RingHomIsometric σ₁₂] : ‖f‖ = 0 ↔ f = 0

docstring:
For unitary `U` in a star-monoid `R`, `U * x = U * y` if and only if `x = y`
for all `x` and `y` in `R`.
name: Unitary.mul_right_inj
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Monoid R] [StarMul R] {x : R} {y : R} (U : ↥(unitary R)) : ↑U * x = ↑U * y ↔ x = y
