docstring: A type is terminal if and only if it is isomorphic to `PUnit`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.isTerminalEquivIsoPUnit
statement_text: (X : Type u) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal X ≃ (X ≅ PUnit.{u + 1})

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which antivary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f ∘ σ` and `g` antivary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `f`.
name: Antivary.sum_comp_perm_mul_eq_sum_mul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i : ι, f (σ i) * g i) (∑ i : ι, f i * g i) ↔ Antivary (f ∘ ⇑σ) g

docstring:
If an analytic function `f` vanishes at `z₀`, then its derivative has finite analytic order `n`
at `z₀` if and only if `f` has analytic order `n + 1` at `z₀`.
name: analyticOrderAt_deriv_eq_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CharZero 𝕜] [CompleteSpace E] {z₀ : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) (hzero : f z₀ = 0) {n : ℕ} : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = ↑n + 1 ↔ analyticOrderAt (deriv f) z₀ = ↑n

docstring: A set belongs to `coclosedCompact` if and only if the closure of its complement is compact.
name: Filter.mem_coclosedCompact_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : s ∈ Filter.coclosedCompact X ↔ IsCompact (closure sᶜ)

docstring:
`x` belongs to the closure of `s` if and only if some ultrafilter
supported on `s` converges to `x`.
name: mem_closure_iff_ultrafilter
statement_text: {X : Type u} {x : X} {s : Set X} [TopologicalSpace X] : x ∈ closure s ↔ ∃ u, s ∈ u ∧ ↑u ≤ nhds x

docstring: `HasSum` over `Nat.Primes` iff over `ℕ` extending `f` by `0`.
name: Nat.Primes.hasSum_iff_hasSum_ite
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] [TopologicalSpace M] (f : ℕ → M) {a : M} : HasSum (fun p => f ↑p) a ↔ HasSum (fun n => if Nat.Prime n then f n else 0) a

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise scalar multiplication of `f` and
`g`, which monovary together on `s`, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f ∘ σ` and `g`
monovary together on `s`. Stated by permuting the entries of `f`.
name: MonovaryOn.sum_comp_perm_smul_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddCommMonoid β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β} (hfg : MonovaryOn f g ↑s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := β) (∑ i ∈ s, f (σ i) • g i) (∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i) ↔ MonovaryOn (f ∘ ⇑σ) g ↑s

docstring:
A linear map `f : M → N` is strict if and only if the induced map `M ⧸ f.ker → N` is an
embedding.
name: LinearMap.isStrictMap_iff_isEmbedding_liftQ_ker
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [Ring R] [Ring S] {σ : R →+* S} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module S N] {f : M →ₛₗ[σ] N} [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace N] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_3, u_4} (X := M) (Y := N) ⇑f ↔ Topology.IsEmbedding.{u_3, u_4} (X := M ⧸ f.ker) (Y := N) ⇑(f.ker.liftQ f ⋯)

docstring:
In case `R` is PID, given a polynomial `p` in `R[X]`, `p` is primitive if and only if the
`v`-adic Gauss norms of `p` are equal to 1 for all `v`.
name: Polynomial.isPrimitive_iff_forall_gaussNorm_eq_one
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] (hR : ¬IsField R) {b : NNReal} (hb : 1 < b) (p : Polynomial R) : p.IsPrimitive ↔ ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R), Polynomial.gaussNorm (v.intAdicAbv hb) 1 p = 1

docstring: `Summable` over `Nat.Primes` iff over `ℕ` extending `f` by `0`.
name: Nat.Primes.summable_iff_summable_ite
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] [TopologicalSpace M] (f : ℕ → M) : (Summable.{u_1, 0} (α := M) fun p => f ↑p) ↔ Summable.{u_1, 0} (α := M) fun n => if Nat.Prime n then f n else 0

docstring:
The inner product of two vectors, divided by the product of their
norms, has value -1 if and only if they are nonzero and one is
a negative multiple of the other.
name: real_inner_div_norm_mul_norm_eq_neg_one_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (x : F) (y : F) : inner ℝ x y / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) = -1 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r < 0, y = r • x

docstring: A vector is in `(𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ` iff it is orthogonal to `u`.
name: Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {u : E} {v : E} : Membership.mem (γ := Submodule 𝕜 E) (𝕜 ∙ u)ᗮ v ↔ inner 𝕜 u v = 0

docstring: Matrices `A` and `B` are equal iff `(A * x).trace = (B * x).trace` for all `x`.
name: Matrix.ext_iff_trace_mul_right
statement_text: {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {R : Type u_6} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [NonAssocSemiring R] {A : Matrix m n R} {B : Matrix m n R} : A = B ↔ ∀ (x : Matrix n m R), (A * x).trace = (B * x).trace

docstring:
Given a type `M` with a multiplication, a congruence relation `c` on `M`, and elements of `M`
`x, y`, `(x, y) ∈ M × M` iff `x` is related to `y` by `c`.
name: Con.instMembershipProd
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Mul M] : Membership (M × M) (Con M)

docstring:
A map `f : X → Y` is proper if and only if it is continuous and the map
`(Prod.map f id : X × Filter X → Y × Filter X)` is closed. This is stronger than
`isProperMap_iff_universally_closed` since it shows that there's only one space to check to get
properness, but in most cases it doesn't matter.
name: isProperMap_iff_isClosedMap_filter
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsProperMap f ↔ Continuous f ∧ IsClosedMap (X := X × Filter X) (Prod.map f id)

docstring:
A function is `C^n` at a point, for `n : ℕ`, if and only if it is `C^n` on
a neighborhood of this point.
name: contMDiffAt_iff_contMDiffOn_nhds
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {E' : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] {H' : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H'] {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'} {M' : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M'] {f : M → M'} {x : M} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I' n M'] (hn : n ≠ ↑⊤) : ContMDiffAt I I' n f x ↔ ∃ u ∈ nhds x, ContMDiffOn I I' n f u

docstring:
Let `P` be a polynomial over `R`. `P` is a unit if and only if all its coefficients are
nilpotent, except its constant term which is a unit.

See also `Polynomial.isUnit_iff'`.
name: Polynomial.isUnit_iff_coeff_isUnit_isNilpotent
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {P : Polynomial R} : IsUnit P ↔ IsUnit (M := R) (P.coeff 0 : R) ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), i ≠ 0 → IsNilpotent (R := R) (P.coeff i : R)

docstring: An object `A` is subterminal iff for any `Z`, there is at most one morphism `Z ⟶ A`.
name: CategoryTheory.IsSubterminal
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] (A : C) : Prop

docstring:
`p` is a Taylor series of `f` up to `n+1` if and only if `p` is a Taylor series up to `n`, and
`p (n + 1)` is a derivative of `p n`.
name: hasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn_succ_iff_left
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} {n : ℕ} : HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn (↑n + 1) f p s ↔ HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn (↑n) f p s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivWithinAt (F := E [×n]→L[𝕜] F) (fun y => p y n) (ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft (Ei := fun _i => E) (p x n.succ)) s x) ∧ ContinuousOn (Y := E [×n + 1]→L[𝕜] F) (fun x => p x (n + 1)) s

docstring: A prime does not divide the different ideal iff it is unramified.
name: not_dvd_differentIdeal_iff
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_3} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [IsDomain A] [IsDedekindDomain A] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Module.IsTorsionFree A B] [Module.Finite A B] [Algebra.IsSeparable.{u_1, u_3} (FractionRing A) (FractionRing B)] {P : Ideal B} [P.IsPrime] : ¬P ∣ differentIdeal A B ↔ Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt A P

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `𝟙 M ⊗ f` is injective whenever `f` is an injective linear map.
See `Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap'` to generalize the universe of
`N, N', N''` to any universe that is higher than `R` and `M`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' : Type (max u v)⦄ [inst_3 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_5 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), Function.Injective (α := N) (β := N') ⇑f → Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R M N) (β := TensorProduct R M N') ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f)

docstring:
Two isomorphisms `G ≃+ G'` of additive groups are equal if and only if they agree
on a generator of `G`.
name: AddEquiv.eq_iff_eq_on_generator
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} {G' : Type u_3} [AddGroup G] [AddGroup G'] {g : G} (hg : ∀ (x : G), Membership.mem (γ := AddSubgroup G) (AddSubgroup.zmultiples g) x) (f₁ : G ≃+ G') (f₂ : G ≃+ G') : f₁ = f₂ ↔ Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := G') (f₁ g : G') (f₂ g : G')

docstring:
`F(S) / F` is an algebraic extension if and only if all elements of `S` are
algebraic elements.
name: IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_isAlgebraic
statement_text: (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {S : Set E} : Algebra.IsAlgebraic.{u_1, u_2} F ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin F S) ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, IsAlgebraic F x

docstring: A nonempty finite `G`-set is connected if and only if the `G`-action is transitive.
name: CategoryTheory.FintypeCat.Action.isConnected_iff_transitive
statement_text: (G : Type u) [Group G] (X : Action FintypeCat G) [Nonempty.{u_1 + 1} X.V.obj] : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected X ↔ MulAction.IsPretransitive.{u, u_1} G X.V.obj

docstring:
A finite number of random variables are independent if and only if their joint characteristic
function is equal to the product of the characteristic functions. This is the version for Hilbert
spaces, see `iIndepFun_iff_charFunDual_pi` for the Banach space version.
name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_iff_charFun_pi
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {E : ι → Type u_3} {mE : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (E i)} [(i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), CompleteSpace.{u_3} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), BorelSpace.{u_3} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), SecondCountableTopology.{u_3} (E i)] {X : (i : ι) → Ω → E i} [(i : ι) → InnerProductSpace ℝ (E i)] (hX : ∀ (i : ι), AEMeasurable (X i) P) : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (β := E) X P ↔ ∀ (t : WithLp 2 ((x : ι) → E x)), MeasureTheory.charFun (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace 2 ((x : ι) → E x)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 fun x => X x ω) P) t = ∏ i : ι, MeasureTheory.charFun (mE := mE i) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) P) (t.ofLp i)

docstring:
An additive subgroup has index two if and only if there exists `a ∉ H` such that
for all `b`, one of `a + b` and `b` belongs to `H`.
name: AddSubgroup.index_eq_two_iff_exists_notMem_and'
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} : H.index = 2 ↔ ∃ a ∉ H, ∀ (b : G), a + b ∈ H ∨ b ∈ H

docstring: When `f` is an epimorphism, `f ≫ g` is epic iff `g` is.
name: CategoryTheory.epi_comp_iff_of_epi
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [CategoryTheory.Epi f] (g : Y ⟶ Z) : CategoryTheory.Epi (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) ↔ CategoryTheory.Epi g

docstring: A set in `WeakDual 𝕜 E` is bounded iff its image in `StrongDual 𝕜 E` is bounded.
name: WeakDual.isBounded_toStrongDual_preimage_iff_isBounded
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {s : Set (StrongDual 𝕜 E)} : Bornology.IsBounded (α := WeakDual 𝕜 E) (⇑WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' s) ↔ Bornology.IsBounded s

docstring:
The order of a meromorphic function `f` at `z₀` is finite iff `f` can locally be
written as `f z = (z - z₀) ^ order • g z`, where `g` is analytic and does not
vanish at `z₀`.
name: meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f z₀) : meromorphicOrderAt f z₀ ≠ ⊤ ↔ ∃ g, AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z₀ ∧ g z₀ ≠ 0 ∧ f =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z₀ {z₀}ᶜ] fun z => (z - z₀) ^ (meromorphicOrderAt f z₀).untop₀ • g z

docstring:
The function `fun z ↦ (z - w) ^ n`, `n : ℤ`, is circle integrable on the circle with center `c`
and radius `|R|` if and only if `R = 0` or `0 ≤ n`, or `w` does not belong to this circle.
name: circleIntegrable_sub_zpow_iff
statement_text: {c : ℂ} {w : ℂ} {R : ℝ} {n : ℤ} : CircleIntegrable (E := ℂ) (fun z => (z - w) ^ n) c R ↔ R = 0 ∨ 0 ≤ n ∨ w ∉ Metric.sphere c |R|

docstring: In a monoid, an element `a` divides an element `b` iff `a` divides all associates of `b`.
name: Units.dvd_mul_right
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Monoid α] {a : α} {b : α} {u : αˣ} : a ∣ b * ↑u ↔ a ∣ b

docstring:
Given a presheaf `F` on the topological space `X` and a family of opens `U` of `X`,
the natural cone associated to `F` and `U` used in the definition of
`F.IsSheafOpensLeCover` is a limit cone iff the natural cone associated to `F`
and the sieve generated by the presieve associated to `U` is a limit cone.
name: TopCat.Presheaf.isLimitOpensLeEquivGenerate₁
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X : TopCat} (F : TopCat.Presheaf.{w, v_1, u_1} C X) {ι : Type u_2} (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) {Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X} (hY : Y = iSup U) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Functor.mapCone F (TopCat.Presheaf.SheafCondition.opensLeCoverCocone U).op) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Functor.mapCone F (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate (TopCat.Presheaf.presieveOfCoveringAux U Y)).arrows.cocone.op)

docstring:
Let `F` and `G` be sheaves valued in a concrete category, whose forgetful functor reflects
isomorphisms, preserves limits and filtered colimits. Then a morphism `f : F ⟶ G` is an
isomorphism if and only if all of its stalk maps are isomorphisms.
name: TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_iff_stalkFunctor_map_iso
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimits.{v, u} C] {X : TopCat} {FC : C → C → Type u_1} {CC : C → Type v} [(X Y : C) → FunLike.{u_1 + 1, v + 1, v + 1} (FC X Y) (CC X) (CC Y)] [CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory C FC (CC := CC)] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFilteredColimits (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimits.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimits (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] [CategoryTheory.Functor.ReflectsIsomorphisms (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] {F : TopCat.Sheaf C X} {G : TopCat.Sheaf C X} (f : F ⟶ G) : CategoryTheory.IsIso f ↔ ∀ (x : ↑X), CategoryTheory.IsIso (X := CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor C x) (F.obj (P := CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↑X)))) (CategoryTheory.Functor.map (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor C x) f.hom)

docstring: An R-module is Noetherian iff all its submodules are finitely-generated.
name: isNoetherian_def
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] : IsNoetherian R M ↔ ∀ (s : Submodule R M), s.FG

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → β → α` is uniformly equicontinuous on `S` iff `range 𝓕` is uniformly
equicontinuous on `S`, i.e the family `(↑) : range F → β → α` is uniformly equicontinuous on `S`.
name: uniformEquicontinuousOn_iff_range
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → β → α} {S : Set β} : UniformEquicontinuousOn F S ↔ UniformEquicontinuousOn (ι := { x : β → α // x ∈ Set.range F }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range F)) S

docstring:
An `R`-algebra `A` is formally smooth iff "for every `R`-algebra `B`,
every square-zero ideal `I : Ideal B` and `f : A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I`, there exists
at least one lift `A →ₐ[R] B`".
name: Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_comp_surjective
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] : Algebra.FormallySmooth R A ↔ ∀ ⦃B : Type (max u v)⦄ [inst_3 : CommRing B] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (I : Ideal B), I ^ 2 = ⊥ → Function.Surjective (α := A →ₐ[R] B) (β := A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I) (AlgHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I))

docstring:
The prime spectrum of a semiring has discrete Zariski topology iff there are only
finitely many maximal ideals and their intersection is contained in the nilradical.
name: PrimeSpectrum.discreteTopology_iff_finite_isMaximal_and_sInf_le_nilradical
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] : DiscreteTopology.{u} (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ Finite.{u + 1} ↑{I | I.IsMaximal} ∧ LE.le (α := Ideal R) (sInf {I | I.IsMaximal}) (nilradical R)

docstring:
Given presieve `R` and presheaf `P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A`, the natural cone associated to `P` and
the sieve `Sieve.generate R` generated by `R` is a limit cone iff `Hom (E, P -)` is a
sheaf of types for the presieve `R` and all `E : A`.
name: CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isLimit_iff_isSheafFor_presieve
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {A : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} A] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} Cᵒᵖ A) {X : C} (R : CategoryTheory.Presieve.{v₁, u₁} X) : Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (P.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows.cocone.op)) ↔ ∀ (E : Aᵒᵖ), CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor (P.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.coyoneda E)) R

docstring: A polynomial of degree 2 or 3 is irreducible iff it doesn't have roots.
name: Polynomial.irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp2 : 2 ≤ p.natDegree) (hp3 : p.natDegree ≤ 3) : Irreducible p ↔ p.roots = 0

docstring:
An `R`-module `Q` is injective if and only if every injective `R`-linear map descends to a linear
map to `Q`, i.e.
name: Module.Injective
statement_text: (R : Type u) [Ring R] (Q : Type v) [AddCommGroup Q] [_root_.Module R Q] : Prop

docstring: A set `s` is codiscrete within `U` iff `s ∪ Uᶜ` is a punctured neighborhood of every point in `U`.
name: mem_codiscreteWithin_iff_forall_mem_nhdsNE
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {T : Set X} : S ∈ Filter.codiscreteWithin T ↔ ∀ x ∈ T, S ∪ Tᶜ ∈ nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ

docstring:
For two finite measures `μ ≪ ν`, the function `x ↦ klFun (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal` is integrable
with respect to `ν` iff `llr μ ν` is integrable with respect to `μ`.
name: InformationTheory.integrable_klFun_rnDeriv_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hμν : μ.AbsolutelyContinuous ν) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (ε := ℝ) (fun x => InformationTheory.klFun (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal) ν ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable (MeasureTheory.llr μ ν) μ

docstring: A pseudo-metric space is complete iff every Cauchy sequence converges.
name: Metric.complete_of_cauchySeq_tendsto
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoMetricSpace α] : (∀ (u : ℕ → α), CauchySeq u → ∃ a, Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds a)) → CompleteSpace α

docstring:
An additive character is *primitive* iff all its multiplicative shifts by nonzero
elements are nontrivial.
name: AddChar.IsPrimitive
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {R' : Type v} [CommMonoid R'] (ψ : AddChar R R') : Prop

docstring:
A set `S` is codiscrete within `T` iff it is a punctured neighborhood within `T` of every
point of `T`.
name: mem_codiscreteWithin_iff_forall_mem_nhdsWithin
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {T : Set X} : S ∈ Filter.codiscreteWithin T ↔ ∀ x ∈ T, S ∈ nhdsWithin x (T \ {x})

docstring:
Rule `r` rewrites string `u` is to string `v` iff they share both a prefix `p` and postfix `q`
such that the remaining middle part of `u` is the input of `r` and the remaining middle part
of `u` is the output of `r`.
name: ContextFreeRule.rewrites_iff
statement_text: {T : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {r : ContextFreeRule T N} {u : List (Symbol T N)} {v : List (Symbol T N)} : r.Rewrites u v ↔ ∃ p q, u = p ++ [Symbol.nonterminal r.input] ++ q ∧ v = p ++ r.output ++ q

docstring:
If `w : TwoSquare T L R B` is a Guitart exact square, with `B` essentially surjective,
and `E` is a left extension of `F` along `R`, then `E` is a pointwise left Kan extension
of `F` along `R` iff `E.compTwoSquare w` is a pointwise left Kan extension
of `T ⋙ F` along `L`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.LeftExtension.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionEquivOfGuitartExact
statement_text: {C₁ : Type u₁} {C₂ : Type u₂} {C₃ : Type u₃} {C₄ : Type u₄} {D : Type u₅} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} C₂] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C₃] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₄, u₄} C₄] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₅, u₅} D] {T : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C₁ C₂} {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} C₁ C₃} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₄, u₂, u₄} C₂ C₄} {B : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₄, u₃, u₄} C₃ C₄} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₅, u₂, u₅} C₂ D} (E : R.LeftExtension F) (w : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare T L R B) [w.GuitartExact] [B.EssSurj] : (E.compTwoSquare w).IsPointwiseLeftKanExtension ≃ E.IsPointwiseLeftKanExtension

docstring: Given a linear map `f : N → P`, `f ⊗ M` is bijective if and only if `M ⊗ f` is bijective.
name: LinearMap.lTensor_bij_iff_rTensor_bij
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (M : Type u_4) {N : Type u_5} {P : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R N] [_root_.Module R P] (f : N →ₗ[R] P) : Function.Bijective (α := TensorProduct R M N) (β := TensorProduct R M P) ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f) ↔ Function.Bijective (α := TensorProduct R N M) (β := TensorProduct R P M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f)

docstring: An operator is a star projection if and only if it is an orthogonal projection.
name: isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] {p : E →L[𝕜] E} : IsStarProjection p ↔ ∃ (x : (↑p).range.HasOrthogonalProjection), p = (↑p).range.starProjection

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is non-strictly below the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a c ≤ slope f c b`.
name: map_le_lineMap_iff_slope_le_slope
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (hab : a < b) (h₀ : 0 < r) (h₁ : r < 1) : f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ≤ (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ↔ slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ≤ slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b

docstring:
If an algebra is simultaneously localizations for two submonoids, then an arbitrary algebra
is a localization of one submonoid iff it is a localization of the other.
name: IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_isLocalization
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (M : Submonoid R) (N : Submonoid R) (S : Type u_2) [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] {P : Type u_3} [CommSemiring P] [IsLocalization M S] [IsLocalization N S] [Algebra R P] : IsLocalization M P ↔ IsLocalization N P

docstring: A morphism in `Stonean` is an epi iff it is surjective.
name: Stonean.epi_iff_surjective
statement_text: {X : Stonean} {Y : Stonean} (f : X ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.Epi f ↔ Function.Surjective (α := (fun (X : CompHausLike fun X => ExtremallyDisconnected.{u_1} ↑X) => ↑(X.toTop (P := fun X => ExtremallyDisconnected.{u_1} ↑X))) X) (β := (fun (X : CompHausLike fun X => ExtremallyDisconnected.{u_1} ↑X) => ↑(X.toTop (P := fun X => ExtremallyDisconnected.{u_1} ↑X))) Y) ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := fun x1 x2 => C(↑(x1.toTop (P := fun X => ExtremallyDisconnected.{u_1} ↑X)), ↑(x2.toTop (P := fun X => ExtremallyDisconnected.{u_1} ↑X)))) (CC := fun X => ↑(X.toTop (P := fun X => ExtremallyDisconnected.{u_1} ↑X))) f)

docstring:
A finite measure is Gaussian iff its characteristic function has value
`exp (μ[L] * I - Var[L; μ] / 2)` for every `L : Dual ℝ E`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.isGaussian_iff_charFunDual_eq
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] : ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian μ ↔ ∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ E), MeasureTheory.charFunDual μ L = Complex.exp ((∫ (x : E), ↑(L x) ∂μ) * Complex.I - ↑(ProbabilityTheory.variance (⇑L) μ) / 2)

docstring: An object in `Type u` is initial if and only if it is empty.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.initial_iff_empty
statement_text: (X : Type u) : Nonempty.{u + 2} (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial X) ↔ IsEmpty X

docstring: `f` is homotopic to `g` iff `g` is homotopic to `f`.
name: Homotopy.symm
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {V : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v, u} V] {c : ComplexShape ι} {C : HomologicalComplex.{v, u, u_1} V c} {D : HomologicalComplex.{v, u, u_1} V c} {f : C ⟶ D} {g : C ⟶ D} (h : Homotopy f g) : Homotopy g f

docstring: A set `s` is discrete iff for every `t ⊆ s` there is a closed `u` with `u ∩ s = t`.
name: isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isClosed
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} : IsDiscrete S ↔ ∀ s ⊆ S, ∃ U, IsClosed U ∧ U ∩ S = s

docstring:
`p` is a Taylor series of `f` up to `⊤` if and only if `p.shift` is a Taylor series up to `⊤`
for `p 1`, which is a derivative of `f`.
name: hasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn_top_iff_right
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {N : WithTop ℕ∞} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} (hN : ↑⊤ ≤ N) : HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn N f p s ↔ (∀ x ∈ s, (p x 0).curry0 = f x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivWithinAt (fun y => p y 0) ((p x 1).curryLeft (Ei := fun _i => E)) s x) ∧ HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn (𝕜 := 𝕜) (F := E →L[𝕜] F) N (fun x => (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 𝕜 E F) (p x 1)) (fun x => (p x).shift) s

docstring: A property of objects `Q.unop` is closed under extensions iff `Q` is.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isClosedUnderExtensions_unop_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v, u} C] (Q : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} Cᵒᵖ) : Q.unop.IsClosedUnderExtensions ↔ CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions.{v, u} Q

docstring:
The integer `n` is a square if and only if `n` is nonnegative,
and for any `p`, the power of `p` in `|n|` is even.
name: Int.isSquare_iff_nonneg_even_factorization
statement_text: {n : ℤ} : IsSquare n ↔ 0 ≤ n ∧ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Even (α := ℕ) (n.natAbs.factorization p : ℕ)

docstring:
For prime `p`, `g` lies in the additive `p`-primary component iff its additive
order is a power of `p`.
name: AddCommGroup.mem_primaryComponent_iff_addOrderOf
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup G] {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := AddSubgroup G) (AddCommGroup.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ n, addOrderOf g = p ^ n

docstring:
A subgroup is nilpotent iff its lower central series (computed in the ambient group) eventually
vanishes.
name: Subgroup.isNilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] (S : Subgroup G) : Group.IsNilpotent.{u_1} ↥S ↔ ∃ n, S.lowerCentralSeries n = ⊥

docstring:
A group is nilpotent if and only if its lower central series eventually reaches
the trivial subgroup.
name: Subgroup.nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] : Group.IsNilpotent G ↔ ∃ n, Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := Subgroup G) (Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries ⊤ n) ⊥

docstring:
The adjoint is unique: a map `A` is the adjoint of `B` iff it satisfies `⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, B y⟫`
for all basis vectors `x` and `y`.
name: LinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff_basis
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F] {ι₁ : Type u_5} {ι₂ : Type u_6} (b₁ : Module.Basis ι₁ 𝕜 E) (b₂ : Module.Basis ι₂ 𝕜 F) (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (B : F →ₗ[𝕜] E) : A = LinearMap.adjoint B ↔ ∀ (i₁ : ι₁) (i₂ : ι₂), inner.{u_1, u_3} 𝕜 (E := F) (A (b₁ i₁ : E) : F) (b₂ i₂ : F) = inner.{u_1, u_2} 𝕜 (E := E) (b₁ i₁ : E) (B (b₂ i₂ : F) : E)

docstring: `lift ⟨u, h⟩` is injective iff `1` and `u` are `R`-linearly independent.
name: QuadraticAlgebra.lift_injective_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} {a : R} {b : R} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_3} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {u : A} (h : u * u = a • 1 + b • u) : Function.Injective.{u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} (α := QuadraticAlgebra R a b) (β := A) ⇑(QuadraticAlgebra.lift ⟨u, h⟩ : QuadraticAlgebra R a b →ₐ[R] A) ↔ LinearIndependent R ![1, u]

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → β → α` is uniformly equicontinuous on `S` iff the function
`swap 𝓕 : β → ι → α` is uniformly continuous on `S`
*when `ι → α` is equipped with the uniform structure of uniform convergence*. This is very useful
for developing the equicontinuity API, but it should not be used directly for other purposes.
name: uniformEquicontinuousOn_iff_uniformContinuousOn
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → β → α} {S : Set β} : UniformEquicontinuousOn F S ↔ UniformContinuousOn (β := UniformFun ι α) (⇑UniformFun.ofFun ∘ Function.swap (φ := fun a a_1 => α) F) S

docstring:
If `E` and `F` are isomorphic pre-`1`-hypercovers and `G` is a presheaf,
the multifork for `E` is exact if and only if the multifork for `F` is exact.
name: CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.isLimitEquivOfIso
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {A : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} A] {S : C} {E : CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.{w, v, u} S} {F : CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.{w, v, u} S} (f : E ≅ F) (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v_1, u, u_1} Cᵒᵖ A) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (E.multifork G) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (F.multifork G)

docstring: `v ∈ Kᗮ` if and only if `⟪u, v⟫ = 0` for all `u ∈ K`.
name: ClosedSubmodule.mem_orthogonal
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_4} {E : Type u_5} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (K : ClosedSubmodule 𝕜 E) (v : E) : v ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ u ∈ K, inner 𝕜 u v = 0

docstring:
The adjoint is unique: a map `A` is the adjoint of `B` iff it satisfies `⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, B y⟫`
for all `x` and `y`.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (B : F →L[𝕜] E) : A = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint B ↔ ∀ (x : E) (y : F), inner 𝕜 (A x) y = inner 𝕜 x (B y)

docstring: The element `0` is left-regular if and only if `R` is trivial.
name: isLeftRegular_zero_iff_subsingleton
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [MulZeroClass R] : IsLeftRegular 0 ↔ Subsingleton R

docstring:
A function has temperate growth if and only if it is smooth and its `n`-th iterated
derivative is `O((1 + ‖x‖) ^ k)` for some `k : ℕ` (depending on `n`).

Note that the `O` here is with respect to the `⊤` filter, meaning that the bound holds everywhere.

TODO: when `E` is finite dimensional, this is equivalent to the derivatives being `O(‖x‖ ^ k)`
as `‖x‖ → ∞`.
name: Function.hasTemperateGrowth_iff_isBigO
statement_text: {E : Type u_5} {F : Type u_6} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} : Function.HasTemperateGrowth f ↔ ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ k, Asymptotics.IsBigO (E := E [×n]→L[ℝ] F) (F := ℝ) ⊤ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) fun x => (1 + ‖x‖) ^ k

docstring:
Two random variables `f, g` are conditionally independent given a third `k` iff the
joint distribution of `k, f, g` factors into a product of their conditional distributions
given `k`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.condIndepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_condDistrib_prod_condDistrib
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {β' : Type u_4} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [StandardBorelSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Ω → β} {g : Ω → β'} {γ : Type u_5} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mβ' : MeasurableSpace β'} [StandardBorelSpace β] [Nonempty β] [StandardBorelSpace β'] [Nonempty β'] (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) {k : Ω → γ} (hk : Measurable k) : ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun (MeasurableSpace.comap k inferInstance) ⋯ f g μ ↔ Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure (γ × β × β')) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => (k ω, f ω, g ω)) μ) (MeasureTheory.Measure.bind (mα := mγ) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map k μ) ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prod ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.id (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prod (ProbabilityTheory.condDistrib f k μ) (ProbabilityTheory.condDistrib g k μ))))

docstring:
Two random variables are independent if and only if their joint characteristic function is equal
to the product of the characteristic functions. This is the version for Hilbert spaces, see
`indepFun_iff_charFunDual_prod` for the Banach space version.
name: ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_charFun_prod
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {mF : MeasurableSpace F} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [CompleteSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology F] {X : Ω → E} {Y : Ω → F} [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace E] (hX : AEMeasurable X P) (hY : AEMeasurable Y P) : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P ↔ ∀ (t : WithLp 2 (E × F)), MeasureTheory.charFun (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace 2 (E × F)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω, Y ω)) P) t = MeasureTheory.charFun (mE := mE) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map X P) t.ofLp.1 * MeasureTheory.charFun (mE := mF) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map Y P) t.ofLp.2

docstring:
Captures information when a model with corners is the trivial model on a normed space
(or on an inner product space, which is also a normed space):
contains the expressions describing the normed space and its base field.

Searching for a model with corners will return an `Option NormedSpaceInfo`,
which is `some` if and only if the trivial model on a normed space was found.
name: Manifold.Elab.NormedSpaceInfo
statement_text: : Type

docstring:
The map of a pullback cone is a limit iff the fork consisting of the mapped morphisms is a
limit. This essentially lets us commute `PullbackCone.mk` with `Functor.mapCone`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitMapConePullbackConeEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) {W : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Z} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : W ⟶ X} {k : W ⟶ Y} (comm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp k g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (G.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.mk h k comm)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.mk (G.map h) (G.map k) ⋯)

docstring:
The composition in the opposite direction is equal to the identity if and only if `F` preserves
the biproduct, see `preservesBiproduct_of_monoBiproductComparison`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.biproductComparison'_comp_biproductComparison
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v₂, u₂} D] {J : Type w₁} (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) (f : J → C) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBiproduct.{w₁, v₁, u₁} f] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBiproduct.{w₁, v₂, u₂} (F.obj ∘ f)] [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms] : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Y := F.obj (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.{w₁, v₁, u₁} f)) (F.biproductComparison' f) (F.biproductComparison f) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.{w₁, v₂, u₂} (F.obj ∘ f))

docstring:
A non-negative function with locally finite support has finite support if and only if its
logarithmic counting function is big-O of `log`.
name: Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.finite_support_iff_logCounting_isBigO_log
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E] {D : Function.locallyFinsupp E ℤ} (h : 0 ≤ D) : (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.support D).Finite ↔ Asymptotics.IsBigO (E := ℝ) Filter.atTop (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.logCounting D) Real.log

docstring: If `f : X → Y` is an inducing map, `f(F)` is path-connected iff `F` is.
name: Topology.IsInducing.isPathConnected_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {F : Set X} {f : X → Y} (hf : Topology.IsInducing f) : IsPathConnected F ↔ IsPathConnected (f '' F)

docstring: An element of `K` is fixed by the complex conjugation iff it lies in `K⁺`.
name: NumberField.IsCMField.complexConj_eq_self_iff
statement_text: (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [CharZero K] [NumberField.IsCMField K] [Algebra.IsIntegral ℚ K] (x : K) : (NumberField.IsCMField.complexConj K) x = x ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Subfield K) (NumberField.maximalRealSubfield K) x

docstring:
A set of points, whose `vectorSpan` is finite-dimensional, is
collinear if and only if their `vectorSpan` has dimension at most
`1`.
name: collinear_iff_finrank_le_one
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k ↥(vectorSpan k s)] : Collinear k s ↔ Module.finrank.{u_1, u_2} k ↥(vectorSpan k s) ≤ 1

docstring:
A function is analytic at a point iff it is analytic after scalar
multiplication with a non-vanishing analytic function.
name: analyticAt_iff_analytic_smul
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {𝕝 : Type u_8} [NormedDivisionRing 𝕝] [NormedAlgebra 𝕜 𝕝] [_root_.Module 𝕝 F] [IsBoundedSMul 𝕝 F] [IsScalarTower 𝕜 𝕝 F] {f : E → 𝕝} {g : E → F} {z : E} (h₁f : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z) (h₂f : f z ≠ 0) : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z ↔ AnalyticAt 𝕜 (f • g) z

docstring:
For an adjoint triple `F ⊣ G ⊣ H` where `G` is fully faithful and `H` preserves epimorphisms
(which is for example the case if `H` has a further right adjoint), the components of the natural
transformation `H ⟶ F` are epic iff the respective components of the natural transformation
`H ⋙ G ⟶ F ⋙ G` obtained from the units and counits of the adjunctions are.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple.epi_rightToLeft_app_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {H : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} (t : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple F G H) [G.Full] [G.Faithful] [H.PreservesEpimorphisms] {X : C} : CategoryTheory.Epi (t.rightToLeft.app X) ↔ CategoryTheory.Epi (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (t.adj₂.counit.app X) (t.adj₁.unit.app X))

docstring:
Associate a coverage to any Grothendieck topology.
If `J` is a Grothendieck topology, and `K` is the associated coverage, then a presieve
`S` is a covering presieve for `K` if and only if the sieve that it generates is a
covering sieve for `J`.
name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.toCoverage
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v_1, u_1} C) : CategoryTheory.Coverage.{v_1, u_1} C

docstring:
Given a point `p₁` in an affine subspace `s`, and a point `p₂`, a point `p` is in the span of
`s` with `p₂` added if and only if it is a multiple of `p₂ -ᵥ p₁` added to a point in `s`.
name: AffineSubspace.mem_affineSpan_insert_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p₁ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ s) (p₂ : P) (p : P) : Membership.mem (γ := AffineSubspace k P) (affineSpan k (insert p₂ ↑s)) p ↔ ∃ r, ∃ p0 ∈ s, p = r • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) +ᵥ p0

docstring: The power function `x ↦ x^s` is integrable on `(0, t)` iff `-1 < s`.
name: intervalIntegral.integrableOn_Ioo_rpow_iff
statement_text: {s : ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (ε := ℝ) (mα := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace) (fun x => x ^ s) (Set.Ioo 0 t) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ -1 < s

docstring:
`ker f` is invariant under `T` if and only if `f ∘L T ∘L f = f ∘L T`,
for idempotent `f`.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.ker_mem_invtSubmodule_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {f : M →L[R] M} {T : M →L[R] M} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : (↑f).ker ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule ↑T ↔ f ∘SL T ∘SL f = f ∘SL T

docstring:
For a prime `p`, a ℚ-linear combination `∑_{i < p} αᵢ ζⁱ` vanishes if and only if all
coefficients `αᵢ` are equal. This follows from the irreducibility of the `p`-th cyclotomic
polynomial. See de Launey–Flannery, *Algebraic Design Theory*, Lemma 2.8.5.
name: IsPrimitiveRoot.sum_eq_zero_iff_forall_eq
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [CharZero K] {p : ℕ} {ζ : K} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) (α : Fin p → ℚ) : ∑ i : Fin p, ↑(α i) * ζ ^ ↑i = 0 ↔ ∀ (i j : Fin p), α i = α j

docstring:
An additive group is finitely generated iff there exists a surjective homomorphism
from a `FreeAddGroup` on finitely many generators.
name: AddGroup.fg_iff_exists_freeAddGroup_hom_surjective
statement_text: {G : Type u_3} [AddGroup G] : AddGroup.FG G ↔ ∃ S, ∃ (_ : S.Finite), ∃ φ, Function.Surjective (α := FreeAddGroup ↑S) (β := G) ⇑φ

docstring:
A group `G` acts properly on a topological space `X` if and only if for all ultrafilters
`𝒰` on `X × G`, if `𝒰` converges to `(x₁, x₂)` along the map `(g, x) ↦ (g • x, x)`,
then there exists `g : G` such that `g • x₂ = x₁` and `𝒰.fst` converges to `g`.
name: properSMul_iff_continuousSMul_ultrafilter_tendsto
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace X] : ProperSMul G X ↔ ContinuousSMul G X ∧ ∀ (𝒰 : Ultrafilter (G × X)) (x₁ x₂ : X), Filter.Tendsto (fun gx => (gx.1 • gx.2, gx.2)) (↑𝒰) (nhds (x₁, x₂)) → ∃ g, g • x₂ = x₁ ∧ Filter.Tendsto Prod.fst (↑𝒰) (nhds g)

docstring:
If `R` and `S` are rings, `p` is in the subring of polynomials that lift if and only if it is in
the subsemiring of polynomials that lift.
name: Polynomial.lifts_iff_liftsRing
statement_text: {R : Type u} [Ring R] {S : Type v} [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) (p : Polynomial S) : p ∈ Polynomial.lifts f ↔ p ∈ Polynomial.liftsRing f

docstring: A space is completely normal iff all open subspaces are normal.
name: completelyNormalSpace_iff_forall_isOpen_normalSpace
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : CompletelyNormalSpace X ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), IsOpen s → NormalSpace.{u_1} ↑s

docstring:
One subspace is not less than or equal to another if and only if it has a point not in the
second subspace.
name: AffineSubspace.not_le_iff_exists
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (s₁ : AffineSubspace k P) (s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : ¬s₁ ≤ s₂ ↔ ∃ p ∈ s₁, p ∉ s₂

docstring: If `h : X → Y` is a homeomorphism, `h(s)` is compact iff `s` is.
name: Homeomorph.isCompact_image
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : IsCompact.{u_2} (X := Y) (⇑h '' s) ↔ IsCompact s

docstring: A set system is a compact system iff adding `∅` gives a compact system.
name: isCompactSystem_insert_empty_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {S : Set (Set α)} : IsCompactSystem (insert ∅ S) ↔ IsCompactSystem S

docstring:
A presheaf `P` is separated for the Grothendieck topology `J` iff for every covering sieve
`S` of `J`, the natural cone associated to `P` and `S` admits at most one morphism from every
cone in the same category.
name: CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSeparated_iff_subsingleton
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {A : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} A] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v₁, u₁} C) (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} Cᵒᵖ A) : (∀ (E : A), CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSeparated.{v₂, v₁, u₁} J (P.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.coyoneda (Opposite.op E)))) ↔ ∀ ⦃X : C⦄, ∀ S ∈ J X, ∀ (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone (S.arrows.diagram.op.comp P)), Subsingleton.{v₂ + 1} (c ⟶ P.mapCone S.arrows.cocone.op)

docstring: A set of points is cospherical if and only if they lie in some sphere.
name: EuclideanGeometry.cospherical_iff_exists_sphere
statement_text: {P : Type u_2} [MetricSpace P] {ps : Set P} : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ps ↔ ∃ s, ps ⊆ Metric.sphere s.center s.radius

docstring:
Assume that
1. `C` has binary products and pullbacks,
2. `D` has pullbacks, binary products and a terminal object, and
3. `F : C ⥤ D` is full and preserves binary products and pullbacks.

For an object `X` in a category `D`, the diagonal morphism `X ⟶ X × X` is relatively representable
with respect to `F` if and only if so is every morphism of the form `F.obj a ⟶ X`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.relativelyRepresentable.diag_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryProducts.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryProducts.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasTerminal.{v₂, u₂} D] [F.Full] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.Discrete CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair) F] {X : D} [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingCospan F] : F.relativelyRepresentable (Y := CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.{v₂, u₂} X X) (CategoryTheory.Limits.diag X) ↔ ∀ ⦃a : C⦄ (g : F.obj a ⟶ X), F.relativelyRepresentable g

docstring: The Legendre symbol of `p` and `a` is zero iff `p ∣ a`.
name: legendreSym.eq_zero_iff
statement_text: (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ℤ) : legendreSym p a = 0 ↔ ↑a = 0

docstring:
The equivalence relation associated to a submodule `p`, defined by `x ≈ y` iff `-x + y ∈ p`.

Note this is equivalent to `y - x ∈ p`, but defined this way to be defeq to the `AddSubgroup`
version, where commutativity can't be assumed.
name: Submodule.quotientRel
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] (p : Submodule R M) : Setoid M

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `M ⊗ -` is an exact functor.
See `Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_exact'` to generalize the universe of
`N, N', N''` to any universe that is higher than `R` and `M`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_exact
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' N'' : Type (max u v)⦄ [inst_3 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N''] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N'] [inst_8 : _root_.Module R N''] ⦃f : N →ₗ[R] N'⦄ ⦃g : N' →ₗ[R] N''⦄, Function.Exact (M := N) (N := N') (P := N'') ⇑f ⇑g → Function.Exact (M := TensorProduct R M N) (N := TensorProduct R M N') (P := TensorProduct R M N'') ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f) ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M g)

docstring:
An action of a monoid `M` on `α` is topologically transitive if and only if for any nonempty
open subset `U` of `α` the union over the elements of `M` of images of `U` is dense in `α`.
name: MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion
statement_text: (M : Type u_1) {α : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] [Monoid M] [MulAction M α] : MulAction.IsTopologicallyTransitive M α ↔ ∀ {U : Set α}, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → Dense.{u_2} (X := α) (⋃ m, m • U)

docstring: Sets of subtype are σ-compact iff the image under a coercion is.
name: Subtype.isSigmaCompact_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {p : X → Prop} {s : Set { a : X // p a }} : IsSigmaCompact s ↔ IsSigmaCompact (Subtype.val (p := fun a => p a) '' s)

docstring:
A linear map is symmetric iff the corresponding matrix with an orthonormal basis is
Hermitian.
name: LinearMap.isHermitian_toMatrix_iff
statement_text: {n : Type u_1} {𝕜 : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {f : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (b : OrthonormalBasis n 𝕜 E) : Matrix.IsHermitian.{u_2, u_1} (α := 𝕜) (n := n) ((LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis) f) ↔ LinearMap.IsSymmetric.{u_2, u_3} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) f

docstring:
A monoid is finitely generated iff there exists a surjective homomorphism from a `FreeMonoid`
on finitely many generators.
name: Monoid.fg_iff_exists_freeMonoid_hom_surjective
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Monoid M] : Monoid.FG M ↔ ∃ S, ∃ (_ : S.Finite), ∃ φ, Function.Surjective (α := FreeMonoid ↑S) (β := M) ⇑φ

docstring:
If `α` is non-empty, an additive action is pretransitive if and only if the
quotient has exactly one element.
name: AddAction.pretransitive_iff_unique_quotient_of_nonempty
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] [Nonempty α] : AddAction.IsPretransitive G α ↔ Nonempty.{max 1 (u_2 + 1)} (Unique (AddAction.orbitRel.Quotient G α))

docstring: A proper ideal `I` is primary iff `xy ∈ I` implies `x ∈ I` or `y ∈ radical I`.
name: Ideal.isPrimary_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal R} : I.IsPrimary ↔ I ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ {x y : R}, x * y ∈ I → x ∈ I ∨ y ∈ I.radical

docstring: A set `B` is a `G`-block iff the sets of the form `g • B` are pairwise equal or disjoint.
name: MulAction.IsBlock
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) {X : Type u_2} [SMul G X] (B : Set X) : Prop

docstring: A set `s` is open iff for every point `x` in `s` and every `y` close to `x`, `y` is in `s`.
name: isOpen_iff_eventually
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsOpen s ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ᶠ (y : X) in nhds x, y ∈ s

docstring:
The sieve `S` is in the topology iff its closure is the maximal sieve. This shows that the closure
operator determines the topology.
name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.close_eq_top_iff_mem
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (J₁ : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C) {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v, u} X) : J₁.close S = ⊤ ↔ S ∈ J₁ X

docstring:
An element in a non-unital star `ℂ`-algebra is normal if and only if its real and imaginary
parts commute.
name: isStarNormal_iff_commute_realPart_imaginaryPart
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing A] [StarRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A] [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A] [StarModule ℂ A] {x : A} : IsStarNormal x ↔ Commute.{u_1} (M := A) ↑((realPart : A →ₗ[ℝ] ↥(selfAdjoint A)) x) ↑((imaginaryPart : A →ₗ[ℝ] ↥(selfAdjoint A)) x)

docstring: `n` is a square if and only if for any prime `p`, the power of `p` in `n` is even.
name: Nat.isSquare_iff_even_factorization
statement_text: {n : ℕ} : IsSquare n ↔ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Even (α := ℕ) (n.factorization p : ℕ)

docstring:
If `I : Ideal S` has a basis over `R`,
`x ∈ I` iff it is a linear combination of basis vectors.
name: Basis.mem_ideal_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] {I : Ideal S} (b : Module.Basis.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι R ↥I) {x : S} : x ∈ I ↔ ∃ c, x = c.sum fun i x => HSMul.hSMul (β := S) x ↑(b i)

docstring: An additive action is `1`-pretransitive iff it is pretransitive.
name: AddAction.zeroEmbedding_isPretransitive_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] {zero : Type u_5} [Unique zero] : AddAction.IsPretransitive G (zero ↪ α) ↔ AddAction.IsPretransitive G α

docstring: `Spec (R ⧸ I) ⟶ Spec R` is an open immersion iff `I` is generated by an idempotent.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_iff_of_surjective
statement_text: {R : CommRingCat} {S : CommRingCat} (f : R ⟶ S) (hf : Function.Surjective (α := ↑R) (β := ↑S) ⇑(CommRingCat.Hom.hom f)) : AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map f) ↔ ∃ e, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ Eq (α := Ideal ↑R) (RingHom.ker (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f)) (Ideal.span {e})

docstring:
`z • r` is a multiple of `p` iff `r` is `k * (p / z)` above a multiple of `p`, where
`0 ≤ k < |z|`.
name: AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem_zmultiples_iff_exists_sub_div
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [DivisionRing R] [CharZero R] {p : R} {r : R} {z : ℤ} (hz : z ≠ 0) : Membership.mem (γ := AddSubgroup R) (AddSubgroup.zmultiples p) (z • r) ↔ ∃ k, Membership.mem (γ := AddSubgroup R) (AddSubgroup.zmultiples p) (r - ↑k • (p / ↑z))

docstring:
The product (in the sense of `LinearMap.prodMap`) of linear maps is strict if and only if both
maps are strict.
name: LinearMap.isStrictMap_prodMap_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {Nₗ : Type u_5} {M' : Type u_6} {Nₗ' : Type u_7} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup Nₗ] [AddCommGroup M'] [AddCommGroup Nₗ'] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R Nₗ] [_root_.Module R M'] [_root_.Module R Nₗ'] {fₗ : M →ₗ[R] Nₗ} {gₗ : M' →ₗ[R] Nₗ'} [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace Nₗ] [IsTopologicalAddGroup M] [TopologicalSpace M'] [IsTopologicalAddGroup M'] [TopologicalSpace Nₗ'] : Topology.IsStrictMap (X := M × M') (Y := Nₗ × Nₗ') ⇑(fₗ.prodMap gₗ) ↔ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_3, u_5} (X := M) (Y := Nₗ) ⇑fₗ ∧ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_6, u_7} (X := M') (Y := Nₗ') ⇑gₗ

docstring:
If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` moves `h • x` iff `g` moves `x`.
This is equivalent to say that the set `(fixedBy α g)ᶜ` is fixed by `h`.
name: MulAction.movedBy_mem_fixedBy_of_commute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : Commute g h) : Membership.mem (γ := Set (Set α)) (MulAction.fixedBy (Set α) h) (MulAction.fixedBy α g)ᶜ

docstring: A set is stable under generalization iff it is an intersection of open sets.
name: stableUnderGeneralization_iff_exists_sInter_eq
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : StableUnderGeneralization s ↔ ∃ S, (∀ s ∈ S, IsOpen s) ∧ ⋂₀ S = s

docstring: Star projection operators are equal iff their range are.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.IsStarProjection.ext_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {T : E →L[𝕜] E} [CompleteSpace E] {S : E →L[𝕜] E} (hS : IsStarProjection S) (hT : IsStarProjection T) : S = T ↔ (↑S).range = (↑T).range

docstring:
Given `u : α → γ` a uniform inducing map, a family `𝓕 : ι → β → α` is uniformly equicontinuous
on a subset `S : Set β` iff the family `𝓕'`, obtained by composing each function of `𝓕` by `u`,
is uniformly equicontinuous on `S`.
name: IsUniformInducing.uniformEquicontinuousOn_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} {γ : Type u_10} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ] {F : ι → β → α} {S : Set β} {u : α → γ} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : UniformEquicontinuousOn F S ↔ UniformEquicontinuousOn.{u_1, u_10, u_8} (α := γ) ((fun x => u ∘ x) ∘ F) S

docstring:
A monic irreducible polynomial over a field `F` of exponential characteristic `q` has
separable degree one if and only if it is of the form `X ^ (q ^ n) - C y`
for some `n : ℕ` and `y : F`.
name: Irreducible.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_of_monic
statement_text: {F : Type u} [Field F] {f : Polynomial F} (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] (hm : f.Monic) (hi : Irreducible f) : f.natSepDegree = 1 ↔ ∃ n y, f = HSub.hSub (β := Polynomial F) (HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial F) Polynomial.X (q ^ n)) (Polynomial.C y : Polynomial F)

docstring: The range of an injective indexed family of points is convex independent iff that family is.
name: Function.Injective.convexIndependent_iff_set
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] {p : ι → E} (hi : Function.Injective p) : ConvexIndependent.{u_1, u_2, u_2} 𝕜 (E := E) (ι := { x : E // x ∈ Set.range p }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range p)) ↔ ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p

docstring: A module has dimension 1 iff there is some nonzero `v : V` so every vector is a multiple of `v`.
name: finrank_eq_one_iff'
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Ring K] [StrongRankCondition K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] [Module.Free K V] : Module.finrank K V = 1 ↔ ∃ v, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (w : V), ∃ c, c • v = w

docstring: The sieve `S` is closed iff its closure is equal to itself.
name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.isClosed_iff_close_eq_self
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (J₁ : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C) {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v, u} X) : J₁.IsClosed S ↔ J₁.close S = S

docstring:
Derangements on a subtype are equivalent to permutations on the original type where points are
fixed iff they are not in the subtype.
name: derangements.subtypeEquiv
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] : ↑(derangements (Subtype p)) ≃ { f : Equiv.Perm α // ∀ (a : α), ¬p a ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Set α) (Function.fixedPoints ⇑f) a }

docstring: `g` lies in the additive `p`-primary component iff `p ^ k • g = 0` for some `k`.
name: AddCommGroup.mem_primaryComponent
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup G] {p : ℕ} {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := AddSubgroup G) (AddCommGroup.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ k, p ^ k • g = 0

docstring:
If `f : X → Z` is a Borel measurable map from a standard Borel space
to a countably separated measurable space,
then for any measurable space `β` and `g : Z → β`, the composition `g ∘ f` is
measurable if and only if the restriction of `g` to the range of `f` is measurable.
name: Measurable.measurable_comp_iff_restrict
statement_text: {X : Type u_3} {Z : Type u_5} {β : Type u_6} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace Z] {f : X → Z} [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated.{u_5} ↑(Set.range f)] (hf : Measurable f) {g : Z → β} : Measurable (g ∘ f) ↔ Measurable ((Set.range f).domRestrict (π := fun a => β) g)

docstring:
`m` is `n`-smooth if and only if `m` is nonzero and all prime divisors `≤ m` of `m`
are less than `n`.
name: Nat.mem_smoothNumbers_iff_forall_le
statement_text: {n : ℕ} {m : ℕ} : m ∈ n.smoothNumbers ↔ m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ≤ m, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p < n

docstring: In a sequential space, a set is closed iff it's sequentially closed.
name: isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [SequentialSpace X] {M : Set X} : IsSeqClosed M ↔ IsClosed M

docstring: Congruence holds if and only if all extended distances are the same.
name: congruent_iff_edist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoEMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoEMetricSpace P₂] : Congruent v₁ v₂ ↔ ∀ (i₁ i₂ : ι), edist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = edist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
Let `A` and `B` be topological groups, and let `φ : A → B` be a continuous surjective group
homomorphism. Assume furthermore that `φ` is a quotient map (i.e., `V ⊆ B`
is open iff `φ⁻¹ V` is open). Then `φ` is an open quotient map, and in particular an open map.
name: MonoidHom.isOpenQuotientMap_of_isQuotientMap
statement_text: {A : Type u_2} [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [ContinuousMul A] {B : Type u_3} [Group B] [TopologicalSpace B] {F : Type u_4} [FunLike F A B] [MonoidHomClass F A B] {φ : F} (hφ : Topology.IsQuotientMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := A) (Y := B) ⇑φ) : IsOpenQuotientMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := A) (Y := B) ⇑φ

docstring:
The norm of the image of `m : M` in the quotient by `S` is zero if and only if `m`
belongs to the closure of `S`.
name: QuotientAddGroup.norm_mk_eq_zero_iff_mem_closure
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup M] {S : AddSubgroup M} {m : M} : norm (E := M ⧸ S) ↑m = 0 ↔ m ∈ closure ↑S

docstring: For `A` positive semidefinite, we have `x⋆ A x = 0` iff `A x = 0` (linear maps version).
name: Matrix.PosSemidef.toLinearMap₂'_zero_iff
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {R' : Type u_4} [CommRing R'] [PartialOrder R'] [StarRing R'] [Fintype n] [StarOrderedRing R'] [IsProperStar R'] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n R'} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {x : n → R'} : (((Matrix.toLinearMap₂' R' : Matrix n n R' ≃ₗ[R'] (n → R') →ₗ[R'] (n → R') →ₗ[R'] R') A : (n → R') →ₗ[R'] (n → R') →ₗ[R'] R') (star x) : (n → R') →ₗ[R'] R') x = 0 ↔ A.mulVec x = 0

docstring:
For a matrix `A` with nonnegative entries, the `(i, j)`-entry of the `k`-th power `A ^ k`
is strictly positive if and only if there exists a path of length `k` from `i` to `j` in the
quiver associated to `A` via `toQuiver`.
name: Matrix.pow_apply_pos_iff_nonempty_path
statement_text: {n : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] {A : Matrix n n R} [Fintype n] [IsOrderedRing R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [Nontrivial R] [DecidableEq n] (hA : ∀ (i j : n), 0 ≤ A i j) (k : ℕ) (i : n) (j : n) : 0 < (A ^ k) i j ↔ Nonempty.{max 1 (u_1 + 1)} { p : Quiver.Path i j // p.length = k }

docstring: A non-zero `a : F` is a square if and only if `a ^ (#F / 2) = 1`.
name: FiniteField.isSquare_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_3} [Field F] [Fintype F] (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) {a : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsSquare a ↔ a ^ (Fintype.card F / 2) = 1

docstring: `x` is an accumulation point of a set `C` iff it is a cluster point of `C ∖ {x}`.
name: accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} {C : Set X} : AccPt x (Filter.principal C) ↔ ClusterPt x (Filter.principal (C \ {x}))

docstring:
A family is affinely independent if and only if any affine
combinations (with sum of weights 1) that evaluate to the same point
have equal `Set.indicator`.
name: affineIndependent_iff_indicator_eq_of_affineCombination_eq
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} (p : ι → P) : AffineIndependent k p ↔ ∀ (s1 s2 : Finset ι) (w1 w2 : ι → k), ∑ i ∈ s1, w1 i = 1 → ∑ i ∈ s2, w2 i = 1 → Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := P) ((Finset.affineCombination k s1 p) w1 : P) ((Finset.affineCombination k s2 p) w2 : P) → (↑s1).indicator w1 = (↑s2).indicator w2

docstring:
Two functions agree along the codiscrete filter iff they agree along the punctured neighborhood of
every point.
name: eventuallyEq_codiscrete_iff_forall_eventuallyEq_nhdsNE
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Z : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] {g₁ : X → Z} {g₂ : X → Z} : g₁ =ᶠ[Filter.codiscrete X] g₂ ↔ ∀ (x : X), g₁ =ᶠ[nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ] g₂

docstring: A group `G` is finitely generated if and only if `R[G]` is of finite type.
name: MonoidAlgebra.finiteType_iff_group_fg
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {G : Type u_3} [Group G] [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] : Algebra.FiniteType R (MonoidAlgebra R G) ↔ Group.FG G

docstring:
**Korselt's criterion** for Carmichael numbers:
`n` is a Carmichael number if and only if it is greater than two, composite, squarefree, and for
each prime divisor `p` of `n`, we have `p - 1 ∣ n - 1`.
name: Nat.isCarmichael_iff_korselt
statement_text: {n : ℕ} : n.IsCarmichael ↔ 2 < n ∧ ¬Nat.Prime n ∧ Squarefree n ∧ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n → p - 1 ∣ n - 1

docstring: A submonoid `S` includes `closure s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: Submonoid.closure_le
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [MulOneClass M] {s : Set M} {S : Submonoid M} : Submonoid.closure s ≤ S ↔ s ⊆ ↑S

docstring: `K` is a function field over `F` iff it is a finite extension of `F(t)`.
name: functionField_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u_1) (K : Type u_2) [Field F] [Field K] (Ft : Type u_3) [Field Ft] [Algebra.{u_1, u_3} (Polynomial F) Ft] [IsFractionRing.{u_1, u_3} (Polynomial F) Ft] [Algebra.{u_1, u_2} (RatFunc F) K] [Algebra Ft K] [Algebra.{u_1, u_2} (Polynomial F) K] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_3, u_2} (Polynomial F) Ft K] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} (Polynomial F) (RatFunc F) K] : FunctionField F K ↔ FiniteDimensional Ft K

docstring:
An element is left-regular if and only if multiplying it on the left by a left-regular element
is left-regular.
name: mul_isLeftRegular_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semigroup R] {a : R} (b : R) (ha : IsLeftRegular a) : IsLeftRegular (a * b) ↔ IsLeftRegular b

docstring: A function has finite integral for the counting measure iff its norm is summable.
name: MeasureTheory.hasFiniteIntegral_count_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [NormedAddCommGroup β] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {f : α → β} : @MeasureTheory.HasFiniteIntegral _ _ _ m f MeasureTheory.Measure.count ↔ Summable (α := ℝ) fun x => ‖f x‖

docstring: The order of an analytic function `f` at `z₀` is zero iff `f` does not vanish at `z₀`.
name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = 0 ↔ f z₀ ≠ 0

docstring:
If `w` is a nontorsion weight function, then a multivariate polynomial has weighted total
degree zero if and only if for every `m ∈ p.support` and `x : σ`, `m x = 0`.
name: MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid M] [LinearOrder M] [OrderBot M] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] {w : σ → M} (hw : MvPolynomial.NonTorsionWeight w) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree w p = 0 ↔ ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ (x : σ), m x = 0

docstring:
A vector lies in the `vectorSpan` of two points if and only if it is a multiple of their
difference (reversed).
name: mem_vectorSpan_pair_rev
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {v : V} : Membership.mem (γ := Submodule k V) (vectorSpan k (P := P) {p₁, p₂}) v ↔ ∃ r, r • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) = v

docstring:
A prime `p` is a unit in a commutative ring `R` of nonzero characteristic iff it does not divide
the characteristic.
name: isUnit_iff_not_dvd_char_of_ringChar_ne_zero
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hR : ringChar R ≠ 0) : IsUnit.{u_1} (M := R) ↑p ↔ ¬p ∣ ringChar R

docstring:
The category structure coming from a preorder. There is a morphism `X ⟶ Y` if and only if `X ≤ Y`.

Because we don't allow morphisms to live in `Prop`,
we have to define `X ⟶ Y` as `ULift (PLift (X ≤ Y))`.
See `CategoryTheory.homOfLE` and `CategoryTheory.leOfHom`.
name: Preorder.smallCategory
statement_text: (α : Type u) [Preorder α] : CategoryTheory.SmallCategory α

docstring: A `Subalgebra` is `FiniteDimensional` iff it is `FiniteDimensional` as a submodule.
name: Subalgebra.finiteDimensional_toSubmodule
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field F] [Ring E] [Algebra F E] {S : Subalgebra F E} : FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} F ↥(Subalgebra.toSubmodule S : Submodule F E) ↔ FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} F ↥S

docstring:
A family of points in projective space is independent if and only if the family of
submodules which the points determine is independent in the lattice-theoretic sense.
name: Projectivization.independent_iff_iSupIndep
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {f : ι → Projectivization K V} : Projectivization.Independent f ↔ iSupIndep.{u_1 + 1, u_3} (α := Submodule K V) fun (i : ι) => (f i).submodule

docstring: A map out of a sum type is continuous iff its restriction to each summand is.
name: continuous_sigma_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_2} {σ : ι → Type u_4} [(i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (σ i)] [TopologicalSpace X] {f : Sigma σ → X} : Continuous f ↔ ∀ (i : ι), Continuous.{u_4, u} (Y := X) fun (a : σ i) => f (Sigma.mk (β := σ) i a)

docstring: A left transversal is finite iff the subgroup has finite index.
name: AddSubgroup.IsComplement.finite_left_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} {S : Set G} (h : AddSubgroup.IsComplement S ↑H) : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑S ↔ H.FiniteIndex

docstring:
Let `A` and `B` be topological additive groups, and let `φ : A → B` be a
continuous surjective additive group homomorphism. Assume furthermore that `φ` is a quotient map
(i.e., `V ⊆ B` is open iff `φ⁻¹ V` is open). Then `φ` is an open quotient map, and in particular an
open map.
name: AddMonoidHom.isOpenQuotientMap_of_isQuotientMap
statement_text: {A : Type u_2} [AddGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [ContinuousAdd A] {B : Type u_3} [AddGroup B] [TopologicalSpace B] {F : Type u_4} [FunLike F A B] [AddMonoidHomClass F A B] {φ : F} (hφ : Topology.IsQuotientMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := A) (Y := B) ⇑φ) : IsOpenQuotientMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := A) (Y := B) ⇑φ

docstring:
`Prod.fst ⁻¹' s` is null measurable w.r.t. `μ.prod ν` iff `s` is null measurable w.r.t. `μ`
provided that `ν ≠ 0`.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.nullMeasurableSet_preimage_fst
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure β} [MeasureTheory.SFinite ν] [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ] [NeZero ν] {s : Set α} : MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet (Prod.fst ⁻¹' s) (μ.prod ν) ↔ MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet s μ

docstring:
Given two forks with isomorphic components in such a way that the natural diagrams commute, then
one is a limit if and only if the other one is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitEquivOfIsos
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} {X' : C} {Y' : C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork f g) {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ Y'} (c' : CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork f' g') (e₀ : X ≅ X') (e₁ : Y ≅ Y') (e : c.pt ≅ c'.pt) (comm₁ : autoParam (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e₀.hom f' = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f e₁.hom) CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitEquivOfIsos._auto_1) (comm₂ : autoParam (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e₀.hom g' = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g e₁.hom) CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitEquivOfIsos._auto_3) (comm₃ : autoParam (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e.hom c'.ι = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c.ι e₀.hom) CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitEquivOfIsos._auto_5) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c'

docstring:
If `f` is any function and `g` is analytic without zero at `z₀`, then `f` is meromorphic in normal
form at `z₀` iff `f * g` is meromorphic in normal form at `z₀`.
name: meromorphicNFAt_mul_iff_left
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (h₁g : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x) (h₂g : g x ≠ 0) : MeromorphicNFAt (f * g) x ↔ MeromorphicNFAt f x

docstring:
A point `x` lies outside the support of `μ` iff all of the subsets of one of its neighborhoods
have measure zero.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.notMem_support_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} {x : X} : x ∉ μ.support ↔ ∀ᶠ (u : Set X) in (nhds x).smallSets, μ u = 0

docstring: A vertex is in the ball of radius `⊤` iff it is reachable from the center.
name: SimpleGraph.mem_ball_top
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {c : V} {v : V} : v ∈ G.ball c ⊤ ↔ G.Reachable v c

docstring:
If a function is meromorphic in normal form on `U`, then its divisor is non-negative iff it is
analytic.
name: MeromorphicNFOn.divisor_nonneg_iff_analyticOnNhd
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {U : Set 𝕜} (h₁f : MeromorphicNFOn f U) : 0 ≤ MeromorphicOn.divisor f U ↔ AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 f U

docstring:
The map of a pushout cocone is a colimit iff the cofork consisting of the mapped morphisms is a
colimit. This essentially lets us commute `PushoutCocone.mk` with `Functor.mapCocone`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isColimitMapCoconePushoutCoconeEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) {W : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {h : X ⟶ Z} {k : Y ⟶ Z} {f : W ⟶ X} {g : W ⟶ Y} (comm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f h = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g k) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (G.mapCocone (CategoryTheory.Limits.PushoutCocone.mk h k comm)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.PushoutCocone.mk (G.map h) (G.map k) ⋯)

docstring: An object has injective dimension zero iff it is injective and it is not zero object.
name: CategoryTheory.injectiveDimension_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{v, u} C] (X : C) : CategoryTheory.injectiveDimension.{v, u} X = 0 ↔ CategoryTheory.Injective.{v, u} X ∧ ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero.{v, u} X

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsDenseSubsite
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v_1, u_1} C) (K : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v_2, u_2} D) (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D) : Prop

docstring: For `u : Opens M`, `x : u` is a boundary point iff `x.val : M` is.
name: ModelWithCorners.isBoundaryPoint_iff_isBoundaryPoint_val
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {u : TopologicalSpace.Opens M} {x : ↥u} : I.IsBoundaryPoint x ↔ I.IsBoundaryPoint ↑x

docstring: The projection to `p` along `q` of `x` equals `x` if and only if `x ∈ p`.
name: Submodule.projection_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module R E] {p : Submodule R E} {q : Submodule R E} (hpq : IsCompl p q) (x : E) : (p.projection q hpq) x = x ↔ x ∈ p

docstring:
A `LinearMap` on a finite-dimensional space over a complete field
is injective iff it is anti-Lipschitz.
name: LinearMap.injective_iff_antilipschitz
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] (f : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) : Function.Injective.{v + 1, w + 1} (α := E) (β := F) ⇑f ↔ ∃ K > 0, AntilipschitzWith.{v, w} (α := E) (β := F) K ⇑f

docstring:
If `f` is meromorphic at `x`, then `f - g` is meromorphic at `x` if and only if `g` is meromorphic
at `x`.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicAt_sub_iff_meromorphicAt₁
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : MeromorphicAt (f - g) x ↔ MeromorphicAt g x

docstring:
`f : X ⟶ Y` is an epimorphism iff for all `Z`, composition of morphisms `Y ⟶ Z` with `f`
is injective.
name: CategoryTheory.epi_iff_forall_injective
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.Epi f ↔ ∀ (Z : C), Function.Injective (β := X ⟶ Z) fun (g : Y ⟶ Z) => CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g

docstring: If `v` is an additive valuation on a division ring then `v(x) = ⊤` iff `x = 0`.
name: AddValuation.top_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [DivisionRing K] {Γ₀ : Type u_4} [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] [Nontrivial Γ₀] (v : AddValuation K Γ₀) {x : K} : Eq.{u_4 + 1} (α := Γ₀) (v x : Γ₀) (⊤ : Γ₀) ↔ x = 0

docstring:
Let `X` be a topological space, `𝔖` a covering of `X` by compact subsets,
`α` a uniform space, `F : ι → (X → α)` a family equicontinuous on each `K ∈ 𝔖`, and `ℱ` a filter
on `ι`. Then, `F` tends to `f : X → α` along `ℱ` *uniformly on each `K ∈ 𝔖`* iff it tends to `f`
*pointwise* along `ℱ`.

This is a specialization of `EquicontinuousOn.tendsto_uniformOnFun_iff_pi'` to the case
where `𝔖` covers `X`.
name: EquicontinuousOn.tendsto_uniformOnFun_iff_pi
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {𝔖 : Set (Set X)} (𝔖_compact : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, IsCompact K) (𝔖_covers : ⋃₀ 𝔖 = Set.univ) (F_eqcont : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, EquicontinuousOn F K) (ℱ : Filter ι) (f : X → α) : Filter.Tendsto (β := UniformOnFun X α 𝔖) (⇑(UniformOnFun.ofFun 𝔖) ∘ F : ι → UniformOnFun X α 𝔖) ℱ (nhds ((UniformOnFun.ofFun 𝔖) f) : Filter (UniformOnFun X α 𝔖)) ↔ Filter.Tendsto F ℱ (nhds f)

docstring: An object `J` is injective iff every morphism into `J` can be obtained by extending a monomorphism.
name: CategoryTheory.Injective.factors
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} : ∀ {inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C} {J : C} [self : CategoryTheory.Injective.{v₁, u₁} J] {X Y : C} (g : X ⟶ J) (f : X ⟶ Y) [CategoryTheory.Mono f], ∃ h, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f h = g

docstring:
An oriented angle is not zero or `π` if and only if the three points are affinely
independent.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_ne_zero_and_ne_pi_iff_affineIndependent
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ 0 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ↑Real.pi ↔ AffineIndependent ℝ ![p₁, p₂, p₃]

docstring: The quotient of a ring by an ideal is a field iff the ideal is maximal.
name: Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient
statement_text: {R : Type u_4} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) : I.IsMaximal ↔ IsField.{u_4} (R ⧸ I)

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `[a, +∞)` if and only if it contains an interval `[a, u]`
with `a < u`.
name: mem_nhdsGE_iff_exists_Icc_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ici a) ↔ ∃ u, a < u ∧ Set.Icc a u ⊆ s

docstring: The oscillation within `D` of `f` at `x ∈ D` is 0 if and only if `ContinuousWithinAt f D x`.
name: OscillationWithin.eq_zero_iff_continuousWithinAt
statement_text: {E : Type u} {F : Type v} [PseudoEMetricSpace F] [TopologicalSpace E] (f : E → F) {D : Set E} {x : E} (xD : x ∈ D) : oscillationWithin f D x = 0 ↔ ContinuousWithinAt f D x

docstring:
The image of a cone `F` under an injective linear map is a face of the
image of another cone `C` if and only if `F` is a face of `C`.
name: PointedCone.isFaceOf_map_iff
