statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {C : PointedCone R M} {F : PointedCone R M} [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R N] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (hf : Function.Injective.{u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} (α := M) (β := N) ⇑f) : (PointedCone.map f F).IsFaceOf (PointedCone.map f C) ↔ F.IsFaceOf C

docstring:
Two finite-dimensional topological vector spaces over a complete normed field are continuously
linearly equivalent if and only if they have the same (finite) dimension.
name: FiniteDimensional.nonempty_continuousLinearEquiv_iff_finrank_eq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type v} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace E] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 E] {F : Type w} [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] [T2Space E] [T2Space F] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F] : Nonempty (E ≃L[𝕜] F) ↔ Module.finrank 𝕜 E = Module.finrank 𝕜 F

docstring:
If `w : TwoSquare T L R B` is a Guitart exact square, and `E` is a right extension
of `F` along `B`, then `E` is a pointwise right Kan extension of `F` along `B` at
`R.obj X₃` iff `E.compTwoSquare w` is a pointwise right Kan extension
of `L ⋙ F` along `T` at `X₃`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.RightExtension.isPointwiseRightKanExtensionAtCompTwoSquareEquiv
statement_text: {C₁ : Type u₁} {C₂ : Type u₂} {C₃ : Type u₃} {C₄ : Type u₄} {D : Type u₅} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} C₂] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C₃] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₄, u₄} C₄] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₅, u₅} D] {T : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C₁ C₂} {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} C₁ C₃} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₄, u₂, u₄} C₂ C₄} {B : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₄, u₃, u₄} C₃ C₄} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₅, u₃, u₅} C₃ D} (E : B.RightExtension F) (w : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare T L R B) (X₂ : C₂) [(w.structuredArrowDownwards X₂).Initial] : (E.compTwoSquare w).IsPointwiseRightKanExtensionAt X₂ ≃ E.IsPointwiseRightKanExtensionAt (R.obj X₂)

docstring:
Dirac delta measures at two points are different if and only if there is a measurable set
containing one of the points but not the other.
name: MeasureTheory.dirac_ne_dirac_iff_exists_measurableSet
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace α] {x : α} {y : α} : Ne (α := MeasureTheory.Measure α) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac y) ↔ ∃ A, MeasurableSet A ∧ x ∈ A ∧ y ∉ A

docstring:
`range f` is invariant under `T` if and only if `f ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ f = T ∘ₗ f`,
for idempotent `f`.
name: LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.range_mem_invtSubmodule_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module R E] {T : E →ₗ[R] E} {f : E →ₗ[R] E} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : f.range ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T ↔ f ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ f = T ∘ₗ f

docstring: A function is `C^(n + 1)` on a domain iff locally, it has a derivative which is `C^n`.
name: contDiffOn_succ_iff_hasFDerivWithinAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hn : n ≠ ↑⊤) : ContDiffOn 𝕜 (n + 1) f s ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ u ∈ nhdsWithin x (insert x s), (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f u) ∧ ∃ f', (∀ x ∈ u, HasFDerivWithinAt f (f' x) u x) ∧ ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f' u

docstring: Sets of subtype are Lindelöf iff the image under a coercion is.
name: Subtype.isLindelof_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {p : X → Prop} {s : Set { x : X // p x }} : IsLindelof s ↔ IsLindelof (Subtype.val (p := fun x => p x) '' s)

docstring: A polynomial lifts if and only if it can be lifted to a polynomial of the same degree.
name: Polynomial.exists_degree_eq_of_mem_lifts
statement_text: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {S : Type v} [Semiring S] {f : R →+* S} {p : Polynomial S} (hlifts : p ∈ Polynomial.lifts f) : ∃ q, Polynomial.map f q = p ∧ q.degree = p.degree

docstring:
`n + 2` points are affinely independent if and only if their
`vectorSpan` does not have dimension at most `n`.
name: affineIndependent_iff_not_finrank_vectorSpan_le
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] [Fintype ι] (p : ι → P) {n : ℕ} (hc : Fintype.card ι = n + 2) : AffineIndependent k p ↔ ¬Module.finrank.{u_1, u_2} k ↥(vectorSpan k (Set.range p)) ≤ n

docstring:
A function is `C^(n + 1)` on a domain iff locally, it has a derivative which is `C^n`
(and moreover the function is analytic when `n = ω`).
name: contDiffWithinAt_succ_iff_hasFDerivWithinAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {x : E} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hn : n ≠ ↑⊤) : ContDiffWithinAt 𝕜 (n + 1) f s x ↔ ∃ u ∈ nhdsWithin x (insert x s), (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f u) ∧ ∃ f', (∀ x ∈ u, HasFDerivWithinAt f (f' x) u x) ∧ ContDiffWithinAt 𝕜 n f' u x

docstring: In a first-countable space, a set is countably compact iff it is sequentially compact.
name: isCountablyCompact_iff_isSeqCompact
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace E] {A : Set E} [FirstCountableTopology E] : IsCountablyCompact A ↔ IsSeqCompact A

docstring:
A group `G` acts properly on a T2 topological space `X` if and only if for all ultrafilters
`𝒰` on `X × G`, if `𝒰` converges to `(x₁, x₂)` along the map `(g, x) ↦ (g • x, x)`,
then there exists `g : G` such that `𝒰.fst` converges to `g`.
name: properSMul_iff_continuousSMul_ultrafilter_tendsto_t2
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] : ProperSMul G X ↔ ContinuousSMul G X ∧ ∀ (𝒰 : Ultrafilter (G × X)) (x₁ x₂ : X), Filter.Tendsto (fun gx => (gx.1 • gx.2, gx.2)) (↑𝒰) (nhds (x₁, x₂)) → ∃ g, Filter.Tendsto Prod.fst (↑𝒰) (nhds g)

docstring:
A topological space is perfectly normal iff every closed set is the zero set of a continuous
function taking values in the unit interval.
name: perfectlyNormalSpace_iff_forall_isClosed_preimage_zero
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : PerfectlyNormalSpace X ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), IsClosed s → ∃ f, s = Set.preimage (β := ℝ) ⇑f {0} ∧ ∀ (x : X), Membership.mem (α := ℝ) (Set.Icc 0 1) (f x : ℝ)

docstring:
If the submodule `P` has a finite basis,
`x ∈ P` iff it is a linear combination of basis vectors.
name: Module.Basis.mem_submodule_iff'
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Fintype ι] {P : Submodule R M} (b : Module.Basis.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι R ↥P) {x : M} : x ∈ P ↔ ∃ c, x = ∑ i : ι, HSMul.hSMul (β := M) (c i) ↑(b i)

docstring:
`s ∈ ∂ 𝒜` iff `s` is exactly one element less than something from `𝒜`.

See also `Finset.mem_shadow_iff_exists_sdiff`.
name: Finset.mem_shadow_iff_exists_mem_card_add_one
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} : t ∈ 𝒜.shadow ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, t ⊆ s ∧ s.card = t.card + 1

docstring:
A multiple of a nonzero vector is in the same ray as that vector if and only if that multiple
is positive.
name: sameRay_smul_left_iff_of_ne
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] {v : M} (hv : v ≠ 0) {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) : SameRay R (r • v) v ↔ 0 < r

docstring:
Three points are collinear if and only if the first or third point equals the second or
the sine of the angle between three points is zero.
name: EuclideanGeometry.collinear_iff_eq_or_eq_or_sin_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : Collinear ℝ (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃} ↔ p₁ = p₂ ∨ p₃ = p₂ ∨ Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃) = 0

docstring: Two points in a projective space are independent if and only if the points are not equal.
name: Projectivization.independent_pair_iff_ne
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (u : Projectivization K V) (v : Projectivization K V) : Projectivization.Independent ![u, v] ↔ u ≠ v

docstring: The range of a linear map is FG if and only if the kernel is CoFG.
name: Submodule.range_fg_iff_ker_cofg
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R N] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} : f.range.FG ↔ f.ker.CoFG

docstring:
Let `L / K` be a normal field extension. For any two elements `x` and `y` in `L`, `y` is a
conjugate root of `x` if and only if there exists a `K`-automorphism `σ : Gal(L/K)` such
that `σ y = x`.
name: isConjRoot_iff_exists_algEquiv
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Normal K L] {x : L} {y : L} : IsConjRoot K x y ↔ ∃ σ, σ y = x

docstring:
If `E` is an algebraic closure of `F`, then `F` is perfect if and only if `E / F` is
separable.
name: perfectField_iff_isSeparable_algebraicClosure
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [IsAlgClosure F E] : PerfectField F ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable F E

docstring:
`Fork.ofι ι w` is a limit cone in `Cᵒᵖ` if and only if `Cofork.ofπ ι.unop w.unop` in `C` is
a colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitOfιEquivIsColimitUnop
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : Cᵒᵖ} {Y : Cᵒᵖ} {P : Cᵒᵖ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} (ι : P ⟶ X) (ι' : P ⟶ X) (w : Eq.{v₁ + 1} (α := P ⟶ Y) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ι f) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ι g)) (w' : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f.unop ι'.unop = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g.unop ι'.unop) (h : ι = ι') : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.{0, v₁, 0, u₁} (C := Cᵒᵖ) (F := CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair f g) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι ι w) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.ofπ ι'.unop w')

docstring:
A filter `l` with the countable intersection property is disjoint with the neighborhood
filter of a Lindelöf set if and only if it is disjoint with the neighborhood filter of each point
of this set.
name: IsLindelof.disjoint_nhdsSet_right
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter X} [CountableInterFilter l] (hs : IsLindelof s) : Disjoint l (nhdsSet s) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, Disjoint l (nhds x)

docstring:
A matrix is `s` times a doubly stochastic matrix iff all entries are nonnegative, and all row and
column sums are equal to `s`.

This lemma is useful for the proof of Birkhoff's theorem - in particular because it allows scaling
by nonnegative factors rather than positive ones only.
name: exists_mem_doublyStochastic_eq_smul_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Semifield R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Matrix n n R} {s : R} (hs : 0 ≤ s) : (∃ M', Membership.mem (γ := Submonoid (Matrix n n R)) (doublyStochastic R n) M' ∧ M = s • M') ↔ (∀ (i j : n), 0 ≤ M i j) ∧ (∀ (i : n), ∑ j : n, M i j = s) ∧ ∀ (j : n), ∑ i : n, M i j = s

docstring:
A finite number of random variables are independent if and only if their joint characteristic
function is equal to the product of the characteristic functions.
This is `iIndepFun_iff_charFunDual_pi` for `WithLp`. See `iIndepFun_iff_charFun_pi` for the
Hilbert space version.
name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_iff_charFunDual_pi'
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (p : ENNReal) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {E : ι → Type u_3} {mE : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (E i)} [(i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), CompleteSpace.{u_3} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), BorelSpace.{u_3} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), SecondCountableTopology.{u_3} (E i)] {X : (i : ι) → Ω → E i} [(i : ι) → NormedSpace ℝ (E i)] [DecidableEq ι] (hX : ∀ (i : ι), AEMeasurable (X i) P) : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (β := E) X P ↔ ∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ (WithLp p ((x : ι) → E x))), MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace p ((x : ι) → E x)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp p fun x => X x ω) P) L = ∏ i : ι, MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := mE i) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) P) (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) (↑(ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E))) (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ E i)))

docstring:
Two multiplicative characters on a monoid whose unit group is generated by `g`
are equal if and only if they agree on `g`.
name: MulChar.eq_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoid R] {R' : Type u_3} [CommMonoidWithZero R'] {g : Rˣ} (hg : ∀ (x : Rˣ), Membership.mem (γ := Subgroup Rˣ) (Subgroup.zpowers g) x) (χ₁ : MulChar R R') (χ₂ : MulChar R R') : χ₁ = χ₂ ↔ Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := R') (χ₁ ↑g : R') (χ₂ ↑g : R')

docstring:
The sum of a locally finite collection of sections is `C^k` iff each section is.
Version at a point within a set.
name: ContMDiffWithinAt.sum_section_of_locallyFinite
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {V : M → Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace (Bundle.TotalSpace F V)] [(x : M) → TopologicalSpace (V x)] [FiberBundle F V] [(x : M) → AddCommGroup (V x)] [(x : M) → _root_.Module.{u_1, u_6} 𝕜 (V x)] [VectorBundle 𝕜 F V] {u : Set M} {x₀ : M} {ι : Type u_7} {t : ι → (x : M) → V x} (ht : LocallyFinite.{u_7, u_4} (X := M) fun (i : ι) => {x | t i x ≠ 0}) (ht' : ∀ (i : ι), ContMDiffWithinAt I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n (fun x => ⟨x, t i x⟩) u x₀) : ContMDiffWithinAt I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n (fun x => ⟨x, ∑' (i : ι), t i x⟩) u x₀

docstring: Functions are harmonic iff their compositions with continuous linear equivalences are harmonic.
name: InnerProductSpace.harmonicAt_comp_CLE_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {G : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] {f : E → F} {x : E} (l : F ≃L[ℝ] G) : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicAt.{u_1, u_3} (F := G) (⇑l ∘ f) x ↔ InnerProductSpace.HarmonicAt f x

docstring: A ring homomorphism is étale if and only if it is standard smooth of relative dimension `0`.
name: RingHom.etale_iff_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_zero
statement_text: {R : Type u} {S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {f : R →+* S} : f.Etale ↔ RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 f

docstring: A non-unital subsemiring `S` includes `closure s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: NonUnitalSubsemiring.closure_le
statement_text: {R : Type u} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {s : Set R} {t : NonUnitalSubsemiring R} : NonUnitalSubsemiring.closure s ≤ t ↔ s ⊆ ↑t

docstring: The oriented angle between two vectors is `π` if and only if the unoriented angle is `π`.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_pi_iff_angle_eq_pi
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y = ↑Real.pi ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = Real.pi

docstring:
Two nonzero elements of a `UniqueFactorizationMonoid` are associated iff they have the
same `multiplicity` at every prime.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.associated_iff_multiplicity_eq
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [CommMonoidWithZero R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {a : R} {b : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : Associated a b ↔ ∀ (p : R), Prime p → multiplicity p a = multiplicity p b

docstring: A functor has a colimit iff there exists a lub.
name: Preorder.hasColimit_iff_hasLUB
statement_text: {C : Type u} [Preorder C] {J : Type u'} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u'} J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, u, u', u} J C) : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimit F ↔ ∃ x, IsLUB (Set.range F.obj) x

docstring:
Over a characteristic-zero division ring, the centroids given by
two subsets of the points of a simplex are equal if and only if those
faces are given by the same subset of points.
name: Affine.Simplex.centroid_eq_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} (s : Affine.Simplex k P n) {fs₁ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {fs₂ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m₁ : ℕ} {m₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : fs₁.card = m₁ + 1) (h₂ : fs₂.card = m₂ + 1) : Finset.centroid k fs₁ s.points = Finset.centroid k fs₂ s.points ↔ fs₁ = fs₂

docstring:
The dynamical entourage associated to a transformation `T`, entourage `U` and time `n`
is the entourage where `x` and `y` are close iff `T^[k] x` and `T^[k] y` are `U`-close
for all `k < n`, i.e. iff they are `U`-close up to time `n`.
name: Dynamics.dynEntourage
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} (T : X → X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) : SetRel X X

docstring:
The Fourier integral is well defined iff the function is integrable. Version with a general
continuous bilinear function `L`. For the specialization to the inner product in an inner product
space, see `Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff`.
name: Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff'
statement_text: {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {V : Type u_4} {W : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] [MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure V} {f : V → E} (L : ContinuousLinearMap.{0, 0, u_4, u_5} (RingHom.id ℝ) V (W →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (w : W) : MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_3, u_4} (ε := E) (fun v => HSMul.hSMul (α := Circle) (Real.fourierChar (-(L v : W →L[ℝ] ℝ) w) : Circle) (f v)) μ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ

docstring: Three points are affinely independent if and only if they are not collinear.
name: affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : AffineIndependent k ![p₁, p₂, p₃] ↔ ¬Collinear k (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃}

docstring:
A family of points in a projective space is independent if and only if the representative
vectors determined by the family are linearly independent.
name: Projectivization.independent_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {f : ι → Projectivization K V} : Projectivization.Independent f ↔ LinearIndependent K (Projectivization.rep ∘ f)

docstring: Two measures on a countable space are equal if and only if they agree on singletons.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.ext_iff_singleton
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace α] [Countable α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} : μ = ν ↔ ∀ (a : α), Eq (α := ENNReal) (μ {a} : ENNReal) (ν {a} : ENNReal)

docstring:
A commutative algebra is finitely generated if and only if it is a quotient of a polynomial ring
in `n` variables.
name: Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''
statement_text: {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] : Algebra.FiniteType R S ↔ ∃ n f, Function.Surjective.{uR + 1, uS + 1} (α := MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (β := S) ⇑f

docstring: For a non-trivial space, the affine span of a set is `⊤` iff its vector span is `⊤`.
name: AffineSubspace.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_vectorSpan_eq_top_of_nontrivial
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) (P : Type u_3) [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} [Nontrivial P] : Eq (α := AffineSubspace k P) (affineSpan k s) ⊤ ↔ Eq (α := Submodule k V) (vectorSpan k s) ⊤

docstring: `-2` is a square modulo an odd prime `p` iff `p` is congruent to `1` or `3` mod `8`.
name: ZMod.exists_sq_eq_neg_two_iff
statement_text: {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hp : p ≠ 2) : IsSquare (-2) ↔ p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 3

docstring: A function to 𝕜 is meromorphic in normal form on `U` iff its inverse is.
name: meromorphicNFOn_inv
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {U : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} : MeromorphicNFOn f⁻¹ U ↔ MeromorphicNFOn f U

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(-∞, a]` if and only if it contains an interval
`[u, a]` with `u < a`.
name: mem_nhdsLE_iff_exists_Icc_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMinOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Iic a) ↔ ∃ u < a, Set.Icc u a ⊆ s

docstring:
The oriented angle between three points is zero if and only if one of the first and third
points is weakly between the other two.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_zero_iff_wbtw
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0 ↔ Wbtw ℝ p₂ p₁ p₃ ∨ Wbtw ℝ p₂ p₃ p₁

docstring: `t : Cocone F` is a colimit cocone if and only if `t.op : Cone F.op` is a limit cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isColimitEquivIsLimitOp
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v, u₁, u} J C} {t : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F} : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit t ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit t.op

docstring: A point is its own reflection if and only if it is in the subspace.
name: Submodule.reflection_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E) : K.reflection x = x ↔ x ∈ K

docstring:
An action is pretransitive if and only if the quotient by `MulAction.orbitRel` is a
subsingleton.
name: MulAction.pretransitive_iff_subsingleton_quotient
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [Group G] [MulAction G α] : MulAction.IsPretransitive G α ↔ Subsingleton.{u_2 + 1} (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G α)

docstring:
A map `f : X → Y` is proper if and only if it is continuous and the map
`(Prod.map f id : X × Ultrafilter X → Y × Ultrafilter X)` is closed. This is stronger than
`isProperMap_iff_universally_closed` since it shows that there's only one space to check to get
properness, but in most cases it doesn't matter.
name: isProperMap_iff_isClosedMap_ultrafilter
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsProperMap f ↔ Continuous f ∧ IsClosedMap (X := X × Ultrafilter X) (Prod.map f id)

docstring:
If `g` is meromorphic at `x`, then `f + g` is meromorphic at `x` if and only if `f` is meromorphic
at `x`.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicAt_add_iff_meromorphicAt₂
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (hg : MeromorphicAt g x) : MeromorphicAt (f + g) x ↔ MeromorphicAt f x

docstring:
Two complementary submodules are topological complements if and only if the linear equivalence
`Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl` is continuous in the inverse direction.
name: Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_iff_continuous_symm_prodEquivOfIsCompl
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {M : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} {q : Submodule R M} [IsTopologicalAddGroup M] (h : IsCompl p q) : Submodule.IsTopCompl p q ↔ Continuous (X := M) (Y := ↥p × ↥q) ⇑(p.prodEquivOfIsCompl q h).symm

docstring:
Two finite kernels `κ` and `η` are `μ`-a.e. equal iff the composition-products `μ ⊗ₘ κ`
and `μ ⊗ₘ η` are equal.
name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.compProd_eq_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} {η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η] : μ.compProd κ = μ.compProd η ↔ ⇑κ =ᵐ[μ] ⇑η

docstring:
`C` is filtered if and only if for every functor `F : J ⥤ C` from a finite category there is
some `X : C` such that `lim Hom(F·, X)` is nonempty.
name: CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.iff_nonempty_limit
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.{v, u} C ↔ ∀ {J : Type v} [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.SmallCategory J] [CategoryTheory.FinCategory J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor J C), ∃ X, Nonempty.{v + 1} (CategoryTheory.Limits.limit (F.op.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.yoneda X)))

docstring:
A morphism `f` in `Arrow V` is sent to `0` in `RightFreyd V` if and only if there
exists a right homotopy between `f` and `0`.
name: CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.quotient_map_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} V] {u : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {v : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} (f : u ⟶ v) : CategoryTheory.Functor.map (CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.quotient V) f = 0 ↔ Nonempty.{v_1 + 1} (CategoryTheory.Arrow.RightHomotopy f 0)

docstring:
Two maps `f : M →+ N` and `g : N →+ P` are exact if and only if the induced maps
`AddMonoidHom.range f → N → AddMonoidHom.range g` are exact.
name: Function.Exact.iff_addMonoidHom_rangeRestrict
statement_text: {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} {P : Type u_6} [AddGroup M] [AddGroup N] [AddGroup P] {f : M →+ N} {g : N →+ P} : Function.Exact.{u_2, u_4, u_6} (M := M) (N := N) (P := P) ⇑f ⇑g ↔ Function.Exact.{u_4, u_4, u_6} (M := ↥f.range) (N := N) (P := ↥g.range) ⇑f.range.subtype ⇑g.rangeRestrict

docstring: If `M` is a `CanonicallyOrderedAddCommMonoid`, then `weight f` is zero iff `f = 0`.
name: Finsupp.weight_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
statement_text: {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (w : σ → M) [Finsupp.NonTorsionWeight ℕ w] {f : σ →₀ ℕ} : (Finsupp.weight w) f = 0 ↔ f = 0

docstring:
An `R`-module `M` is faithfully flat iff it is flat and for all linear maps `f`, the map
`id ⊗ f = 0`, if and only if `f = 0`.
name: Module.FaithfullyFlat.iff_zero_iff_rTensor_zero
statement_text: (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.FaithfullyFlat R M ↔ Module.Flat R M ∧ ∀ {N : Type (max u v)} [inst_3 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_4 : _root_.Module R N] {N' : Type (max u v)} [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), LinearMap.rTensor M f = 0 ↔ f = 0

docstring:
Given types with multiplications `M, N`, the product of two congruence relations `c` on `M` and
`d` on `N`: `(x₁, x₂), (y₁, y₂) ∈ M × N` are related by `c.prod d` iff `x₁` is related to `y₁`
by `c` and `x₂` is related to `y₂` by `d`.
name: Con.prod
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} [Mul M] [Mul N] (c : Con M) (d : Con N) : Con (M × N)

docstring:
The **Cauchy-Riemann Equation**: A real-differentiable function `f` on `ℂ` is complex-differentiable
at `x` within `s` iff the derivative `fderivWithin ℝ f s x` maps `I` to
`I • (fderivWithin ℝ f s x) 1`.
name: differentiableWithinAt_complex_iff_differentiableWithinAt_real
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {f : ℂ → E} {x : ℂ} {s : Set ℂ} (hs : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ s x) : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ f s x ↔ DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ f s x ∧ (fderivWithin ℝ f s x) Complex.I = HSMul.hSMul (β := E) Complex.I ((fderivWithin ℝ f s x) 1 : E)

docstring:
An upper block-triangular matrix is invertible iff both elements of its diagonal are.

This is a propositional form of `Matrix.fromBlocksZero₂₁InvertibleEquiv`.
name: Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁
statement_text: {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {α : Type u_4} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing α] {A : Matrix m m α} {B : Matrix m n α} {D : Matrix n n α} : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A B 0 D) ↔ IsUnit A ∧ IsUnit D

docstring:
The `affineSpan` of a finite affinely independent family is `⊤` iff the
family's cardinality is one more than that of the finite-dimensional space.
name: AffineIndependent.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_card_eq_finrank_add_one
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] [FiniteDimensional k V] [Fintype ι] {p : ι → P} (hi : AffineIndependent k p) : Eq (α := AffineSubspace k P) (affineSpan k (Set.range p)) ⊤ ↔ Fintype.card ι = Module.finrank k V + 1

docstring:
A divisor `d` of `n` belongs to the conductor set of `χ` if and only if the conductor of `χ`
divides `d`.
name: DirichletCharacter.mem_conductorSet_iff_conductor_dvd
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero R] {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter R n) {d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hd : d ∣ n) : d ∈ χ.conductorSet ↔ χ.conductor ∣ d

docstring:
If `2` is invertible, the polynomial `X ^ 2 - b * X - a` has a root if and only if the
discriminant is a square.
name: QuadraticAlgebra.exists_sq_eq_iff_isSquare_discr
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] {a : R} {b : R} : (∃ r, r ^ 2 = a + b * r) ↔ IsSquare (QuadraticAlgebra.discr a b)

docstring:
Let `X` be a topological space, `𝔖` a covering of `X` by compact subsets, and
`α` a uniform space. An equicontinuous subset of `X → α` is closed in the topology of uniform
convergence on all `K ∈ 𝔖` iff it is closed in the topology of pointwise convergence.

This is a specialization of `EquicontinuousOn.isClosed_range_pi_of_uniformOnFun'` to the case where
`𝔖` covers `X`.
name: EquicontinuousOn.isClosed_range_uniformOnFun_iff_pi
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {𝔖 : Set (Set X)} (𝔖_compact : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, IsCompact K) (𝔖_covers : ⋃₀ 𝔖 = Set.univ) (F_eqcont : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, EquicontinuousOn F K) : IsClosed (X := UniformOnFun X α 𝔖) (Set.range (⇑(UniformOnFun.ofFun 𝔖) ∘ F)) ↔ IsClosed (Set.range F)

docstring:
For a local ring with finite Krull dimension, a prime ideal has height equal to the Krull
dimension if and only if it is the maximal ideal.
name: Ideal.height_eq_ringKrullDim_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [FiniteRingKrullDim R] [IsLocalRing R] {I : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] : ↑I.height = ringKrullDim R ↔ I = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R

docstring: In a monoid whose only unit is `1`, a product is equal to `1` iff all factors are `1`.
name: Finset.prod_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [CommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} [Subsingleton.{u_4 + 1} Mˣ] : ∏ i ∈ s, f i = 1 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 1

docstring: The element `0` is regular if and only if `R` is trivial.
name: isRegular_iff_subsingleton
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [MulZeroClass R] : IsRegular 0 ↔ Subsingleton R

docstring: An object is not initial if and only if its fiber is nonempty.
name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u₂, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u₂, w, u₁, w + 1} C FintypeCat) [CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.{u₁, u₂} C] [CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.FiberFunctor F] (X : C) : (∀ (a : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.{u₂, u₁} X), False) ↔ Nonempty.{w + 1} (F.obj X).obj

docstring:
Let `{ fᵢ : Xᵢ ⟶ S }` be a family of morphisms. If `∐ᵢ Xᵢ` is a universal coproduct
and the presheaf `F` preserves products, then `F` is a sheaf for the single object covering
`{ ∐ᵢ Xᵢ ⟶ S }` if and only if it is a sheaf for `{ fᵢ : Xᵢ ⟶ S }ᵢ`.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.isSheafFor_sigmaDesc_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {S : C} {ι : Type u_3} {X : ι → C} (f : (i : ι) → X i ⟶ S) [(CategoryTheory.Presieve.ofArrows X f).HasPairwisePullbacks] {c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.{u_3, v_1, u_1} X} (hc : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c) (hc' : CategoryTheory.IsUniversalColimit c) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullback (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.IsColimit.desc hc f) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.IsColimit.desc hc f)] [∀ (i : ι), CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullback (f i) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.IsColimit.desc hc f)] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, u_4, u_1, u_4 + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type u_4)) [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimit.{u_3, u_3, v_1, u_4, u_1, u_4 + 1} (J := CategoryTheory.Discrete ι) (CategoryTheory.Discrete.functor fun i => Opposite.op (X i)) F] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimit.{u_3, u_3, v_1, u_4, u_1, u_4 + 1} (J := CategoryTheory.Discrete (ι × ι)) (CategoryTheory.Discrete.functor fun ij => Opposite.op (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback (X := X ij.1) (Y := X ij.2) (f ij.1) (f ij.2))) F] : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor F (CategoryTheory.Presieve.singleton (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.IsColimit.desc hc f)) ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor F (CategoryTheory.Presieve.ofArrows X f)

docstring: `p` is `f.symm` invariant if and only if `p ≤ p.map f`.
name: Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule_symm_iff_le_map
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {f : M ≃ₗ[R] M} {p : Submodule R M} : p ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule ↑f.symm ↔ p ≤ Submodule.map (↑f) p

docstring:
Two maps `f : M → N` and `g : N → P` are exact if and only if the induced maps
`Set.range f → N → Set.range g` are exact.

Note that if you already have an instance `[Zero (Set.range g)]` (which is unlikely) this lemma
may not apply if the zero of `Set.range g` is not definitionally equal to `⟨0, hg⟩`.
name: Function.Exact.iff_rangeFactorization
statement_text: {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} {P : Type u_6} {f : M → N} {g : N → P} [Zero P] (hg : 0 ∈ Set.range g) : Function.Exact f g ↔ Function.Exact (M := { x : N // x ∈ Set.range f }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range f)) (Set.rangeFactorization g)

docstring:
`R` is integrally closed iff all integral elements of its fraction field `K`
are also elements of `R`.
name: isIntegrallyClosed_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (K : Type u_4) [CommRing K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] : IsIntegrallyClosed R ↔ ∀ {x : K}, IsIntegral R x → ∃ y, (algebraMap R K) y = x

docstring:
A property of objects `P.op` is closed under quotients iff `P` is closed under
subobjects, since epimorphisms in `Cᵒᵖ` correspond to monomorphisms in `C`.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isClosedUnderQuotients_op_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} C) : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderQuotients.{v, u} P.op ↔ P.IsClosedUnderSubobjects

docstring: The discrete Fourier transform of `Φ` is odd if and only if `Φ` itself is.
name: ZMod.dft_odd_iff
statement_text: {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {Φ : ZMod N → ℂ} : Function.Odd (α := ZMod N) (β := ℂ) (ZMod.dft Φ) ↔ Function.Odd Φ

docstring: Convex hull of `s` is bounded if and only if `s` is bounded.
name: isBounded_convexHull
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {s : Set E} : Bornology.IsBounded.{u_1} (α := E) ((convexHull ℝ) s) ↔ Bornology.IsBounded s

docstring:
The characteristic function of a measure is a product of
characteristic functions if and only if it is a product measure.
This is the version for Hilbert spaces, see `charFunDual_eq_prod_iff`
for the Banach space version.
name: MeasureTheory.charFun_eq_prod_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_4} {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {mF : MeasurableSpace F} [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology E] [SecondCountableTopology F] [BorelSpace E] [BorelSpace F] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure F} {ξ : MeasureTheory.Measure (E × F)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ξ] : (∀ (t : WithLp 2 (E × F)), MeasureTheory.charFun (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace 2 (E × F)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (WithLp.toLp 2) ξ) t = MeasureTheory.charFun μ t.ofLp.1 * MeasureTheory.charFun ν t.ofLp.2) ↔ ξ = μ.prod ν

docstring: `f □ g` lifts against `h` if and only if `f` lifts against `g ⋔ h`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_mk_iff'
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u} C] {A : C} {B : C} {K : C} {L : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {f : A ⟶ B} {g : K ⟶ L} {h : X ⟶ Y} : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk f)).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk g)).hom h ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty f ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pullbackHom (Opposite.op (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk g))).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk h)).hom

docstring:
If a family is convex independent, a point in the family is in the convex hull of some of the
points given by a subset of the index type if and only if the point's index is in this subset.
name: ConvexIndependent.mem_convexHull_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] {p : ι → E} (hc : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p) (s : Set ι) (i : ι) : Membership.mem (γ := Set E) ((convexHull 𝕜) (p '' s) : Set E) (p i) ↔ i ∈ s

docstring:
A partial function `f` is partial recursive if and only if it is recursive in
every partial function `g`.
name: partrec_iff_forall_turingReducible
statement_text: {f : ℕ →. ℕ} : Partrec f ↔ ∀ (g : ℕ →. ℕ), TuringReducible f g

docstring:
A non-unital normed ring `R` has summable geometric series if and only if every element of
in the open unit ball is quasiregular.
name: hasSummableGeomSeries_iff_isQuasiregular
statement_text: {R : Type u_4} [NonUnitalNormedRing R] : HasSummableGeomSeries R ↔ ∀ ⦃x : R⦄, ‖x‖ < 1 → IsQuasiregular x

docstring: `lift ⟨u, h⟩` is surjective iff `u` generates `A` as an `R`-algebra.
name: QuadraticAlgebra.lift_surjective_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} {a : R} {b : R} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_3} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {u : A} (h : u * u = a • 1 + b • u) : Function.Surjective.{u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} (α := QuadraticAlgebra R a b) (β := A) ⇑(QuadraticAlgebra.lift ⟨u, h⟩ : QuadraticAlgebra R a b →ₐ[R] A) ↔ Eq (α := Subalgebra R A) R[u] ⊤

docstring:
If `f` is meromorphic function on `ℝ` or `ℂ`, then there exists a point where a meromorphic function
`f` has finite order iff `f` has finite order at every point.
name: Meromorphic.exists_meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_forall
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : Meromorphic f) : (∃ u, meromorphicOrderAt f u ≠ ⊤) ↔ ∀ (u : 𝕜), meromorphicOrderAt f u ≠ ⊤

docstring: A sum is finite iff all summands are finite.
name: ENNReal.sum_lt_top
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ENNReal} : LT.lt (α := ENNReal) (∑ a ∈ s, f a) ⊤ ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, f a < ⊤

docstring: Two vectors with zero angle between them are equal if and only if they have equal norms.
name: Orientation.eq_iff_norm_eq_of_oangle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (h : o.oangle x y = 0) : x = y ↔ ‖x‖ = ‖y‖

docstring:
Given that the bottom square is a pullback, the pasted square is a pullback iff the top
square is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.pasteVertIsPullbackEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X₁ : C} {X₂ : C} {X₃ : C} {Y₁ : C} {f₁ : X₂ ⟶ X₁} {f₂ : X₃ ⟶ X₂} {i₁ : Y₁ ⟶ X₁} {t₁ : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone i₁ f₁} {i₂ : t₁.pt ⟶ X₂} (t₂ : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone i₂ f₂) (hi₂ : i₂ = t₁.snd) (H : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit t₁) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (t₁.pasteVert t₂ hi₂) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit t₂

docstring: If A ≠ B and C ≠ B then ∠ABC = 0 if and only if (dist A C) = abs ((dist A B) - (dist B C)).
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_eq_abs_sub_dist_iff_angle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} (hp₁p₂ : p₁ ≠ p₂) (hp₃p₂ : p₃ ≠ p₂) : dist p₁ p₃ = |dist p₁ p₂ - dist p₃ p₂| ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0

docstring:
A sequence `f` with values in an additive topological group `R` is summable on the
residue class of `k` mod `m` if and only if `f (m*n + k)` is summable.
name: summable_indicator_mod_iff_summable
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalAddGroup R] (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) : Summable (Set.indicator {n | Eq (α := ZMod m) ↑n ↑k} f) ↔ Summable.{u_1, 0} (α := R) fun n => f (m * n + k)

docstring:
A bilinear form is positive semidefinite if and only if it is positive semidefinite
as a sesquilinear form.
name: LinearMap.BilinForm.isPosSemidef_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [LE R] {B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M} : B.IsPosSemidef ↔ LinearMap.IsPosSemidef B

docstring: If `h : X → Y` is a homeomorphism, `s` is σ-compact iff `h(s)` is.
name: Homeomorph.isSigmaCompact_image
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : IsSigmaCompact.{u_2} (X := Y) (⇑h '' s) ↔ IsSigmaCompact s

docstring: A graph is `n`-independent set free iff its complement is `n`-clique free.
name: SimpleGraph.cliqueFree_compl
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph α) {n : ℕ} : Gᶜ.CliqueFree n ↔ G.IndepSetFree n

docstring:
`t` is in the shadow of `𝒜` iff we can add an element to it so that the resulting finset is in
`𝒜`.
name: Finset.mem_shadow_iff_insert_mem
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} : t ∈ 𝒜.shadow ↔ ∃ a ∉ t, insert a t ∈ 𝒜

docstring:
Left multiplication is strictly monotone if and only if it is monotone and
left-cancellative.
name: mulLeftStrictMono_iff_mulLeftMono_and_isLeftCancelMul
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Mul α] [LinearOrder α] : MulLeftStrictMono α ↔ MulLeftMono α ∧ IsLeftCancelMul α

docstring:
A multifork `c : Multifork I` in the category of types is limit iff the
map `c.toSections : c.pt → I.sections` is a bijection.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork.isLimit_types_iff
statement_text: {J : CategoryTheory.Limits.MulticospanShape} {I : CategoryTheory.Limits.MulticospanIndex J (Type u)} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork I) : Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c) ↔ Function.Bijective c.toSections

docstring:
Two random variables are independent if and only if their joint characteristic function is equal
to the product of the characteristic functions. This is the version for Banach spaces, see
`indepFun_iff_charFun_prod` for the Hilbert space version.
name: ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_charFunDual_prod
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {mF : MeasurableSpace F} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [CompleteSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology F] {X : Ω → E} {Y : Ω → F} [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace E] (hX : AEMeasurable X P) (hY : AEMeasurable Y P) : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P ↔ ∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ (E × F)), MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := Prod.instMeasurableSpace) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) P) L = MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := mE) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map X P) (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E F)) * MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := mF) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map Y P) (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E F))

docstring: A module is semisimple iff it is generated by its simple submodules.
name: sSup_simples_eq_top_iff_isSemisimpleModule
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] {M : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Eq.{u_4 + 1} (α := Submodule R M) (sSup {m | IsSimpleModule.{u_2, u_4} R ↥m}) ⊤ ↔ IsSemisimpleModule R M

docstring:
Simple graphs contain a copy of a `completeBipartiteGraph α β` iff there exists a "left"
subset of `card α` vertices and a "right" subset of `card β` vertices such that every vertex
in the "left" subset is adjacent to every vertex in the "right" subset.
name: SimpleGraph.completeBipartiteGraph_isContained_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] : (completeBipartiteGraph α β).IsContained G ↔ ∃ left right, left.card = Fintype.card α ∧ right.card = Fintype.card β ∧ G.IsCompleteBetween ↑left ↑right

docstring: For normed groups, an operator is zero iff its norm vanishes.
name: NormedAddGroupHom.opNorm_zero_iff
statement_text: {V₁ : Type u_5} {V₂ : Type u_6} [NormedAddCommGroup V₁] [NormedAddCommGroup V₂] {f : NormedAddGroupHom V₁ V₂} : ‖f‖ = 0 ↔ f = 0

docstring:
A function is `C^(n + 1)` if and only if it is differentiable,
and its derivative (formulated in terms of `deriv`) is `C^n`.
name: contDiff_succ_iff_deriv
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : 𝕜 → F} : ContDiff 𝕜 (n + 1) f ↔ Differentiable 𝕜 f ∧ (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f Set.univ) ∧ ContDiff 𝕜 n (deriv f)

docstring:
If `2 ≠ 0` in the field `K`, `QuadraticAlgebra K a b` is a field iff `discr a b` is
not a square.
name: QuadraticAlgebra.isField_iff_not_isSquare_discr
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [NeZero 2] {a : K} {b : K} : IsField.{u_2} (QuadraticAlgebra K a b) ↔ ¬IsSquare (QuadraticAlgebra.discr a b)

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise scalar multiplication of `f` and
`g`, which monovary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ` monovary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: Monovary.sum_smul_comp_perm_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddCommMonoid β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Monovary f g) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := β) (∑ i : ι, f i • g (σ i)) (∑ i : ι, f i • g i) ↔ Monovary f (g ∘ ⇑σ)

docstring: `P` holds geometrically for `f` if and only if all fibers are geometrically `P`.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.geometrically_iff_forall_fiberToSpecResidueField
statement_text: {P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ Y} : AlgebraicGeometry.geometrically P f ↔ ∀ (y : ↥Y), AlgebraicGeometry.geometrically P (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberToSpecResidueField f y)

docstring: `U.starProjection ≤ V.starProjection` iff `U ≤ V`.
name: Submodule.starProjection_le_starProjection_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {U : Submodule 𝕜 E} {V : Submodule 𝕜 E} [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] [V.HasOrthogonalProjection] : U.starProjection ≤ V.starProjection ↔ U ≤ V

docstring: If `h : X → Y` is a homeomorphism, `h⁻¹(s)` is compact iff `s` is.
name: Homeomorph.isCompact_preimage
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set Y} (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : IsCompact.{u_1} (X := X) (⇑h ⁻¹' s) ↔ IsCompact s

docstring:
`D` is a fundamental discriminant if and only if either `D ≡ 1 mod 4` and `D` is squarefree,
or `D = 4 * d` with `d` squarefree and `d ≡ 2, 3 mod 4`.
name: Int.isFundamentalDiscr_iff_squarefree
statement_text: {D : ℤ} : D.IsFundamentalDiscr ↔ D % 4 = 1 ∧ Squarefree D ∨ D % 4 = 0 ∧ Squarefree (D / 4) ∧ (D / 4 % 4 = 2 ∨ D / 4 % 4 = 3)

docstring:
A function `f : X → Y` between topological spaces is coinducing if the topology on `Y` is
coinduced by the topology on `X` through `f`, meaning that a set `s : Set Y` is open iff its
preimage is open.
name: Topology.IsCoinducing
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) : Prop

docstring: `P` is a sheaf for `Presieve.ofArrows X π`, iff the fork given by `w` is an equalizer.
name: CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.sheaf_condition
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, w, u, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) {B : C} {I : Type t} [Small.{w, t} I] (X : I → C) (π : (i : I) → X i ⟶ B) [(CategoryTheory.Presieve.ofArrows X π).HasPairwisePullbacks] : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor P (CategoryTheory.Presieve.ofArrows X π) ↔ Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (F := CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair (X := CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.FirstObj P X) (Y := CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.SecondObj P X π) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.firstMap P X π) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.secondMap P X π)) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.forkMap P X π) ⋯))

docstring:
Let `μ` be a σ-finite left invariant measure on `G`. Then `μ` is equal to the
additive Haar measure defined by `K₀` iff `μ K₀ = 1`.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaarMeasure_eq_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [SecondCountableTopology G] (K₀ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts G) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] [μ.IsAddLeftInvariant] : MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaarMeasure K₀ = μ ↔ μ ↑K₀ = 1

docstring:
A pair of finsets of vertices is `ε`-uniform (aka `ε`-regular) iff their edge density is close
to the density of any big enough pair of subsets. Intuitively, the edges between them are
random-like.
name: SimpleGraph.IsUniform
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {𝕜 : Type u_2} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (ε : 𝕜) (s : Finset α) (t : Finset α) : Prop

docstring:
A group `G` is nilpotent iff there exists a descending central series which reaches the
trivial group in a finite time.
name: Subgroup.nilpotent_iff_finite_descending_central_series
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) [Group G] : Group.IsNilpotent G ↔ ∃ n H, Subgroup.IsDescendingCentralSeries H ∧ H n = ⊥

docstring:
A function `f` has derivative `f'` at `z` iff `star ∘ f ∘ conj` has derivative `star f'` at
`conj z`.
name: hasDerivAt_star_conj_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [StarRing 𝕜] {F : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [StarAddMonoid F] [StarModule 𝕜 F] [ContinuousStar F] [NormedStarGroup 𝕜] {f : 𝕜 → F} {x : 𝕜} {f' : F} : HasDerivAt (star ∘ f ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜)) f' x ↔ HasDerivAt f (star f') ((starRingEnd 𝕜) x)

docstring:
A real differentiable map `f` is conformal at point `x` if and only if its
differential `f'` at that point scales every inner product by a positive scalar.
name: conformalAt_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {x : E} {f' : E →L[ℝ] F} (h : HasFDerivAt f f' x) : ConformalAt f x ↔ ∃ c, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (u v : E), inner.{0, u_2} ℝ (E := F) (f' u : F) (f' v : F) = c * inner ℝ u v

docstring: A property holds for every prime iff it holds for `2` and for every odd prime.
name: Nat.forall_prime_iff_two_and_odd
statement_text: {P : ℕ → Prop} : (∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → P p) ↔ P 2 ∧ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Odd p → P p

docstring:
A set `s` is a neighbourhood of `a` iff it contains a left-additive coset of some ideal
`I ∈ F`.
name: WithIdealFilter.mem_nhds_iff
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] {F : IdealFilter A} {a : WithIdealFilter F} {s : Set (WithIdealFilter F)} : s ∈ nhds a ↔ ∃ I ∈ F, HVAdd.hVAdd (β := Set (WithIdealFilter F)) a (WithIdealFilter.idealSet I) ⊆ s

docstring: For prime `p`, `g` lies in the `p`-primary component iff its order is a power of `p`.
name: CommMonoid.mem_primaryComponent_iff_orderOf
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [CommMonoid G] {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := Submonoid G) (CommMonoid.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ n, orderOf g = p ^ n

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which monovary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f ∘ σ` and `g` monovary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: Monovary.sum_comp_perm_mul_eq_sum_mul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Monovary f g) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i : ι, f (σ i) * g i) (∑ i : ι, f i * g i) ↔ Monovary (f ∘ ⇑σ) g

docstring: A quadratic has roots if and only if its discriminant equals some square.
name: quadratic_eq_zero_iff_discrim_eq_sq
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {a : R} {b : R} {c : R} [NeZero 2] [NoZeroDivisors R] (ha : a ≠ 0) (x : R) : a * (x * x) + b * x + c = 0 ↔ discrim a b c = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2

docstring: An object `Y` is terminal iff for every `X` there is a unique morphism `X ⟶ Y`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isTerminalEquivUnique
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{0, v₁, 0, u₁} (CategoryTheory.Discrete PEmpty.{1}) C) (Y : C) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit { pt := Y, π := { app := fun X => id (CategoryTheory.Discrete.casesOn (motive := fun x => Y ⟶ F.obj x) X fun as => ⋯.elim), naturality := ⋯ : CategoryTheory.NatTrans (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Functor.const (CategoryTheory.Discrete PEmpty.{1})) Y) F } : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F } ≃ ((X : C) → Unique (X ⟶ Y))

docstring: `t : Cone F` is a limit cone if and only if `t.op : Cocone F.op` is a colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitEquivIsColimitOp
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v, u₁, u} J C} {t : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F} : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit t ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit t.op

docstring: An edge `e` is incident to something if and only if `e` is in the edge set.
name: Graph.edge_mem_iff_exists_isLink
statement_text: {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} (self : Graph α β) (e : β) : e ∈ self.edgeSet ↔ ∃ x y, self.IsLink e x y

docstring: The `v`-adic valuation of `r : R` is less than 1 if and only if `r ∈ v`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_lt_one_iff_mem
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation K v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) ↑r < 1 ↔ r ∈ v.asIdeal

docstring:
Two stochastic processes are identically distributed iff they have the same
finite-dimensional distributions.
name: ProbabilityTheory.identDistrib_iff_forall_finset_identDistrib
statement_text: {T : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {𝓧 : T → Type u_3} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mα : (t : T) → MeasurableSpace (𝓧 t)} {X : (t : T) → Ω → 𝓧 t} {Y : (t : T) → Ω → 𝓧 t} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (hX : AEMeasurable (β := (x : T) → 𝓧 x) (fun ω x => X x ω) P) (hY : AEMeasurable (β := (x : T) → 𝓧 x) (fun ω x => Y x ω) P) : ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (γ := (x : T) → 𝓧 x) (fun ω x => X x ω) (fun ω x => Y x ω) P P ↔ ∀ (I : Finset T), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (γ := (i : ↥I) → 𝓧 ↑i) (fun ω => I.restrict (π := 𝓧) fun x => X x ω) (fun ω => I.restrict (π := 𝓧) fun x => Y x ω) P P

docstring:
In a linearly ordered additive group, the integer multiples of an element are
dense iff they are the whole group.
name: denseRange_zsmul_iff_surjective
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace G] [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [OrderTopology G] {a : G} : (DenseRange.{u_1, 0} (X := G) fun (x : ℤ) => x • a) ↔ Function.Surjective.{1, u_1 + 1} (β := G) fun (x : ℤ) => x • a

docstring: The closure of `K` is the full space iff `Kᗮ` is trivial.
name: Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} [CompleteSpace E] : K.topologicalClosure = ⊤ ↔ Kᗮ = ⊥

docstring:
The adjoint is unique: a map `A` is the adjoint of `B` iff it satisfies `⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, B y⟫`
for all `x` and `y`.
name: LinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F] (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (B : F →ₗ[𝕜] E) : A = LinearMap.adjoint B ↔ ∀ (x : E) (y : F), inner 𝕜 (A x) y = inner 𝕜 x (B y)

docstring: The Schnirelmann density of `A` is `1` if and only if `A` contains all the positive naturals.
name: schnirelmannDensity_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {A : Set ℕ} [DecidablePred fun (x : ℕ) => x ∈ A] : schnirelmannDensity A = 1 ↔ {0}ᶜ ⊆ A

docstring:
A useful restatement using `segment`: `x` is an extreme point iff the only (closed) segments
that contain it are those with `x` as one of their endpoints.
name: mem_extremePoints_iff_forall_segment
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Ring 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [DenselyOrdered 𝕜] [Module.IsTorsionFree 𝕜 E] {A : Set E} {x : E} : x ∈ Set.extremePoints 𝕜 A ↔ x ∈ A ∧ ∀ x₁ ∈ A, ∀ x₂ ∈ A, x ∈ segment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x ∨ x₂ = x

docstring: If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` moves `h ^ j • x` iff `g` moves `x`.
name: MulAction.smul_zpow_movedBy_eq_of_commute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : Commute g h) (j : ℤ) : h ^ j • (MulAction.fixedBy α g)ᶜ = (MulAction.fixedBy α g)ᶜ

docstring:
A ring `R` is Jacobson if and only if for every prime ideal `I`,
`I` can be written as the infimum of some collection of maximal ideals.
Allowing ⊤ in the set `M` of maximal ideals is equivalent, but makes some proofs cleaner.
name: isJacobsonRing_iff_sInf_maximal
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] : IsJacobsonRing R ↔ ∀ {I : Ideal R}, I.IsPrime → ∃ M, (∀ J ∈ M, J.IsMaximal ∨ J = ⊤) ∧ I = sInf M

docstring:
If `C` is cofiltered, then `F : C ⥤ D` is initial if and only if `CostructuredArrow F d` is
cofiltered for all `d : D`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.initial_iff_isCofiltered_costructuredArrow
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) [CategoryTheory.IsCofilteredOrEmpty.{v₁, u₁} C] : F.Initial ↔ ∀ (d : D), CategoryTheory.IsCofiltered (CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow F d)

docstring: An s-finite measure `μ` is sigma-finite iff `μ μ.sigmaFiniteSetᶜ = 0`.
name: MeasureTheory.measure_compl_sigmaFiniteSet_eq_zero_iff_sigmaFinite
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) : μ μ.sigmaFiniteSetᶜ = 0 ↔ MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ

docstring:
The **Cauchy-Riemann Equation**: A real-differentiable function `f` on `ℂ` is complex-differentiable
at `x` if and only if the derivative `fderiv ℝ f x` maps `I` to `I • (fderiv ℝ f x) 1`.
name: differentiableAt_complex_iff_differentiableAt_real
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] {f : ℂ → E} {x : ℂ} : DifferentiableAt ℂ f x ↔ DifferentiableAt ℝ f x ∧ (fderiv ℝ f x) Complex.I = HSMul.hSMul (β := E) Complex.I ((fderiv ℝ f x) 1 : E)

docstring: If `h : X → Y` is a homeomorphism, `h(s)` is path-connected iff `s` is.
name: Homeomorph.isPathConnected_image
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set X} (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : IsPathConnected.{u_2} (X := Y) (⇑h '' s) ↔ IsPathConnected s

docstring:
The orientations given by two bases are equal if and only if the determinant of one basis
with respect to the other is positive.
name: Module.Basis.orientation_eq_iff_det_pos
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {ι : Type u_3} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (e₁ : Module.Basis ι R M) (e₂ : Module.Basis ι R M) : Eq (α := Orientation R M ι) e₁.orientation e₂.orientation ↔ 0 < e₁.det ⇑e₂

docstring:
If `g` is meromorphic at `x`, then `f - g` is meromorphic at `x` if and only if `f` is meromorphic
at `x`.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicAt_sub_iff_meromorphicAt₂
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (hg : MeromorphicAt g x) : MeromorphicAt (f - g) x ↔ MeromorphicAt f x

docstring:
If `φ` is mono, it is a normal group homomorphism if and only if for all `X` the image of
`H(X)` in `G(X)` is a normal subgroup.
name: CategoryTheory.IsMonHom.normal_iff_normal_monoidHom
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v_1, u_1} C] {G : C} {H : C} [CategoryTheory.GrpObj G] [CategoryTheory.GrpObj H] {φ : H ⟶ G} [CategoryTheory.IsMonHom φ] [CategoryTheory.Mono φ] : CategoryTheory.IsMonHom.Normal φ ↔ ∀ (X : C), Subgroup.Normal.{v_1} (G := X ⟶ G) (MonoidHom.range (G := X ⟶ H) (CategoryTheory.IsMonHom.monoidHom φ X))

docstring:
If `K` generates `J`, then any presheaf is a sheaf if and only if it is a sheaf
for all `K`-covers.
name: CategoryTheory.Precoverage.Generates.isSheaf_type_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {K : CategoryTheory.Precoverage.{v, u} C} {J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C} (H : K.Generates J) {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, w, u, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)} : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf J F ↔ ∀ ⦃X : C⦄, ∀ R ∈ K.coverings X, CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor F R

docstring:
In a finite-dimensional vector space over `ℝ`, the series `∑ x, ‖f x‖` is unconditionally
summable if and only if the series `∑ x, f x` is unconditionally summable. One implication holds in
any complete normed space, while the other holds only in finite-dimensional spaces.
name: summable_norm_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {f : α → E} : (Summable (α := ℝ) fun x => ‖f x‖) ↔ Summable f

docstring:
If `H ≃g H'` and `G ≃g G'` then `H` is contained in `G` if and only if `H'` is contained
in `G'`.
name: SimpleGraph.isContained_congr
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} {V' : Type u_4} {W' : Type u_5} {G' : SimpleGraph V'} {H' : SimpleGraph W'} (e₁ : H ≃g H') (e₂ : G ≃g G') : H.IsContained G ↔ H'.IsContained G'

docstring:
A category is idempotent complete iff for all idempotent endomorphisms,
the equalizer of the identity and this idempotent exists.
name: CategoryTheory.Idempotents.isIdempotentComplete_iff_hasEqualizer_of_id_and_idempotent
statement_text: (C : Type u_1) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] : CategoryTheory.IsIdempotentComplete.{v_1, u_1} C ↔ ∀ (X : C) (p : X ⟶ X), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p p = p → CategoryTheory.Limits.HasEqualizer (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X) p

docstring:
If `G` is an additive topological group and `H` a finite-index additive subgroup,
then `G` is topologically discrete iff `H` is.
name: AddSubgroup.discreteTopology_iff_of_finiteIndex
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] [T2Space G] {H : AddSubgroup G} [H.FiniteIndex] : DiscreteTopology.{u_1} ↥H ↔ DiscreteTopology G

docstring: The class number is `1` iff the ring of integers is a principal ideal domain.
name: card_classGroup_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDedekindDomain R] [Fintype (ClassGroup R)] : Fintype.card.{u_1} (ClassGroup R) = 1 ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing R

docstring: An element `a` is `M`-regular if and only if a positive power of `a` is `M`-regular.
name: IsSMulRegular.pow_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {a : R} [Monoid R] [MulAction R M] {n : ℕ} (n0 : 0 < n) : IsSMulRegular M (a ^ n) ↔ IsSMulRegular M a

docstring: A right transversal is finite iff the subgroup has finite index.
name: AddSubgroup.IsComplement.finite_right_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} {T : Set G} (h : AddSubgroup.IsComplement (↑H) T) : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑T ↔ H.FiniteIndex

docstring:
The **Jacobian criterion** for smoothness of local algebras.
Suppose `S` is a local `R`-algebra, and `0 → I → P → S → 0` is a presentation such that
`P` is formally-smooth over `R`, `Ω[P⁄R]` is finite free over `P`,
(typically satisfied when `P` is the localization of a polynomial ring of finite type)
and `I` is finitely generated.
Then `S` is formally smooth iff `k ⊗ₛ I → k ⊗ₚ Ω[P/R]` is injective,
where `k` any field extension of the residue field of `S`.
name: Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_injective_cotangentComplexBaseChange
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] [Algebra R S] (P : Type u_3) (K : Type u_4) [Field K] [CommRing P] [Algebra R P] [Algebra P S] [IsScalarTower R P S] [Algebra S K] [Algebra P K] [IsScalarTower P S K] [Algebra.FormallySmooth R P] [Module.Free P Ω[P⁄R]] [Module.Finite P Ω[P⁄R]] (h₁ : Function.Surjective.{u_3 + 1, u_2 + 1} (α := P) (β := S) ⇑(algebraMap P S)) (h₂ : Ideal.FG (RingHom.ker (F := P →+* S) (algebraMap P S))) (h₃ : LE.le (α := Ideal S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) (RingHom.ker (F := S →+* K) (algebraMap S K))) : Algebra.FormallySmooth R S ↔ Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct P K ↥(RingHom.ker (F := P →+* S) (algebraMap P S))) (β := TensorProduct P K Ω[P⁄R]) ⇑(KaehlerDifferential.cotangentComplexBaseChange R S P K)

docstring: Similarity holds if and only if all distances are proportional with a positive real ratio.
name: similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ ∀ (i₁ i₂ : ι), dist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = r * dist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring: The cosine of the angle between two vectors is 1 if and only if the angle is 0.
name: InnerProductGeometry.cos_eq_one_iff_angle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : Real.cos (InnerProductGeometry.angle x y) = 1 ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = 0

docstring:
Two vectors are in the same ray, or the first is in the same ray as the negation of the
second, if and only if they are not linearly independent.
name: sameRay_or_sameRay_neg_iff_not_linearIndependent
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] {x : M} {y : M} : SameRay R x y ∨ SameRay R x (-y) ↔ ¬LinearIndependent R ![x, y]

docstring: In a Polish space, a set is clopenable if and only if it is Borel-measurable.
name: MeasureTheory.isClopenable_iff_measurableSet
statement_text: {γ : Type u_3} {s : Set γ} [TopologicalSpace γ] [PolishSpace γ] [MeasurableSpace γ] [BorelSpace γ] : PolishSpace.IsClopenable s ↔ MeasurableSet s

docstring:
A set `S` of continuous linear maps with topology of uniform convergence on sets `s ∈ 𝔖`
is von Neumann bounded iff for any `s ∈ 𝔖`,
the set `{f x | (f ∈ S) (x ∈ s)}` is von Neumann bounded.
name: UniformConvergenceCLM.isVonNBounded_iff
statement_text: {𝕜₁ : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} [NormedField 𝕜₁] [NormedField 𝕜₂] {σ : 𝕜₁ →+* 𝕜₂} {E : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜₁ E] [TopologicalSpace E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜₂ F] {R : Type u_6} [NormedDivisionRing R] [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [_root_.Module R F] [ContinuousConstSMul R F] [SMulCommClass 𝕜₂ R F] {𝔖 : Set (Set E)} {S : Set (UniformConvergenceCLM σ F 𝔖)} : Bornology.IsVonNBounded R S ↔ ∀ s ∈ 𝔖, Bornology.IsVonNBounded.{u_6, u_4} R (E := F) (Set.image2 (fun f x => f x) S s)

docstring: A function is differentiable on two open sets iff it is differentiable on their union.
name: differentiableOn_union_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace E] {F : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace F] {f : E → F} {s : Set E} {t : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s) (ht : IsOpen t) : DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f (s ∪ t) ↔ DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s ∧ DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f t

docstring: A set is ample iff its pre-image under a continuous affine equivalence is.
name: AmpleSet.preimage_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module ℝ F] [TopologicalSpace F] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E] {s : Set F} (L : E ≃ᴬ[ℝ] F) : AmpleSet.{u_2} (F := E) (⇑L ⁻¹' s) ↔ AmpleSet s

docstring:
A set is dissociated iff all its finite subsets have different products.

This is an analog of linear independence in a vector space, but with the "scalars" restricted to
`0` and `±1`.
name: MulDissociated
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [CommGroup α] (s : Set α) : Prop

docstring:
A point `x` in a C¹ manifold is a boundary point if and only if it gets mapped to the boundary
of the model space by any given chart - in other words, the notion of boundary points does not
depend on any choice of charts.

Also see `ModelWithCorners.isInteriorPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas`.
name: ModelWithCorners.isBoundaryPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [IsManifold I n M] {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H} {x : M} (hn : n ≠ 0) (he : Membership.mem (γ := Set (OpenPartialHomeomorph M H)) (atlas H M) e) (hx : x ∈ e.source) : I.IsBoundaryPoint x ↔ ↑(e.extend I) x ∈ frontier (e.extend I).target

docstring:
The largest cardinality of a `(U, n)`-dynamical net of `F`. Takes values in `ℕ∞`, and is
infinite if and only if `F` admits nets of arbitrarily large size.
name: Dynamics.netMaxcard
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) : ℕ∞

docstring:
A sieve `S` is covering for `J` if and only if the subobject classifier
is a sheaf for `S`.
name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.mem_iff_isSheafFor_closedSieves
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C) {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v, u} X) : S ∈ J X ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor (CategoryTheory.Functor.closedSieves J).toFunctor S.arrows

docstring: An action of a group is pretransitive iff any element can be moved from a fixed given one.
name: MulAction.isPretransitive_iff_base
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (a : X) : MulAction.IsPretransitive G X ↔ ∀ (x : X), ∃ g, g • a = x

docstring:
An additive group `G` is nilpotent iff there exists an ascending central series
which reaches `G` in finitely many steps.
name: AddSubgroup.nilpotent_iff_finite_ascending_central_series
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) [AddGroup G] : AddGroup.IsNilpotent G ↔ ∃ n H, AddSubgroup.IsAscendingCentralSeries H ∧ H n = ⊤

docstring:
Given `a : S`, `S` a localization of `R`, `IsInteger R a` iff `a` is in the image of
the localization map from `R` to `S`.
name: IsLocalization.IsInteger
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_2} [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] (a : S) : Prop

docstring: A preradical `Φ` is radical if and only if it `Φ` vanishes on the quotient `Φ.quotient`.
name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Preradical.isRadical_iff_isZero
statement_text: (C : Type u_1) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{v_1, u_1} C] (Φ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Preradical.{v_1, u_1} C) : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Preradical.isRadical C Φ ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (Φ.quotient.comp Φ.r)

docstring:
The minimal polynomial of an element `x` of `E / F` of exponential characteristic `q` has
separable degree one if and only if the minimal polynomial is of the form
`(X - x) ^ (q ^ n)` for some `n : ℕ`.
name: minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_eq_X_sub_C_pow
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Ring E] [IsDomain E] [Algebra F E] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] {x : E} : Polynomial.natSepDegree (minpoly F x) = 1 ↔ ∃ n, Polynomial.map (algebraMap F E) (minpoly F x) = HSub.hSub (α := Polynomial E) (β := Polynomial E) Polynomial.X (Polynomial.C x : Polynomial E) ^ q ^ n

docstring:
If `f → a` and `g → b` along a nontrivial filter, valued in a Hausdorff
`GroupWithZero` with continuous multiplication and `ContinuousInv₀`, and `b ≠ 0`,
then `f / g → 1` if and only if `a = b`.
name: tendsto_div_nhds_one_iff_eq₀
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G₀ : Type u_3} [GroupWithZero G₀] [TopologicalSpace G₀] [ContinuousInv₀ G₀] [ContinuousMul G₀] {f : α → G₀} {g : α → G₀} {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] [T2Space G₀] {a : G₀} {b : G₀} (hf : Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds a)) (hg : Filter.Tendsto g l (nhds b)) (hb : b ≠ 0) : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) l (nhds 1) ↔ a = b

docstring: `HasProd` over `Nat.Primes` iff over `ℕ` extending `f` by `1`.
name: Nat.Primes.hasProd_iff_hasProd_ite
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [CommMonoid M] [TopologicalSpace M] (f : ℕ → M) {a : M} : HasProd (fun p => f ↑p) a ↔ HasProd (fun n => if Nat.Prime n then f n else 1) a

docstring: An idempotent linear map is positive iff it is symmetric.
name: LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isPositive_iff_isSymmetric
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (hT : IsIdempotentElem T) : T.IsPositive ↔ LinearMap.IsSymmetric.{u_1, u_2} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) T

docstring:
If `s` is locally closed (e.g. open or closed), then `f` is locally integrable on `s` iff it is
integrable on every compact subset contained in `s`.
name: MeasureTheory.locallyIntegrableOn_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {ε : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace ε] [ContinuousENorm ε] {f : X → ε} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} {s : Set X} [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace ε] [LocallyCompactSpace X] (hs : IsLocallyClosed s) : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn f s μ ↔ ∀ k ⊆ s, IsCompact k → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f k μ

docstring:
The map of a cofan is a colimit iff the cofan consisting of the mapped morphisms is a colimit.
This essentially lets us commute `Cofan.mk` with `Functor.mapCocone`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isColimitMapCoconeCofanMkEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) {J : Type w} (f : J → C) {P : C} (g : (j : J) → f j ⟶ P) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (G.mapCocone (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.mk P g)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.{w, v₂, w, u₂} (J := CategoryTheory.Discrete J) (F := CategoryTheory.Discrete.functor fun j => G.obj (f j)) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.mk (G.obj P) fun j => G.map (g j))

docstring:
In a compactly coherent space `X`, a set `s` is open iff `f ⁻¹' s` is open for every continuous
map from a compact space.
name: CompactlyCoherentSpace.isOpen_iff_forall_compactSpace
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactlyCoherentSpace X] (s : Set X) : IsOpen s ↔ ∀ (K : Type u) [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace K] [CompactSpace K] (f : K → X), Continuous f → IsOpen (f ⁻¹' s)

docstring:
An algebra is finitely presented if and only if it is a quotient of a polynomial ring whose
variables are indexed by a fintype by a finitely generated ideal.
name: Algebra.FinitePresentation.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial'
statement_text: {R : Type w₁} {A : Type w₂} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] : Algebra.FinitePresentation R A ↔ ∃ ι x f, Function.Surjective (α := MvPolynomial ι R) (β := A) ⇑f ∧ Ideal.FG (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom)

docstring:
`GroupExtension`s are equivalent iff there is an isomorphism making a commuting diagram.
Use `GroupExtension.Equiv.ofMonoidHom` in `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/Basic.lean` to
construct an equivalence without providing the inverse map.
name: GroupExtension.Equiv
statement_text: {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [Group N] [Group E] [Group G] (S : GroupExtension N E G) {E' : Type u_4} [Group E'] (S' : GroupExtension N E' G) : Type (max u_2 u_4)

docstring:
If `f` is a meromorphic function on `ℝ` or `ℂ`, then `f` has infinite order at some point iff `f`
has infinite order at every point.  This is the counterpart of
`Meromorphic.exists_meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_forall` for infinite order.
name: Meromorphic.exists_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff_forall
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : Meromorphic f) : (∃ u, meromorphicOrderAt f u = ⊤) ↔ ∀ (u : 𝕜), meromorphicOrderAt f u = ⊤

docstring: A point equals its orthogonal projection if and only if it lies in the subspace.
name: Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] {v : E} : K.starProjection v = v ↔ v ∈ K

docstring: The sum of a locally finite collection of sections is `C^k` on a set `u` iff each section is.
name: ContMDiffOn.sum_section_of_locallyFinite
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {V : M → Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace (Bundle.TotalSpace F V)] [(x : M) → TopologicalSpace (V x)] [FiberBundle F V] [(x : M) → AddCommGroup (V x)] [(x : M) → _root_.Module.{u_1, u_6} 𝕜 (V x)] [VectorBundle 𝕜 F V] {u : Set M} {ι : Type u_7} {t : ι → (x : M) → V x} (ht : LocallyFinite.{u_7, u_4} (X := M) fun (i : ι) => {x | t i x ≠ 0}) (ht' : ∀ (i : ι), ContMDiffOn I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n (fun x => ⟨x, t i x⟩) u) : ContMDiffOn I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n (fun x => ⟨x, ∑' (i : ι), t i x⟩) u

docstring:
A set of points is cospherical in an affine subspace `S₁` if and only if its image under the
inclusion into a larger affine subspace `S₂` is cospherical.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical.inclusion_iff
