statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {S₁ : AffineSubspace ℝ P} {S₂ : AffineSubspace ℝ P} [Nonempty.{u_2 + 1} ↥S₁] {ps : Set ↥S₁} [S₁.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] [S₂.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] (hS : S₁ ≤ S₂) : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical (P := ↥S₂) (⇑(AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) '' ps) ↔ EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ps

docstring: A point is its own reflection if and only if it is in the subspace.
name: EuclideanGeometry.reflection_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace 𝕜 P} [Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} ↥s] [s.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] (p : P) : (EuclideanGeometry.reflection s) p = p ↔ p ∈ s

docstring:
A group homomorphism is strict if and only if the canonical isomorphism
`G ⧸ f.ker ≃ f.range` is a homeomorphism.
name: MonoidHom.isStrictMap_iff_isHomeomorph_quotientKerEquivRange
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [Group G] [Group H] {f : G →* H} [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := H) ⇑f ↔ IsHomeomorph.{u_1, u_2} (X := G ⧸ f.ker) (Y := ↥f.range) ⇑(QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange f)

docstring:
A splitting of an extension `S` is `N`-conjugate to another iff there exists `n : N` such that
the section homomorphism is a conjugate of the other section homomorphism by `S.inl n`.
name: GroupExtension.IsConj
statement_text: {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [Group N] [Group E] [Group G] (S : GroupExtension N E G) (s : S.Splitting) (s' : S.Splitting) : Prop

docstring:
An element of a DVR is irreducible iff it is a uniformizer, that is, generates the
maximal ideal of `R`.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] (ϖ : R) : Irreducible ϖ ↔ Eq (α := Ideal R) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (Ideal.span {ϖ})

docstring:
A map `f : X → Y` is proper if and only if it is continuous and **universally closed**, in the
sense that for any topological space `Z`, the map `Prod.map f id : X × Z → Y × Z` is closed. Note
that `Z` lives in the same universe as `X` here, but `IsProperMap.universally_closed` does not
have this restriction.

This is taken as the definition of properness in
[N. Bourbaki, *General Topology*][bourbaki1966].
name: isProperMap_iff_universally_closed
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsProperMap f ↔ Continuous f ∧ ∀ (Z : Type u) [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace Z], IsClosedMap (X := X × Z) (Prod.map f id)

docstring:
`M.reverse` constructs an NFA with the same states as `M`, but all the transitions reversed. The
resulting automaton accepts a word `x` if and only if `M` accepts `List.reverse x`.
name: NFA.reverse
statement_text: {α : Type u} {σ : Type v} (M : NFA α σ) : NFA α σ

docstring: For `u : Opens M`, `x : u` is an interior point iff `x.val : M` is.
name: ModelWithCorners.isInteriorPoint_iff_isInteriorPoint_val
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {u : TopologicalSpace.Opens M} {x : ↥u} : I.IsInteriorPoint x ↔ I.IsInteriorPoint ↑x

docstring:
The inner product of two vectors, divided by the product of their
norms, has absolute value 1 if and only if they are nonzero and one is
a multiple of the other. One form of equality case for Cauchy-Schwarz.
name: abs_real_inner_div_norm_mul_norm_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (x : F) (y : F) : |inner ℝ x y / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖)| = 1 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ y = r • x

docstring:
A function is `C^n` at a point iff it is `C^m` at this point, for
any `m ≤ n` which is different from `∞`. This result is useful because, when `m ≠ ∞`, being
`C^m` extends locally to a neighborhood, giving flexibility for local proofs.
name: contMDiffAt_iff_le_ne_infty
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {E' : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] {H' : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H'] {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'} {M' : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M'] {f : M → M'} {x : M} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} : ContMDiffAt I I' n f x ↔ ∀ m ≤ n, m ≠ ↑⊤ → ContMDiffAt I I' m f x

docstring: A group element has finite order iff its order is positive.
name: orderOf_pos_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Monoid G] {x : G} : 0 < orderOf x ↔ IsOfFinOrder x

docstring:
Given `x, y : E ⊗ F ⊗ G`, `x = y` iff `⟪a ⊗ₜ b ⊗ₜ c, x⟫ = ⟪a ⊗ₜ b ⊗ₜ c, y⟫` for all `a, b, c`.

See also `ext_iff_inner_left_threefold'` for when `x, y : E ⊗ (F ⊗ G)`.
name: TensorProduct.ext_iff_inner_left_threefold
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {G : Type u_4} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G] {x : TensorProduct 𝕜 (TensorProduct 𝕜 E F) G} {y : TensorProduct 𝕜 (TensorProduct 𝕜 E F) G} : x = y ↔ ∀ (a : E) (b : F) (c : G), inner 𝕜 (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] b ⊗ₜ[𝕜] c) x = inner 𝕜 (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] b ⊗ₜ[𝕜] c) y

docstring:
`C` is cofiltered if and only if for every functor `F : J ⥤ C` from a finite category there is
some `X : C` such that `lim Hom(X, F·)` is nonempty.
name: CategoryTheory.IsCofiltered.iff_nonempty_limit
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.IsCofiltered.{v, u} C ↔ ∀ {J : Type v} [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.SmallCategory J] [CategoryTheory.FinCategory J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor J C), ∃ X, Nonempty.{v + 1} (CategoryTheory.Limits.limit (F.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.coyoneda (Opposite.op X))))

docstring: An additive action is `1`-pretransitive iff it is pretransitive.
name: AddAction.is_zero_pretransitive_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] : AddAction.IsMultiplyPretransitive G α 1 ↔ AddAction.IsPretransitive G α

docstring:
An additive monoid is finitely generated iff there exists a surjective
homomorphism from a `FreeAddMonoid` on an arbitrary finite type `α` to the monoid.
name: AddMonoid.fg_iff_exists_freeAddGroup_hom_surjective_finite
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [AddMonoid M] : AddMonoid.FG M ↔ ∃ α, ∃ (_ : Finite α), ∃ φ, Function.Surjective (α := FreeAddMonoid α) (β := M) ⇑φ

docstring:
Two elements `a` and `b` are `M`-regular if and only if both products `a * b` and `b * a`
are `M`-regular.
name: IsSMulRegular.mul_and_mul_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {a : R} {b : R} [SMul R M] [Mul R] [IsScalarTower R R M] : IsSMulRegular M (a * b) ∧ IsSMulRegular M (b * a) ↔ IsSMulRegular M a ∧ IsSMulRegular M b

docstring:
The **complete equipartite graph** in `r` parts each of *equal* size `t` such that two
vertices are adjacent if and only if they are in different parts, often denoted $K_r(t)$.

This is isomorphic to a corresponding `completeMultipartiteGraph` and `turanGraph`. The difference
is that the former vertices are a product type.

See `completeEquipartiteGraph.completeMultipartiteGraph`, `completeEquipartiteGraph.turanGraph`.
name: SimpleGraph.completeEquipartiteGraph
statement_text: (r : ℕ) (t : ℕ) : SimpleGraph (Fin r × Fin t)

docstring:
A function `f : 𝕜 → 𝕜` is concave iff for any three points `x < y < z` the slope of the secant
line of `f` on `[x, y]` is greater than the slope of the secant line of `f` on `[y, z]`.
name: concaveOn_iff_slope_anti_adjacent
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] {s : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f ↔ Convex 𝕜 s ∧ ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄, x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f z - f y) / (z - y) ≤ (f y - f x) / (y - x)

docstring: Two algebra morphisms are equal on `Algebra.span s` iff they are equal on `s`.
name: AlgHom.eqOn_adjoin_iff
statement_text: {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] {φ : A →ₐ[R] B} {ψ : A →ₐ[R] B} {s : Set A} : Set.EqOn.{uA, uB} (β := B) ⇑φ ⇑ψ ↑(Algebra.adjoin R s) ↔ Set.EqOn.{uA, uB} (β := B) (⇑φ) (⇑ψ) s

docstring: A subset `s` is σ-compact iff `s` (with the subspace topology) is a σ-compact space.
name: isSigmaCompact_iff_isSigmaCompact_univ
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsSigmaCompact s ↔ IsSigmaCompact.{u_1} (X := ↑s) Set.univ

docstring:
A subgroup has index dividing 2 if and only if there exists `a` such that for all `b`, at least
one of `a * b` and `b` belongs to `H`.
name: Subgroup.index_dvd_two_iff'
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {H : Subgroup G} : H.index ∣ 2 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : G), a * b ∈ H ∨ b ∈ H

docstring:
`y` is a conjugate root of `x` over `K` if and only if `y` is a root of the minimal polynomial of
`x`. This is variant of `isConjRoot_iff_aeval_eq_zero`.
name: isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_rootSet
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {S : Type u_4} [CommRing S] [Field K] [Algebra K S] [IsDomain S] {x : S} {y : S} (h : IsIntegral K x) : IsConjRoot K x y ↔ y ∈ Polynomial.rootSet (minpoly K x) S

docstring:
Another statement of the **Lefschetz principle**. A first-order sentence is modeled by the
theory of algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero if and only if it is modeled by the
theory of algebraically closed fields of characteristic `p` for all but finitely many primes `p`.
name: FirstOrder.Field.ACF_zero_realize_iff_finite_ACF_prime_not_realize
statement_text: {φ : FirstOrder.Language.ring.Sentence} : FirstOrder.Language.Theory.ACF 0 ⊨ᵇ φ ↔ Set.Finite (α := Nat.Primes) {p | FirstOrder.Language.Theory.ACF ↑p ⊨ᵇ φ}ᶜ

docstring:
Two sections `s` and `t` are equal at `x` if and only if their coefficients w.r.t. some local
frame at `x` agree.
name: IsLocalFrameOn.eq_iff_coeff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {V : M → Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace (Bundle.TotalSpace F V)] [(x : M) → AddCommGroup (V x)] [(x : M) → _root_.Module.{u_1, u_6} 𝕜 (V x)] [(x : M) → TopologicalSpace (V x)] [FiberBundle F V] {ι : Type u_7} {s : ι → (x : M) → V x} {u : Set M} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {x : M} {t : (x : M) → V x} {t' : (x : M) → V x} [VectorBundle 𝕜 F V] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F] (hs : IsLocalFrameOn I F (V := V) n s u) (hx : x ∈ u) : t x = t' x ↔ ∀ (i : ι), Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := 𝕜) ((hs.coeff (V := V) i x) (t x) : 𝕜) ((hs.coeff (V := V) i x) (t' x) : 𝕜)

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(a, +∞)` if and only if it contains an interval `(a, u)`
with `a < u < u'`, provided `a` is not a top element.
name: mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] {a : α} {u' : α} {s : Set α} (hu' : a < u') : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Ioi a, Set.Ioo a u ⊆ s

docstring:
Given an idempotent linear operator `q`,
we have `q ∘ p = p` iff `range p ⊆ range q` for all `p`.
name: LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.comp_eq_right_iff
statement_text: {S : Type u_5} [Semiring S] {M : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module S M] {q : M →ₗ[S] M} (hq : IsIdempotentElem q) {E : Type u_7} [AddCommMonoid E] [_root_.Module S E] (p : E →ₗ[S] M) : q ∘ₗ p = p ↔ p.range ≤ q.range

docstring: Two solutions are equal iff their initial conditions are equal.
name: LinearRecurrence.eq_iff_eqOn_range_order
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (E : LinearRecurrence R) (u : ℕ → R) (v : ℕ → R) (hu : E.IsSolution u) (hv : E.IsSolution v) : u = v ↔ Set.EqOn u v ↑(Finset.range E.order)

docstring:
A point `a` is a cluster point of the sequence `x` if and only if `a` belongs to the closure
of every tail `x '' {n | i ≤ n}`.
name: mapClusterPt_atTop_iff_forall_mem_closure
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type u_3} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] [Nonempty ι] {x : ι → X} {a : X} : MapClusterPt a Filter.atTop x ↔ ∀ (i : ι), a ∈ closure (x '' Set.Ici i)

docstring: `A.toEuclideanLin` is positive if and only if `A` is positive semi-definite.
name: Matrix.isPositive_toEuclideanLin_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [RCLike 𝕜] {n : Type u_4} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} : LinearMap.IsPositive (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) ↔ A.PosSemidef

docstring:
`v ∈ Kᗮ` if and only if `re ⟪v, u⟫ = 0` for all `u ∈ K`; it suffices to check only the
real part of the inner product is zero. Variation of `mem_orthogonal_iff_re_inner_eq_zero` with
the inner product reversed.
name: Submodule.mem_orthogonal_iff_re_inner_eq_zero'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} {v : E} : v ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ u ∈ K, RCLike.re (inner 𝕜 v u) = 0

docstring: If `F` is an empty diagram, then a cone over `F` is limiting iff the cone point is terminal.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitEquivIsTerminalOfIsEmpty
statement_text: (C : Type u₁) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {J : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} J] [IsEmpty J] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v₁, u_1, u₁} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v₁, u₁} c.pt

docstring:
The quotient of a monoid by the `Associated` relation. Two elements `x` and `y`
are associated iff there is a unit `u` such that `x * u = y`. There is a natural
monoid structure on `Associates M`.
name: Associates
statement_text: (M : Type u_2) [Monoid M] : Type u_2

docstring:
A point `p` is equidistant to two affine subspaces if and only if the angles at a point `p'`
in their intersection between `p` and its orthogonal projections onto the subspaces are equal.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_orthogonalProjection_eq_iff_angle_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p : P} {p' : P} {s₁ : AffineSubspace ℝ P} {s₂ : AffineSubspace ℝ P} [s₁.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] [s₂.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] (hp'₁ : p' ∈ s₁) (hp'₂ : p' ∈ s₂) : dist p ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₁) p) = dist p ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₂) p) ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p p' ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₁) p) = EuclideanGeometry.angle p p' ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₂) p)

docstring:
A pushout cocone in `C` is colimit iff it becomes limit
after the application of `yoneda.obj X` for all `X : C`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.PushoutCocone.isColimitYonedaEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Z} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.PushoutCocone f g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c ≃ ((X_1 : C) → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (c.op.map (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.yoneda X_1)))

docstring:
A section over a compact open of a scheme is nilpotent if and only if its associated
basic open is empty.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isNilpotent_iff_basicOpen_eq_bot_of_isCompact
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsCompact ↑U) (f : ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))) : IsNilpotent f ↔ X.basicOpen f = ⊥

docstring:
An `R`-algebra `A` is geometrically reduced iff for every prime ideal `p` of R`
the base change to `AlgebraicClosure p.ResidueField` is reduced.
name: Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced
statement_text: (R : Type u_3) (A : Type u_4) [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] : Prop

docstring: A function `-f` is convex iff `f` is concave.
name: neg_convexOn_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_5} [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [SMul 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} : ConvexOn 𝕜 s (-f) ↔ ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f

docstring:
If `w : TwoSquare T L R B` is a Guitart exact square, with `R` essentially surjective,
and `E` is a right extension of `F` along `B`, then `E` is a pointwise right Kan extension
of `F` along `B` iff `E.compTwoSquare w` is a pointwise right Kan extension
of `L ⋙ F` along `T`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.RightExtension.isPointwiseRightKanExtensionEquivOfGuitartExact
statement_text: {C₁ : Type u₁} {C₂ : Type u₂} {C₃ : Type u₃} {C₄ : Type u₄} {D : Type u₅} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} C₂] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C₃] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₄, u₄} C₄] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₅, u₅} D] {T : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C₁ C₂} {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} C₁ C₃} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₄, u₂, u₄} C₂ C₄} {B : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₄, u₃, u₄} C₃ C₄} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₅, u₃, u₅} C₃ D} (E : B.RightExtension F) (w : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare T L R B) [w.GuitartExact] [R.EssSurj] : (E.compTwoSquare w).IsPointwiseRightKanExtension ≃ E.IsPointwiseRightKanExtension

docstring:
Three points are collinear if and only if the first or third point equals the second or the
angle between them is 0 or π.
name: EuclideanGeometry.collinear_iff_eq_or_eq_or_angle_eq_zero_or_angle_eq_pi
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : Collinear ℝ (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃} ↔ p₁ = p₂ ∨ p₃ = p₂ ∨ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0 ∨ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi

docstring:
`α` is a fixed point of `next` if and only if it satisfies the integral equation
`α t = x + ∫_{t₀}^t f τ (α τ) dτ` for all `t`.
name: ODE.FunSpace.isFixedPt_next_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {f : ℝ → E → E} {tmin : ℝ} {tmax : ℝ} {t₀ : ↑(Set.Icc tmin tmax)} {x₀ : E} {x : E} {a : NNReal} {r : NNReal} {L : NNReal} {K : NNReal} (hf : IsPicardLindelof f t₀ x₀ a r L K) (hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ↑r) {α : ODE.FunSpace t₀ x₀ r L} : Function.IsFixedPt (ODE.FunSpace.next hf hx) α ↔ ∀ (t : ↑(Set.Icc tmin tmax)), α.toFun t = ODE.picard f (↑t₀) x α.compProj ↑t

docstring: `p` is `f` invariant if and only if `p.map f ≤ p`.
name: Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule_iff_map_le
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] (f : Module.End R M) {p : Submodule R M} : p ∈ f.invtSubmodule ↔ Submodule.map f p ≤ p

docstring:
`Prod.snd ⁻¹' t` is null measurable w.r.t. `μ.prod ν` iff `t` is null measurable w.r.t. `ν`
provided that `μ ≠ 0`.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.nullMeasurableSet_preimage_snd
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure β} [MeasureTheory.SFinite ν] [NeZero μ] {t : Set β} : MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet (Prod.snd ⁻¹' t) (μ.prod ν) ↔ MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet t ν

docstring: `X □ Y` lifts against `Z` if and only if `Y` lifts against `X ⋔ Z`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] {X : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v, u} C} {Y : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v, u} C} {Z : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v, u} C} : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct X).obj Y).hom Z.hom ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty Y.hom ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pullbackHom (Opposite.op X)).obj Z).hom

docstring:
A correspondence `f : α → Set β` is upper hemicontinuous if and only if its *lower inverse*
(i.e., `u : Set β ↦ (f ⁻¹' (Iic uᶜ))ᶜ`, note that `f ⁻¹' (Iic u) = {x | (f x ∩ u).Nonempty}`)
sends closed sets to closed sets.
name: upperHemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_compl_preimage_Iic_compl
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] {f : α → Set β} [TopologicalSpace β] : UpperHemicontinuous f ↔ ∀ (u : Set β), IsClosed u → IsClosed (f ⁻¹' Set.Iic uᶜ)ᶜ

docstring:
A function is strongly measurable if and only if it is measurable and has separable
range.
name: stronglyMeasurable_iff_measurable_separable
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [TopologicalSpace β] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace β] [BorelSpace β] : MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable f ↔ Measurable f ∧ TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable (Set.range f)

docstring: Two congruence relations are equal iff their underlying binary relations are equal.
name: Con.coe_inj
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Mul M] {c : Con M} {d : Con M} : Eq (α := M → M → Prop) ⇑c ⇑d ↔ c = d

docstring: The `v`-adic valuation of `r : R` is equal to 1 if and only if `r ∈ vᶜ`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_eq_one_iff_mem_primeCompl
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) : v.intValuation r = 1 ↔ r ∈ v.asIdeal.primeCompl

docstring: A bilinear form is nonnegative if and only if it is nonnegative as a sesquilinear form.
name: LinearMap.BilinForm.isNonneg_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [LE R] {B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M} : B.IsNonneg ↔ LinearMap.IsNonneg B

docstring: Two simplices are equal if and only if they have the same points.
name: Affine.Simplex.ext_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_5} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {n : ℕ} {s1 : Affine.Simplex k P n} {s2 : Affine.Simplex k P n} : s1 = s2 ↔ ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), s1.points i = s2.points i

docstring: The projection to `p` along `q` of `x` equals `x` if and only if `x ∈ p`.
name: Submodule.projectionL_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {M : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} {q : Submodule R M} (h : Submodule.IsTopCompl p q) (x : M) : (p.projectionL q h) x = x ↔ x ∈ p

docstring: A set is Baire measurable if and only if it differs from some open set by a meager set.
name: BaireMeasurableSet.iff_residualEq_isOpen
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} : BaireMeasurableSet s ↔ ∃ u, IsOpen u ∧ s =ᵇ u

docstring:
On pseudometric spaces, a map is an isometry if and only if it preserves nonnegative
distances.
name: isometry_iff_nndist_eq
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PseudoMetricSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β] {f : α → β} : Isometry f ↔ ∀ (x y : α), nndist (f x) (f y) = nndist x y

docstring: An object `J` is injective iff every morphism into `J` can be obtained by extending a monomorphism.
name: CategoryTheory.Injective
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] (J : C) : Prop

docstring: A meromorphic function converges to a nonzero limit iff its order is zero.
name: tendsto_ne_zero_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : (∃ c, c ≠ 0 ∧ Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds c)) ↔ meromorphicOrderAt f x = 0

docstring:
**Equational criterion for flatness**:
a module $M$ is flat if and only if every relation $\sum_i f_i x_i = 0$ in $M$ is trivial.
name: Module.Flat.iff_forall_isTrivialRelation
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ {l : ℕ} {f : Fin l → R} {x : Fin l → M}, ∑ i : Fin l, f i • x i = 0 → Module.IsTrivialRelation f x

docstring: A sum is finite iff all terms are finite.
name: WithTop.sum_lt_top
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → WithTop M} [LT M] : LT.lt.{u_2} (α := WithTop M) (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊤ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i < ⊤

docstring:
A prime ideal `P` of `R⟦X⟧` is finitely generated if and only if `P.map constantCoeff` is
finitely generated.
name: PowerSeries.fg_iff_of_isPrime
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {P : Ideal (PowerSeries R)} [P.IsPrime] : P.FG ↔ Ideal.FG (R := R) (Ideal.map (F := PowerSeries R →+* R) PowerSeries.constantCoeff P)

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous iff `range 𝓕` is equicontinuous,
i.e the family `(↑) : range F → X → α` is equicontinuous.
name: equicontinuous_iff_range
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} : Equicontinuous F ↔ Equicontinuous (ι := { x : X → α // x ∈ Set.range F }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range F))

docstring: `f.hom` is dominant iff any restriction of `f` is.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.isDominant_hom_iff_isDominant_restrict_hom
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X.PartialMap Y) (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense ↑U) (hU' : U ≤ f.domain) : AlgebraicGeometry.IsDominant f.hom ↔ AlgebraicGeometry.IsDominant (f.restrict U hU hU').hom

docstring: The `v`-adic valuation of `r : R` is less than 1 if and only if `r ∈ v`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_lt_one_iff_mem
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) : v.intValuation r < 1 ↔ r ∈ v.asIdeal

docstring:
In a finite dimensional normed affine space over `ℝ`, a set is unbounded if and only if its
asymptotic cone contains a nonzero vector.
name: not_bounded_iff_exists_ne_zero_mem_asymptoticCone
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] {s : Set P} : ¬Bornology.IsBounded s ↔ ∃ v, v ≠ 0 ∧ v ∈ asymptoticCone ℝ s

docstring:
`γ` is an integral curve for `v` at `t₀` iff `γ` is an integral curve on some interval
containing `t₀`.
name: isMIntegralCurveAt_iff'
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {H : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {M : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {γ : ℝ → M} {v : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x} {t₀ : ℝ} : IsMIntegralCurveAt γ v t₀ ↔ ∃ ε > 0, IsMIntegralCurveOn γ v (Metric.ball t₀ ε)

docstring: `(∅ ⟶ B) □ g` lifts against `X ⟶ ⋆` if and only if `g` lifts against `(B ⟹ X) ⟶ ⋆`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_mk_isInitial_isTerminal_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u} C] {A : C} {B : C} {K : C} {L : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {g : K ⟶ L} (i : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.{v, u} A) (t : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v, u} Y) : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk (i.to B))).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk g)).hom (t.from X) ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty (X := B ⟹ X) g (t.from (B ⟹ X))

docstring: `U.starProjection = V.starProjection` iff `U = V`.
name: Submodule.starProjection_inj
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {U : Submodule 𝕜 E} {V : Submodule 𝕜 E} [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] [V.HasOrthogonalProjection] : U.starProjection = V.starProjection ↔ U = V

docstring:
The relation on the sigma type `(W : J) × (F.obj (op W)).obj W` used to construct explicit
coends in `Type`. Two terms `⟨j, x⟩` and `⟨j', x'⟩` are related if and only if there is a
morphism `f : j ⟶ j'` in `J` and an element `y : (F.obj (op j')).obj j` such that
`(F.map f.op).app j y = x` and `(F.obj _).map f y = x'`, see `coendRel_iff` below.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.coendRel
statement_text: {J : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor Jᵒᵖ (CategoryTheory.Functor J (Type (max w u)))) : (j : J) × (F.obj (Opposite.op j)).obj j → (j : J) × (F.obj (Opposite.op j)).obj j → Prop

docstring:
`F⟮x⟯ / F` is a separable extension if and only if `x` is a separable element.
As a consequence, any rational function of `x` is also a separable element.
name: IntermediateField.isSeparable_adjoin_simple_iff_isSeparable
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {x : E} : Algebra.IsSeparable.{u, v} F ↥F⟮x⟯ ↔ IsSeparable F x

docstring: An ideal is radical iff it is equal to its radical.
name: Ideal.radical_eq_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal R} : I.radical = I ↔ I.IsRadical

docstring: A bilinear map is right-separating if and only if its flip has a trivial kernel.
name: LinearMap.separatingRight_iff_flip_ker_eq_bot
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {R₁ : Type u_2} {R₂ : Type u_3} {M : Type u_5} {M₁ : Type u_6} {M₂ : Type u_7} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [CommSemiring R₁] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [_root_.Module R₁ M₁] [CommSemiring R₂] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [_root_.Module R₂ M₂] {I₁ : R₁ →+* R} {I₂ : R₂ →+* R} {B : M₁ →ₛₗ[I₁] M₂ →ₛₗ[I₂] M} : B.SeparatingRight ↔ B.flip.ker = ⊥

docstring:
If `w : TwoSquare T L R B` is a Guitart exact square, and `E` is a left extension
of `F` along `R`, then `E` is a pointwise left Kan extension of `F` along `R` at
`B.obj X₃` iff `E.compTwoSquare w` is a pointwise left Kan extension
of `T ⋙ F` along `L` at `X₃`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.LeftExtension.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionAtCompTwoSquareEquiv
statement_text: {C₁ : Type u₁} {C₂ : Type u₂} {C₃ : Type u₃} {C₄ : Type u₄} {D : Type u₅} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} C₂] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C₃] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₄, u₄} C₄] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₅, u₅} D] {T : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C₁ C₂} {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} C₁ C₃} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₄, u₂, u₄} C₂ C₄} {B : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₄, u₃, u₄} C₃ C₄} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₅, u₂, u₅} C₂ D} (E : R.LeftExtension F) (w : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare T L R B) (X₃ : C₃) [(w.costructuredArrowRightwards X₃).Final] : (E.compTwoSquare w).IsPointwiseLeftKanExtensionAt X₃ ≃ E.IsPointwiseLeftKanExtensionAt (B.obj X₃)

docstring:
When we have a commutative diagram from a sequence of two maps to another,
such that the left vertical map is surjective, the middle vertical map is bijective and the right
vertical map is injective, then the upper row is exact iff the lower row is.
See `ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono` in the file
`Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/Exact.lean` for the categorical version of this result.
name: AddMonoidHom.exact_iff_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_injective
statement_text: {M₁ : Type u_8} {M₂ : Type u_9} {M₃ : Type u_10} {N₁ : Type u_11} {N₂ : Type u_12} {N₃ : Type u_13} [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [AddCommMonoid N₁] [AddCommMonoid N₂] [AddCommMonoid N₃] (f : M₁ →+ M₂) (g : M₂ →+ M₃) (f' : N₁ →+ N₂) (g' : N₂ →+ N₃) (τ₁ : M₁ →+ N₁) (τ₂ : M₂ →+ N₂) (τ₃ : M₃ →+ N₃) (comm₁₂ : f'.comp τ₁ = τ₂.comp f) (comm₂₃ : g'.comp τ₂ = τ₃.comp g) (h₁ : Function.Surjective.{u_8 + 1, u_11 + 1} (α := M₁) (β := N₁) ⇑τ₁) (h₂ : Function.Bijective.{u_9 + 1, u_12 + 1} (α := M₂) (β := N₂) ⇑τ₂) (h₃ : Function.Injective.{u_10 + 1, u_13 + 1} (α := M₃) (β := N₃) ⇑τ₃) : Function.Exact.{u_8, u_9, u_10} (M := M₁) (N := M₂) (P := M₃) ⇑f ⇑g ↔ Function.Exact.{u_11, u_12, u_13} (M := N₁) (N := N₂) (P := N₃) ⇑f' ⇑g'

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(-∞, a)` if and only if it
contains an interval `(u, a)` with `l' < u < a`, provided `a` is not a bottom element.
name: mem_nhdsLT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] {a : α} {l' : α} {s : Set α} (hu' : l' < a) : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Iio a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Iio a, Set.Ioo u a ⊆ s

docstring: A submodule's `spanRank` is finite if and only if it is finitely generated.
name: Submodule.spanRank_finite_iff_fg
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} : p.spanRank < Cardinal.aleph0 ↔ p.FG

docstring:
A vector added to the first point lies in the affine span of two points if and only if it is
a multiple of their difference.
name: vadd_left_mem_affineSpan_pair
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {v : V} : Membership.mem (γ := AffineSubspace k P) line[k, p₁, p₂] (v +ᵥ p₁) ↔ ∃ r, r • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) = v

docstring: The `v`-adic norm of an integer is 1 if and only if it is not in the ideal.
name: NumberField.FinitePlace.norm_eq_one_iff_notMem
statement_text: (K : Type u_1) [Field K] {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [Algebra R K] [IsDedekindDomain R] [IsFractionRing R K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Ring.HasFiniteQuotients R] [Infinite R] (x : R) : norm.{u_1} (E := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) ((NumberField.FinitePlace.embedding v) ((algebraMap R K) x : K) : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) = 1 ↔ x ∉ v.asIdeal

docstring:
A function is `C^(n + 1)` if and only if it is differentiable,
and its derivative (formulated in terms of `fderiv`) is `C^n`.
name: contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} : ContDiff 𝕜 (n + 1) f ↔ Differentiable 𝕜 f ∧ (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 f Set.univ) ∧ ContDiff 𝕜 (F := E →L[𝕜] F) n (fderiv 𝕜 f)

docstring:
The order of a meromorphic function `f` at `z₀` equals an integer `n` iff `f` can locally be
written as `f z = (z - z₀) ^ n • g z`, where `g` is analytic and does not vanish at `z₀`.
name: meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} {n : ℤ} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : meromorphicOrderAt f x = ↑n ↔ ∃ g, AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x ∧ g x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ (z : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, f z = (z - x) ^ n • g z

docstring: `(∅ ⟶ B) □ g` lifts against `X ⟶ Y` if and only if `g` lifts against `B ⟹ X ⟶ B ⟹ Y`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_mk_isInitial_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u} C] {A : C} {B : C} {K : C} {L : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {g : K ⟶ L} {h : X ⟶ Y} (i : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.{v, u} A) : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk (i.to B))).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk g)).hom h ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty (X := B ⟹ X) g (CategoryTheory.Functor.map (CategoryTheory.ihom B) h)

docstring:
Let `u : E →L[𝕜] F` be a continuous linear map. A **Fredholm package** for `u` is the data of
Fredholm decompositions `decDom` and `decCodom` of `E` and `F` respectively, together with
a continuous linear equivalence `equiv : decDom.X₁ ≃L[𝕜] decCodom.X₁` between the "essential"
(i.e. finite codimension) parts of these decompositions, such that `u` equals the composition
`decCodom.X₁.subtypeL ∘L equiv ∘L decDom.proj`. In other words, in these
"essential ⊕ inessential" decompositions, the matrix of `u` is
$\begin{pmatrix} \texttt{equiv} & 0 \cr 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$.

We will show in `isFredholm_tfae` that an operator is Fredholm if and only if it admits
a Fredholm package. In practice, the condition that `u` is Fredholm (`IsFredholm`) is always easier
to prove, so if you need a Fredholm package you should probably get it from
`IsFredholm.nonempty_fredholmPackage` or `IsFredholm.fredholmPackage`.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.FredholmPackage
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace F] (u : E →L[𝕜] F) : Type (max u_2 u_3)

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise scalar multiplication of `f` and
`g`, which monovary together on `s`, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ`
monovary together on `s`. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: MonovaryOn.sum_smul_comp_perm_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddCommMonoid β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β} (hfg : MonovaryOn f g ↑s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := β) (∑ i ∈ s, f i • g (σ i)) (∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i) ↔ MonovaryOn f (g ∘ ⇑σ) ↑s

docstring: `M[1/f] = 0` if and only if `D(f) ∩ Supp M = 0`.
name: LocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff_disjoint
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {f : R} : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule.Away f M) ↔ Disjoint (↑(PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)) (Module.support R M)

docstring:
A vector field on a vector space is `C^n` in the manifold sense iff it is `C^n` in the vector
space sense.
name: contMDiffAt_vectorSpace_iff_contDiffAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {V : (x : E) → TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E) x} {x : E} : ContMDiffAt (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E) (ModelWithCorners.tangent (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace (B := E) E (TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E))) n (fun x => ⟨x, V x⟩) x ↔ ContDiffAt 𝕜 n V x

docstring:
A finite family is affinely independent if and only if any affine
combinations (with sum of weights 1) that evaluate to the same point are equal.
name: affineIndependent_iff_eq_of_fintype_affineCombination_eq
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → P) : AffineIndependent k p ↔ ∀ (w1 w2 : ι → k), ∑ i : ι, w1 i = 1 → ∑ i : ι, w2 i = 1 → Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := P) ((Finset.affineCombination k Finset.univ p) w1 : P) ((Finset.affineCombination k Finset.univ p) w2 : P) → w1 = w2

docstring:
A triangle in `Cᵒᵖ` shall be distinguished iff it corresponds to a distinguished
triangle in `C` via the equivalence `triangleOpEquivalence C : (Triangle C)ᵒᵖ ≌ Triangle Cᵒᵖ`.
name: CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Opposite.distinguishedTriangles
statement_text: (C : Type u_1) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.HasShift.{v_1, u_1, 0} C ℤ] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} C] [∀ (n : ℤ), CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive.{v_1, u_1, v_1, u_1} (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor C n)] [CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.{v_1, u_1} C] : Set (CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.{v_1, u_1} Cᵒᵖ)

docstring:
For an adjoint triple `F ⊣ G ⊣ H` where `G` is fully faithful, the natural transformation
`H ⟶ F` is epic at `X` iff the image of the counit of the adjunction `G ⊣ H` under `F` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple.epi_rightToLeft_app_iff_epi_map_adj₂_counit_app
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {H : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} (t : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple F G H) [G.Full] [G.Faithful] {X : C} : CategoryTheory.Epi (t.rightToLeft.app X) ↔ CategoryTheory.Epi (F.map (t.adj₂.counit.app X))

docstring:
Fix a locally convex topology `t` on `𝓓^{n}(Ω, F)`. `t` is coarser than the canonical topology
on `𝓓^{n}(Ω, F)` if and only if it is coarser than the "original topology" given by
`TestFunction.originalTop`.
name: TestFunction.topologicalSpace_le_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {Ω : TopologicalSpace.Opens E} {F : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {t : TopologicalSpace (TestFunction Ω F n)} [IsTopologicalAddGroup (TestFunction Ω F n)] [ContinuousSMul ℝ (TestFunction Ω F n)] [LocallyConvexSpace ℝ (TestFunction Ω F n)] : TestFunction.topologicalSpace Ω F n ≤ t ↔ TestFunction.originalTop Ω F n ≤ t

docstring:
The angle between two vectors is π if and only if they are nonzero
and one is a negative multiple of the other.
name: InnerProductGeometry.angle_eq_pi_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = Real.pi ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r < 0, y = r • x

docstring:
If `S` is a finite and flat `R`-algebra, `R → S` is surjective iff `S ⊗[R] S → S` is an
isomorphism iff the rank of `S` is at most `1` at all primes.
name: Module.Flat.tfae_algebraMap_surjective
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) (S : Type u_2) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Module.Flat R S] [Module.Finite R S] : [Function.Surjective.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} (α := R) (β := S) ⇑(algebraMap R S), Function.Bijective (α := TensorProduct R S S) (β := S) ⇑(LinearMap.mul' R S : TensorProduct R S S →ₗ[R] S), ∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum R), Module.rankAtStalk S p ≤ 1].TFAE

docstring: The value of the quadratic character on `a` is zero iff `a = 0`.

docstring: A space is T₂ iff the neighbourhoods of distinct points generate the bottom filter.
name: t2_iff_nhds

docstring: A sheaf is zero if and only if its stalks are all zero.
name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero
statement_text: {C : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, v} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimits.{u, v} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimits.{u, v} C] {FC : C → C → Type u_1} {CC : C → Type u} [(X Y : C) → FunLike.{u_1 + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (FC X Y) (CC X) (CC Y)] [CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory C FC (CC := CC)] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFilteredColimits (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimits (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{u, v} C] {X : TopCat} (F : TopCat.Sheaf C X) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero F ↔ ∀ (x : ↑X), CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero.{u, v} (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (TopCat.Sheaf.forget C X) (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor C x)) F)

docstring:

`Quotient (Setoid.ker f) ≃ Set.range f` is a homeomorphism.

docstring: In `ZMod (p ^ d)` with `0 < d`, a natural number is a unit iff `p` does not divide it.
name: ZMod.isUnit_natCast_iff_not_dvd_pow

docstring:
There exists `r` such that `p` has distance `r` from all the
points of a set of points in `s` if and only if there exists (possibly
different) `r` such that its `orthogonalProjection` has that distance
from all the points in that set.
name: EuclideanGeometry.exists_dist_eq_iff_exists_dist_orthogonalProjection_eq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace 𝕜 P} [Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} ↥s] [s.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] {ps : Set P} (hps : ps ⊆ ↑s) (p : P) : (∃ r, ∀ p₁ ∈ ps, dist p₁ p = r) ↔ ∃ r, ∀ p₁ ∈ ps, dist p₁ ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s) p) = r

docstring:
An antitone function is continuous at a point if and only if its left and right limits
coincide.
name: Antitone.continuousAt_iff_leftLim_eq_rightLim
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f) {x : α} [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] : ContinuousAt f x ↔ Function.leftLim f x = Function.rightLim f x

docstring:
A map defined on a sigma type (a.k.a. the disjoint union of an indexed family of topological
spaces) is inducing iff its restriction to each component is inducing and each the image of each
component under `f` can be separated from the images of all other components by an open set.
name: inducing_sigma
statement_text: {X : Type u} {ι : Type u_2} {σ : ι → Type u_4} [(i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (σ i)] [TopologicalSpace X] {f : Sigma σ → X} : Topology.IsInducing f ↔ (∀ (i : ι), Topology.IsInducing (f ∘ Sigma.mk (β := σ) i)) ∧ ∀ (i : ι), ∃ U, IsOpen U ∧ ∀ (x : Sigma σ), f x ∈ U ↔ x.fst (β := σ) = i

docstring: An element is in `pinGroup Q` if and only if it is in `lipschitzGroup Q` and `unitary`.
name: pinGroup.mem_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {Q : QuadraticForm R M} {x : CliffordAlgebra Q} : x ∈ pinGroup Q ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Submonoid (CliffordAlgebra Q)) (Submonoid.map (F := (CliffordAlgebra Q)ˣ →* CliffordAlgebra Q) (Units.coeHom (CliffordAlgebra Q)) (lipschitzGroup Q).toSubmonoid) x ∧ Membership.mem (γ := Submonoid (CliffordAlgebra Q)) (unitary (CliffordAlgebra Q)) x

docstring:
A property of objects `Q.unop` is closed under subobjects iff `Q` is closed under

docstring:
A subgroup `H` has index two if and only if there exists `a ∉ H` such that for all `b`, one
of `b * a` and `b` belongs to `H`.

name: SimpleGraph.isIndepSet_compl_iff_isVertexCover
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {c : Set V} : G.IsIndepSet cᶜ ↔ G.IsVertexCover c

docstring:

equal if and only if the unoriented angles are equal.
name: Orientation.angle_eq_iff_oangle_eq_of_sign_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {w : V} {x : V} {y : V} {z : V} (hw : w ≠ 0) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hs : (o.oangle w x).sign = (o.oangle y z).sign) : InnerProductGeometry.angle w x = InnerProductGeometry.angle y z ↔ o.oangle w x = o.oangle y z

docstring: The image of a quotient is torsion iff the group is torsion.
name: IsMulTorsion.quotient_iff

docstring: `2` is a square modulo an odd prime `p` iff `p` is congruent to `1` or `7` mod `8`.
name: ZMod.exists_sq_eq_two_iff

docstring:
If we localise a ring `R` at a submonoid `M` made of regular elements, then `r / m : R[1/M]` is
regular iff `r : R` is.
name: IsLocalization.isRegular_mk'

docstring: A fractional ideal is a unit iff its integral numerator `num` is a unit.
name: FractionalIdeal.isUnit_num

docstring: An object has projective dimension zero iff it is projective and it is not zero object.
name: CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension_eq_zero_iff

docstring:
A set `s` is discrete iff for every `t ⊆ s` there is an open `u` with `u ∩ s = t`.
See `isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen` for a similar version of this with singletons.
name: isDiscrete_iff_forall_subset_exists_isOpen
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsDiscrete s ↔ ∀ t ⊆ s, ∃ u, IsOpen u ∧ u ∩ s = t

docstring:
A commutative algebra is finitely generated if and only if it is a quotient
of a polynomial ring whose variables are indexed by a finset.
name: Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial
statement_text: {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] : Algebra.FiniteType R S ↔ ∃ s f, Function.Surjective (α := MvPolynomial.{uS, uR} (↥s) R) (β := S) ⇑f

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is non-strictly above the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f c b ≤ slope f a c`.
name: lineMap_le_map_iff_slope_le_slope
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (hab : a < b) (h₀ : 0 < r) (h₁ : r < 1) : (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ≤ f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ↔ slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b ≤ slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r)

docstring:
A `Monoid A` is `α`-rootable iff `xⁿ = a` has a solution for all `n ≠ 0 ∈ α` and `a ∈ A`.
Here we adopt a constructive approach where we ask an explicit `root : A → α → A` function such that
* `root a 0 = 1` for all `a ∈ A`
* `(root a n)ⁿ = a` for all `n ≠ 0 ∈ α` and `a ∈ A`.
name: RootableBy
statement_text: (A : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [Monoid A] [Pow A α] [Zero α] : Type (max u_1 u_2)

docstring: A set is countably compact if and only if every countable open cover has a finite subcover.
name: isCountablyCompact_iff_countable_open_cover
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace E] {A : Set E} : IsCountablyCompact A ↔ ∀ (U : ℕ → Set E), (∀ (i : ℕ), IsOpen (U i)) → A ⊆ ⋃ i, U i → ∃ t, A ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, U i

docstring:
A point lies on the sphere if and only if its power with respect to
the sphere is zero.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.power_eq_zero_iff_mem_sphere
statement_text: {P : Type u_2} [MetricSpace P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p : P} (hr : 0 ≤ s.radius) : s.power p = 0 ↔ p ∈ s

docstring:
Integrability in the change of variable formula for differentiable functions: if a real
function `f` is antitone and differentiable on a measurable set `s`, then a function
`g : ℝ → F` is integrable on `f '' s` if and only if `-f' x • g ∘ f` is integrable on `s` .
name: MeasureTheory.integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_deriv_smul_of_antitoneOn
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf' : ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) s x) (hf : AntitoneOn f s) (g : ℝ → F) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (mα := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace) g (f '' s) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.{0, u_1} (ε := F) (mα := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace) (fun x => -f' x • g (f x)) s MeasureTheory.volume

docstring:
if `f` is integrable, then `fun x ↦ f x + g x` is integrable iff `g` is.
See `integrable_add_iff_integrable_right` for the same statement with `f + g` instead
of `fun x ↦ f x + g x`.
name: MeasureTheory.integrable_add_iff_integrable_right'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [NormedAddCommGroup β] {f : α → β} {g : α → β} (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ) : MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_2, u_1} (ε := β) (fun x => f x + g x) μ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable g μ

docstring: `f □ (∅ ⟶ L)` lifts against `X ⟶ ⋆` if and only if `f` lifts against `(L ⟹ X) ⟶ ⋆`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_mk_isInitial_isTerminal_iff'
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u} C] {A : C} {B : C} {K : C} {L : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {f : A ⟶ B} (i : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.{v, u} K) (t : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v, u} Y) : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk f)).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk (i.to L))).hom (t.from X) ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty (X := L ⟹ X) f (t.from (L ⟹ X))

docstring:
The family of elements given by `x : FirstObj P S` is compatible iff `firstMap` and `secondMap`
map it to the same point.
name: CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.compatible_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type (max v u))) {X : C} (R : CategoryTheory.Presieve.{v, u} X) [R.HasPairwisePullbacks] (x : CategoryTheory.Equalizer.FirstObj P R) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.FamilyOfElements.Compatible (P := P) (R := R) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.firstObjEqFamily P R).hom) x) ↔ Eq (α := (fun (X : Type (max u v)) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.SecondObj P R)) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.firstMap P R)) x : (fun (X : Type (max u v)) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.SecondObj P R)) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.secondMap P R)) x : (fun (X : Type (max u v)) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.SecondObj P R))

docstring:
Given a point in an affine subspace, a result of subtracting that point on the right is in the
direction if and only if the other point is in the subspace.
name: AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) (p₂ : P) : p₂ -ᵥ p ∈ s.direction ↔ p₂ ∈ s

docstring:
An ordered additive monoid is `CanonicallyOrderedAdd`
if the ordering coincides with the subtractibility relation,
which is to say, `a ≤ b` iff there exists `c` with `b = a + c`.
This is satisfied by the natural numbers, for example, but not
the integers or other nontrivial ordered groups.

We have `a ≤ b + a` and `a ≤ a + b` as separate fields. In the commutative case the second field
is redundant, but in the noncommutative case (satisfied most relevantly by the ordinals), this
extra field allows us to prove more things without the extra commutativity assumption.
name: CanonicallyOrderedAdd
statement_text: (α : Type u_1) [Add α] [LE α] : Prop

docstring:
A point `x` in a C¹ manifold is an interior point if and only if it gets mapped to the interior
of the model space by any given chart - in other words, the notion of interior points does not
depend on any choice of charts.
name: ModelWithCorners.isInteriorPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [IsManifold I n M] {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H} {x : M} (hn : n ≠ 0) (he : Membership.mem (γ := Set (OpenPartialHomeomorph M H)) (atlas H M) e) (hx : x ∈ e.source) : I.IsInteriorPoint x ↔ ↑(e.extend I) x ∈ interior (e.extend I).target

docstring: A CW complex is finite iff the total number of its cells is finite.
name: Topology.RelCWComplex.finite_iff_finite_cells
statement_text: {X : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] {C : Set X} {D : Set X} [Topology.RelCWComplex C D] : Topology.RelCWComplex.Finite C ↔ Finite.{max (u_2 + 1) 1} ((n : ℕ) × @Topology.RelCWComplex.cell _ inst C _ _ n)

docstring: A function is `C^k` on two open sets iff it is `C^k` on their union.
name: contDiffOn_union_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {t : Set E} {f : E → F} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hs : IsOpen s) (ht : IsOpen t) : ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f (s ∪ t) ↔ ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f s ∧ ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f t

docstring: `f` is right homotopic to `g` iff `g` is right homotopic to `f`.
name: CategoryTheory.Arrow.RightHomotopy.symm
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} V] {u : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {v : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {f : u ⟶ v} {g : u ⟶ v} (h : CategoryTheory.Arrow.RightHomotopy f g) : CategoryTheory.Arrow.RightHomotopy g f

docstring: The cosine of the angle between two vectors is -1 if and only if the angle is π.
name: InnerProductGeometry.cos_eq_neg_one_iff_angle_eq_pi
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : Real.cos (InnerProductGeometry.angle x y) = -1 ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = Real.pi

docstring:
Let `L : C ⥤ D` be a localization functor with respect to a Serre class `P`
in the abelian category `C`. If `G : C ⥤ₑ E` is an exact functor to an abelian
category, it "factors" through `D` (i.e. it is in the essential image of
`whiskeringLeft L P E : (D ⥤ₑ E) ⥤ C ⥤ₑ E`) iff `G` inverts the class
of morphisms `P.isoModSerre`.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.essImage_whiskeringLeft
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{v, u} C] {D : Type u'} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v', u'} D] (L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v', u, u'} C D) (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} C) [P.IsSerreClass] (E : Type u'') [CategoryTheory.Category.{v'', u''} E] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{v'', u''} E] [L.IsLocalization P.isoModSerre] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v', u'} D] [L.Additive] : Eq (α := CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (CategoryTheory.ExactFunctor.{v, v'', u, u''} C E)) (CategoryTheory.Functor.essImage (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.whiskeringLeft L P E)) fun G => P.isoModSerre.IsInvertedBy (G.obj (P := CategoryTheory.exactFunctor C E))

docstring:
Given `u : α → β` a uniform inducing map, a family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous on a
subset `S : Set X` iff the family `𝓕'`, obtained by composing each function of `𝓕` by `u`, is
equicontinuous on `S`.
name: IsUniformInducing.equicontinuousOn_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → X → α} {S : Set X} {u : α → β} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : EquicontinuousOn F S ↔ EquicontinuousOn.{u_1, u_3, u_8} (α := β) ((fun x => u ∘ x) ∘ F) S

docstring: An element `a` is regular if and only if a positive power of `a` is regular.
name: IsRegular.pow_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Monoid R] {a : R} {n : ℕ} (n0 : 0 < n) : IsRegular (a ^ n) ↔ IsRegular a

docstring:
`s ∪ star s` commutes pairwise if and only if all elements of `s` are normal, elements of `s`
commute pairwise, and distinct elements of `s` commute with the `star` of the other.
name: Set.Pairwise.commute_union_star_self_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Mul R] [StarMul R] {s : Set R} : (s ∪ star s).Pairwise Commute ↔ s.Pairwise Commute ∧ (s.Pairwise fun x1 x2 => Commute x1 (star x2)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, IsStarNormal x

docstring:
If `A` is a finite type algebra over an Artinian ring `R`,
then `A` is finite over `R` if and only if `A` is an Artinian ring.
name: Module.finite_iff_isArtinianRing
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra.FiniteType R A] [IsArtinianRing R] : Module.Finite R A ↔ IsArtinianRing A

docstring:
The oriented angle between two vectors is zero or `π` if and only if the first vector is zero
or the second is a multiple of the first.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_zero_or_eq_pi_iff_right_eq_smul
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y = 0 ∨ o.oangle x y = ↑Real.pi ↔ x = 0 ∨ ∃ r, y = r • x

docstring: Symmetric projections are equal iff their range are.
name: LinearMap.IsSymmetricProjection.ext_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {S : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (hS : LinearMap.IsSymmetricProjection.{u_1, u_2} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) S) (hT : LinearMap.IsSymmetricProjection.{u_1, u_2} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) T) : S = T ↔ S.range = T.range

docstring:
A category (with morphisms in `Type v`) is well-powered relative to a universe `w`
if it is locally small and `Subobject X` is `w`-small for every `X`.

We show in `wellPowered_of_essentiallySmall_monoOver` and `essentiallySmall_monoOver`
that this is the case if and only if `MonoOver X` is `w`-essentially small for every `X`.
name: CategoryTheory.WellPowered
statement_text: (C : Type u₁) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.LocallySmall.{w, v, u₁} C] : Prop

docstring:
A point lies in the interior of a 1-dimensional face of a simplex if and only if it lies
strictly between its vertices.
name: Affine.Simplex.mem_interior_face_iff_sbtw
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_4} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module R V] [AddTorsor V P] [IsOrderedRing R] [IsDomain R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R V] {n : ℕ} (s : Affine.Simplex R P n) {p : P} {i : Fin (n + 1)} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i ≠ j) : p ∈ (s.face (fs := {i, j}) ⋯).interior ↔ Sbtw R (s.points i) p (s.points j)

docstring:
The angle between two vectors is zero if and only if they are
nonzero and one is a positive multiple of the other.
name: InnerProductGeometry.angle_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = 0 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ y = r • x

docstring: Two closed sets are at zero Hausdorff distance if and only if they coincide.
name: IsClosed.hausdorffDist_zero_iff_eq
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoMetricSpace α] {s : Set α} {t : Set α} (hs : IsClosed s) (ht : IsClosed t) (fin : Metric.hausdorffEDist s t ≠ ⊤) : Metric.hausdorffDist s t = 0 ↔ s = t

docstring:
`f : M → N` is called a **`C^n` local diffeomorphism on `s`** iff it is a local diffeomorphism
at each `x : s`.
name: IsLocalDiffeomorphOn
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {H₁ : Type u_5} [TopologicalSpace H₁] {H₂ : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H₂] (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H₁) (J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 F H₂) {M : Type u_8} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H₁ M] {N : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace H₂ N] (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (f : M → N) (s : Set M) : Prop

docstring:
A set is irreducible if and only if for every cover by a finite collection of closed sets, it is
contained in one of the members of the collection.
name: isIrreducible_iff_sUnion_isClosed
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsIrreducible s ↔ ∀ (t : Finset (Set X)), (∀ z ∈ t, IsClosed z) → s ⊆ ⋃₀ ↑t → ∃ z ∈ t, s ⊆ z

docstring:
Under `UniqueDiffOn`, a function is absolutely monotone on `s` iff it is `C^∞` on `s` with
every iterated derivative within `s` nonnegative.
name: AbsolutelyMonotoneOn.iff_iteratedDerivWithin_nonneg
statement_text: {f : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} (hs : UniqueDiffOn ℝ s) : AbsolutelyMonotoneOn f s ↔ ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f s ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ iteratedDerivWithin n f s x

docstring:
A finite family of vectors `v i` is linear independent iff the linear map that sends
`c : ι → R` to `∑ i, c i • v i` has the trivial kernel.
name: Fintype.linearIndependent_iff'
statement_text: {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] : LinearIndependent R v ↔ Eq (α := Submodule R (ι → R)) (LinearMap.ker (R₂ := R) (M₂ := M) (τ₁₂ := RingHom.id R) ((LinearMap.lsum R (fun x => R) ℕ) fun i => LinearMap.smulRight LinearMap.id (v i))) ⊥

docstring:
The morphism `(m, x) ↦ (m • x, x)` is an isomorphism if and only if the induced
action is pointwise simply transitive.
name: CategoryTheory.ModObj.isIso_leftSMul_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] {M : C} [CategoryTheory.MonObj M] {X : C} [CategoryTheory.ModObj M X] : CategoryTheory.IsIso.{v, u} (X := CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{v, u} (𝒞 := inst) M X) (CategoryTheory.ModObj.leftSMul M X) ↔ ∀ (Z : C) (x y : Z ⟶ X), ∃! m : Z ⟶ M, m • x = y

docstring: A category has a subobject classifier if and only if the subobjects functor is representable.
name: CategoryTheory.hasSubobjectClassifier_iff_isRepresentable
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasTerminal.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.HasSubobjectClassifier.{v, u} C ↔ CategoryTheory.Functor.IsRepresentable (Subobject.presheaf C)

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `𝟙 M ⊗ f` is injective whenever `f` is an injective linear map.
See `Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap` to specialize the universe of
`N, N', N''` to `Type (max u v)`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap'
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Small.{v', u} R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' : Type v'⦄ [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), Function.Injective (α := N) (β := N') ⇑f → Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R M N) (β := TensorProduct R M N') ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f)

docstring:
`v ∈ Kᗮ` if and only if `⟪v, u⟫ = 0` for all `u ∈ K`.
Variation of `mem_orthogonal` with the inner product reversed.
name: ClosedSubmodule.mem_orthogonal'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_4} {E : Type u_5} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (K : ClosedSubmodule 𝕜 E) (v : E) : v ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ u ∈ K, inner 𝕜 v u = 0

docstring: A cone is limit iff it is so after the application of `coyoneda.obj X` for all `X : Cᵒᵖ`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.isLimitCoyonedaEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {J : Type w} [CategoryTheory.Category.{t, w} J] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{t, v, w, u} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ ((X : Cᵒᵖ) → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (F := F.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.coyoneda X)) (CategoryTheory.Functor.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.coyoneda X) c))

docstring:
Two affine subspaces with nonempty intersection are equal if and only if their directions are
equal.
name: AffineSubspace.eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s₁ : AffineSubspace k P} {s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (h₁ : p ∈ s₁) (h₂ : p ∈ s₂) : s₁ = s₂ ↔ s₁.direction = s₂.direction

docstring: `f □ g` lifts against `h` if and only if `g` lifts against `f ⋔ h`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_mk_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] {A : C} {B : C} {K : C} {L : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {f : A ⟶ B} {g : K ⟶ L} {h : X ⟶ Y} : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk f)).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk g)).hom h ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty g ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pullbackHom (Opposite.op (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk f))).obj (CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk h)).hom

docstring:
The top submodule of another submodule `N` is FG iff `N` is `FG`.

See also `Module.Finite.fg_top`.
name: Submodule.fg_top
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] (N : Submodule R M) : Submodule.FG.{u_1, u_2} (R := R) (M := ↥N) ⊤ ↔ N.FG

docstring: `Aᵀ` has orthogonal rows iff `A` has orthogonal columns.
name: Matrix.transpose_hasOrthogonalRows_iff_hasOrthogonalCols
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] (A : Matrix m n α) [Fintype m] : A.transpose.HasOrthogonalRows ↔ A.HasOrthogonalCols

docstring:
A morphism is a (locally-closed) immersion if and only if it can be factored into
a closed immersion followed by an open immersion.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsImmersion.isImmersion_iff_exists
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ Y} : AlgebraicGeometry.IsImmersion f ↔ ∃ Z g₁ g₂, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion g₁ ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion g₂ ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g₁ g₂ = f

docstring: A set is residual iff it includes a countable intersection of dense open sets.
name: mem_residual_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : s ∈ residual X ↔ ∃ S, (∀ t ∈ S, IsOpen t) ∧ (∀ t ∈ S, Dense t) ∧ S.Countable ∧ ⋂₀ S ⊆ s

docstring:
Canonical form of the **equality case of Jensen's equality**.

For a strictly convex function `f` and positive weights `w`, we have
`f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i)` if and only if the points `p` are all equal
(and in fact all equal to their center of mass w.r.t. `w`).
name: StrictConvexOn.map_sum_eq_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] [IsStrictOrderedModule 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} {t : Finset ι} {w : ι → 𝕜} {p : ι → E} (hf : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f) (h₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 < w i) (h₁ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hmem : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s) : f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i) ↔ ∀ j ∈ t, p j = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i

docstring:
A discrete process `u` is predictable iff `u (n + 1)` is `𝓕 n`-measurable for all `n` and
`u 0` is `𝓕 0`-measurable.
name: MeasureTheory.IsStronglyPredictable.iff_measurable_add_one
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {E : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace E] {𝓕 : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m} {u : ℕ → Ω → E} : MeasureTheory.IsStronglyPredictable 𝓕 u ↔ MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (u 0) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (u (n + 1))

docstring:
The map of a fan is a limit iff the fan consisting of the mapped morphisms is a limit. This
essentially lets us commute `Fan.mk` with `Functor.mapCone`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitMapConeFanMkEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) {J : Type w} (f : J → C) {P : C} (g : (j : J) → P ⟶ f j) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (G.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fan.mk P g)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.{w, v₂, w, u₂} (J := CategoryTheory.Discrete J) (F := CategoryTheory.Discrete.functor fun j => G.obj (f j)) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fan.mk (G.obj P) fun j => G.map (g j))

docstring:
Given a family of vertex types indexed by `ι`, pulling back from `⊤ : SimpleGraph ι`
yields the complete multipartite graph on the family.
Two vertices are adjacent if and only if their indices are not equal.
name: SimpleGraph.completeMultipartiteGraph
statement_text: {ι : Type u_5} (V : ι → Type u_6) : SimpleGraph ((i : ι) × V i)

docstring:
If `A` is a finite type algebra over an Artinian ring `R`,
then `A` is finite over `R` if and only if `dim A = 0`.
name: Module.finite_iff_krullDimLE_zero

docstring:
Returns the `GenContFract` of a value. In fact, the returned gcf is also a `ContFract` that
terminates if and only if `v` is rational
(see `Mathlib/Algebra/ContinuedFractions/Computation/TerminatesIffRat.lean`).

The continued fraction representation of `v` is given by `[⌊v⌋; b₀, b₁, b₂,...]`, where
`[b₀; b₁, b₂,...]` recursively is the continued fraction representation of `1 / (v - ⌊v⌋)`. This
process stops when the fractional part `v - ⌊v⌋` hits 0 at some step.

The implementation uses `IntFractPair.stream` to obtain the partial denominators of the continued
fraction. Refer to said function for more details about the computation process.

statement_text: {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {mF : MeasurableSpace F} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure F} [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [BorelSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology F] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] {ξ : MeasureTheory.Measure (E × F)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ξ] : (∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ (E × F)), MeasureTheory.charFunDual ξ L = MeasureTheory.charFunDual μ (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E F)) * MeasureTheory.charFunDual ν (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E F))) ↔ ξ = μ.prod ν

docstring: A ring has krull dimension at most zero if and only if all minimal primes are maximal.
name: Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff_forall_minimalPrimes_isMaximal
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R ↔ ∀ (I : Ideal R), Membership.mem (γ := Set (Ideal R)) (minimalPrimes R) I → I.IsMaximal

docstring:
The seminorm of an element in a product space is `< r` if and only if the norm of each
component is.
name: pi_norm_lt_iff'
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {G : ι → Type u_5} [Fintype ι] [(i : ι) → SeminormedGroup (G i)] {x : (i : ι) → G i} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : ‖x‖ < r ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ‖x i‖ < r

docstring:
The **Lefschetz principle**. A first-order sentence is modeled by the theory
of algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero if and only if it is modeled by
the theory of algebraically closed fields of characteristic `p` for infinitely many `p`.
name: FirstOrder.Field.ACF_zero_realize_iff_infinite_ACF_prime_realize
statement_text: {φ : FirstOrder.Language.ring.Sentence} : FirstOrder.Language.Theory.ACF 0 ⊨ᵇ φ ↔ Set.Infinite (α := Nat.Primes) {p | FirstOrder.Language.Theory.ACF ↑p ⊨ᵇ φ}

docstring:
A morphism in `Truncated d` is an epimorphism if and only if it is an epimorphism in
`SimplexCategory`.
name: SimplexCategory.Truncated.epi_iff
statement_text: {d : ℕ} {a : SimplexCategory.Truncated d} {b : SimplexCategory.Truncated d} {f : a ⟶ b} : CategoryTheory.Epi f ↔ CategoryTheory.Epi f.hom

docstring:
A presheaf is a sheaf for the `P`-qc topology if and only if it is a sheaf
for the Zariski topology and satisfies the sheaf property for all single object coverings
`{ f : Spec S ⟶ Spec R }` where `f` satisfies `P`.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSheaf_propQCTopology_iff
statement_text: {P : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] {A : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} A] [P.IsMultiplicative] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u, v_1, u + 1, u_1} AlgebraicGeometry.Schemeᵒᵖ A) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsZariskiLocalAtSource P] : CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.propQCTopology P) F ↔ CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.zariskiTopology F ∧ ∀ {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S), P (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map f) → AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map f) → ∀ (M : A), CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor (F.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.coyoneda (Opposite.op M))) (CategoryTheory.Presieve.singleton (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map f))

docstring: In a finite ring, an element is a unit iff it is a non-zero-divisor.
name: isUnit_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_finite
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {a : R} [Finite R] : IsUnit a ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Submonoid R) (nonZeroDivisors R) a

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `f ⊗ 𝟙 M` is injective whenever `f` is an injective linear map.
See `Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap'` to generalize the universe of
`N, N', N''` to any universe that is higher than `R` and `M`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' : Type (max u v)⦄ [inst_3 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_5 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), Function.Injective (α := N) (β := N') ⇑f → Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R N M) (β := TensorProduct R N' M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f)

docstring:
Variant of `accPt_iff_frequently`: A point `x` is an accumulation point of a set `C` iff points in
punctured neighborhoods are frequently contained in `C`.
name: accPt_iff_frequently_nhdsNE
statement_text: {X : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} {C : Set X} : AccPt x (Filter.principal C) ↔ ∃ᶠ (y : X) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, y ∈ C

docstring:
The angle between two vectors is `θ` if and only if they are nonzero and the second vector
is the first rotated by `θ` and scaled by the ratio of the norms, or `θ` and at least one of the
vectors are zero.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_iff_eq_norm_div_norm_smul_rotation_or_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (θ : Real.Angle) : o.oangle x y = θ ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ y = HSMul.hSMul (β := V) (‖y‖ / ‖x‖) ((o.rotation θ) x : V) ∨ θ = 0 ∧ (x = 0 ∨ y = 0)

docstring: Self-adjoint elements commute if and only if their product is self-adjoint.
name: IsSelfAdjoint.commute_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_3} [Mul R] [StarMul R] {x : R} {y : R} (hx : IsSelfAdjoint x) (hy : IsSelfAdjoint y) : Commute x y ↔ IsSelfAdjoint (x * y)

docstring: A left transversal is finite iff the subgroup has finite index.
name: Subgroup.IsComplement.finite_left_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {H : Subgroup G} {S : Set G} (h : Subgroup.IsComplement S ↑H) : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑S ↔ H.FiniteIndex

docstring: An object of `Rep k G` is zero iff its restriction to `H` is zero.
name: Rep.isZero_res_iff
statement_text: {G : Type v1} {H : Type v2} [Monoid G] [Monoid H] (f : H →* G) {k : Type u} [Ring k] (M : Rep.{u_1, u, v1} k G) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (Rep.res f M) ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero M

docstring:
If `f` is a linear map injective on the span of the range of `v`, then the family `f ∘ v`
is linearly independent if and only if the family `v` is linearly independent.
See `LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_disjoint` for the version with `Set.InjOn` replaced
by `Disjoint` when working over a ring.
name: LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_injOn
statement_text: {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {M' : Type u_5} {v : ι → M} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M'] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (hf_inj : Set.InjOn.{u_4, u_5} (β := M') ⇑f ↑(Submodule.span R (Set.range v))) : LinearIndependent.{u', u_2, u_5} R (M := M') (⇑f ∘ v) ↔ LinearIndependent R v

docstring:
A convenient formulation for a pushout being a van Kampen colimit. For any commutative cube of
which a van Kampen pushout forms the bottom face and the back faces are pullbacks, the front faces
are pullbacks if and only if the top face is a pushout. See `IsPushout.isVanKampen_iff` below.
name: CategoryTheory.IsPushout.IsVanKampen
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {W : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : W ⟶ X} {g : W ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {i : Y ⟶ Z} : CategoryTheory.IsPushout f g h i → Prop

docstring:
The separable closure of `F` in `E` is equal to `E` if and only if `E / F` is
separable.
name: separableClosure.eq_top_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] : Eq (α := IntermediateField F E) (separableClosure F E) ⊤ ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable F E

docstring:
A nontrivial additive monoid has prime exponent `p` if and only if every
non-identity element has order `p`.
name: AddMonoid.exponent_eq_prime_iff
