statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddMonoid G] [Nontrivial G] {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) : AddMonoid.exponent G = p ↔ ∀ (g : G), g ≠ 0 → addOrderOf g = p

docstring:
*McCoy theorem*: a polynomial `P : R[X]` is a zerodivisor if and only if there is `a : R`
such that `a ≠ 0` and `a • P = 0`.
name: Polynomial.notMem_nonZeroDivisors_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {P : Polynomial R} : P ∉ nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial R) ↔ ∃ a, a ≠ 0 ∧ a • P = 0

docstring:
If `A` is an essentially of finite type algebra over a field `K`, then `A` is formally étale
over `K` if and only if `A` is a finite product of separable field extensions.
name: Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod
statement_text: (K : Type u_1) (A : Type u) [Field K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra.EssFiniteType K A] : Algebra.FormallyEtale K A ↔ ∃ I, ∃ (_ : Finite I), ∃ Ai x x_1 x_2, ∀ (i : I), Algebra.IsSeparable.{u_1, u} K (Ai i)

docstring: Sets of subtype are compact iff the image under a coercion is.
name: Subtype.isCompact_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {p : X → Prop} {s : Set { x : X // p x }} : IsCompact s ↔ IsCompact (Subtype.val (p := fun x => p x) '' s)

docstring: The series defining the theta function is summable if and only if `0 < im τ`.
name: summable_jacobiTheta₂_term_iff
statement_text: (z : ℂ) (τ : ℂ) : (Summable (α := ℂ) fun x => jacobiTheta₂_term x z τ) ↔ 0 < τ.im

docstring:
A ring is a Jacobson ring if and only if for all prime ideals `P`,
the Jacobson radical of `P` is equal to `P`.
name: isJacobsonRing_iff_prime_eq
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] : IsJacobsonRing R ↔ ∀ (P : Ideal R), P.IsPrime → P.jacobson = P

docstring:
The maps `f` and `g` form an exact pair:
`g y = 0` iff `y` belongs to the image of `f`.
name: Function.Exact
statement_text: {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} {P : Type u_6} (f : M → N) (g : N → P) [Zero P] : Prop

docstring:
An additive group `G` is finitely generated if and only if `R[G]` is of
finite type.
name: AddMonoidAlgebra.finiteType_iff_group_fg
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {G : Type u_3} [AddGroup G] [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] : Algebra.FiniteType R (AddMonoidAlgebra R G) ↔ AddGroup.FG G

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → β → α` is uniformly equicontinuous iff `range 𝓕` is uniformly equicontinuous,
i.e the family `(↑) : range F → β → α` is uniformly equicontinuous.
name: uniformEquicontinuous_iff_range
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → β → α} : UniformEquicontinuous F ↔ UniformEquicontinuous (ι := { x : β → α // x ∈ Set.range F }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range F))

docstring:
If `C` is finitely accessible and `P` implies finitely presentable, then `X`
satisfies `ind P` if and only if every morphism `Z ⟶ X` from a finitely presentable object
factors via an object satisfying `P`.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ind_iff_exists
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} C} (H : P ≤ CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isFinitelyPresentable C) [CategoryTheory.IsFinitelyAccessibleCategory.{w, v, u} C] {X : C} : P.ind X ↔ ∀ {Z : C} (g : Z ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.IsFinitelyPresentable.{w, v, u} Z], ∃ W u v, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp u v = g ∧ P W

docstring:
A function between diffeological spaces is smooth iff composition with it preserves
smoothness of plots.
name: Diffeology.DSmooth
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [DiffeologicalSpace X] [DiffeologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) : Prop

docstring:
An element of `ℤ√d` has norm equal to `1` if and only if it is contained in the submonoid
of unitary elements.
name: Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff_mem_unitary
statement_text: {d : ℤ} {a : ℤ√d} : a.norm = 1 ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Submonoid (ℤ√d)) (unitary (ℤ√d)) a

docstring:
The **universal property** of the topology on `𝓓^{n}_{K}(E, F)`: a map to `𝓓^{n}_{K}(E, F)`
is continuous if and only if its composition with the structure map
`structureMapCLM ℝ n i : 𝓓^{n}_{K}(E, F) → (E →ᵇ (E [×i]→L[ℝ] F))` is continuous for each
`i ≤ n`.
name: ContDiffMapSupportedIn.continuous_iff_comp_order_le
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} {X : Type u_5} [TopologicalSpace X] (φ : X → ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) : Continuous φ ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ), ↑i ≤ n → Continuous (Y := BoundedContinuousFunction E (E [×i]→L[ℝ] F)) (⇑(ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ n i) ∘ φ)

docstring:
Two complementary submodules are topological complements if and only if the linear equivalence
`Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl` is a homeomorphism.
name: Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_iff_isHomeomorph_prodEquivOfIsCompl
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {M : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} {q : Submodule R M} [IsTopologicalAddGroup M] (h : IsCompl p q) : Submodule.IsTopCompl p q ↔ IsHomeomorph (X := ↥p × ↥q) (Y := M) ⇑(p.prodEquivOfIsCompl q h)

docstring: `basis σ R ⟨J, d⟩ ≤ basis σ R ⟨K, e⟩` if and only if `J ≤ K` and `e ≤ d`.
name: MvPowerSeries.LinearTopology.basis_le_iff
statement_text: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] {J : TwoSidedIdeal R} {K : TwoSidedIdeal R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {e : σ →₀ ℕ} (hK : K ≠ ⊤) : MvPowerSeries.LinearTopology.basis σ R (J, d) ≤ MvPowerSeries.LinearTopology.basis σ R (K, e) ↔ J ≤ K ∧ e ≤ d

docstring:
A cofork is a colimit cocone if and only if the corresponding fork in the opposite category is
a limit cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.isColimitEquivIsLimitOp
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork f g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c.op

docstring: `g` lies in the `p`-primary component iff `g ^ p ^ k = 1` for some `k`.
name: CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [CommGroup G] {p : ℕ} {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := Subgroup G) (CommGroup.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ k, g ^ p ^ k = 1

docstring:
A precoverage `K` generates the topology `J` if a presheaf on `C` is a sheaf
for `K` if and only if it is a sheaf for `J`.
name: CategoryTheory.Precoverage.Generates
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (K : CategoryTheory.Precoverage.{v, u} C) (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C) : Prop

docstring: If `f` is an affine map, then its linear part is an open embedding iff `f` is an open embedding.
name: AffineMap.isOpenEmbedding_linear_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} {Q : Type u_5} [AddCommGroup V] [TopologicalSpace V] [AddTorsor V P] [TopologicalSpace P] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor P] [AddCommGroup W] [TopologicalSpace W] [AddTorsor W Q] [TopologicalSpace Q] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor Q] [Ring R] [_root_.Module R V] [_root_.Module R W] {f : P →ᵃ[R] Q} : Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.{u_2, u_4} (X := V) (Y := W) ⇑f.linear ↔ Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.{u_3, u_5} (X := P) (Y := Q) ⇑f

docstring:
This is the special case of `Valuation.Integers.isUnit_of_one` when the valuation is defined
over a field. Let `v` be a valuation on some field `F` and `O` be its integers. For every element
`x` in `O`, `x` is a unit in `O` if and only if the image of `x` in `F` has valuation 1.
name: Valuation.Integers.isUnit_of_one'
statement_text: {F : Type u} {Γ₀ : Type v} [Field F] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation F Γ₀} {O : Type w} [CommRing O] [Algebra O F] (hv : v.Integers O) {x : O} (hvx : v ((algebraMap O F) x : F) = 1) : IsUnit x

docstring:
A linearly-ordered additive abelian group is cyclic iff it is isomorphic to `ℤ` as an ordered
additive monoid.
name: LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.isAddCyclic_iff_nonempty_equiv_int
statement_text: {A : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup A] [LinearOrder A] [IsOrderedAddMonoid A] [Nontrivial A] : IsAddCyclic A ↔ Nonempty.{max 1 (u_4 + 1)} (A ≃+o ℤ)

docstring:
A function is meromorphic in normal form at a point iff it is meromorphic in normal form after
composition with an analytic function of nonvanishing derivative, such as translation.
name: meromorphicNFAt_comp_iff_of_deriv_ne_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} [CompleteSpace 𝕜] [CharZero 𝕜] {x : 𝕜} {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (hg : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x) (hg' : deriv g x ≠ 0) : MeromorphicNFAt (f ∘ g) x ↔ MeromorphicNFAt f (g x)

docstring: `G` contains `H` if and only if `G` has a subgraph `G'` and `G'` is isomorphic to `H`.
name: SimpleGraph.isContained_iff_exists_iso_subgraph
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} : H.IsContained G ↔ ∃ G', Nonempty (H ≃g G'.coe)

docstring:
An orthogonal family of subspaces of `E` satisfies `DirectSum.IsInternal` (that is,
they provide an internal direct sum decomposition of `E`) if and only if their span has trivial
orthogonal complement.
name: OrthogonalFamily.isInternal_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {ι : Type u_4} [DecidableEq ι] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {V : ι → Submodule 𝕜 E} (hV : OrthogonalFamily.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_2} 𝕜 (E := E) (fun (i : ι) => ↥(V i)) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) : DirectSum.IsInternal V ↔ (iSup V)ᗮ = ⊥

docstring:
A monic polynomial lifts if and only if it can be lifted to a monic polynomial
of the same degree.
name: Polynomial.lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic
statement_text: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {S : Type v} [Semiring S] {f : R →+* S} [Nontrivial S] {p : Polynomial S} (hlifts : p ∈ Polynomial.lifts f) (hp : p.Monic) : ∃ q, Polynomial.map f q = p ∧ q.degree = p.degree ∧ q.Monic

docstring:
The map of a fork is a limit iff the fork consisting of the mapped morphisms is a limit. This
essentially lets us commute `Fork.ofι` with `Functor.mapCone`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitMapConeForkEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} {h : Z ⟶ X} (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (G.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι h w)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι (G.map h) ⋯)

docstring:
A closed set `s` is preconnected if and only if for every cover by two closed sets that are
disjoint, it is contained in one of the two covering sets.
name: isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_fully_disjoint_closed
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} (hs : IsClosed s) : IsPreconnected s ↔ ∀ (u v : Set α), IsClosed u → IsClosed v → s ⊆ u ∪ v → Disjoint u v → s ⊆ u ∨ s ⊆ v

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which monovary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ` monovary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: Monovary.sum_mul_comp_perm_eq_sum_mul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Monovary f g) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i : ι, f i * g (σ i)) (∑ i : ι, f i * g i) ↔ Monovary f (g ∘ ⇑σ)

docstring: On (starGraph r), r is adjacent to v iff v ≠ r.
name: SimpleGraph.starGraph_adj_center_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {r : V} {v : V} : (SimpleGraph.starGraph r).Adj r v ↔ r ≠ v

docstring:
An element in a non-unital C⋆-algebra is selfadjoint if and only if it is normal and its
quasispectrum is contained in `ℝ`.
name: isSelfAdjoint_iff_isStarNormal_and_quasispectrumRestricts
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace A] [NonUnitalRing A] [StarRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A] [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A] [NonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℂ A IsStarNormal] {a : A} : IsSelfAdjoint a ↔ IsStarNormal a ∧ QuasispectrumRestricts (R := ℝ) (S := ℂ) a ⇑Complex.reCLM

docstring:
The **universal property** of the topology on `𝓓^{n}(Ω, F)`: a **linear** map from
`𝓓^{n}(Ω, F)` to a locally convex topological vector space is continuous if and only if its
precomposition with the inclusion `ofSupportedIn K_sub_Ω : 𝓓^{n}_{K}(E, F) → 𝓓^{n}(Ω, F)` is
continuous for every compact `K ⊆ Ω`.
name: TestFunction.continuous_iff_continuous_comp
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {Ω : TopologicalSpace.Opens E} {F : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : ℕ∞} {V : Type u_6} [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module ℝ V] [TopologicalSpace V] [IsTopologicalAddGroup V] [ContinuousSMul ℝ V] [LocallyConvexSpace ℝ V] [Algebra ℝ 𝕜] [IsScalarTower ℝ 𝕜 F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 V] [IsScalarTower ℝ 𝕜 V] (f : TestFunction Ω F n →ₗ[𝕜] V) : Continuous (X := TestFunction Ω F n) (Y := V) ⇑f ↔ ∀ (K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E) (K_sub_Ω : ↑K ⊆ ↑Ω), Continuous (X := ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (Y := V) (⇑f ∘ TestFunction.ofSupportedIn K_sub_Ω)

docstring:
An oriented angle is zero if and only if the angle with the order of the points reversed is
zero.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_zero_iff_oangle_rev_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0 ↔ EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₃ p₂ p₁ = 0

docstring:
The order of a formal power series is at least `n` if and only if its coefficients below `n`
vanish.
name: PowerSeries.le_order_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {φ : PowerSeries R} {n : ℕ∞} : n ≤ φ.order ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ), ↑i < n → (PowerSeries.coeff i) φ = 0

docstring:
A ring of characteristic zero has equal characteristic iff it does not
have mixed characteristic for any `p`.
name: EqualCharZero.iff_not_mixedCharZero
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] [CharZero R] : (∀ (I : Ideal R), I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero.{u_1} (R ⧸ I)) ↔ ∀ p > 0, ¬MixedCharZero R p

docstring:
A vector space has dimension `1` if and only if there is a
single non-zero vector of which all vectors are multiples.
name: rank_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Ring K] [StrongRankCondition K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] [Module.Free K V] : Module.rank K V = 1 ↔ ∃ v₀, v₀ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (v : V), ∃ r, r • v₀ = v

docstring:
The map of a cofork is a colimit iff the cofork consisting of the mapped morphisms is a colimit.
This essentially lets us commute `Cofork.ofπ` with `Functor.mapCocone`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isColimitMapCoconeCoforkEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} {h : Y ⟶ Z} (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f h = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g h) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (G.mapCocone (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.ofπ h w)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.ofπ (G.map h) ⋯)

docstring:
If twice the oriented angles between two triples of points are equal, one triple is affinely
independent if and only if the other is.
name: EuclideanGeometry.affineIndependent_iff_of_two_zsmul_oangle_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} {p₄ : P} {p₅ : P} {p₆ : P} (h : 2 • EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 2 • EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₄ p₅ p₆) : AffineIndependent ℝ ![p₁, p₂, p₃] ↔ AffineIndependent ℝ ![p₄, p₅, p₆]

docstring:
A set is simply connected iff it's path connected
and any loop is homotopic to the constant path within `s`.
name: isSimplyConnected_iff_exists_homotopy_refl_forall_mem
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsSimplyConnected s ↔ IsPathConnected s ∧ ∀ (x : X) (p : Path x x), (∀ (t : ↑unitInterval), Membership.mem (α := X) s (p t : X)) → ∃ F, ∀ (t : ↑unitInterval × ↑unitInterval), Membership.mem (α := X) s (F t : X)

docstring:
The order of a meromorphic function `f` at `z₀` is finite iff `f` has multiplicative inverse
in a sufficiently small neighborhood of `z₀`.
name: meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_mul_inv_eventuallyEq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {𝕜' : Type u_4} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜'] [NormedAlgebra 𝕜 𝕜'] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜'} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : meromorphicOrderAt f x ≠ ⊤ ↔ f * f⁻¹ =ᶠ[nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ] 1

docstring: A function `-f` is strictly concave iff `f` is strictly convex.
name: neg_strictConcaveOn_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_5} [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [SMul 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} : StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s (-f) ↔ StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f

docstring: `x * y` is square-free iff `x` and `y` have no common factors and are themselves square-free.
name: squarefree_mul_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero R] [IsCancelMulZero R] {x : R} {y : R} [DecompositionMonoid R] : Squarefree (x * y) ↔ IsRelPrime x y ∧ Squarefree x ∧ Squarefree y

docstring:
If two right extensions `E` and `E'` are isomorphic, `E` is a pointwise
right Kan extension iff `E'` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.RightExtension.isPointwiseRightKanExtensionEquivOfIso
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} {H : Type u_4} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_4, u_4} H] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_4, u_1, u_4} C H} {E : L.RightExtension F} {E' : L.RightExtension F} (e : E ≅ E') : E.IsPointwiseRightKanExtension ≃ E'.IsPointwiseRightKanExtension

docstring: `g` lies in the `p`-primary component iff `g ^ p ^ k = 1` for some `k`.
name: CommMonoid.mem_primaryComponent
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [CommMonoid G] {p : ℕ} {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := Submonoid G) (CommMonoid.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ k, g ^ p ^ k = 1

docstring:
A function `f : 𝕜 → 𝕜` is convex iff for any three points `x < y < z` the slope of the secant
line of `f` on `[x, y]` is less than the slope of the secant line of `f` on `[y, z]`.
name: convexOn_iff_slope_mono_adjacent
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] {s : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f ↔ Convex 𝕜 s ∧ ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄, x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f y - f x) / (y - x) ≤ (f z - f y) / (z - y)

docstring:
A family of points in a projective space is dependent if and only if their
representatives are linearly dependent.
name: Projectivization.dependent_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {f : ι → Projectivization K V} : Projectivization.Dependent f ↔ ¬LinearIndependent K (Projectivization.rep ∘ f)

docstring: The maximal reduction of a word. It is computable iff `α` has decidable equality.
name: FreeAddGroup.reduce
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (L : List (α × Bool)) : List (α × Bool)

docstring:
For an invertible matrix `U`, `U * x * star U` is positive definite iff `x` is.
This works on any ⋆-ring with a partial order.

See `IsUnit.isStrictlyPositive_star_right_conjugate_iff` for a similar statement for star-ordered
rings. For matrices, positive definiteness is equivalent to strict positivity when the underlying
field is `ℝ` or `ℂ` (see `Matrix.isStrictlyPositive_iff_posDef`).
name: Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_right_conjugate_iff
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {x : Matrix n n R} {U : Matrix n n R} (hU : IsUnit U) : (U * x * star U).PosDef ↔ x.PosDef

docstring:
An additive subgroup is nilpotent iff its lower central series eventually
vanishes.
name: AddSubgroup.isNilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] (S : AddSubgroup G) : AddGroup.IsNilpotent.{u_1} ↥S ↔ ∃ n, S.lowerCentralSeries n = ⊥

docstring:
A `Finitary` matroid is one where a set is independent if and only if it all
its finite subsets are independent, or equivalently a matroid whose circuits are finite.
name: Matroid.Finitary
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} (M : Matroid α) : Prop

docstring: An extension is purely inseparable if and only if it has finite separable degree one.
name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_finSepDegree_eq_one
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] : IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ Field.finSepDegree F E = 1

docstring:
`p` is equidistant from two points in `s` if and only if its
`orthogonalProjection` is.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_eq_iff_dist_orthogonalProjection_eq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace 𝕜 P} [Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} ↥s] [s.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} (p₃ : P) (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ s) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ s) : dist p₁ p₃ = dist p₂ p₃ ↔ dist p₁ ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s) p₃) = dist p₂ ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s) p₃)

docstring: If `F` is flat, it is continuous if and only if it preserves covers.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.isContinuous_iff_coverPreserving
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v₁, u₁} C} {K : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v₂, u₂} D} [CategoryTheory.RepresentablyFlat F] : F.IsContinuous J K ↔ CategoryTheory.CoverPreserving J K F

docstring:
A subspace is less than another if and only if it is less than or equal to the second subspace
and there is a point only in the second.
name: AffineSubspace.lt_iff_le_and_exists
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (s₁ : AffineSubspace k P) (s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : s₁ < s₂ ↔ s₁ ≤ s₂ ∧ ∃ p ∈ s₂, p ∉ s₁

docstring: A Lie (ring) module is trivial iff all brackets vanish.
name: LieModule.IsTrivial
statement_text: (L : Type v) (M : Type w) [Bracket L M] [Zero M] : Prop

docstring: `R` is integrally closed iff it is the integral closure of itself in its field of fractions.
name: isIntegrallyClosed_iff_isIntegrallyClosedIn
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (K : Type u_4) [CommRing K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] : IsIntegrallyClosed R ↔ IsIntegrallyClosedIn R K

docstring: A subobject is simple iff it is an atom in the subobject lattice.
name: CategoryTheory.subobject_simple_iff_isAtom
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject.{v, u} C] {X : C} (Y : CategoryTheory.Subobject.{v, u} X) : CategoryTheory.Simple.{v, u} (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.Subobject.underlying Y) ↔ IsAtom Y

docstring: A function `-f` is concave iff `f` is convex.
name: neg_concaveOn_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_5} [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [SMul 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s (-f) ↔ ConvexOn 𝕜 s f

docstring:
Given `u : α → β` a uniform inducing map, a family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous at a point
`x₀ : X` iff the family `𝓕'`, obtained by composing each function of `𝓕` by `u`, is
equicontinuous at `x₀`.
name: IsUniformInducing.equicontinuousAt_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → X → α} {x₀ : X} {u : α → β} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : EquicontinuousAt F x₀ ↔ EquicontinuousAt.{u_1, u_3, u_8} (α := β) ((fun x => u ∘ x) ∘ F) x₀

docstring:
Dirac delta measures at two points are equal if and only if the two points are equal,
assuming the measurable space separates points.
name: MeasureTheory.dirac_eq_dirac_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace.SeparatesPoints α] {x : α} {y : α} : Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure α) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac y) ↔ x = y

docstring:
A cone `t` of `K : J ⥤ Over X` is a limit if and only if the corresponding cone
`coneLift t` of `liftFromOver.obj K : WithTerminal K ⥤ C` is a limit.
name: CategoryTheory.WithTerminal.isLimitEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {J : Type w} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w', w} J] {X : C} {K : CategoryTheory.Functor J (CategoryTheory.Over.{v₁, u₁} X)} {t : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone K} : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Equivalence.functor CategoryTheory.WithTerminal.coneEquiv) t) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit t

docstring:
If `C` is finitely complete, then `F : C ⥤ D` is representably flat iff it preserves
finite limits.
name: CategoryTheory.preservesFiniteLimits_iff_flat
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteLimits.{v₁, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) : CategoryTheory.RepresentablyFlat F ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits F

docstring:
A property of objects `Q.unop` is closed under quotients iff `Q` is closed under
subobjects.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isClosedUnderQuotients_unop_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (Q : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} Cᵒᵖ) : Q.unop.IsClosedUnderQuotients ↔ CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderSubobjects.{v, u} Q

docstring:
A family of continuous linear maps is `C^n` at `x` within `s` if and only if all its
applications are.
name: contDiffWithinAt_clm_apply
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {D : Type uD} [NormedAddCommGroup D] [NormedSpace 𝕜 D] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [CompleteSpace 𝕜] {f : D → E →L[𝕜] F} {s : Set D} {x : D} [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] : ContDiffWithinAt 𝕜 n f s x ↔ ∀ (y : E), ContDiffWithinAt.{u_1, uD, uF} 𝕜 (F := F) n (fun x => (f x) y) s x

docstring:
Integrability in the change of variable formula for differentiable functions (one-variable
version): if a function `f` is injective and differentiable on a measurable set `s ⊆ ℝ`, then a
function `g : ℝ → F` is integrable on `f '' s` if and only if `|(f' x)| • g ∘ f` is integrable on
`s`.
name: MeasureTheory.integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_deriv_smul
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf' : ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) s x) (hf : Set.InjOn f s) (g : ℝ → F) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (mα := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace) g (f '' s) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.{0, u_1} (ε := F) (mα := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace) (fun x => |f' x| • g (f x)) s MeasureTheory.volume

docstring: Two finite and free modules are isomorphic if and only if they have the same (finite) rank.
name: FiniteDimensional.nonempty_linearEquiv_iff_finrank_eq
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {M' : Type v'} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [AddCommMonoid M'] [_root_.Module R M'] [Module.Free R M'] [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Finite R M'] : Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] M') ↔ Module.finrank R M = Module.finrank R M'

docstring:
When we have a commutative diagram from a sequence of two linear maps to another,
such that the left vertical map is surjective, the middle vertical map is bijective and the right
vertical map is injective, then the upper row is exact iff the lower row is.
See `ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono` in the file
`Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/Exact.lean` for the categorical version of this result.
name: LinearMap.exact_iff_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_injective
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {M₁ : Type u_8} {M₂ : Type u_9} {M₃ : Type u_10} {N₁ : Type u_11} {N₂ : Type u_12} {N₃ : Type u_13} [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [AddCommMonoid N₁] [AddCommMonoid N₂] [AddCommMonoid N₃] [_root_.Module R M₁] [_root_.Module R M₂] [_root_.Module R M₃] [_root_.Module R N₁] [_root_.Module R N₂] [_root_.Module R N₃] (f : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₂) (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (f' : N₁ →ₗ[R] N₂) (g' : N₂ →ₗ[R] N₃) (τ₁ : M₁ →ₗ[R] N₁) (τ₂ : M₂ →ₗ[R] N₂) (τ₃ : M₃ →ₗ[R] N₃) (comm₁₂ : f' ∘ₗ τ₁ = τ₂ ∘ₗ f) (comm₂₃ : g' ∘ₗ τ₂ = τ₃ ∘ₗ g) (h₁ : Function.Surjective.{u_8 + 1, u_11 + 1} (α := M₁) (β := N₁) ⇑τ₁) (h₂ : Function.Bijective.{u_9 + 1, u_12 + 1} (α := M₂) (β := N₂) ⇑τ₂) (h₃ : Function.Injective.{u_10 + 1, u_13 + 1} (α := M₃) (β := N₃) ⇑τ₃) : Function.Exact.{u_8, u_9, u_10} (M := M₁) (N := M₂) (P := M₃) ⇑f ⇑g ↔ Function.Exact.{u_11, u_12, u_13} (M := N₁) (N := N₂) (P := N₃) ⇑f' ⇑g'

docstring:
**Gauss's Lemma** for GCD domains states that a primitive polynomial is irreducible iff it is
irreducible in the fraction field.
name: Polynomial.IsPrimitive.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] [IsDomain R] [IsGCDMonoid R] {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p.IsPrimitive) : Irreducible p ↔ Irreducible (M := Polynomial K) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p)

docstring:
If `k` is a perfect ring of characteristic `p`, a Witt vector `x : 𝕎 k` falls in ideal generated by
`p ^ n` if and only if its initial `n` coefficients are `0`.
name: WittVector.mem_span_p_pow_iff_le_coeff_eq_zero
statement_text: {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {k : Type u_1} [CommRing k] [CharP k p] [PerfectRing k p] (x : WittVector p k) (n : ℕ) : Membership.mem (γ := Ideal (WittVector p k)) (Ideal.span {HPow.hPow (α := WittVector p k) (↑p) n}) x ↔ ∀ m < n, x.coeff m = 0

docstring:
A pushout is van Kampen if and only if whenever it forms the bottom face of a commutative
"half-cube", the front faces are pullbacks if and only if there exist back faces which are pullbacks
and a top face which is a pushout.
name: CategoryTheory.IsPushout.isVanKampen_iff'
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {W : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} {f : W ⟶ X} {g : W ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {i : Y ⟶ Z} {H : CategoryTheory.IsPushout f g h i} : H.IsVanKampen ↔ ∀ ⦃X' Y' Z' : C⦄ (h' : X' ⟶ Z') (i' : Y' ⟶ Z') (αX : X' ⟶ X) (αY : Y' ⟶ Y) (αZ : Z' ⟶ Z), CategoryTheory.CommSq h' αX αZ h → CategoryTheory.CommSq i' αY αZ i → ∀ [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullback αX f], CategoryTheory.IsPullback h' αX αZ h ∧ CategoryTheory.IsPullback i' αY αZ i ↔ ∃ W' f' g' αW, CategoryTheory.IsPullback f' αW αX f ∧ CategoryTheory.IsPullback g' αW αY g ∧ CategoryTheory.IsPushout f' g' h' i'

docstring: A subspace is dense iff its topological closure is the entire space.
name: Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [ContinuousConstSMul R M] [ContinuousAdd M] {s : Submodule R M} : Dense ↑s ↔ s.topologicalClosure = ⊤

docstring:
Two continuous maps into a Hausdorff space disagree at a point iff they disagree in a
neighborhood.
name: ContinuousAt.ne_iff_eventually_ne
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] {x : X} {f : X → Y} {g : X → Y} (hf : ContinuousAt f x) (hg : ContinuousAt g x) : f x ≠ g x ↔ ∀ᶠ (x : X) in nhds x, f x ≠ g x

docstring: A continuous linear operator is self-adjoint iff it is equal to its adjoint.
name: LinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {A : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} : IsSelfAdjoint A ↔ LinearMap.adjoint A = A

docstring: A morphism in `Type` is a monomorphism if and only if it is injective.
name: CategoryTheory.mono_iff_injective
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.Mono f ↔ Function.Injective (α := (fun (X : Type u) => X) X) (β := (fun (X : Type u) => X) Y) ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) f)

docstring:
An element is add-left-regular if and only if adding to it on the
left an add-left-regular element is add-left-regular.
name: add_isAddLeftRegular_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [AddSemigroup R] {a : R} (b : R) (ha : IsAddLeftRegular a) : IsAddLeftRegular (a + b) ↔ IsAddLeftRegular b

docstring: `X` is simple iff it has subobject lattice `{⊥, ⊤}`.
name: CategoryTheory.simple_iff_subobject_isSimpleOrder
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject.{v, u} C] (X : C) : CategoryTheory.Simple.{v, u} X ↔ IsSimpleOrder (CategoryTheory.Subobject.{v, u} X)

docstring:
A variant of `topologically_isZariskiLocalAtTarget`
that takes one iff statement instead of two implications.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologically_isZariskiLocalAtTarget'
statement_text: (P : {α β : Type u} → [TopologicalSpace α] → [TopologicalSpace β] → (α → β) → Prop) [(AlgebraicGeometry.topologically fun {α β} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] => P).RespectsIso] (hP : ∀ {α β : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] (f : α → β) {ι : Type u} (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens β), TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover U → Continuous f → (P f ↔ ∀ (i : ι), P ((U i).carrier.restrictPreimage f))) : AlgebraicGeometry.IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.{u} (AlgebraicGeometry.topologically fun {α β} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] => P)

docstring:
When we have a commutative diagram from a sequence of two maps to another,
such that the left vertical map is surjective, the middle vertical map is bijective and the right
vertical map is injective, then the upper row is exact iff the lower row is.
See `ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono` in the file
`Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/Exact.lean` for the categorical version of this result.
name: MonoidHom.mulExact_iff_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_injective
statement_text: {M₁ : Type u_8} {M₂ : Type u_9} {M₃ : Type u_10} {N₁ : Type u_11} {N₂ : Type u_12} {N₃ : Type u_13} [CommMonoid M₁] [CommMonoid M₂] [CommMonoid M₃] [CommMonoid N₁] [CommMonoid N₂] [CommMonoid N₃] (f : M₁ →* M₂) (g : M₂ →* M₃) (f' : N₁ →* N₂) (g' : N₂ →* N₃) (τ₁ : M₁ →* N₁) (τ₂ : M₂ →* N₂) (τ₃ : M₃ →* N₃) (comm₁₂ : f'.comp τ₁ = τ₂.comp f) (comm₂₃ : g'.comp τ₂ = τ₃.comp g) (h₁ : Function.Surjective.{u_8 + 1, u_11 + 1} (α := M₁) (β := N₁) ⇑τ₁) (h₂ : Function.Bijective.{u_9 + 1, u_12 + 1} (α := M₂) (β := N₂) ⇑τ₂) (h₃ : Function.Injective.{u_10 + 1, u_13 + 1} (α := M₃) (β := N₃) ⇑τ₃) : Function.MulExact.{u_8, u_9, u_10} (M := M₁) (N := M₂) (P := M₃) ⇑f ⇑g ↔ Function.MulExact.{u_11, u_12, u_13} (M := N₁) (N := N₂) (P := N₃) ⇑f' ⇑g'

docstring: In a cyclic group, if `H` and `K` are finite then `H = K` iff `Nat.card H = Nat.card K`.
name: IsCyclic.subgroup_eq_iff_card_eq
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [IsCyclic G] {H : Subgroup G} {K : Subgroup G} [Finite.{u_2 + 1} ↥H] [Finite.{u_2 + 1} ↥K] : H = K ↔ Nat.card.{u_2} ↥H = Nat.card.{u_2} ↥K

docstring: `R` is a Noetherian ring if and only if `Spec R` is a Noetherian scheme.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherian_Spec
statement_text: {R : CommRingCat} : AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian.{u_1} (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec R) ↔ IsNoetherianRing.{u_1} ↑R

docstring: A group homomorphism is strict if and only if its `rangeRestrict` is an open quotient map.
name: MonoidHom.isStrictMap_iff_isOpenQuotientMap_rangeRestrict
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [Group G] [Group H] {f : G →* H} [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup G] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := H) ⇑f ↔ IsOpenQuotientMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := ↥f.range) ⇑f.rangeRestrict

docstring:
A function is continuous on a set if and only if its composition with an open partial
homeomorphism on the left is continuous on the corresponding set.
name: OpenPartialHomeomorph.continuousOn_iff_continuousOn_comp_left
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace Z] (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X Y) {f : Z → X} {s : Set Z} (h : s ⊆ f ⁻¹' e.source) : ContinuousOn f s ↔ ContinuousOn (↑e ∘ f) s

docstring:
A group `G` is nilpotent iff there exists an ascending central series which reaches `G` in
finitely many steps.
name: Subgroup.nilpotent_iff_finite_ascending_central_series
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) [Group G] : Group.IsNilpotent G ↔ ∃ n H, Subgroup.IsAscendingCentralSeries H ∧ H n = ⊤

docstring:
Three points are affinely independent if and only if they are not
collinear.
name: affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p : Fin 3 → P} : AffineIndependent k p ↔ ¬Collinear k (Set.range p)

docstring: If `C` and `D` are equivalent categories, that `C` is idempotent complete iff `D` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Idempotents.isIdempotentComplete_iff_of_equivalence
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] (ε : CategoryTheory.Equivalence.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D) : CategoryTheory.IsIdempotentComplete.{v_1, u_1} C ↔ CategoryTheory.IsIdempotentComplete.{v_2, u_2} D

docstring:
Two infinite places `v` and `w` are equal if and only if their underlying absolute values
are equivalent.
name: NumberField.InfinitePlace.eq_iff_isEquiv
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} : w = v ↔ (↑w).IsEquiv ↑v

docstring:
An `AddMonoid A` is `α`-divisible iff `n • _` is a surjective function, i.e. the
constructive version implies the textbook approach.
name: divisibleByOfSMulRightSurj
statement_text: (A : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [AddMonoid A] [SMul α A] [Zero α] (H : ∀ {n : α}, n ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (β := A) fun (a : A) => n • a) : DivisibleBy A α

docstring:
`m` is `s`-factored if and only if `m` is nonzero and all prime divisors `≤ m` of `m`
are in `s`.
name: Nat.mem_factoredNumbers_iff_forall_le
statement_text: {s : Finset ℕ} {m : ℕ} : m ∈ Nat.factoredNumbers s ↔ m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ≤ m, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p ∈ s

docstring:
If the canonical functor `CostructuredArrow (G ≫ F) Y ⥤ CostructuredArrow F Y` is final, then
`G ⋙ F` is dense at `Y` if and only if `F` is dense at `Y`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.DenseAt.precompEquivOfFinal
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {Y : D} {C' : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C'] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v₁, u_1, u₁} C' C) [(CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.pre G F Y).Final] : (G.comp F).DenseAt Y ≃ F.DenseAt Y

docstring:
A cone is dually finitely generated if and only if it is the dual of a finitely generated
cone.
name: PointedCone.DualFG.iff_exists_fg_dual
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R N] {p : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] R} {C : PointedCone R N} : PointedCone.DualFG p C ↔ ∃ D, Submodule.FG D ∧ PointedCone.dual p ↑D = C

docstring: `A` dominates `B` if and only if `B ≤ A` (as subrings) and `m_A ∩ B = m_B`.
name: LocalSubring.le_def
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : LocalSubring R} {B : LocalSubring R} : A ≤ B ↔ ∃ (h : A.toSubring ≤ B.toSubring), IsLocalHom (R := ↥A.toSubring) (S := ↥B.toSubring) (Subring.inclusion h)

docstring:
Two maps `f : M → N` and `g : N → P` are exact if and only if the induced maps
`Set.range f → N → Set.range g` are exact.

Note that if you already have an instance `[One (Set.range g)]` (which is unlikely) this lemma
may not apply if the one of `Set.range g` is not definitionally equal to `⟨1, hg⟩`.
name: Function.MulExact.iff_rangeFactorization
statement_text: {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} {P : Type u_6} {f : M → N} {g : N → P} [One P] (hg : 1 ∈ Set.range g) : Function.MulExact f g ↔ Function.MulExact (M := { x : N // x ∈ Set.range f }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range f)) (Set.rangeFactorization g)

docstring:
An index category is connected iff the colimit of the constant singleton-valued functor is a
singleton.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.isConnected_iff_colimit_constPUnitFunctor_iso_pUnit
statement_text: (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimit.{v, u, w, w + 1} (CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.constPUnitFunctor C)] : CategoryTheory.IsConnected.{v, u} C ↔ Nonempty.{w + 1} (CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.{v, u, w, w + 1} (CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.constPUnitFunctor C) ≅ PUnit.{w + 1})

docstring:
Similarity holds if and only if all distances between points with different indices are
proportional.
name: similar_iff_exists_pairwise_dist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ Pairwise fun (i₁ : ι) i₂ => dist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = ↑r * dist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
An additive subgroup has index two if and only if there exists `a` such that
for all `b`, exactly one of `a + b` and `b` belong to `H`.
name: AddSubgroup.index_eq_two_iff'
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} : H.index = 2 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : G), Xor (a + b ∈ H) (b ∈ H)

docstring:
A point lies in the closed interior of a 1-simplex if and only if it lies weakly between its
vertices.
name: Affine.Simplex.mem_closedInterior_iff_wbtw
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_4} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module R V] [AddTorsor V P] [IsOrderedRing R] {s : Affine.Simplex R P 1} {p : P} : p ∈ s.closedInterior ↔ Wbtw R (s.points 0) p (s.points 1)

docstring:
Two finite measures on a product `α × β × γ` are equal iff they are equal on products of sets.
See `ext_prod₃_iff'` for the same statement for `(α × β) × γ`.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.ext_prod₃_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_4} {β : Type u_5} {γ : Type u_6} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (α × β × γ)} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (α × β × γ)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] : μ = ν ↔ ∀ {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {u : Set γ}, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet t → MeasurableSet u → Eq (α := ENNReal) (μ (s ×ˢ t ×ˢ u) : ENNReal) (ν (s ×ˢ t ×ˢ u) : ENNReal)

docstring:
In an Archimedean linearly ordered additive group (with the order topology), a
subgroup is discrete iff it is cyclic.
name: AddSubgroup.isAddCyclic_iff_discreteTopology
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [TopologicalSpace G] [OrderTopology G] [Archimedean G] {H : AddSubgroup G} : IsAddCyclic.{u_1} ↥H ↔ DiscreteTopology.{u_1} ↥H

docstring: `F` is triangulated if and only if `F.op` is triangulated.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.op_isTriangulated_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.HasShift.{v_1, u_1, 0} C ℤ] [CategoryTheory.HasShift.{v_2, u_2, 0} D ℤ] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} C] [∀ (n : ℤ), CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive.{v_1, u_1, v_1, u_1} (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor C n)] [CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_2, u_2} D] [∀ (n : ℤ), CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive.{v_2, u_2, v_2, u_2} (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor D n)] [CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.{v_2, u_2} D] : F.op.IsTriangulated ↔ F.IsTriangulated

docstring:
In the topology of pointwise convergence, `a` converges to `a₀` iff for every `x : E` the map
`a · x` converges to `a₀ x`.
name: PointwiseConvergenceCLM.tendsto_iff_forall_tendsto
statement_text: {ι : Type u_2} {𝕜₁ : Type u_4} {𝕜₂ : Type u_5} [NormedField 𝕜₁] [NormedField 𝕜₂] {σ : 𝕜₁ →+* 𝕜₂} {E : Type u_7} {F : Type u_8} [AddCommGroup E] [TopologicalSpace E] [AddCommGroup F] [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜₁ E] [_root_.Module 𝕜₂ F] {p : Filter ι} {a : ι → E →SLₚₜ[σ] F} {a₀ : E →SLₚₜ[σ] F} : Filter.Tendsto a p (nhds a₀) ↔ ∀ (x : E), Filter.Tendsto.{u_2, u_8} (β := F) (fun (x_1 : ι) => ((a x_1) x : F)) p (nhds (a₀ x) : Filter F)

docstring:
A function is continuous if and only if its composition with an open partial homeomorphism
on the left is continuous and its image is contained in the source.
name: OpenPartialHomeomorph.continuous_iff_continuous_comp_left
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace Z] (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X Y) {f : Z → X} (h : f ⁻¹' e.source = Set.univ) : Continuous f ↔ Continuous (↑e ∘ f)

docstring:
A global section of a quasi-compact scheme is nilpotent if and only if its associated
basic open is empty.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isNilpotent_iff_basicOpen_eq_bot
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [CompactSpace.{u} ↥X] (f : ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))) : IsNilpotent f ↔ X.basicOpen f = ⊥

docstring: A presheaf is a sheaf after composing with a universe lift if and only if it is a sheaf.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.isSheaf_comp_uliftFunctor_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, w, u, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)} (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf J (P.comp CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{w', w}) ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf J P

docstring: A function is continuous on two open sets iff it is also continuous on their union.
name: continuousOn_union_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α} {t : Set α} {f : α → β} (hs : IsOpen s) (ht : IsOpen t) : ContinuousOn f (s ∪ t) ↔ ContinuousOn f s ∧ ContinuousOn f t

docstring: The fixed-point polynomial is identically zero iff `g` is scalar.
name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.fixpointPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {g : GL (Fin 2) R} : g.fixpointPolynomial = 0 ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Set (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R)) (Set.range (ι := R) ⇑(Matrix.scalar (Fin 2))) ↑g

docstring: A face of a cone is a face of another if and only if they are contained in each other.
name: PointedCone.IsFaceOf.isFaceOf_iff_le
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {C : PointedCone R M} {F₁ : PointedCone R M} {F₂ : PointedCone R M} (h₁ : F₁.IsFaceOf C) (h₂ : F₂.IsFaceOf C) : F₁.IsFaceOf F₂ ↔ F₁ ≤ F₂

docstring:
For an invertible matrix `U`, `U * x * star U` is positive semi-definite iff `x` is.
This works on any ⋆-ring with a partial order.

See `IsUnit.star_right_conjugate_nonneg_iff` for a similar statement for star-ordered rings.
name: Matrix.IsUnit.posSemidef_star_right_conjugate_iff
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {U : Matrix n n R} {x : Matrix n n R} (hU : IsUnit U) : (U * x * star U).PosSemidef ↔ x.PosSemidef

docstring:
A graph is connected if it's preconnected and contains at least one vertex.
This follows the convention observed by mathlib that something is connected iff it has
exactly one connected component.

There is a `CoeFun` instance so that `h u v` can be used instead of `h.Preconnected u v`.
name: SimpleGraph.Connected
statement_text: {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop

docstring: Three points are collinear if and only if they are not affinely independent.
name: collinear_iff_not_affineIndependent_of_ne
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p : Fin 3 → P} {i₁ : Fin 3} {i₂ : Fin 3} {i₃ : Fin 3} (h₁₂ : i₁ ≠ i₂) (h₁₃ : i₁ ≠ i₃) (h₂₃ : i₂ ≠ i₃) : Collinear k (P := P) {p i₁, p i₂, p i₃} ↔ ¬AffineIndependent k p

docstring: `P` is a sheaf for `S`, iff the fork given by `w` is an equalizer.
name: CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Sieve.equalizer_sheaf_condition
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type (max v u))) {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v, u} X) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor P S.arrows ↔ Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.forkMap P S.arrows) ⋯))

docstring:
If `f` is nonnegative and integrable on the unordered interval `Set.uIoc a b`, then its
integral over `a..b` is positive if and only if `a < b` and the measure of
`Function.support f ∩ Set.Ioc a b` is positive.
name: intervalIntegral.integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae'
statement_text: {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} {b : ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ} (hf : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)] f) (hfi : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) : 0 < ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x ∂μ ↔ a < b ∧ 0 < μ (Function.support f ∩ Set.Ioc a b)

docstring: A pair belongs to `mulAntidiagonal n` iff the product of its components is equal to `n`.
name: Finset.HasMulAntidiagonal.mem_mulAntidiagonal
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} : ∀ {inst : Mul A} [self : Finset.HasMulAntidiagonal A] {n : A} {a : A × A}, a ∈ @Finset.HasMulAntidiagonal.mulAntidiagonal _ inst _ n ↔ a.1 * a.2 = n

docstring:
If a discrete additive group acts on a T2 space `X` such that `X × X` is compactly
generated, and if the action is continuous in the second variable, then the action is properly
discontinuous if and only if it is proper. This is in particular true if `X` is first-countable or
weakly locally compact.
name: properlyDiscontinuousVAdd_iff_properVAdd
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [AddGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [AddAction G X] [CompactlyCoherentSpace.{u_2} (X × X)] [T2Space X] [DiscreteTopology G] [ContinuousConstVAdd G X] : ProperlyDiscontinuousVAdd G X ↔ ProperVAdd G X

docstring: A family of continuous linear maps is continuous at a point iff all its applications are.
name: continuousAt_clm_apply
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {f : X → E →L[𝕜] F} {x : X} : ContinuousAt f x ↔ ∀ (y : E), ContinuousAt.{u_1, w} (Y := F) (fun q => (f q) y) x

docstring:
`x` is a root of the `2`-torsion polynomial of a Weierstrass curve of characteristic
different from `2` with nonzero discriminant if and only if it is the `X`-coordinate of a nonzero
affine `2`-torsion point.
name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.isRoot_twoTorsionPolynomial_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} [Field F] {W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine F} [DecidableEq F] (h2 : NeZero 2) (hΔ : WeierstrassCurve.Δ W ≠ 0) (x : F) : Polynomial.IsRoot (WeierstrassCurve.twoTorsionPolynomial W).toPoly x ↔ ∃ y, ∃ (h : W.Nonsingular x y), WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y h + WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y h = 0

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(-∞, a)` if and only if it contains an interval
`[u, a)` with `u < a`.
name: mem_nhdsLT_iff_exists_Ico_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMinOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Iio a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Iio a, Set.Ico u a ⊆ s

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise scalar multiplication of `f` and
`g`, which antivary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f ∘ σ` and `g` antivary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `f`.
name: Antivary.sum_comp_perm_smul_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddCommMonoid β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := β) (∑ i : ι, f (σ i) • g i) (∑ i : ι, f i • g i) ↔ Antivary (f ∘ ⇑σ) g

docstring: Equality is achieved in the triangle inequality iff the two vectors are collinear.
name: norm_add_eq_iff_real
statement_text: {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] {x : F} {y : F} : ‖x + y‖ = ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ ↔ ‖y‖ • x = ‖x‖ • y

docstring:
`zarankiewicz m n s t` is at most `x` if and only if every
`completeBipartiteGraph α β`-free bipartite graph `G` has at most `x` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.zarankiewicz_le_iff_of_nonneg
statement_text: {m : ℕ} {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ} {t : ℕ} {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] {R : Type u_5} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [FloorSemiring R] (hm : Fintype.card V = m) (hn : Fintype.card W = n) (hs : Fintype.card α = s) (ht : Fintype.card β = t) {x : R} (h : 0 ≤ x) : ↑(SimpleGraph.zarankiewicz m n s t) ≤ x ↔ ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W)⦄ [inst_7 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W → (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G → ↑G.edgeFinset.card ≤ x

docstring: An action is `1`-pretransitive iff it is pretransitive.
name: MulAction.is_one_pretransitive_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G α] : MulAction.IsMultiplyPretransitive G α 1 ↔ MulAction.IsPretransitive G α

docstring: Given an equivalence of diagrams `e`, `s` is a limit cone iff `s.whisker e.functor` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.whiskerEquivalenceEquiv
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {K : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} K] {C : Type u₃} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} J C} {s : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F} (e : CategoryTheory.Equivalence.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} K J) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit s ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.whisker e.functor s)

docstring:
Coordinate characterisation of unimodularity in the free case: given a basis `b`, the
coordinates of `v` generate the unit ideal iff `v` is unimodular.
name: Module.Basis.isUnimodular_iff_span_repr_eq_top
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {ι : Type u_3} {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {v : M} : Module.IsUnimodular R v ↔ Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := Ideal R) (Ideal.span (Set.range.{u_1, u_3 + 1} (ι := ι) ⇑(b.repr v : ι →₀ R))) ⊤

docstring:
The order of an analytic function `f` at `z₀` equals a natural number `n` iff `f` can locally
be written as `f z = (z - z₀) ^ n • g z`, where `g` is analytic and does not vanish at `z₀`.
name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_eq_natCast
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {n : ℕ} {z₀ : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = ↑n ↔ ∃ g, AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z₀ ∧ g z₀ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ (z : 𝕜) in nhds z₀, f z = (z - z₀) ^ n • g z

docstring:
A function `f : 𝕜 → 𝕜` is strictly convex iff for any three points `x < y < z` the slope of
the secant line of `f` on `[x, y]` is strictly less than the slope of the secant line of `f` on
`[y, z]`.
name: strictConvexOn_iff_slope_strict_mono_adjacent
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] {s : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f ↔ Convex 𝕜 s ∧ ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄, x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f y - f x) / (y - x) < (f z - f y) / (z - y)

docstring:
The angle between three points is zero if and only if one of the first and third points is
strictly between the other two, or those two points are equal but not equal to the second.
name: EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_zero_iff_eq_and_ne_or_sbtw
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0 ↔ p₁ = p₃ ∧ p₁ ≠ p₂ ∨ Sbtw ℝ p₂ p₁ p₃ ∨ Sbtw ℝ p₂ p₃ p₁

docstring:
`F⟮x⟯ / F` is a purely inseparable extension if and only if the minimal polynomial of `x`
has separable degree one.
name: IntermediateField.isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_simple_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {x : E} : IsPurelyInseparable.{u, v} F ↥F⟮x⟯ ↔ Polynomial.natSepDegree (minpoly F x) = 1

docstring: A set `s` is a neighbourhood of `0` iff it contains an ideal belonging to `F`.
name: WithIdealFilter.mem_nhds_zero_iff
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] {F : IdealFilter A} {s : Set (WithIdealFilter F)} : s ∈ nhds 0 ↔ ∃ I ∈ F, WithIdealFilter.idealSet I ⊆ s

docstring:
Given a ring homomorphism `f` from `M` to `P` whose kernel contains `c`,
the lift of `M` to `P` is injective iff `ker f = c`.
name: RingCon.lift_injective_iff
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} {P : Type u_3} [NonAssocSemiring M] [NonAssocSemiring P] {c : RingCon M} {f : M →+* P} {h : c ≤ RingCon.ker f} : Function.Injective.{u_1 + 1, u_3 + 1} (α := c.Quotient) (β := P) ⇑(c.lift f h) ↔ c = RingCon.ker f

docstring:
In a Fréchet-Urysohn space, a point belongs to the closure of a set iff it is a limit
of a sequence taking values in this set.
name: mem_closure_iff_seq_limit
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [FrechetUrysohnSpace X] {s : Set X} {a : X} : a ∈ closure s ↔ ∃ x, (∀ (n : ℕ), x n ∈ s) ∧ Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a)

docstring:
For a topological space `X` the compact coherentification is defined as:
`A` is open iff for all compact sets `B`, the intersection `A ∩ B` is open in `B`.
name: CompactCoherentification.instTopologicalSpace
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : TopologicalSpace (CompactCoherentification X)

docstring:
Over a characteristic-zero division ring, the centroids of two
faces of a simplex are equal if and only if those faces are given by
the same subset of points.
name: Affine.Simplex.face_centroid_eq_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} (s : Affine.Simplex k P n) {fs₁ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {fs₂ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m₁ : ℕ} {m₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : fs₁.card = m₁ + 1) (h₂ : fs₂.card = m₂ + 1) : Finset.centroid k Finset.univ (s.face h₁).points = Finset.centroid k Finset.univ (s.face h₂).points ↔ fs₁ = fs₂

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise scalar multiplication of `f` and
`g`, which antivary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ` antivary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: Antivary.sum_smul_comp_perm_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddCommMonoid β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := β) (∑ i : ι, f i • g (σ i)) (∑ i : ι, f i • g i) ↔ Antivary f (g ∘ ⇑σ)

docstring: A morphism in `Type` is a monomorphism if and only if it is injective.
name: CategoryTheory.ofHom_mono_iff_injective
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type u} (f : X → Y) : CategoryTheory.Mono (TypeCat.ofHom f) ↔ Function.Injective f

docstring:
The finset of prime factors of `x` is empty if and only if `x` is a unit.
The converse is true without the nonzero assumption, see `primeFactors_of_isUnit`.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.primeFactors_eq_empty_iff
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [NormalizationMonoid M] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid M] {a : M} (ha : a ≠ 0) : UniqueFactorizationMonoid.primeFactors a = ∅ ↔ IsUnit a

docstring:
The oriented angle between three points is π if and only if the second point is strictly
between the other two.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_pi_iff_sbtw
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = ↑Real.pi ↔ Sbtw ℝ p₁ p₂ p₃

docstring: When `g` is an isomorphism, `f ≫ g` is epic iff `f` is.
name: CategoryTheory.epi_comp_iff_of_isIso
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [CategoryTheory.IsIso g] : CategoryTheory.Epi (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) ↔ CategoryTheory.Epi f

docstring: A sum is finite iff all summands are finite.
name: ENNReal.sum_ne_top
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ENNReal} : Ne (α := ENNReal) (∑ a ∈ s, f a) ⊤ ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, f a ≠ ⊤

docstring:
In a strictly convex space, the triangle inequality turns into an equality if and only if the
middle point belongs to the segment joining two other points.
name: dist_add_dist_eq_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [StrictConvexSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {a : P} {b : P} {c : P} : dist a b + dist b c = dist a c ↔ Wbtw ℝ a b c

docstring:
A nonzero ideal of `R` is unramified in `S` if and only if every prime ideal of `S` lying
over it has ramification index `1`.
name: Algebra.isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_ramificationIdx_eq_one
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsDomain R] [Module.Finite ℤ R] [CharZero R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] {𝔭 : Ideal R} : Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn S 𝔭 ↔ ∀ (𝔓 : Ideal S) [𝔓.IsPrime], 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 → 𝔓.ramificationIdx R = 1

docstring:
A point `c` belongs the perpendicular bisector of `[p₁, p₂]` iff `p₂ -ᵥ p₁` is orthogonal to
`c -ᵥ midpoint ℝ p₁ p₂`.
name: AffineSubspace.mem_perpBisector_iff_inner_eq_zero'
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {c : P} {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} : Membership.mem (γ := AffineSubspace ℝ P) (AffineSubspace.perpBisector p₁ p₂) c ↔ inner ℝ (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) (c -ᵥ midpoint ℝ p₁ p₂) = 0

docstring:
A function is `C^(n + 1)` on an open domain if and only if it is
differentiable there, and its derivative (formulated with `deriv`) is `C^n`.
name: contDiffOn_succ_iff_deriv_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : 𝕜 → F} {s : Set 𝕜} (hs : IsOpen s) : ContDiffOn 𝕜 (n + 1) f s ↔ DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s ∧ (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f s) ∧ ContDiffOn 𝕜 n (deriv f) s

docstring:
The multiset of normalized factors of `x` is nil if and only if `x` is a unit.
The converse is true without the nonzero assumption, see `normalizedFactors_of_isUnit`.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizationMonoid α] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid α] {x : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) : UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors x = 0 ↔ IsUnit x

docstring:
For an adjoint quadruple `L ⊣ F ⊣ G ⊣ R` where `L` and `G` are fully faithful and their domain
and codomain have all pullbacks resp. pushouts, the natural transformation `L ⟶ G` is an
epimorphism iff the natural transformation `R ⟶ F` is a monomorphism.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple.epi_leftTriple_leftToRight_iff_mono_rightTriple_rightToLeft
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} (q : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple L F G R) [L.Full] [L.Faithful] [G.Full] [G.Faithful] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v₂, u₂} D] : CategoryTheory.Epi q.leftTriple.leftToRight ↔ CategoryTheory.Mono q.rightTriple.rightToLeft

docstring:
A linear map `f : M → N` is strict if and only if the canonical isomorphism
`M ⧸ f.ker ≃ f.range` is a homeomorphism.
name: LinearMap.isStrictMap_iff_isHomeomorph_quotKerEquivRange
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {Nₗ : Type u_5} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup Nₗ] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R Nₗ] {fₗ : M →ₗ[R] Nₗ} [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace Nₗ] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_3, u_5} (X := M) (Y := Nₗ) ⇑fₗ ↔ IsHomeomorph.{u_3, u_5} (X := M ⧸ fₗ.ker) (Y := ↥fₗ.range) ⇑fₗ.quotKerEquivRange

docstring:
If the order of a meromorphic function is nonnegative, then this function converges
at this point. See also the iff version `tendsto_nhds_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg`.
name: tendsto_nhds_of_meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) (ho : 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt f x) : ∃ c, Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds c)

docstring:
If `g : ι → G × G` converges to the uniformity, then any `f : ι → G × G` converges to the
uniformity iff `f * g` does. This is often useful when `g` is valued in the diagonal,
in which case its convergence is automatic.
name: Filter.Tendsto.uniformity_mul_iff_left
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [UniformSpace α] [Group α] [IsUniformGroup α] {ι : Type u_3} {f : ι → α × α} {g : ι → α × α} {l : Filter ι} (hg : Filter.Tendsto g l (uniformity α)) : Filter.Tendsto (f * g) l (uniformity α) ↔ Filter.Tendsto f l (uniformity α)

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c`, the point `(c, f c)` is strictly below the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a c < slope f a b`.
name: map_lt_lineMap_iff_slope_lt_slope_left
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < r * (b - a)) : f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) < (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ↔ slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) < slope f a b

docstring: An element `a` is right-regular if and only if a positive power of `a` is right-regular.
name: IsRightRegular.pow_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Monoid R] {a : R} {n : ℕ} (n0 : 0 < n) : IsRightRegular (a ^ n) ↔ IsRightRegular a

docstring:
**Liouville's theorem for functions with polynomial growth**: an entire function `f : ℂ → ℂ` is
`O(z ^ n)` along `cobounded` if and only if it is a polynomial of degree at most `n`.
name: Differentiable.isBigO_pow_iff_exists_eq_polynomial_eval
statement_text: {n : ℕ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) : (Asymptotics.IsBigO (F := ℂ) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) f fun x => x ^ n) ↔ ∃ p, p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ f = fun x => Polynomial.eval x p

docstring: A point `x` lies outside the support of `μ` iff some neighborhood of `x` has measure zero.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.notMem_support_iff_exists
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} {x : X} : x ∉ μ.support ↔ ∃ U ∈ nhds x, μ U = 0

docstring:
An element is contained in the relative perfect closure if and only if its minimal polynomial
has separable degree one.
name: mem_perfectClosure_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {x : E} : Membership.mem (γ := IntermediateField F E) (perfectClosure F E) x ↔ Polynomial.natSepDegree (minpoly F x) = 1

docstring: A circulant of `v` is symmetric iff `v` equals its reverse.
name: Matrix.circulant_isSymm_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {n : Type u_3} [SubtractionMonoid n] {v : n → α} : (Matrix.circulant v).IsSymm ↔ ∀ (i : n), v (-i) = v i

docstring:
An additive monoid object `M` is commutative if and only if `X ⟶ M` is commutative for all
`X`.
name: CategoryTheory.isCommAddMonObj_iff_isAddCommutative
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u_1} C] (M : C) [CategoryTheory.AddMonObj M] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u_1} C] : CategoryTheory.IsCommAddMonObj.{v, u_1} M ↔ ∀ (X : C), IsAddCommutative.{v} (X ⟶ M)

docstring:
A topological ring is `J`-adic if and only if it admits the powers of `J` as a basis of
open neighborhoods of zero.
name: isAdic_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R] {J : Ideal R} : IsAdic J ↔ (∀ (n : ℕ), IsOpen ↑(J ^ n)) ∧ ∀ s ∈ nhds 0, ∃ n, ↑(J ^ n) ⊆ s

docstring:
The commutator of `G` as a morphism. This is the map `(x, y) ↦ x * y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹`,
see `CategoryTheory.GrpObj.lift_commutator_eq_mul_mul_inv_inv`.
This morphism is constant with value `1` if and only if `G` is commutative
(see `CategoryTheory.isCommMonObj_iff_commutator_eq_toUnit_η`).
name: CategoryTheory.GrpObj.commutator
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] (G : C) [CategoryTheory.GrpObj G] : CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{v, u} (𝒞 := inst) G G ⟶ G

docstring:
`IsIntegralClosure A R B` is the characteristic predicate stating `A` is
the integral closure of `R` in `B`,
i.e. that an element of `B` is integral over `R` iff it is an element of (the image of) `A`.
name: IsIntegralClosure
statement_text: (A : Type u_1) (R : Type u_2) (B : Type u_3) [CommRing R] [CommSemiring A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra A B] : Prop

docstring:
A self-map `f : X → X` has compact fixed support if and only if `f` fixes the complement of a
closed compact set. If `X` is preregular, then use `compactSupport_iff` instead.
name: Function.HasCompactFixedSupport_iff'
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : X → X} : Function.HasCompactFixedSupport f ↔ ∃ K, IsClosed K ∧ IsCompact K ∧ (Function.fixedPoints f)ᶜ ⊆ K

docstring:
A set `A` in a compactly coherent space is closed iff for every compact set `K`, the
intersection `K ∩ A` is closed in `K`.
name: CompactlyCoherentSpace.isClosed_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactlyCoherentSpace X] (A : Set X) : IsClosed A ↔ ∀ (K : Set X), IsCompact K → IsClosed (X := ↑K) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ K) ⁻¹' A)

docstring: The `LSeries` of the constant sequence `1` converges at `s` if and only if `re s > 1`.
name: LSeriesSummable_one_iff
statement_text: {s : ℂ} : LSeriesSummable 1 s ↔ 1 < s.re

docstring: A module over a division ring is Noetherian if and only if it is finitely generated.
name: IsNoetherian.iff_fg
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] : IsNoetherian K V ↔ Module.Finite K V

docstring: A ring is Dedekind-finite if and only if every element has at most one left inverse.
name: IsDedekindFiniteMonoid.iff_eq_of_mul_right_eq_one
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Ring α] : IsDedekindFiniteMonoid α ↔ ∀ (x y z : α), x * z = 1 → y * z = 1 → x = y

docstring:
A subspace is complement to its orthogonal complement with respect to some reflexive bilinear
form if and only if that bilinear form restricted on to the subspace is nondegenerate.
name: LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_nondegenerate_iff_isCompl_orthogonal
statement_text: {V : Type u_5} {K : Type u_6} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] {B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V} {W : Submodule K V} (b₁ : B.IsRefl) : (B.restrict W).Nondegenerate ↔ IsCompl W (B.orthogonal W)

docstring:
A function is almost everywhere strongly measurable if and only if it is almost everywhere
measurable, and up to a zero measure set its range is contained in a separable set.
name: aestronglyMeasurable_iff_aemeasurable_separable
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace β] {m₀ : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → β} [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace β] [BorelSpace β] : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ ↔ AEMeasurable f μ ∧ ∃ t, TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable t ∧ ∀ᵐ (x : α) ∂μ, f x ∈ t

docstring:
A homomorphism from a uniform additive group to a discrete uniform additive group
is continuous if and only if its kernel is open.
name: IsUniformAddGroup.uniformContinuous_iff_isOpen_ker
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [UniformSpace α] [AddGroup α] [IsUniformAddGroup α] {hom : Type u_3} [UniformSpace β] [DiscreteTopology β] [AddGroup β] [IsUniformAddGroup β] [FunLike hom α β] [AddMonoidHomClass hom α β] {f : hom} : UniformContinuous.{u_1, u_2} (α := α) (β := β) ⇑f ↔ IsOpen ↑(AddMonoidHom.ker ↑f)

docstring:
Two additive congruence relations are equal iff their underlying binary relations
are equal.
name: AddCon.coe_inj
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Add M] {c : AddCon M} {d : AddCon M} : Eq (α := M → M → Prop) ⇑c ⇑d ↔ c = d

docstring: A map is a homeomorphism iff it is the map underlying a bundled homeomorphism `h : X ≃ₜ Y`.
name: isHomeomorph_iff_exists_homeomorph
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsHomeomorph f ↔ ∃ h, ⇑h = f

docstring: A set in a linear ordered field is strictly convex if and only if it is convex.
name: strictConvex_iff_convex
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [TopologicalSpace 𝕜] [OrderTopology 𝕜] {s : Set 𝕜} : StrictConvex 𝕜 s ↔ Convex 𝕜 s

docstring:
`p` is equidistant from a set of points in `s` if and only if its
`orthogonalProjection` is.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_set_eq_iff_dist_orthogonalProjection_eq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace 𝕜 P} [Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} ↥s] [s.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] {ps : Set P} (hps : ps ⊆ ↑s) (p : P) : (ps.Pairwise fun p₁ p₂ => dist p₁ p = dist p₂ p) ↔ ps.Pairwise fun p₁ p₂ => dist p₁ ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s) p) = dist p₂ ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s) p)

docstring:
Given two multiforks with isomorphic components in such a way that the natural diagrams
commute, then one is a limit if and only if the other one is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork.isLimitEquivOfIsos
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {J : CategoryTheory.Limits.MulticospanShape} {I : CategoryTheory.Limits.MulticospanIndex.{w, w', v, u} J C} {I' : CategoryTheory.Limits.MulticospanIndex.{w, w', v, u} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork I) (c' : CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork I') (e : c.pt ≅ c'.pt) (el : (i : J.L) → I.left i ≅ I'.left i) (er : (i : J.R) → I.right i ≅ I'.right i) (hl : autoParam (∀ (i : J.R), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (I.fst i) (er i).hom = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (el (J.fst i))) (I'.fst i)) CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork.isLimitEquivOfIsos._auto_1) (hr : autoParam (∀ (i : J.R), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (I.snd i) (er i).hom = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (el (J.snd i))) (I'.snd i)) CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork.isLimitEquivOfIsos._auto_3) (he : autoParam (∀ (i : J.L), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e.hom (c'.ι i) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (c.ι i) (el i).hom) CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork.isLimitEquivOfIsos._auto_5) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c'

docstring: An oriented angle is zero or `π` if and only if the three points are collinear.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_zero_or_eq_pi_iff_collinear
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0 ∨ EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = ↑Real.pi ↔ Collinear ℝ (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃}

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `f ⊗ 𝟙 M` is injective whenever `f` is an injective linear map.
See `Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap` to specialize the universe of
`N, N', N''` to `Type (max u v)`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap'
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Small.{v', u} R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' : Type v'⦄ [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), Function.Injective (α := N) (β := N') ⇑f → Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R N M) (β := TensorProduct R N' M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f)

docstring:
An edge is a bridge iff its endpoints are not 2-edge-reachable.

The forward direction of this is true without assuming `u` and `v` are adjacent.
See `IsBridge.not_isEdgeReachable_two`.
name: SimpleGraph.isBridge_iff_not_isEdgeReachable_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {u : V} {v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) : G.IsBridge s(u, v) ↔ ¬G.IsEdgeReachable 2 u v

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(-∞, a)` if and only if it contains an interval
`(u, a)` with `u < a`.
name: mem_nhdsLT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMinOrder α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Iio a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Iio a, Set.Ioo u a ⊆ s

docstring:
An algebra is finitely generated if and only if it is a quotient
of a free algebra whose variables are indexed by a finset.
name: Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_freeAlgebra
statement_text: {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] : Algebra.FiniteType R A ↔ ∃ s f, Function.Surjective (α := FreeAlgebra.{uR, uA} R ↥s) (β := A) ⇑f

docstring:
A map `f : X → Y` is closed if and only if for all sets `s`, any cluster point of `f '' s` is
the image by `f` of some cluster point of `s`.
If you require this for all filters instead of just principal filters, and also that `f` is
continuous, you get the notion of **proper map**. See `isProperMap_iff_clusterPt`.
name: isClosedMap_iff_clusterPt
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {f : X → Y} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] : IsClosedMap f ↔ ∀ (s : Set X) (y : Y), MapClusterPt y (Filter.principal s) f → ∃ x, f x = y ∧ ClusterPt x (Filter.principal s)

docstring: A function is meromorphic iff it is meromorphic on Set.univ.
name: meromorphicOn_univ
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} : MeromorphicOn f Set.univ ↔ Meromorphic f

docstring:
If the kernel of a linear map is disjoint from the span of a family of vectors,
then the family is linearly independent iff it is linearly independent after composing with
the linear map.
name: LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_disjoint
