statement_text: {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {M' : Type u_5} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup M'] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R M'] {v : ι → M} (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (hf_inj : Disjoint (Submodule.span R (Set.range v)) f.ker) : LinearIndependent.{u', u_2, u_5} R (M := M') (⇑f ∘ v) ↔ LinearIndependent R v

docstring:
The map of a binary fan is a limit iff the fork consisting of the mapped morphisms is a limit. This
essentially lets us commute `BinaryFan.mk` with `Functor.mapCone`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isLimitMapConeBinaryFanEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) {P : C} {X : C} {Y : C} (f : P ⟶ X) (g : P ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (G.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryFan.mk f g)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryFan.mk (G.map f) (G.map g))

docstring: `R` is integrally closed in `A` iff all integral elements of `A` are also elements of `R`.
name: isIntegrallyClosedIn_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] : IsIntegrallyClosedIn R A ↔ Function.Injective.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} (α := R) (β := A) ⇑(algebraMap R A) ∧ ∀ {x : A}, IsIntegral R x → ∃ y, (algebraMap R A) y = x

docstring:
If we consider `x : F α` to, in some sense, contain values of type `α`,
predicate `Liftp p x` holds iff every value contained by `x` satisfies `p`.
name: Functor.Liftp
statement_text: {F : Type u → Type v} [Functor F] {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (x : F α) : Prop

docstring:
If the tangent of a complex number is well-defined,
then it is equal to zero iff the number is equal to `k * π` for an integer `k`.

See also `Complex.tan_eq_zero_iff` for a version that takes into account junk values of `θ`.
name: Complex.tan_eq_zero_iff'
statement_text: {θ : ℂ} (hθ : Complex.cos θ ≠ 0) : Complex.tan θ = 0 ↔ ∃ k, ↑k * ↑Real.pi = θ

docstring:
An operator is positive iff it is self-adjoint and `0 ≤ ⟪T x, x⟫`.

For the version with `IsSymmetric` instead of `IsSelfAdjoint`, see
`ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff`.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] (T : E →L[𝕜] E) : T.IsPositive ↔ IsSelfAdjoint T ∧ ∀ (x : E), 0 ≤ inner 𝕜 (T x) x

docstring: A module with a nonzero vector `v` has dimension 1 iff every vector is a multiple of `v`.
name: finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero'
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (v : V) (nz : v ≠ 0) : Module.finrank K V = 1 ↔ ∀ (w : V), ∃ c, c • v = w

docstring:
Suppose `X Y : SheafedSpace C`, where `C` is a concrete category,
whose forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, preserves limits and filtered colimits.
Then a morphism `X ⟶ Y` that is a topological open embedding
is an open immersion iff every stalk map is an iso.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.of_stalk_iso
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : Topology.IsOpenEmbedding (X := ↑↑X.toPresheafedSpace) (Y := ↑↑Y.toPresheafedSpace) ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := fun X Y => C(↑X, ↑Y)) (CC := TopCat.carrier) f.base)) [∀ (x : ↑↑X.toPresheafedSpace), CategoryTheory.IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.stalkMap f x)] : AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion f

docstring:
Let `X` be a compact topological space, `α` a uniform space, `F : ι → (X → α)` an
equicontinuous family, and `ℱ` a filter on `ι`. Then, `F` tends *uniformly* to `f : X → α` along
`ℱ` iff it tends to `f` *pointwise* along `ℱ`.
name: Equicontinuous.tendsto_uniformFun_iff_pi
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} [CompactSpace X] (F_eqcont : Equicontinuous F) (ℱ : Filter ι) (f : X → α) : Filter.Tendsto (β := UniformFun X α) (⇑UniformFun.ofFun ∘ F : ι → UniformFun X α) ℱ (nhds (UniformFun.ofFun f) : Filter (UniformFun X α)) ↔ Filter.Tendsto F ℱ (nhds f)

docstring: `t ∈ ∂^k 𝒜` iff `t` is exactly `k` elements more than something in `𝒜`.
name: Finset.mem_upShadow_iff_exists_mem_card_add
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {s : Finset α} {k : ℕ} : s ∈ Finset.upShadow^[k] 𝒜 ↔ ∃ t ∈ 𝒜, t ⊆ s ∧ t.card + k = s.card

docstring:
The partial order on a C⋆-algebra defined by `x ≤ y` if and only if `y - x` is
selfadjoint and has nonnegative spectrum.

This is not declared as an instance because one may already have a partial order with better
definitional properties. However, it can be useful to invoke this as an instance in proofs.
name: CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder
statement_text: (A : Type u_1) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] : PartialOrder A

docstring: An action is preprimitive iff it is `1`-preprimitive.
name: MulAction.is_one_preprimitive_iff
statement_text: (M : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [Group M] [MulAction M α] : MulAction.IsMultiplyPreprimitive M α 1 ↔ MulAction.IsPreprimitive M α

docstring: `f` is left homotopic to `g` iff `f - g` is left homotopic to `0`.
name: CategoryTheory.Arrow.LeftHomotopy.equivSubZero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} V] {u : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {v : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {f : u ⟶ v} {g : u ⟶ v} : CategoryTheory.Arrow.LeftHomotopy f g ≃ CategoryTheory.Arrow.LeftHomotopy (f - g) 0

docstring:
Two compatible families on the sieve generated by a presieve `R` are equal if and only if they are
equal when restricted to `R`.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.restrict_inj
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, w, u₁, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)} {X : C} {R : CategoryTheory.Presieve.{v₁, u₁} X} {x₁ : CategoryTheory.Presieve.FamilyOfElements P (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows} {x₂ : CategoryTheory.Presieve.FamilyOfElements P (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows} (t₁ : x₁.Compatible (R := (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows)) (t₂ : x₂.Compatible (R := (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows)) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.FamilyOfElements.restrict (R₁ := R) (R₂ := (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows) ⋯ x₁ = CategoryTheory.Presieve.FamilyOfElements.restrict (R₁ := R) (R₂ := (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows) ⋯ x₂ → x₁ = x₂

docstring:
In a finite dimensional normed affine space over `ℝ`, a set is bounded if and only if its
asymptotic cone is trivial.
name: isBounded_iff_asymptoticCone_subset_singleton
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] {s : Set P} : Bornology.IsBounded s ↔ asymptoticCone ℝ s ⊆ {0}

docstring:
A module is simple iff it's isomorphic to the quotient of the ring by a maximal left ideal
(not necessarily unique if the ring is not commutative).
name: isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] {M : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : IsSimpleModule R M ↔ ∃ I, I.IsMaximal ∧ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] R ⧸ I)

docstring: Two points in a projective space are dependent if and only if they are equal.
name: Projectivization.dependent_pair_iff_eq
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (u : Projectivization K V) (v : Projectivization K V) : Projectivization.Dependent ![u, v] ↔ u = v

docstring:
Let `S` be a Dedekind domain that is integral and torsion-free over a characteristic-zero
domain `R`. Then an ideal `p` of `R` is unramified in `S` if and only if `S` is unramified at every
maximal ideal `P` of `S` lying over `p`.
name: Algebra.isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_of_isDedekindDomain
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsDomain R] [IsDedekindDomain S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S] [CharZero R] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] {p : Ideal R} : Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn S p ↔ ∀ (P : Ideal S) (x : P.IsMaximal), P.LiesOver p → Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P

docstring:
On a connected set, there exists a point where a meromorphic function `f` has finite order iff `f`
has finite order at every point.

See `Meromorphic.exists_meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_forall` in file
`Mathlib/Analysis/Meromorphic/RCLike` for a related result assuming that `f` is meromorphic on all
of `𝕜`.
name: MeromorphicOn.exists_meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_forall
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {U : Set 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicOn f U) (hU : IsConnected U) : (∃ u, meromorphicOrderAt f ↑u ≠ ⊤) ↔ ∀ (u : ↑U), meromorphicOrderAt f ↑u ≠ ⊤

docstring:
The **Heine–Borel theorem**:
In a proper metric space, a set is compact if and only if it is closed and bounded.
name: Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} {s : Set α} [MetricSpace α] [ProperSpace α] : IsCompact s ↔ IsClosed s ∧ Bornology.IsBounded s

docstring:
Assuming `f 0 = 0`, the `LSeries` of `f` is zero if and only if either `f = 0` or the
L-series converges nowhere.
name: LSeries_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {f : ℕ → ℂ} (hf : f 0 = 0) : LSeries f = 0 ↔ f = 0 ∨ LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f = ⊤

docstring:
A family `f : X → α → β`, each of which is continuous on a compact set `s : Set α` is
continuous in the topology `X → α →ᵤ[{s}] β` if and only if the family of continuous restrictions
`X → C(s, β)` is continuous.
name: ContinuousOn.continuous_domRestrict_iff_continuous_uniformOnFun
statement_text: {α : Type u₁} {β : Type u₂} [TopologicalSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : X → α → β} {s : Set α} (hf : ∀ (x : X), ContinuousOn (f x) s) [CompactSpace.{u₁} ↑s] : (Continuous (Y := ContinuousMap.{u₁, u₂} (↑s) β) fun (x : X) => { toFun := s.domRestrict (π := fun a => β) (f x), continuous_toFun := ⋯ }) ↔ Continuous (Y := UniformOnFun α β {s}) fun (x : X) => (UniformOnFun.ofFun {s}) (f x)

docstring:
If the order of a meromorphic function is positive, then this function converges to zero
at this point. See also the iff version `tendsto_zero_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_pos`.
name: tendsto_zero_of_meromorphicOrderAt_pos
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (ho : 0 < meromorphicOrderAt f x) : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds 0)

docstring:
The `v` adic valuation of `a / b : K` is `≤ 1` if and only if `b ∉ v`, provided that `a` and
`b` are coprime at `v`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_div_le_one_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) (a : R) {b : R} (hb : b ≠ 0) (h : b ∈ v.asIdeal → a ∉ v.asIdeal) : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation K v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (HDiv.hDiv (α := K) ↑a ↑b) ≤ 1 ↔ b ∉ v.asIdeal

docstring:
Two nonzero vectors `x y` in a real normed space are on the same ray if and only if the unit
vectors `‖x‖⁻¹ • x` and `‖y‖⁻¹ • y` are equal.
name: sameRay_iff_inv_norm_smul_eq_of_ne
statement_text: {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {x : F} {y : F} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : SameRay ℝ x y ↔ ‖x‖⁻¹ • x = ‖y‖⁻¹ • y

docstring: A scheme is Artinian if and only if it is Noetherian and has the discrete topology.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsArtinianScheme.iff_isNoetherian_and_discreteTopology
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} : AlgebraicGeometry.IsArtinianScheme X ↔ AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian X ∧ DiscreteTopology.{u} ↥X

docstring: A group homomorphism is strict if and only if its `QuotientGroup.kerLift` is an embedding.
name: MonoidHom.isStrictMap_iff_isEmbedding_kerLift
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [Group G] [Group H] {f : G →* H} [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := H) ⇑f ↔ Topology.IsEmbedding.{u_1, u_2} (X := G ⧸ f.ker) (Y := H) ⇑(QuotientGroup.kerLift f)

docstring:
An element `x` is transcendental over `R` if and only if the map `Polynomial.aeval x`
is injective. This is similar to `algebraicIndependent_iff_injective_aeval`.
name: transcendental_iff_injective
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {x : A} : Transcendental R x ↔ Function.Injective.{u + 1, v + 1} (α := Polynomial R) (β := A) ⇑(Polynomial.aeval x)

docstring:
If `i` is an `F`-algebra homomorphism from `E` to `K`, then `i x` is contained in
`perfectClosure F K` if and only if `x` is contained in `perfectClosure F E`.
name: map_mem_perfectClosure_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {K : Type w} [Field K] [Algebra F K] (i : E →ₐ[F] K) {x : E} : Membership.mem (α := K) (γ := IntermediateField F K) (perfectClosure F K) (i x : K) ↔ Membership.mem (γ := IntermediateField F E) (perfectClosure F E) x

docstring: A function is `C^(n + 1)` at a point iff locally, it has a derivative which is `C^n`.
name: contDiffAt_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F} {x : E} {n : ℕ} : ContDiffAt 𝕜 (↑n + 1) f x ↔ ∃ f', (∃ u ∈ nhds x, ∀ x ∈ u, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) ∧ ContDiffAt 𝕜 (↑n) f' x

docstring: A point `a` is in the closure of `s` iff all basis sets containing `a` intersect `s`.
name: TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis.mem_closure_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] {b : Set (Set α)} (hb : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis b) {s : Set α} {a : α} : a ∈ closure s ↔ ∀ o ∈ b, a ∈ o → (o ∩ s).Nonempty

docstring:
Three points are collinear if and only if they are not affinely
independent.
name: collinear_iff_not_affineIndependent
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p : Fin 3 → P} : Collinear k (Set.range p) ↔ ¬AffineIndependent k p

docstring: **Myhill–Nerode theorem**. A language is regular if and only if the set of left quotients is finite.
name: Language.isRegular_iff_finite_range_leftQuotient
statement_text: {α : Type u} {L : Language α} : L.IsRegular ↔ (Set.range L.leftQuotient).Finite

docstring: A polynomial `p` lifts if and only if it is in the image of `mapAlg`.
name: Polynomial.mem_lifts_iff_mem_alg
statement_text: (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R] {S : Type v} [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] (p : Polynomial S) : Membership.mem (γ := Subsemiring (Polynomial S)) (Polynomial.lifts (algebraMap R S)) p ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Subalgebra R (Polynomial S)) (AlgHom.range (Polynomial.mapAlg R S)) p

docstring: An `R`-finite torsion-free module has positive `finrank` iff it is nontrivial.
name: Module.finrank_pos_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Finite R M] [IsDomain R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] : 0 < Module.finrank R M ↔ Nontrivial M

docstring:
A set is countably compact if and only if every sequence eventually in it has a cluster point
in it.
name: isCountablyCompact_iff_seq_clusterPt
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace E] {A : Set E} : IsCountablyCompact A ↔ ∀ (x : ℕ → E), (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, x n ∈ A) → ∃ a ∈ A, MapClusterPt a Filter.atTop x

docstring: An additive submonoid `S` includes `closure s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: AddSubmonoid.closure_le
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [AddZeroClass M] {s : Set M} {S : AddSubmonoid M} : AddSubmonoid.closure s ≤ S ↔ s ⊆ ↑S

docstring: A thin category is essentially small if and only if the underlying type of its skeleton is small.
name: CategoryTheory.essentiallySmall_iff_of_thin
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [Quiver.IsThin.{u, v} C] : CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.{w, v, u} C ↔ Small.{w, u} (CategoryTheory.Skeleton.{v, u} C)

docstring:
Let `P →ₐ[R] A` be a surjection with kernel `J`, and `P` a formally smooth `R`-algebra,
then `A` is formally smooth over `R` iff the surjection `P ⧸ J ^ 2 →ₐ[R] A` has a section.

Geometric intuition: we require that a first-order thickening of `Spec A` inside `Spec P` admits
a retraction.
name: Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_split_surjection
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] {P : Type u_2} [CommRing P] [Algebra R P] [Algebra.FormallySmooth R P] (f : P →ₐ[R] A) (hf : Function.Surjective.{u_2 + 1, v + 1} (α := P) (β := A) ⇑f) : Algebra.FormallySmooth R A ↔ ∃ g, f.kerSquareLift.comp g = AlgHom.id R A

docstring: `dim R ≤ n` if and only if the height of all maximal ideals is less than `n`.
name: ringKrullDim_le_iff_isMaximal_height_le
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (n : WithBot ℕ∞) : ringKrullDim R ≤ n ↔ ∀ ⦃m : Ideal R⦄, m.IsMaximal → ↑m.height ≤ n

docstring:
If the measure of the symmetric difference of two sets is finite,
then one has infinite measure if and only if the other one does.
name: MeasureTheory.measure_eq_top_iff_of_symmDiff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {s : Set α} {t : Set α} (hμst : Ne (α := ENNReal) (μ (symmDiff s t) : ENNReal) (⊤ : ENNReal)) : Eq (α := ENNReal) (μ s : ENNReal) (⊤ : ENNReal) ↔ Eq (α := ENNReal) (μ t : ENNReal) (⊤ : ENNReal)

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous at `x₀` iff the function `swap 𝓕 : X → ι → α` is
continuous at `x₀` *when `ι → α` is equipped with the topology of uniform convergence*. This is
very useful for developing the equicontinuity API, but it should not be used directly for other
purposes.
name: equicontinuousAt_iff_continuousAt
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {x₀ : X} : EquicontinuousAt F x₀ ↔ ContinuousAt (Y := UniformFun ι α) (⇑UniformFun.ofFun ∘ Function.swap (φ := fun a a_1 => α) F) x₀

docstring:
Let `u : E → F` be a continuous linear map, and `A` a *complemented* finite dimensional
subspace of `F`. Then `u` is strict with closed range if and only if the induced map `E → F ⧸ A`
is strict with closed range.

This is [N. Bourbaki, *Théories Spectrales*, Chapitre III, § 3, n° 1, Cor. 2][bourbaki2023].
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isStrictMap_isClosed_range_iff_quotient
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace E] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜 F] [T2Space F] (u : E →L[𝕜] F) (A : Submodule 𝕜 F) [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_3} 𝕜 ↥A] (A_compl : A.ClosedComplemented) : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := E) (Y := F) ⇑u ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑u).range ↔ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_2, u_3} (X := E) (Y := F ⧸ A) ⇑(A.mkQL ∘SL u) ∧ IsClosed ↑(↑(A.mkQL ∘SL u)).range

docstring:
`NoZeroSMulDivisors R M` states that a scalar multiple is `0` only if either argument is `0`.
This is a version of saying that `M` is torsion free, without assuming `R` is zero-divisor free.

The main application of `NoZeroSMulDivisors R M`, when `M` is a module,
is the result `smul_eq_zero`: a scalar multiple is `0` iff either argument is `0`.

It is a generalization of the `NoZeroDivisors` class to heterogeneous multiplication.
name: NoZeroSMulDivisors
statement_text: (R : Type u_4) (M : Type u_5) [Zero R] [Zero M] [SMul R M] : Prop

docstring: The spectral value of `p` equals zero if and only if `p` is of the form `X ^ n`.
name: spectralValue_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [Nontrivial R] {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p.Monic) : spectralValue.{u_1} (R := R) p = 0 ↔ p = HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial R) Polynomial.X p.natDegree

docstring:
The measure `μ` is Gaussian if and only if there
exist `m : E` and `f : E →L[ℝ]  E →L[ℝ] ℝ`
satisfying `f.toBilinForm.IsPosSemidef` and `charFun μ t = exp (⟪t, m⟫ * I - f t t / 2)`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.isGaussian_iff_gaussian_charFun
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] : ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian μ ↔ ∃ m f, f.toBilinForm.IsPosSemidef ∧ ∀ (t : E), MeasureTheory.charFun μ t = Complex.exp (↑(inner ℝ t m) * Complex.I - ↑((f t : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) t) / 2)

docstring: The sine of the angle between three points is 1 if and only if the angle is π / 2.
name: EuclideanGeometry.sin_eq_one_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃) = 1 ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi / 2

docstring:
The family of elements given by `x : FirstObj P S` is compatible iff `firstMap` and `secondMap`
map it to the same point.
See `CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.compatible_iff_of_small` for a version with
less universe assumptions.
name: CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.compatible_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, w, u, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) {B : C} {I : Type w} (X : I → C) (π : (i : I) → X i ⟶ B) [(CategoryTheory.Presieve.ofArrows X π).HasPairwisePullbacks] (x : CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.FirstObj P X) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.Arrows.Compatible P π ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.productIso fun i => P.obj (Opposite.op (X i))))) x) ↔ Eq (α := (fun (X : Type w) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.SecondObj P X π)) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.firstMap P X π)) x : (fun (X : Type w) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.SecondObj P X π)) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.secondMap P X π)) x : (fun (X : Type w) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.SecondObj P X π))

docstring:
An element `x` is transcendental over `R` if and only if for any polynomial `p`,
`Polynomial.aeval x p = 0` implies `p = 0`. This is similar to `algebraicIndependent_iff`.
name: transcendental_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {x : A} : Transcendental R x ↔ ∀ (p : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0 → p = 0

docstring:
For every universe `w`, `C` is filtered if and only if every finite diagram in `C` with shape
in `w` admits a cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.iff_cocone_nonempty
statement_text: (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.{v, u} C ↔ ∀ {J : Type w} [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.SmallCategory J] [CategoryTheory.FinCategory J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{w, v, w, u} J C), Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F)

docstring:
A maximally acyclic graph is a tree. This is similar to `maximal_isAcyclic_iff_isTree` except
with `Nonempty V` as part of the iff rather than an assumption.
name: SimpleGraph.isTree_iff_maximal_isAcyclic
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} : G.IsTree ↔ Nonempty V ∧ Maximal SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic G

docstring:
If `F ⊣ G` is an adjunction, the `G` is lax monoidal iff `F` is oplax monoidal.
It is advisable to use `Adjunction.leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal` and
`Adjunction.rightAdjointLaxMonoidal`, because compatibilities between
the oplax monoidal left adjoint and the lax monoidal right adjoint
(`Adjunction.IsMonoidal`) have been stated for these definitions.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.laxMonoidalEquivOplaxMonoidal
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{v₂, u₂} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} (adj : F ⊣ G) : G.LaxMonoidal ≃ F.OplaxMonoidal

docstring: `M` is boundaryless if and only if its boundary is empty.
name: ModelWithCorners.Boundaryless.iff_boundary_eq_empty
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] : ModelWithCorners.boundary.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (H := H) (I := I) M = ∅ ↔ BoundarylessManifold I M

docstring: A prime divides the different ideal iff it is ramified.
name: dvd_differentIdeal_iff
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_3} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [IsDomain A] [IsDedekindDomain A] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Module.IsTorsionFree A B] [Module.Finite A B] [Algebra.IsSeparable.{u_1, u_3} (FractionRing A) (FractionRing B)] {P : Ideal B} [P.IsPrime] : P ∣ differentIdeal A B ↔ ¬Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt A P

docstring:
A set `s` is preconnected if and only if for every cover by two open sets that are disjoint on
`s`, it is contained in one of the two covering sets.
name: isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} : IsPreconnected s ↔ ∀ (u v : Set α), IsOpen u → IsOpen v → s ⊆ u ∪ v → s ∩ (u ∩ v) = ∅ → s ⊆ u ∨ s ⊆ v

docstring:
The Scott-Hausdorff topology.

A set `u` is open in the Scott-Hausdorff topology iff when the least upper bound of a directed set
`d` lies in `u` then there is a tail of `d` which is a subset of `u`.

For mild conditions on `D`, this is equivalent to saying that open sets are `DirSupInaccOn D`,
and closed sets are `DirSupClosedOn D`.
name: Topology.scottHausdorff
statement_text: (α : Type u_3) (D : Set (Set α)) [Preorder α] : TopologicalSpace α

docstring:
Adding a vector to a point in a subspace produces a point in the subspace if and only if the
vector is in the direction.
name: AffineSubspace.vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace k P} (v : V) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) : v +ᵥ p ∈ s ↔ v ∈ s.direction

docstring:
Given that the right square is a pullback, the pasted square is a pullback iff the left
square is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.pasteHorizIsPullbackEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X₃ : C} {Y₁ : C} {Y₂ : C} {Y₃ : C} {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂} {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Y₃} {i₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃} {t₂ : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone g₂ i₃} {i₂ : t₂.pt ⟶ Y₂} (t₁ : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone g₁ i₂) (hi₂ : i₂ = t₂.fst) (H : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit t₂) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (t₂.pasteHoriz t₁ hi₂) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit t₁

docstring: The `v`-adic valuation of `r : R` is less than 1 if and only if `v` divides the ideal `(r)`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_lt_one_iff_dvd
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) : v.intValuation r < 1 ↔ v.asIdeal ∣ Ideal.span {r}

docstring:
A finite-type `R`-algebra `S` is (formally) unramified iff there exists a `t : S ⊗[R] S` satisfying
1. `t` annihilates every `1 ⊗ s - s ⊗ 1`.
2. the image of `t` is `1` under the map `S ⊗[R] S → S`.

See `Algebra.FormallyUnramified.iff_exists_tensorProduct`.
This is the choice of such a `t`.
name: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.elem
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) (S : Type u_2) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S] [Algebra.EssFiniteType R S] : TensorProduct R S S

docstring:
If `f` is any function and `g` is analytic without zero in `U`, then `f` is meromorphic in normal
form on `U` iff `f * g` is meromorphic in normal form on `U`.
name: meromorphicNFOn_mul_iff_left_of_analyticOnNhd
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {U : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (h₁g : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g U) (h₂g : ∀ u ∈ U, g u ≠ 0) : MeromorphicNFOn (f * g) U ↔ MeromorphicNFOn f U

docstring:
`t ∈ ∂⁺^k 𝒜` iff `t` is exactly `k` elements less than something in `𝒜`.

See also `Finset.mem_upShadow_iterate_iff_exists_sdiff`.
name: Finset.mem_upShadow_iterate_iff_exists_mem_card_add
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} {k : ℕ} : t ∈ Finset.upShadow^[k] 𝒜 ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, s ⊆ t ∧ t.card = s.card + k

docstring: `x` is a conjugate root of `0` if and only if `x = 0`.
name: isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {S : Type u_4} [CommRing S] [Field K] [Algebra K S] [IsDomain S] {x : S} : IsConjRoot K 0 x ↔ x = 0

docstring: `M.mulVec` is surjective iff `M` has full row rank.
name: Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_rank_eq_card
statement_text: {m : Type um} {n : Type un} {R : Type uR} [Fintype n] [Field R] [Fintype m] {M : Matrix m n R} : Function.Surjective M.mulVec ↔ M.rank = Fintype.card m

docstring:
An element is `M`-regular if and only if left vector addition by an `M`-regular element
is `M`-regular.
name: IsVAddRegular.vadd_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {a : R} [VAdd R M] [VAdd R S] [VAdd S M] [VAddAssocClass R S M] (b : S) (ha : IsVAddRegular M a) : IsVAddRegular M (a +ᵥ b) ↔ IsVAddRegular M b

docstring:
Two morphisms in `Arrow V` have the same image in `RightFreyd V` if and only if there
exists a right homotopy between them.
name: CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.quotient_map_eq_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} V] {u : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {v : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} (f : u ⟶ v) (g : u ⟶ v) : Eq (α := Quiver.Hom (V := CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.{v_1, u_1} V) (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.quotient V) u) (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.quotient V) v)) (CategoryTheory.Functor.map (CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.quotient V) f) (CategoryTheory.Functor.map (CategoryTheory.Preadditive.RightFreyd.quotient V) g) ↔ Nonempty.{v_1 + 1} (CategoryTheory.Arrow.RightHomotopy f g)

docstring:
Two ring congruence relations are equal iff their underlying binary
relations are equal.
name: RingCon.coe_inj
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Add R] [Mul R] {c : RingCon R} {d : RingCon R} : Eq (α := R → R → Prop) ⇑c ⇑d ↔ c = d

docstring: A function is integrable for the counting measure iff its norm is summable.
name: MeasureTheory.integrable_count_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [NormedAddCommGroup β] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {f : α → β} : @MeasureTheory.Integrable _ _ _ _ m f MeasureTheory.Measure.count ↔ Summable (α := ℝ) fun x => ‖f x‖

docstring:
A linear functional `φ` is in the span of a collection of linear functionals if and only if `φ`
is continuous with respect to the topology induced by the collection of linear functionals. See
`LinearMap.mem_span_iff_continuous_of_finite` for a result about finite collections of linear
functionals.
name: LinearMap.mem_span_iff_continuous
statement_text: {ι : Type u_4} {𝕜 : Type u_5} {E : Type u_6} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] {f : ι → E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (φ : E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) : Membership.mem (γ := Submodule 𝕜 (E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)) (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range f)) φ ↔ Continuous.{u_6, u_5} (X := E) (Y := 𝕜) ⇑φ

docstring: A nonempty affine subspace is `⊤` if and only if its direction is `⊤`.
name: AffineSubspace.direction_eq_top_iff_of_nonempty
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace k P} (h : (↑s).Nonempty) : s.direction = ⊤ ↔ s = ⊤

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which monovary together on `s`, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f ∘ σ` and `g`
monovary together on `s`. Stated by permuting the entries of `f`.
name: MonovaryOn.sum_comp_perm_mul_eq_sum_mul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {s : Finset ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} (hfg : MonovaryOn f g ↑s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ ↑s) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i ∈ s, f (σ i) * g i) (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ↔ MonovaryOn (f ∘ ⇑σ) g ↑s

docstring:
A natural number `n` is a sum of two squares if and only if `n = a^2 * b` with natural
numbers `a` and `b` such that `-1` is a square modulo `b`.
name: Nat.eq_sq_add_sq_iff_eq_sq_mul
statement_text: {n : ℕ} : (∃ x y, n = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ↔ ∃ a b, n = a ^ 2 * b ∧ IsSquare (-1)

docstring: In an additive monoid whose only unit is `0`, a sum is equal to `0` iff all terms are `0`.
name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} [Subsingleton.{u_4 + 1} (AddUnits M)] : ∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0

docstring:
The comparison morphism for the coproduct of `f`. This is an iso iff `G` preserves the coproduct
of `f`, see `PreservesCoproduct.ofIsoComparison`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaComparison
statement_text: {β : Type w} {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v₂, u, u₂} C D) (f : β → C) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasCoproduct.{w, v, u} f] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasCoproduct.{w, v₂, u₂} (C := D) fun (b : β) => G.obj (f b)] : (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj.{w, v₂, u₂} fun (b : β) => G.obj (f b)) ⟶ G.obj (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj.{w, v, u} f)

docstring:
A linear equivalence between topological modules is a homeomorphism if and only if it is
continuous in both directions.
name: LinearEquiv.isHomeomorph_iff
statement_text: {S : Type u_1} [Semiring S] {S₁ : Type u_6} {M : Type u_7} {M₁ : Type u_8} [Semiring S₁] {σ : S →+* S₁} {σ' : S₁ →+* S} [RingHomInvPair σ σ'] [RingHomInvPair σ' σ] [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module S M] [TopologicalSpace M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [_root_.Module S₁ M₁] (e : M ≃ₛₗ[σ] M₁) : IsHomeomorph.{u_7, u_8} (X := M) (Y := M₁) ⇑e ↔ Continuous.{u_7, u_8} (X := M) (Y := M₁) ⇑e ∧ Continuous.{u_8, u_7} (X := M₁) (Y := M) ⇑e.symm

docstring: For graphs `G`, `H`, `G ≤ H` iff `∀ a b, G.Adj a b → H.Adj a b`.
name: SimpleGraph.instLE
statement_text: {V : Type u} : LE (SimpleGraph V)

docstring: The finite field `F` has even cardinality iff it has characteristic `2`.
name: FiniteField.even_card_iff_char_two
statement_text: {F : Type u_3} [Field F] [Fintype F] : ringChar F = 2 ↔ Fintype.card F % 2 = 0

docstring:
A vector space over a field is isomorphic to its dual if and only if it is finite-dimensional:
a consequence of the Erdős-Kaplansky theorem.
name: Basis.linearEquiv_dual_iff_finiteDimensional
statement_text: {K : Type uK} {V : Type uV} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] : Nonempty (V ≃ₗ[K] Module.Dual K V) ↔ FiniteDimensional K V

docstring:
The inner product of two vectors is nonpositive if and only if the angle between them is
at least `π / 2`.
name: InnerProductGeometry.inner_nonpos_iff_pi_div_two_le_angle
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : inner ℝ x y ≤ 0 ↔ Real.pi / 2 ≤ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y

docstring:
A variant of `topologically_isZariskiLocalAtSource`
that takes one iff statement instead of two implications.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologically_isZariskiLocalAtSource'
statement_text: (P : {α β : Type u} → [TopologicalSpace α] → [TopologicalSpace β] → (α → β) → Prop) [(AlgebraicGeometry.topologically fun {α β} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] => P).RespectsIso] (hP : ∀ {X Y : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) {ι : Type u} (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X), TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover U → Continuous f → (P f ↔ ∀ (i : ι), P (α := ↥(U i)) (f ∘ Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ U i)))) : AlgebraicGeometry.IsZariskiLocalAtSource.{u} (AlgebraicGeometry.topologically fun {α β} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] => P)

docstring:
If the index type has cardinality equal to the finite dimension, composing an alternating
map with the same linear equiv on each argument gives the same orientation if and only if the
determinant is positive.
name: Orientation.map_eq_iff_det_pos
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {ι : Type u_3} [Fintype ι] [FiniteDimensional R M] (x : Orientation R M ι) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (h : Fintype.card ι = Module.finrank R M) : (Orientation.map ι f) x = x ↔ 0 < LinearMap.det ↑f

docstring: In an additive cyclic group, `H = K` iff `H.index = K.index`.
name: IsAddCyclic.addSubgroup_eq_iff_index_eq
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] {H : AddSubgroup G} {K : AddSubgroup G} : H = K ↔ H.index = K.index

docstring:
The images of two vectors under an injective linear map are on the same ray if and only if the
original vectors are on the same ray.
name: Function.Injective.sameRay_map_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid N] [_root_.Module R N] {x : M} {y : M} {F : Type u_5} [FunLike F M N] [LinearMapClass F R M N] {f : F} (hf : Function.Injective.{u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} (α := M) (β := N) ⇑f) : SameRay.{u_1, u_3} R (M := N) (f x : N) (f y : N) ↔ SameRay R x y

docstring:
The directed graph (quiver) associated with a matrix `A`,
with an edge `i ⟶ j` iff `0 < A i j`.
name: Matrix.toQuiver
statement_text: {n : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] (A : Matrix n n R) : Quiver n

docstring: If `a` is even, then `n` is even iff `n % a` is even.
name: Even.mod_even_iff
statement_text: {n : ℕ} {a : ℕ} (ha : Even a) : Even (n % a) ↔ Even n

docstring:
Suppose an indexed family of points is given, along with a subset
of the index type.  A vector can be expressed as
`weightedVSubOfPoint` using a `Finset` lying within that subset and
with a given sum of weights if and only if it can be expressed as
`weightedVSubOfPoint` with that sum of weights for the
corresponding indexed family whose index type is the subtype
corresponding to that subset.
name: Finset.eq_weightedVSubOfPoint_subset_iff_eq_weightedVSubOfPoint_subtype
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} {v : V} {x : k} {s : Set ι} {p : ι → P} {b : P} : (∃ fs, ↑fs ⊆ s ∧ ∃ w, ∑ i ∈ fs, w i = x ∧ v = (fs.weightedVSubOfPoint p b) w) ↔ ∃ fs w, ∑ i ∈ fs, w i = x ∧ v = (fs.weightedVSubOfPoint (fun i => p ↑i) b) w

docstring: A Hermitian matrix is positive semi-definite if and only if its eigenvalues are non-negative.
name: Matrix.IsHermitian.posSemidef_iff_eigenvalues_nonneg
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {𝕜 : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [RCLike 𝕜] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} [DecidableEq n] (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A.PosSemidef ↔ 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues

docstring:
The angle between two vectors is `θ` if and only if they are nonzero and the second vector
is the first rotated by `θ` and scaled by a positive real, or `θ` and at least one of the
vectors are zero.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_iff_eq_pos_smul_rotation_or_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (θ : Real.Angle) : o.oangle x y = θ ↔ (x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ y = HSMul.hSMul (β := V) r ((o.rotation θ) x : V)) ∨ θ = 0 ∧ (x = 0 ∨ y = 0)

docstring: A bilinear map is left-separating if and only if it has a trivial kernel.
name: LinearMap.separatingLeft_iff_ker_eq_bot
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {R₁ : Type u_2} {R₂ : Type u_3} {M : Type u_5} {M₁ : Type u_6} {M₂ : Type u_7} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [CommSemiring R₁] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [_root_.Module R₁ M₁] [CommSemiring R₂] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [_root_.Module R₂ M₂] {I₁ : R₁ →+* R} {I₂ : R₂ →+* R} {B : M₁ →ₛₗ[I₁] M₂ →ₛₗ[I₂] M} : B.SeparatingLeft ↔ B.ker = ⊥

docstring: `-1` is a square in `ZMod p` iff `p` is not congruent to `3` mod `4`.
name: ZMod.exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff
statement_text: {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] : IsSquare (-1) ↔ p % 4 ≠ 3

docstring:
The unoriented angle at `p` between two points not equal to `p` is zero if and only if the
unoriented angle is zero.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p : P} {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ≠ p) (hp₂ : p₂ ≠ p) : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p p₂ = 0 ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p p₂ = 0

docstring:
A set of points in an affine subspace is cospherical if and only if its image in the ambient
space is cospherical.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical.subtype_val_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {S : AffineSubspace ℝ P} [Nonempty.{u_2 + 1} ↥S] [S.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] {ps : Set ↥S} : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ S) '' ps) ↔ EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ps

docstring: A ring is a simple module over itself iff it is a division ring.
name: isSimpleModule_self_iff_isUnit
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] : IsSimpleModule R R ↔ Nontrivial R ∧ ∀ (x : R), x ≠ 0 → IsUnit x

docstring:
A square matrix is column stochastic iff all entries are nonnegative, and left
multiplication by the vector of all 1s gives the vector of all 1s.
name: Matrix.colStochastic
statement_text: (R : Type u_3) (n : Type u_4) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] : Submonoid (Matrix n n R)

docstring: If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` fixes `(j • h) +ᵥ x` iff `g` fixes `x`.
name: AddAction.vadd_zsmul_fixedBy_eq_of_addCommute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : AddCommute g h) (j : ℤ) : j • h +ᵥ AddAction.fixedBy α g = AddAction.fixedBy α g

docstring: **Vieta's formula** for quadratics as an iff (`aroots, Field` version).
name: Polynomial.aroots_quadratic_eq_pair_iff_of_ne_zero'
statement_text: {T : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [CommRing T] [Field S] [Algebra T S] {a : T} {b : T} {c : T} {x1 : S} {x2 : S} (ha : (algebraMap T S) a ≠ 0) : (HAdd.hAdd (β := Polynomial T) (HMul.hMul (α := Polynomial T) (Polynomial.C a : Polynomial T) (HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial T) Polynomial.X 2) + HMul.hMul (α := Polynomial T) (β := Polynomial T) (Polynomial.C b : Polynomial T) Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.C c : Polynomial T)).aroots S = {x1, x2} ↔ x1 + x2 = HDiv.hDiv (α := S) (β := S) (-(algebraMap T S) b : S) ((algebraMap T S) a : S) ∧ x1 * x2 = HDiv.hDiv (α := S) (β := S) ((algebraMap T S) c : S) ((algebraMap T S) a : S)

docstring: `Multipliable` over `Nat.Primes` iff over `ℕ` extending `f` by `1`.
name: Nat.Primes.multipliable_iff_multipliable_ite
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [CommMonoid M] [TopologicalSpace M] (f : ℕ → M) : (Multipliable.{u_1, 0} (α := M) fun p => f ↑p) ↔ Multipliable.{u_1, 0} (α := M) fun n => if Nat.Prime n then f n else 1

docstring:
A submodule has dimension at most `1` if and only if there is a
single vector, not necessarily in the submodule, such that the
submodule is contained in its span.
name: rank_submodule_le_one_iff'
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Ring K] [StrongRankCondition K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (s : Submodule K V) [Module.Free.{u, v} K ↥s] : Module.rank K ↥s ≤ 1 ↔ ∃ v₀, s ≤ K ∙ v₀

docstring:
A set `S ⊆ ℕ^α` is Diophantine if there exists a polynomial on
`α ⊕ β` such that `v ∈ S` iff there exists `t : ℕ^β` with `p (v, t) = 0`.
name: Dioph
statement_text: {α : Type u} (S : Set (α → ℕ)) : Prop

docstring:
`r • 𝟙 M` induces a monomorphism in `Ext M N n` if and only if scalar multiplication by `r`
is faithful on `Ext M N n`.
name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.postcomp_smul_id_mono_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Small.{v, u} R] {M : ModuleCat.{v, u} R} {N : ModuleCat.{v, u} R} (r : R) (i : ℕ) : CategoryTheory.Mono (X := ↧(CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext N M i)) (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.postcomp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (HSMul.hSMul (β := M ⟶ M) r (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id M))) N ⋯)) ↔ IsSMulRegular.{u, v} (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext N M i) r

docstring: A module is Artinian iff every decreasing chain of submodules stabilizes.
name: monotone_stabilizes_iff_artinian
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] : (∀ (f : ℕ →o (Submodule R M)ᵒᵈ), ∃ n, ∀ (m : ℕ), n ≤ m → Eq (α := (Submodule R M)ᵒᵈ) (f n : (Submodule R M)ᵒᵈ) (f m : (Submodule R M)ᵒᵈ)) ↔ IsArtinian R M

docstring:
The algebraic closure of `F` in `E` is equal to `E` if and only if `E / F` is
algebraic.
name: algebraicClosure.eq_top_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] : Eq (α := IntermediateField F E) (algebraicClosure F E) ⊤ ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E

docstring: Three points are affinely independent if and only if they are not collinear.
name: affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_of_ne
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p : Fin 3 → P} {i₁ : Fin 3} {i₂ : Fin 3} {i₃ : Fin 3} (h₁₂ : i₁ ≠ i₂) (h₁₃ : i₁ ≠ i₃) (h₂₃ : i₂ ≠ i₃) : AffineIndependent k p ↔ ¬Collinear k (P := P) {p i₁, p i₂, p i₃}

docstring:
When two right extensions `α₁ : RightExtension L F₁` and `α₂ : RightExtension L F₂`
are essentially the same via an isomorphism of functors `F₁ ≅ F₂`,
then `α₁` is universal iff `α₂` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.RightExtension.isUniversalEquivOfIso₂
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {H : Type u_3} {D : Type u_5} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_3, u_3} H] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_5, u_5} D] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_5, u_1, u_5} C D} {F₁ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_3, u_1, u_3} C H} {F₂ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_3, u_1, u_3} C H} (α₁ : L.RightExtension F₁) (α₂ : L.RightExtension F₂) (e : F₁ ≅ F₂) (e' : CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.left α₁ ≅ CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.left α₂) (h : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (L.whiskerLeft e'.hom) (CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.hom α₂) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.hom α₁) e.hom) : CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.IsUniversal α₁ ≃ CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow.IsUniversal α₂

docstring:
`x` is in a monomial ideal generated by `s` iff every element of its support dominates one of
the generators. Note that `si ≤ xi` is analogous to saying that the monomial corresponding to `si`
divides the monomial corresponding to `xi`.
name: MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_monomial_image
statement_text: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] {x : MvPolynomial σ R} {s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)} : Membership.mem (γ := Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) (Ideal.span ((fun s => (MvPolynomial.monomial s) 1) '' s)) x ↔ ∀ xi ∈ x.support, ∃ si ∈ s, si ≤ xi

docstring: The norms of two vectors on the same ray are equal if and only if they are equal.
name: SameRay.norm_eq_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {x : F} {y : F} (h : SameRay ℝ x y) : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ ↔ x = y

docstring:
Given a nonempty affine subspace, whose direction is
finite-dimensional, that contains a set of points, those points are
cospherical if and only if they are equidistant from some point in
that subspace.
name: EuclideanGeometry.cospherical_iff_exists_mem_of_finiteDimensional
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace ℝ P} {ps : Set P} (h : ps ⊆ ↑s) [Nonempty.{u_2 + 1} ↥s] [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} ℝ ↥s.direction] : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ps ↔ ∃ center ∈ s, ∃ radius, ∀ p ∈ ps, dist p center = radius

docstring:
`v ∈ Kᗮ` if and only if `re ⟪u, v⟫ = 0` for all `u ∈ K`; it suffices to check only the
real part of the inner product is zero.
name: Submodule.mem_orthogonal_iff_re_inner_eq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : Submodule 𝕜 E} {v : E} : v ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ u ∈ K, RCLike.re (inner 𝕜 u v) = 0

docstring:
If `A` is a finite free `R`-algebra, then `f : A` is nilpotent on `κ(𝔭) ⊗ A` for some
prime `𝔭 ◃ R` if and only if every non-leading coefficient of `charpoly(f)` is in `𝔭`.
name: isNilpotent_tensor_residueField_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Module.Free R A] [Module.Finite R A] (f : A) (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime] : IsNilpotent (R := TensorProduct R A I.ResidueField) ((algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A I.ResidueField)) f : TensorProduct R A I.ResidueField) ↔ ∀ i < Module.finrank R A, Membership.mem (α := R) I ((Polynomial.coeff (LinearMap.charpoly.{u_1, u_2} (M := A) ((Algebra.lmul R A) f))) i : R)

docstring: The `p`-adic norm of a natural `m` is one iff `p` doesn't divide `m`.
name: padicNorm.nat_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (m : ℕ) : padicNorm p ↑m = 1 ↔ ¬p ∣ m

docstring:
An integer `n` is divisible by `ζ - 1` in `𝓞 K` if and only if it is divisible by `p`,
where `ζ` is a primitive `p ^ (k + 1)`-th root of unity.
name: IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.zeta_sub_one_dvd_intCast_iff
statement_text: (p : ℕ) (k : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p ^ (k + 1)} ℚ K] {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (k + 1))) {n : ℤ} : hζ.toInteger - 1 ∣ ↑n ↔ ↑p ∣ n

docstring:
A non-negative function with locally finite support is zero if and only if its logarithmic counting
functions is asymptotically bounded.
name: Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.zero_iff_logCounting_bounded
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E] {D : Function.locallyFinsuppWithin (X := E) Set.univ ℤ} (h : 0 ≤ D) : D = 0 ↔ Asymptotics.IsBigO (E := ℝ) Filter.atTop (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.logCounting D) 1

docstring:
An anti-equivalence between the categories of triangles in `C` and in `Cᵒᵖ`.
A triangle in `Cᵒᵖ` shall be distinguished iff it corresponds to a distinguished
triangle in `C` via this equivalence.
name: CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.triangleOpEquivalence
statement_text: (C : Type u_1) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.HasShift.{v_1, u_1, 0} C ℤ] : (CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.{v_1, u_1} C)ᵒᵖ ≌ CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.{v_1, u_1} Cᵒᵖ

docstring:
If `d : MultispanIndex J C`, `c : Multicofork d` and `F : C ⥤ D`,
the cocone `F.mapCocone c` is colimit iff the multicofork `c.map F` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Multicofork.isColimitMapEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {J : CategoryTheory.Limits.MultispanShape} {d : CategoryTheory.Limits.MultispanIndex.{w, w', v_1, u_1} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Multicofork d) (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (F.mapCocone c) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (c.map F)

docstring:
The characteristic function of a measure is a product of
characteristic functions if and only if it is a product measure.
This is the version for Hilbert spaces, see `charFunDual_eq_pi_iff`
for the Banach space version.
name: MeasureTheory.charFun_eq_pi_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_6} [Fintype ι] {E : ι → Type u_7} [(i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [(i : ι) → InnerProductSpace ℝ (E i)] {mE : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (E i)} [∀ (i : ι), CompleteSpace.{u_7} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), SecondCountableTopology.{u_7} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), BorelSpace.{u_7} (E i)] {μ : (i : ι) → MeasureTheory.Measure (E i)} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : ι) → E i)} [∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] : (∀ (t : WithLp 2 ((i : ι) → E i)), MeasureTheory.charFun (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace 2 ((i : ι) → E i)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (WithLp.toLp 2) ν) t = ∏ i : ι, MeasureTheory.charFun (μ i) (t.ofLp i)) ↔ ν = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (α := E) μ

docstring:
If `f : X → Z` is a surjective Borel measurable map from a standard Borel space
to a countably separated measurable space, then the preimage of a set `s`
is measurable if and only if the set is measurable.
One implication is the definition of measurability, the other one heavily relies on `X` being a
standard Borel space.
name: Measurable.measurableSet_preimage_iff_of_surjective
statement_text: {X : Type u_3} {Z : Type u_5} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] {f : X → Z} (hf : Measurable f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) {s : Set Z} : MeasurableSet (f ⁻¹' s) ↔ MeasurableSet s

docstring:
Two finite measures on a product `(α × β) × γ` are equal iff they are equal on products of sets.
See `ext_prod₃_iff` for the same statement for `α × β × γ`.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.ext_prod₃_iff'
statement_text: {α : Type u_4} {β : Type u_5} {γ : Type u_6} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((α × β) × γ)} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure ((α × β) × γ)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] : μ = ν ↔ ∀ {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {u : Set γ}, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet t → MeasurableSet u → Eq (α := ENNReal) (μ ((s ×ˢ t) ×ˢ u) : ENNReal) (ν ((s ×ˢ t) ×ˢ u) : ENNReal)

docstring: `U.starProjection ∘ V.starProjection = 0` iff `U` and `V` are pairwise orthogonal.
name: Submodule.starProjection_comp_starProjection_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {U : Submodule 𝕜 E} {V : Submodule 𝕜 E} [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] [V.HasOrthogonalProjection] : U.starProjection ∘SL V.starProjection = 0 ↔ U ⟂ V

docstring: The fractional part of `a` is positive if and only if `a ≠ ⌊a⌋`.
name: Int.fract_pos
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [FloorRing R] {a : R} [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] : 0 < Int.fract a ↔ a ≠ ↑⌊a⌋

docstring:
A function `f` has a sum in a uniform additive group `α` if and only if it has that sum in the
completion of `α`.
name: hasSum_iff_hasSum_compl
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup α] [UniformSpace α] [IsUniformAddGroup α] {L : SummationFilter β} (f : β → α) (a : α) : HasSum (α := UniformSpace.Completion α) (⇑UniformSpace.Completion.toCompl ∘ f) (↑a) L ↔ HasSum f a L

docstring:
A morphism of schemes is smooth if and only if for each `x : X` there exists an affine open
neighborhood `V` of `x` and an affine open neighborhood `U` of `f.base x` with `V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U`
such that the induced map `Γ(Y, U) ⟶ Γ(X, V)` is standard smooth.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.iff_forall_exists_isStandardSmooth
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) : AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth f ↔ ∀ (x : ↥X), ∃ U, ∃ (_ : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U), ∃ V, ∃ (_ : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen V) (_ : x ∈ V) (e : V ≤ (TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).obj U), (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appLE f U V e)).IsStandardSmooth

docstring:
Given types with additions `M, N`, the product of two congruence relations
`c` on `M` and `d` on `N`: `(x₁, x₂), (y₁, y₂) ∈ M × N` are related by `c.prod d` iff `x₁`
is related to `y₁` by `c` and `x₂` is related to `y₂` by `d`.
name: AddCon.prod
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} [Add M] [Add N] (c : AddCon M) (d : AddCon N) : AddCon (M × N)

docstring: `-1` is a square in `F` iff `#F` is not congruent to `3` mod `4`.
name: FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [Field F] [Fintype F] : IsSquare (-1) ↔ Fintype.card F % 4 ≠ 3

docstring: Given `x, y : E ⊗ F`, `x = y` iff `⟪x, a ⊗ₜ b⟫ = ⟪y, a ⊗ₜ b⟫` for all `a, b`.
name: TensorProduct.ext_iff_inner_right
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] {x : TensorProduct 𝕜 E F} {y : TensorProduct 𝕜 E F} : x = y ↔ ∀ (a : E) (b : F), inner 𝕜 x (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] b) = inner 𝕜 y (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] b)

docstring:
A complex function is conformal if and only if the function is holomorphic or antiholomorphic
with a nonvanishing differential.
name: conformalAt_iff_differentiableAt_or_differentiableAt_comp_conj
statement_text: {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} : ConformalAt f z ↔ (DifferentiableAt ℂ f z ∨ DifferentiableAt ℂ (E := ℂ) (f ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd ℂ) : ℂ → ℂ) ((starRingEnd ℂ) z : ℂ)) ∧ fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0

docstring:
If `R` is of characteristic zero, then `ζ` is a root of `cyclotomic n R` if and only if it is a
primitive `n`-th root of unity.
name: Polynomial.isRoot_cyclotomic_iff_charZero
statement_text: {n : ℕ} {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharZero R] {μ : R} (hn : 0 < n) : Polynomial.IsRoot (Polynomial.cyclotomic n R) μ ↔ IsPrimitiveRoot μ n

docstring: A module is projective iff it is the direct summand of a free module.
name: Module.Projective.iff_split
statement_text: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {P : Type v} [AddCommMonoid P] [_root_.Module R P] : Module.Projective R P ↔ ∃ M x x_1, ∃ (_ : Module.Free R M), ∃ i s, s ∘ₗ i = LinearMap.id

docstring:
A field is finitely generated if and only if it is essentially of finite type over its prime
subfield.
name: Field.fg_iff_essFiniteType
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [Field F] : Field.FG F ↔ Algebra.EssFiniteType (↥⊥) F

docstring:
Two elements `a` and `b` are `M`-regular if and only if both sums `a + b` and `b + a`
are `M`-regular.
name: IsVAddRegular.add_and_add_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {a : R} {b : R} [VAdd R M] [Add R] [VAddAssocClass R R M] : IsVAddRegular M (a + b) ∧ IsVAddRegular M (b + a) ↔ IsVAddRegular M a ∧ IsVAddRegular M b

docstring:
Canonical form of the **equality case of Jensen's equality**.

For a strictly concave function `f` and positive weights `w`, we have
`f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i)` if and only if the points `p` are all equal
(and in fact all equal to their center of mass w.r.t. `w`).
name: StrictConcaveOn.map_sum_eq_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] [IsStrictOrderedModule 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} {t : Finset ι} {w : ι → 𝕜} {p : ι → E} (hf : StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) (h₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 < w i) (h₁ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hmem : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s) : f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i) ↔ ∀ j ∈ t, p j = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i

docstring:
The order of a formal power series is exactly `n` if and only if some coefficient of weight `n`
is nonzero, and the `d`th coefficient is `0` for all `d` such that `weight w d < n`.
name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_eq_nat
statement_text: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ} : MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ↑n ↔ (∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ (Finsupp.weight w) d = n) ∧ ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0

docstring: `X □ Y` lifts against `Z` if and only if `X` lifts against `Y ⋔ Z`.
name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.PushoutProduct.hasLiftingProperty_iff'
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPushouts.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullbacks.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u} C] {X : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v, u} C} {Y : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v, u} C} {Z : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v, u} C} : CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pushoutProduct X).obj Y).hom Z.hom ↔ CategoryTheory.HasLiftingProperty X.hom ((CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Arrow.pullbackHom (Opposite.op Y)).obj Z).hom

docstring:
If the order of a meromorphic function is zero, then this function converges to a nonzero
limit at this point. See also the iff version `tendsto_ne_zero_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero`.
name: tendsto_ne_zero_of_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) (ho : meromorphicOrderAt f x = 0) : ∃ c, c ≠ 0 ∧ Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds c)

docstring: A group is finitely generated if and only if it is finitely generated as a monoid.
name: Group.fg_iff_monoid_fg
statement_text: {G : Type u_3} [Group G] : Group.FG G ↔ Monoid.FG G

docstring:
Given an adjoint triple `F ⊣ G ⊣ H`, the left adjoint `F` is fully faithful if and only if the
right adjoint `H` is fully faithful.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple.fullyFaithfulEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {H : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} (t : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple F G H) : F.FullyFaithful ≃ H.FullyFaithful

docstring:
A presheaf `P` is a sheaf for the Grothendieck topology `J` iff for every covering sieve
`S` of `J`, the natural cone associated to `P` and `S` is a limit cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isLimit
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {A : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} A] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v₁, u₁} C) (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} Cᵒᵖ A) : CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf J P ↔ ∀ ⦃X : C⦄, ∀ S ∈ J X, Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (P.mapCone S.arrows.cocone.op))

docstring: A morphism in `Type u` is an isomorphism if and only if it is bijective.
name: CategoryTheory.isIso_iff_bijective
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.IsIso f ↔ Function.Bijective (α := (fun (X : Type u) => X) X) (β := (fun (X : Type u) => X) Y) ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) f)

docstring: `n : ℕ` is a _weird_ number if and only if it is abundant but not pseudoperfect.
name: Nat.Weird
statement_text: (n : ℕ) : Prop

docstring:
As we are using chain complexes indexed by `ℕ`, we shall need the relation
`c` such `c m n` if and only if `n+1=m`.
name: AlgebraicTopology.DoldKan.c
statement_text: : ComplexShape ℕ

docstring: A polynomial is separable iff it is coprime with its derivative.
name: Polynomial.Separable
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) : Prop

docstring:
Given a presheaf `F` on the topological space `X` and a presieve `R` whose generated sieve
is covering for the associated Grothendieck topology (equivalently, the presieve is covering
for the associated pretopology), the natural cone associated to `F` and the family of opens
associated to `R` is a limit cone iff the natural cone associated to `F` and the generated
sieve is a limit cone.
Since only the existence of a 1-1 correspondence will be used, the exact definition does
not matter, so tactics are used liberally.
name: TopCat.Presheaf.isLimitOpensLeEquivGenerate₂
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X : TopCat} (F : TopCat.Presheaf.{w, v_1, u_1} C X) {Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X} (R : CategoryTheory.Presieve Y) (hR : CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R ∈ (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↑X) Y) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Functor.mapCone F (TopCat.Presheaf.SheafCondition.opensLeCoverCocone (TopCat.Presheaf.coveringOfPresieve Y R)).op) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Functor.mapCone F (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R).arrows.cocone.op)

docstring: A function `f` is differentiable at `conj z` iff `conj ∘ f ∘ conj` is differentiable at `z`.
name: differentiableAt_conj_conj_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [StarRing 𝕜] {x : 𝕜} [NormedStarGroup 𝕜] {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (F := 𝕜) (⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜) ∘ f ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜)) x ↔ DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f ((starRingEnd 𝕜) x)

docstring:
Let `M` and `M'` be manifolds with the same model-with-corners, `I`.  Then `f : M → M'`
is a local structomorphism for `I`, if and only if it is manifold-`C^n` on the domain of definition
in both directions.
name: isLocalStructomorphOn_contDiffGroupoid_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {M' : Type u_5} [TopologicalSpace M'] [IsManifold I n M] [ChartedSpace H M'] [IsManifold I n M'] (f : OpenPartialHomeomorph M M') : ChartedSpace.LiftPropOn (contDiffGroupoid n I).IsLocalStructomorphWithinAt (↑f) f.source ↔ ContMDiffOn I I n (↑f) f.source ∧ ContMDiffOn I I n (↑f.symm) f.target

docstring: The maps `f` and `g` form an exact pair: `g y = 1` iff `y` belongs to the image of `f`.
name: Function.MulExact
statement_text: {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} {P : Type u_6} (f : M → N) (g : N → P) [One P] : Prop

docstring: `f` is left homotopic to `g` iff `g` is left homotopic to `f`.
name: CategoryTheory.Arrow.LeftHomotopy.symm
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} V] {u : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {v : CategoryTheory.Arrow.{v_1, u_1} V} {f : u ⟶ v} {g : u ⟶ v} (h : CategoryTheory.Arrow.LeftHomotopy f g) : CategoryTheory.Arrow.LeftHomotopy g f

docstring: The symbol `J(a | b)` vanishes if and only if `b ≠ 0` and `a` and `b` are not coprime.
name: jacobiSym.eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} : jacobiSym a b = 0 ↔ b ≠ 0 ∧ a.gcd ↑b ≠ 1

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` if and only if it contains an interval `(l, u)` containing `a`,
provided `a` is neither a bottom element nor a top element.
name: mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset'
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] {a : α} {s : Set α} (hl : ∃ l, l < a) (hu : ∃ u, a < u) : s ∈ nhds a ↔ ∃ l u, a ∈ Set.Ioo l u ∧ Set.Ioo l u ⊆ s

docstring:
The oriented angle between two vectors is not zero or `π` if and only if those two vectors
are linearly independent.
name: Orientation.oangle_ne_zero_and_ne_pi_iff_linearIndependent
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y ≠ 0 ∧ o.oangle x y ≠ ↑Real.pi ↔ LinearIndependent ℝ ![x, y]

docstring:
A presheaf of sets on a category which is `FinitaryExtensive` is a sheaf iff it preserves finite
products.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.isSheaf_iff_preservesFiniteProducts
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.FinitaryPreExtensive.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.FinitaryExtensive.{v_1, u_1} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, w, u_1, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf (CategoryTheory.extensiveTopology C) F ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteProducts F

docstring:
Simple graphs contain a copy of a `completeEquipartiteGraph r t` iff the type
`G.CompleteEquipartiteSubgraph r t` is nonempty.
name: SimpleGraph.completeEquipartiteGraph_isContained_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r : ℕ} {t : ℕ} : (SimpleGraph.completeEquipartiteGraph r t).IsContained G ↔ Nonempty.{u_1 + 1} (G.CompleteEquipartiteSubgraph r t)

docstring:
A function `f` is summable in a uniform additive group `α` if and only if it is summable in
`Completion α` and its sum in `Completion α` lies in the range of `toCompl : α →+ Completion α`.
name: summable_iff_summable_compl_and_tsum_mem
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup α] [UniformSpace α] [IsUniformAddGroup α] {L : SummationFilter β} (f : β → α) : Summable f L ↔ Summable (α := UniformSpace.Completion α) (⇑UniformSpace.Completion.toCompl ∘ f) L ∧ Membership.mem (γ := Set (UniformSpace.Completion α)) (Set.range (ι := α) ⇑UniformSpace.Completion.toCompl) (∑'[L] (i : β), UniformSpace.Completion.toCompl (f i))

docstring:
A continuous linear endomorphism is a unit iff it's a unit viewed simply as a linear map, provided
the space is complete.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_isUnit_toLinearMap
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : E →L[𝕜] E} : IsUnit f ↔ IsUnit ↑f

docstring:
A function `f : 𝕜 → E` has `p` as power series expansion at a point `z₀` iff it is the sum of
`p` in a neighborhood of `z₀`. This makes some proofs easier by hiding the fact that
`HasFPowerSeriesAt` depends on `p.radius`.
name: hasFPowerSeriesAt_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 𝕜 E} {f : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜} : HasFPowerSeriesAt (𝕜 := 𝕜) f p z₀ ↔ ∀ᶠ (z : 𝕜) in nhds 0, HasSum (fun n => z ^ n • p.coeff n) (f (z₀ + z))

docstring:
A function `f : 𝕜 → 𝕜` is strictly concave iff for any three points `x < y < z` the slope of
the secant line of `f` on `[x, y]` is strictly greater than the slope of the secant line of `f` on
`[y, z]`.
name: strictConcaveOn_iff_slope_strict_anti_adjacent
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] {s : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} : StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f ↔ Convex 𝕜 s ∧ ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄, x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f z - f y) / (z - y) < (f y - f x) / (y - x)

docstring: There is a field structure on type if and only if its cardinality is a prime power.
name: Field.nonempty_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} : Nonempty.{u + 1} (Field α) ↔ IsPrimePow (Cardinal.mk α)

docstring:
The infimum edistance of a point to a set is positive if and only if the point is not in the
closure of the set.
name: Metric.infEDist_pos_iff_notMem_closure
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] {x : α} {E : Set α} : 0 < Metric.infEDist x E ↔ x ∉ closure E

docstring:
A geometric series in a normed field is summable iff the norm of the common ratio is less than
one.
name: summable_geometric_iff_norm_lt_one
statement_text: {K : Type u_4} [NormedDivisionRing K] {ξ : K} : (Summable.{u_4, 0} (α := K) fun n => ξ ^ n) ↔ ‖ξ‖ < 1

docstring:
`f` is analytic within `s` at `x` iff some local extension of `f` is analytic at `x`. In this
version, we make sure that the extension coincides with `f` on all of `insert x s`.
name: analyticWithinAt_iff_exists_analyticAt'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F] {f : E → F} {s : Set E} {x : E} : AnalyticWithinAt 𝕜 f s x ↔ ∃ g, f x = g x ∧ Set.EqOn f g (insert x s) ∧ AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x

docstring:
Predicate for an ordered topological space to be equipped with its Scott-Hausdorff topology.

A set `u` is open in the Scott-Hausdorff topology iff when the least upper bound of a directed set
`d` lies in `u` then there is a tail of `d` which is a subset of `u`.

For mild conditions on `D`, this is equivalent to saying that open sets are `DirSupInaccOn D`,
and closed sets are `DirSupClosedOn D`.
name: Topology.IsScottHausdorff
statement_text: (α : Type u_3) (D : Set (Set α)) [Preorder α] [TopologicalSpace α] : Prop

docstring: A finitely-semisimple endomorphism is triangularizable if and only if it is diagonalizable.
name: Module.End.IsFinitelySemisimple.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {f : Module.End R M} (hf : f.IsFinitelySemisimple) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := Submodule R M) (⨆ μ, f.maxGenEigenspace μ) ⊤ ↔ Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := Submodule R M) (⨆ μ, f.eigenspace μ) ⊤

docstring: A binary bicone is a bilimit bicone if and only if the corresponding bicone is a bilimit.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryBicone.toBiconeIsBilimit
statement_text: {C : Type uC} [CategoryTheory.Category.{uC', uC} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{uC', uC} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (b : CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryBicone.{uC', uC} X Y) : b.toBicone.IsBilimit ≃ b.IsBilimit

docstring:
Given an affinely independent family of points, an affine combination (with sum of weights 1)
equals the line map of two affine combination points if and only if its weights are given pointwise
by the line map of the corresponding weights.
name: AffineIndependent.affineCombination_eq_lineMap_iff_weight_lineMap
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} {p : ι → P} (ha : AffineIndependent k p) {w : ι → k} {w₁ : ι → k} {w₂ : ι → k} {s : Finset ι} (hw : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) (hw₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₁ i = 1) (hw₂ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₂ i = 1) (c : k) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := P) ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w : P) ((AffineMap.lineMap ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₁) ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₂) : k →ᵃ[k] P) c : P) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, w i = (AffineMap.lineMap (w₁ i) (w₂ i)) c

docstring:
`extremalNumber (card V) H` is at most `x` if and only if every `H`-free simple graph `G` has
at most `x` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.extremalNumber_le_iff_of_nonneg
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [Fintype V] {R : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [FloorSemiring R] (H : SimpleGraph W) {m : R} (h : 0 ≤ m) : ↑(SimpleGraph.extremalNumber (Fintype.card V) H) ≤ m ↔ ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph V⦄ [inst_4 : DecidableRel G.Adj], H.Free G → ↑G.edgeFinset.card ≤ m

docstring: In a non-trivial integral domain, an element is regular iff it is non-zero.
name: isRegular_iff_ne_zero
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [MulZeroClass R] [IsCancelMulZero R] {a : R} [Nontrivial R] : IsRegular a ↔ a ≠ 0

docstring:
Intuitively, a fixed point operator `fix` is lawful if it satisfies `fix f = f (fix f)` for all
`f`, but this is inconsistent / uninteresting in most cases due to the existence of "exotic"
functions `f`, such as the function that is defined iff its argument is not, familiar from the
halting problem. Instead, this requirement is limited to only functions that are `Continuous` in the
sense of `ω`-complete partial orders, which excludes the example because it is not monotone
(making the input argument less defined can make `f` more defined).
name: LawfulFix
statement_text: (α : Type u_3) [OmegaCompletePartialOrder α] : Type u_3

docstring:
The **universal property** of the topology on `𝓓^{n}_{K}(E, F)`: a map to `𝓓^{n}_{K}(E, F)`
is continuous if and only if its composition with each structure map
`structureMapCLM ℝ n i : 𝓓^{n}_{K}(E, F) → (E →ᵇ (E [×i]→L[ℝ] F))` is continuous.

Since `structureMapCLM ℝ n i` is zero whenever `i > n`, it suffices to check it for `i ≤ n`,
as proven by `continuous_iff_comp_order_le`.
name: ContDiffMapSupportedIn.continuous_iff_comp
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} {X : Type u_5} [TopologicalSpace X] (φ : X → ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) : Continuous φ ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ), Continuous (Y := BoundedContinuousFunction E (E [×i]→L[ℝ] F)) (⇑(ContDiffMapSupportedIn.structureMapCLM ℝ n i) ∘ φ)

docstring:
The characteristic function of a measure is a product of
characteristic functions if and only if it is a product measure.
This is `charFunDual_eq_pi_iff` for `PiLp`.
See `charFun_eq_pi_iff` for the Hilbert space version.
name: MeasureTheory.charFunDual_eq_pi_iff'
statement_text: (p : ENNReal) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {ι : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {E : ι → Type u_5} [(i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [(i : ι) → NormedSpace ℝ (E i)] {mE : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (E i)} [∀ (i : ι), BorelSpace.{u_5} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), SecondCountableTopology.{u_5} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), CompleteSpace.{u_5} (E i)] {μ : (i : ι) → MeasureTheory.Measure (E i)} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : ι) → E i)} [∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] : (∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ (WithLp p ((i : ι) → E i))), MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace p ((i : ι) → E i)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (WithLp.toLp p) ν) L = ∏ i : ι, MeasureTheory.charFunDual (μ i) (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) (↑(ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E))) (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ E i)))) ↔ ν = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (α := E) μ

docstring: `S` is an étale `R`-algebra if and only if it is standard smooth of relative dimension `0`.
name: Algebra.Etale.iff_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_zero
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] : Algebra.Etale R S ↔ Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 R S

docstring:
If `f = g` on some neighbourhood of `x`,
then `f` is a submersion at `x` if and only if `g` is a submersion at `x`.
name: Manifold.IsSubmersionAtOfComplement.congr_iff_of_eventuallyEq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E'' : Type u_3} {F : Type u_5} {H : Type u_7} {G : Type u_9} {E : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E''] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace G] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E'' G} {M : Type u_11} {N : Type u_13} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : M → N} {g : M → N} {x : M} (hfg : f =ᶠ[nhds x] g) : Manifold.IsSubmersionAtOfComplement F I J n f x ↔ Manifold.IsSubmersionAtOfComplement F I J n g x

docstring:
A set `B` is exposed with respect to `A` iff it maximizes some functional over `A` (and contains
all points maximizing it). Written `IsExposed 𝕜 A B`.
name: IsExposed
statement_text: (𝕜 : Type u_1) {E : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace 𝕜] [Semiring 𝕜] [Preorder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [TopologicalSpace E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] (A : Set E) (B : Set E) : Prop

docstring:
Canonical form of the **equality case of Jensen's equality**.

For a strictly concave function `f` and nonnegative weights `w`, we have
`f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i)` if and only if the points `p` with nonzero
weight are all equal (and in fact all equal to their center of mass w.r.t. `w`).
name: StrictConcaveOn.map_sum_eq_iff'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] [IsStrictOrderedModule 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} {t : Finset ι} {w : ι → 𝕜} {p : ι → E} (hf : StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) (h₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (h₁ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hmem : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s) : f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i) ↔ ∀ j ∈ t, w j ≠ 0 → p j = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i

docstring: A space is locally path-connected iff all path components of open subsets are open.
name: locallyPathConnectedSpace_iff_isOpen_pathComponentIn
