statement_text: {X : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace X] : LocallyPathConnectedSpace X ↔ ∀ (x : X) (u : Set X), IsOpen u → IsOpen (pathComponentIn u x)

docstring: A submodule is finite as a module iff it is finitely generated.
name: Module.Finite.iff_fg
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {N : Submodule R M} : Module.Finite.{u_1, u_3} R ↥N ↔ N.FG

docstring:
Given a formally smooth `R`-algebra `P` and a surjective algebra homomorphism `f : P →ₐ[R] S`
with kernel `I` (typically a presentation `R[X] → S`),
`S` is formally smooth iff the `P`-linear map `I/I² → S ⊗[P] Ω[P⁄R]` is split injective.
name: Algebra.Extension.formallySmooth_iff_split_injection
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (P : Algebra.Extension.{w, u, v} R A) [Algebra.FormallySmooth.{u, w} R P.Ring] : Algebra.FormallySmooth R A ↔ ∃ l, l ∘ₗ P.cotangentComplex = LinearMap.id

docstring: A function into a compact Hausdorff space is continuous if and only if its graph is closed.
name: continuous_iff_isClosed_graph
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} [CompactSpace Y] [T2Space Y] : Continuous f ↔ IsClosed (Function.graph f)

docstring:
A map `p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → X` is called a plot iff it is part of the diffeology on
`X`. This is equivalent to `p` being smooth with respect to the standard diffeology on
`EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)`.
name: Diffeology.IsPlot
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [DiffeologicalSpace X] {n : ℕ} (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → X) : Prop

docstring: A diagonal matrix is positive semidefinite iff its diagonal entries are nonnegative.
name: Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R] [StarOrderedRing R] [DecidableEq n] {d : n → R} : (Matrix.diagonal d).PosSemidef ↔ ∀ (i : n), 0 ≤ d i

docstring: A subgraph is maximal acyclic iff its reachability relation agrees with the larger graph.
name: SimpleGraph.maximal_isAcyclic_iff_reachable_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {F : SimpleGraph V} (hle : F ≤ G) (hF : F.IsAcyclic) : Maximal (fun F => F ≤ G ∧ F.IsAcyclic) F ↔ F.Reachable = G.Reachable

docstring: `P` satisfies the equalizer condition iff its precomposition by an equivalence does.
name: CategoryTheory.regularTopology.equalizerCondition_iff_of_equivalence
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_3, u_3} E] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} Cᵒᵖ D) (e : CategoryTheory.Equivalence.{v_1, v_3, u_1, u_3} C E) : CategoryTheory.regularTopology.EqualizerCondition P ↔ CategoryTheory.regularTopology.EqualizerCondition (e.op.inverse.comp P)

docstring:
The ideal `J ⊓ I` is a sub-dp-ideal of `I` if and only if the divided powers have
some compatibility mod `J`.
name: DividedPowers.isSubDPIdeal_inf_iff
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] {I : Ideal A} (hI : DividedPowers I) {J : Ideal A} : hI.IsSubDPIdeal (J ⊓ I) ↔ ∀ {n : ℕ} {a b : A}, a ∈ I → b ∈ I → a - b ∈ J → hI.dpow n a - hI.dpow n b ∈ J

docstring:
`x` is an accumulation point of a set `C` iff every neighborhood
of `x` contains a point of `C` other than `x`.
name: accPt_iff_nhds
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} {C : Set X} : AccPt x (Filter.principal C) ↔ ∀ U ∈ nhds x, ∃ y ∈ U ∩ C, y ≠ x

docstring: `f : α →+* β` has a trivial codomain iff it has a trivial range.
name: RingHom.codomain_trivial_iff_range_trivial
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} : ∀ {x : NonAssocSemiring α} {x_1 : NonAssocSemiring β} (f : α →+* β), 0 = 1 ↔ ∀ (x_2 : α), f x_2 = 0

docstring: The oriented angle between three points is `π` if and only if the unoriented angle is `π`.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_pi_iff_angle_eq_pi
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = ↑Real.pi ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi

docstring:
If a function is meromorphic in normal form at `x`, then it has non-negative order iff it is
analytic.
name: MeromorphicNFAt.meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg_iff_analyticAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicNFAt f x) : 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt f x ↔ AnalyticAt 𝕜 f x

docstring:
Two vectors have inner product 0 if and only if the angle between
them is π/2.
name: InnerProductGeometry.inner_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (x : V) (y : V) : inner ℝ x y = 0 ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = Real.pi / 2

docstring:
An action of a topological group on a finite set is continuous if and only if it is trivial
when restricted to some open subgroup.
name: Action.isContinuous_eq_iSup
statement_text: {G : Type u_4} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] : Eq (α := CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (Action FintypeCat G)) (Action.isContinuous FintypeCat (FV := fun X Y => TypeCat.Fun X.obj Y.obj) (CV := fun X => X.obj) G) (⨆ H, Action.trivialOnSet FintypeCat ↑H)

docstring:
If `f` is a surjective uniform inducing map,
then its domain is a complete space iff its codomain is a complete space.
See also `_root_.completeSpace_congr` for a version that assumes `f` to be an equivalence.
name: IsUniformInducing.completeSpace_congr
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {f : α → β} (hf : IsUniformInducing f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) : CompleteSpace α ↔ CompleteSpace β

docstring:
Given `u : α → β` a uniform inducing map, a family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous at a point
`x₀ : X` within a subset `S : Set X` iff the family `𝓕'`, obtained by composing each function
of `𝓕` by `u`, is equicontinuous at `x₀` within `S`.
name: IsUniformInducing.equicontinuousWithinAt_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → X → α} {S : Set X} {x₀ : X} {u : α → β} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : EquicontinuousWithinAt F S x₀ ↔ EquicontinuousWithinAt.{u_1, u_3, u_8} (α := β) ((fun x => u ∘ x) ∘ F) S x₀

docstring:
`a` is in the UV-compressed family iff it's in the original and its compression is in the
original, or it's not in the original but it's the compression of something in the original.
name: UV.mem_compression
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [GeneralizedBooleanAlgebra α] [DecidableRel (α := α) Disjoint] [DecidableLE α] {s : Finset α} {u : α} {v : α} {a : α} [DecidableEq α] : a ∈ UV.compression u v s ↔ a ∈ s ∧ UV.compress u v a ∈ s ∨ a ∉ s ∧ ∃ b ∈ s, UV.compress u v b = a

docstring:
If `d : MulticospanIndex J C`, `c : Multifork d` and `F : C ⥤ D`,
the cone `F.mapCone c` is limiting iff the multifork `c.map F` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork.isLimitMapEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {J : CategoryTheory.Limits.MulticospanShape} {d : CategoryTheory.Limits.MulticospanIndex.{w, w', v_1, u_1} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Multifork d) (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (F.mapCone c) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (c.map F)

docstring:
For an adjoint quadruple `L ⊣ F ⊣ G ⊣ R` where `L` and `G` are fully faithful, all components
of the natural transformation `L ⟶ G` are epimorphisms iff all components of the natural
transformation `R ⟶ F` are monomorphisms.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple.epi_leftTriple_leftToRight_app_iff_mono_rightTriple_rightToLeft_app
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} (q : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple L F G R) [L.Full] [L.Faithful] [G.Full] [G.Faithful] : (∀ (X : C), CategoryTheory.Epi (q.leftTriple.leftToRight.app X)) ↔ ∀ (X : D), CategoryTheory.Mono (q.rightTriple.rightToLeft.app X)

docstring:
Given functions `F i, f` which are continuous on a compact set `s`, `F` tends to `f`
uniformly on `s` if and only if the restrictions (as elements of `C(s, β)`) converge.
name: ContinuousOn.tendsto_domRestrict_iff_tendstoUniformlyOn
statement_text: {α : Type u₁} {β : Type u₂} [TopologicalSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {s : Set α} [CompactSpace.{u₁} ↑s] {f : α → β} (hf : ContinuousOn f s) {ι : Type u_1} {p : Filter ι} {F : ι → α → β} (hF : ∀ (i : ι), ContinuousOn (F i) s) : Filter.Tendsto (fun i => { toFun := s.domRestrict (π := fun a => β) (F i), continuous_toFun := ⋯ }) p (nhds { toFun := s.domRestrict (π := fun a => β) f, continuous_toFun := ⋯ : ContinuousMap.{u₁, u₂} (↑s) β }) ↔ TendstoUniformlyOn F f p s

docstring:
An element is in `pinGroup Q` if and only if `star x` is in `pinGroup Q`.
See `star_mem` for only one direction.
name: pinGroup.star_mem_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {Q : QuadraticForm R M} {x : CliffordAlgebra Q} : star x ∈ pinGroup Q ↔ x ∈ pinGroup Q

docstring:
A language is regular if and only if it is defined by a DFA with finite states.

This is more general than using the definition of `Language.IsRegular` directly, as the state type
`σ` is universe-polymorphic.
name: Language.isRegular_iff
statement_text: {T : Type u} {L : Language T} : L.IsRegular ↔ ∃ σ x M, M.accepts = L

docstring: `-2` is a square in `F` iff `#F` is not congruent to `5` or `7` mod `8`.
name: FiniteField.isSquare_neg_two_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [Field F] [Fintype F] : IsSquare (-2) ↔ Fintype.card F % 8 ≠ 5 ∧ Fintype.card F % 8 ≠ 7

docstring:
If `E / F` is a field extension and `E` is separably closed, then the separable closure
of `F` in `E` is equal to `F` if and only if `F` is separably closed.
name: IsSepClosed.separableClosure_eq_bot_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [IsSepClosed E] : Eq (α := IntermediateField F E) (separableClosure F E) ⊥ ↔ IsSepClosed F

docstring:
Let `μ` be a σ-finite left invariant measure on `G`. Then `μ` is equal to the Haar measure
defined by `K₀` iff `μ K₀ = 1`.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure_eq_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [SecondCountableTopology G] (K₀ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts G) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] : MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K₀ = μ ↔ μ ↑K₀ = 1

docstring:
The indicator functions of `Asᵢ` evaluated at `x` tend to the indicator function of `A`
evaluated at `x` if and only if we eventually have the equivalence `x ∈ Asᵢ ↔ x ∈ A`.
name: tendsto_indicator_const_apply_iff_eventually
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {A : Set α} {β : Type u_2} [Zero β] [TopologicalSpace β] {ι : Type u_3} (L : Filter ι) {As : ι → Set α} [T1Space β] (b : β) [NeZero b] (x : α) : Filter.Tendsto.{u_3, u_2} (β := β) (fun i => (As i).indicator (fun x => b) x) L (nhds (A.indicator (fun x => b) x)) ↔ ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in L, x ∈ As i ↔ x ∈ A

docstring:
A correspondence `f : α → Set β` is upper hemicontinuous if and only if its *upper inverse*
(i.e., `u : Set β ↦ f ⁻¹' (Iic u)`, note that `f ⁻¹' (Iic u) = {x | f x ⊆ u}`) sends open sets
to open sets.
name: upperHemicontinuous_iff_isOpen_preimage_Iic
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] {f : α → Set β} [TopologicalSpace β] : UpperHemicontinuous f ↔ ∀ (u : Set β), IsOpen u → IsOpen (f ⁻¹' Set.Iic u)

docstring:
If `I : Ideal S` has a finite basis over `R`,
`x ∈ I` iff it is a linear combination of basis vectors.
name: Basis.mem_ideal_iff'

docstring:
Two nonempty compact spaces have the same image in `GHSpace` if and only if they are
isometric.

docstring:
An `R`-algebra `A` is smooth at a prime `p` of `A` if `Aₚ` is formally smooth over `R`.

This does not imply `Aₚ` is smooth over `R` under the mathlib definition
even if `A` is finitely presented,
but it can be shown that this is equivalent to the stacks project definition that `A` is smooth
at `p` if and only if there exists `f ∉ p` such that `A_f` is smooth over `R`.
See `Algebra.basicOpen_subset_smoothLocus_iff_smooth` and `Algebra.isOpen_smoothLocus`.
name: Algebra.IsSmoothAt
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] : Prop

docstring:
Two continuous maps from a preconnected space to the total space of a covering map
are homotopic relative to a set `S` if and only if their compositions with the covering map
are homotopic relative to `S`, assuming that they agree at a point in `S`.
name: IsCoveringMap.homotopicRel_iff_comp
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace A] {p : E → X} (cov : IsCoveringMap p) [PreconnectedSpace A] {f₀ : C(A, E)} {f₁ : C(A, E)} {S : Set A} (he : ∃ a ∈ S, Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := E) (f₀ a : E) (f₁ a : E)) : f₀.HomotopicRel f₁ S ↔ ({ toFun := p, continuous_toFun := ⋯ : C(E, X) }.comp f₀).HomotopicRel ({ toFun := p, continuous_toFun := ⋯ : C(E, X) }.comp f₁) S

docstring: The order of an analytic function `f` at `z₀` is zero iff `f` does not vanish at `z₀`.
name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_ne_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) : analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≠ 0 ↔ f z₀ = 0

docstring:
A point `p` is equidistant to two different lines `p₁ p₂` and `p₁ p₃` if and only if the
oriented angles at `p₁` are equal modulo `π`.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_orthogonalProjection_line_eq_iff_two_zsmul_oangle_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p : P} {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} (ha : AffineIndependent ℝ ![p₁, p₂, p₃]) : dist p ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection line[ℝ, p₁, p₂]) p) = dist p ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection line[ℝ, p₁, p₃]) p) ↔ 2 • EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₂ p₁ p = 2 • EuclideanGeometry.oangle p p₁ p₃

docstring: `2` is a square in `F` iff `#F` is not congruent to `3` or `5` mod `8`.
name: FiniteField.isSquare_two_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [Field F] [Fintype F] : IsSquare 2 ↔ Fintype.card F % 8 ≠ 3 ∧ Fintype.card F % 8 ≠ 5

A group is finitely generated iff there exists a surjective homomorphism from a `FreeGroup`

docstring:
If `G` is a compact, topological group that acts continuously and naturally on the
fibers of `F`, `toAut F G` is surjective if and only if it acts transitively on the fibers
of all Galois objects. This is the `if` direction. For the `only if` see
`isPretransitive_of_surjective`.

statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u₂, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u₂, w, u₁, w + 1} C FintypeCat) (G : Type u_1) [Group G] [(X : C) → MulAction.{u_1, w} G (F.obj X).obj] [CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsNaturalSMul F G] [CategoryTheory.GaloisCategory.{u₁, u₂} C] [CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.FiberFunctor F] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [∀ (X : C), ContinuousSMul.{u_1, w} G (F.obj X).obj] (h : ∀ (X : C) [CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois.{u₁, u₂} X], MulAction.IsPretransitive.{u_1, w} G (F.obj X).obj) : Function.Surjective (α := G) (β := CategoryTheory.Aut F) ⇑(CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.toAut F G)

docstring: A module has dimension 1 iff there is some `v : V` so `{v}` is a basis.
name: finrank_eq_one_iff

docstring:
The "standard" skeleton for `FintypeCat`. This is the full subcategory of `FintypeCat`
spanned by objects of the form `ULift (Fin n)` for `n : ℕ`. We parameterize the objects
of `FintypeCat.Skeleton` directly as `ULift ℕ`, as the type `ULift (Fin m) ≃ ULift (Fin n)`
is nonempty if and only if `n = m`. Specifying universes, `Skeleton : Type u` is a small
skeletal category equivalent to `FintypeCat.{u}`.
name: FintypeCat.Skeleton
statement_text: : Type u

docstring:
A set `A` in a compactly coherent space is open iff for every compact set `K`, the intersection
`K ∩ A` is open in `K`.

statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactlyCoherentSpace X] {A : Set X} : IsOpen A ↔ ∀ (K : Set X), IsCompact K → IsOpen (X := ↑K) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ K) ⁻¹' A)

docstring: In an additive cyclic group, `H ≤ K` iff `K.index ∣ H.index`.

docstring:
Proposition I.2.3 + I.2.6 of [iversen]
A finite-type `R`-algebra `S` is (formally) unramified iff there exists a `t : S ⊗[R] S` satisfying
1. `t` annihilates every `1 ⊗ s - s ⊗ 1`.
2. the image of `t` is `1` under the map `S ⊗[R] S → S`.
name: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.iff_exists_tensorProduct
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.EssFiniteType R S] : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S ↔ ∃ t, (∀ (s : S), HSub.hSub (α := TensorProduct R S S) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] s) (s ⊗ₜ[R] 1) * t = 0) ∧ (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R) t = 1

docstring:
A linear map between two Lie modules is a morphism of Lie modules iff the Lie algebra action
on it is trivial.
name: LieModule.maxTrivLinearMapEquivLieModuleHom
statement_text: {R : Type u} {L : Type v} {M : Type w} {N : Type w₁} [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N] : ↥(LieModule.maxTrivSubmodule R L (M →ₗ[R] N)) ≃ₗ[R] M →ₗ⁅R,L⁆ N

docstring:

associates of `b`.

docstring:
Given a category `C` equipped with a Grothendieck topology `J` and a concrete category `A`,

sheafification) iff it is both locally injective and locally surjective.

docstring:
Given two coforks with isomorphic components in such a way that the natural diagrams commute, then
one is a colimit if and only if the other one is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.isColimitEquivOfIsos
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} {X' : C} {Y' : C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork f g) {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ Y'} (c' : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork f' g') (e₀ : X ≅ X') (e₁ : Y ≅ Y') (e : c.pt ≅ c'.pt) (comm₁ : autoParam (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e₀.hom f' = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f e₁.hom) CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.isColimitEquivOfIsos._auto_1) (comm₂ : autoParam (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e₀.hom g' = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g e₁.hom) CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.isColimitEquivOfIsos._auto_3) (comm₃ : autoParam (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e₁.inv (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c.π e.hom) = c'.π) CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.isColimitEquivOfIsos._auto_5) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c'

docstring:
`x` is in a monomial ideal generated by variables `X` iff every element of its support
has a component in `s`.

docstring:
In an affine open set `U`, a family of basic open covers `U` iff the sections span `Γ(X, U)`.

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff

docstring:

statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{u_2, u_1} C] {Φ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Preradical.{u_2, u_1} C} {Ψ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Preradical.{u_2, u_1} C} : CategoryTheory.IsIso (Y := Φ.colon Ψ) (Φ.toColon Ψ) ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (Φ.quotient.comp Ψ.r)

docstring:

(2) we can pair values `a` from `x` and `b` from `y` so that `r a b` holds.

statement_text: {F : Type u → Type v} [Functor F] {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) (x : F α) (y : F α) : Prop

docstring:
For an invertible matrix `U`, `star U * x * U` is positive definite iff `x` is.
This works on any ⋆-ring with a partial order.

See `IsUnit.isStrictlyPositive_star_left_conjugate_iff'` for a similar statement for star-ordered
rings. For matrices, positive definiteness is equivalent to strict positivity when the underlying
field is `ℝ` or `ℂ` (see `Matrix.isStrictlyPositive_iff_posDef`).
name: Matrix.IsUnit.posDef_star_left_conjugate_iff
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {x : Matrix n n R} {U : Matrix n n R} (hU : IsUnit U) : (star U * x * U).PosDef ↔ x.PosDef

docstring: A family of continuous linear maps is `C^n` on `s` if and only if all its applications are.
name: contDiffOn_clm_apply

name: ZMod.dft_even_iff
statement_text: {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {Φ : ZMod N → ℂ} : Function.Even (α := ZMod N) (β := ℂ) (ZMod.dft Φ) ↔ Function.Even Φ

docstring:
In a `T₁` space, a set is countably compact if and only if every infinite subset has an
accumulation point in the set.
name: isCountablyCompact_iff_infinite_subset_has_accPt

A continuous function `f` has bounded range if and only if it is `O(1)` with respect to the
cocompact filter.

docstring:
For a concrete category `(A, s)` where the forgetful functor `s : A ⥤ Type v` preserves limits and
reflects isomorphisms, and `A` has limits, an `A`-valued presheaf `P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A` is a sheaf iff its
underlying `Type`-valued presheaf `P ⋙ s : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type` is a sheaf.

Note this lemma applies for "algebraic" categories, e.g. groups, abelian groups and rings, but not
for the category of topological spaces, topological rings, etc. since reflecting isomorphisms does
not hold.
name: CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {A' : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{max v₁ u₁, u₂} A'] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v₁, u₁} C) (P' : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ A') (s : CategoryTheory.Functor A' (Type (max v₁ u₁))) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimits A'] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimits s] [s.ReflectsIsomorphisms] : CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf J P' ↔ CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf J (P'.comp s)

docstring:
For congruence relations `c, d` on a type `M` with a multiplication, `c ≤ d` iff `∀ x y ∈ M`,
`x` is related to `y` by `d` if `x` is related to `y` by `c`.
name: Con.instLE
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Mul M] : LE (Con M)

docstring:
**The optional stopping theorem** (fair game theorem): a strongly adapted integrable process `f`
is a submartingale if and only if for all bounded stopping times `τ` and `π` such that `τ ≤ π`, the
stopped value of `f` at `τ` has expectation smaller than its stopped value at `π`.
name: MeasureTheory.submartingale_iff_expected_stoppedValue_mono
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {𝒢 : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.SigmaFiniteFiltration μ 𝒢] (hadp : MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted (β := fun i => ℝ) 𝒢 f) (hint : ∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (f i) μ) : MeasureTheory.Submartingale f 𝒢 μ ↔ ∀ (τ π : Ω → WithTop ℕ), MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime 𝒢 τ → MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime 𝒢 π → τ ≤ π → (∃ N, ∀ (x : Ω), π x ≤ ↑N) → LE.le (α := ℝ) (∫ (x : Ω), MeasureTheory.stoppedValue f τ x ∂μ) (∫ (x : Ω), MeasureTheory.stoppedValue f π x ∂μ)

docstring:

name: EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_pi_iff_sbtw

docstring:

name: CategoryTheory.Limits.PushoutCocone.isColimitEquivIsLimitUnop
