docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(-∞, a]` if and only if it contains an interval
`(u, a]` with `u' < u < a`, provided `a` is not a top element.
name: mem_nhdsLE_iff_exists_Ioc_subset'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] {a : α} {u' : α} {s : Set α} (hu' : u' < a) : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Iic a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Iio a, Set.Ioc u a ⊆ s

docstring:
A Dirichlet character `χ` factors through `d | n` iff its associated unit-group hom is trivial
on the kernel of `ZMod.unitsMap`.
name: DirichletCharacter.factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero R] {n : ℕ} {χ : DirichletCharacter R n} {d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hd : d ∣ n) : χ.FactorsThrough d ↔ (ZMod.unitsMap hd).ker ≤ (MulChar.toUnitHom χ).ker

docstring: A family of units is of maximal rank iff the index of the subgroup it generates has finite index.
name: NumberField.Units.isMaxRank_iff_closure_finiteIndex
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [NumberField K] {u : Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ} : NumberField.Units.IsMaxRank u ↔ Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.closure (Set.range u))

docstring:
If we have an adjunction `adj : F ⊣ G` of functors between preadditive categories,
and if `F` is additive, then the hom set equivalence upgrades to an isomorphism between
`G ⋙ preadditiveYoneda` and `preadditiveYoneda ⋙ F`, once we throw in the necessary
universe lifting functors.
Note that `F` is additive if and only if `G` is, by `Adjunction.right_adjoint_additive` and
`Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive`.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.compPreadditiveYonedaIso
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v₂, u₂} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} (adj : F ⊣ G) [F.Additive] : G.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp CategoryTheory.preadditiveYoneda (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskeringRight Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat AddCommGrpCat) AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor)) ≅ CategoryTheory.Functor.comp CategoryTheory.preadditiveYoneda (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskeringLeft Cᵒᵖ Dᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat) F.op) (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskeringRight Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat AddCommGrpCat) AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor))

docstring: The power of a point is nonpositive if and only if the point lies inside or on the sphere.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.power_nonpos_iff_dist_center_le_radius
statement_text: {P : Type u_2} [MetricSpace P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p : P} (hr : 0 ≤ s.radius) : s.power p ≤ 0 ↔ dist p s.center ≤ s.radius

docstring:
An algebra over a Noetherian ring is finitely generated if and only if it is finitely
presented.
name: Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType
statement_text: {R : Type w₁} {A : Type w₂} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsNoetherianRing R] : Algebra.FiniteType R A ↔ Algebra.FinitePresentation R A

docstring:
A function between topological spaces is a quotient map if it is surjective,
and for all `s : Set Y`, `s` is open iff its preimage is an open set.
name: Topology.IsQuotientMap
statement_text: {X : Type u_3} {Y : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) : Prop

docstring: In a cyclic group, `H ≤ K` iff `K.index ∣ H.index`.
name: IsCyclic.subgroup_le_iff_index_dvd
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [IsCyclic G] {H : Subgroup G} {K : Subgroup G} : H ≤ K ↔ K.index ∣ H.index

docstring:
A finite number of random variables are independent if and only if their joint characteristic
function is equal to the product of the characteristic functions. This is the version for Banach
spaces, see `iIndepFun_iff_charFun_pi` for the Hilbert space version.
name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_iff_charFunDual_pi
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {E : ι → Type u_3} {mE : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (E i)} [(i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), CompleteSpace.{u_3} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), BorelSpace.{u_3} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), SecondCountableTopology.{u_3} (E i)] {X : (i : ι) → Ω → E i} [(i : ι) → NormedSpace ℝ (E i)] [DecidableEq ι] (hX : ∀ (i : ι), AEMeasurable (X i) P) : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (β := E) X P ↔ ∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ ((x : ι) → E x)), MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := MeasurableSpace.pi (X := E)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω x => X x ω) P) L = ∏ i : ι, MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := mE i) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) P) (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ E i))

docstring:
If the signs of two oriented angles between nonzero vectors are negations of each other, the
oriented angles are negations of each other if and only if the unoriented angles are equal.
name: Orientation.angle_eq_iff_oangle_eq_neg_of_sign_eq_neg
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {w : V} {x : V} {y : V} {z : V} (hw : w ≠ 0) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hs : (o.oangle w x).sign = -(o.oangle y z).sign) : InnerProductGeometry.angle w x = InnerProductGeometry.angle y z ↔ o.oangle w x = -o.oangle y z

docstring:
If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` fixes `h • x` iff `g` fixes `x`.
This is equivalent to say that the set `fixedBy α g` is fixed by `h`.
name: MulAction.fixedBy_mem_fixedBy_of_commute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : Commute g h) : Membership.mem (γ := Set (Set α)) (MulAction.fixedBy (Set α) h) (MulAction.fixedBy α g)

docstring: Three points are collinear if and only if they are not affinely independent.
name: collinear_iff_not_affineIndependent_set
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : Collinear k (P := P) {p₁, p₂, p₃} ↔ ¬AffineIndependent k ![p₁, p₂, p₃]

docstring:
Two elements `a` and `b` are add-regular if and only if both sums `a + b` and
`b + a` are add-regular.
name: isAddRegular_add_and_add_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [AddSemigroup R] {a : R} {b : R} : IsAddRegular (a + b) ∧ IsAddRegular (b + a) ↔ IsAddRegular a ∧ IsAddRegular b

docstring:
When `α` is complete, a set is closed in the relative lower topology if and only if it is of the
form `hull T a` for some `a` in `α`.
name: PrimitiveSpectrum.isClosed_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [CompleteLattice α] {T : Set α} [TopologicalSpace α] [Topology.IsLower α] (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, InfPrime p) {S : Set ↑T} : IsClosed S ↔ ∃ a, S = PrimitiveSpectrum.hull T a

docstring:
A function `f` is summable in a uniform additive group `α` if and only if the net of its partial
sums is Cauchy and its sum in `Completion α` lies in the range of `toCompl : α →+ Completion α`.
name: summable_iff_cauchySeq_finset_and_tsum_mem
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup α] [UniformSpace α] [IsUniformAddGroup α] (f : β → α) : Summable f ↔ (CauchySeq.{u_1, u_2} (α := α) fun (s : Finset β) => ∑ b ∈ s, f b) ∧ Membership.mem (γ := Set (UniformSpace.Completion α)) (Set.range (ι := α) ⇑UniformSpace.Completion.toCompl) (∑' (i : β), UniformSpace.Completion.toCompl (f i))

docstring:
The oriented angle between two vectors is `π` if and only if the angle with the vectors
swapped is `π`.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_pi_iff_oangle_rev_eq_pi
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y = ↑Real.pi ↔ o.oangle y x = ↑Real.pi

docstring:
The map `(f : M →ₗ[R] M')` is a localization of modules iff the map
`(Localization S) × M → N, (s, m) ↦ s • f m` is the tensor product (insomuch as it is the universal
bilinear map).
In particular, there is an isomorphism between `LocalizedModule S M` and `(Localization S) ⊗[R] M`
given by `m/s ↦ (1/s) ⊗ₜ m`.
name: isLocalizedModule_iff_isBaseChange
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (S : Submonoid R) (A : Type u_2) [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization S A] {M : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {M' : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M'] [_root_.Module R M'] [_root_.Module A M'] [IsScalarTower R A M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') : IsLocalizedModule S f ↔ IsBaseChange A f

docstring: A set is sequentially closed iff it is equal to its sequential closure.
name: isSeqClosed_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsSeqClosed s ↔ seqClosure s = s

docstring:
Let `μ` be a σ-finite left invariant measure on `E`. Then `μ` is equal to the Haar measure
defined by `b` iff the parallelepiped defined by `b` has measure `1` for `μ`.
name: Module.Basis.addHaar_eq_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3} [Fintype ι] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] (b : Module.Basis ι ℝ E) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] [μ.IsAddLeftInvariant] : b.addHaar = μ ↔ μ ↑b.parallelepiped = 1

docstring:
If `E` is an algebraic closure of `F`, then `F` is separably closed if and only if `E / F` is
purely inseparable.
name: isSepClosed_iff_isPurelyInseparable_algebraicClosure
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [IsAlgClosure F E] : IsSepClosed F ↔ IsPurelyInseparable F E

docstring:
If an analytic function `f` vanishes at `z₀`, then the analytic order of its derivative
at `z₀` is at least `n` if and only if the analytic order of `f` at `z₀` is at least `n + 1`.
name: analyticOrderAt_deriv_ge_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CharZero 𝕜] [CompleteSpace E] {z₀ : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) (hzero : f z₀ = 0) {n : ℕ} : ↑n ≤ analyticOrderAt (deriv f) z₀ ↔ ↑n + 1 ≤ analyticOrderAt f z₀

docstring: Similarity holds if and only if all non-negative distances are proportional.
name: similar_iff_exists_nndist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (i₁ i₂ : ι), nndist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = r * nndist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `M ⊗ -` is an exact functor. See
`Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_exact` to specialize the universe of `N, N', N''` to `Type (max u v)`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_exact'
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Small.{v', u} R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' N'' : Type v'⦄ [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_6 : AddCommGroup N''] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_8 : _root_.Module R N'] [inst_9 : _root_.Module R N''] ⦃f : N →ₗ[R] N'⦄ ⦃g : N' →ₗ[R] N''⦄, Function.Exact (M := N) (N := N') (P := N'') ⇑f ⇑g → Function.Exact (M := TensorProduct R M N) (N := TensorProduct R M N') (P := TensorProduct R M N'') ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M f) ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor M g)

docstring:
The order of an analytic function `f` at `z₀` equals a natural number `n` iff `f` can locally
be written as `f z = (z - z₀) ^ n • g z`, where `g` is analytic and does not vanish at `z₀`.
name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderNatAt_eq_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) (hf' : analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≠ ⊤) {n : ℕ} : analyticOrderNatAt f z₀ = n ↔ ∃ g, AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z₀ ∧ g z₀ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ (z : 𝕜) in nhds z₀, f z = (z - z₀) ^ n • g z

docstring:
The order of a meromorphic function `f` at `z₀` is finite iff `f` does not have
any zeros in a sufficiently small neighborhood of `z₀`.
name: meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : meromorphicOrderAt f x ≠ ⊤ ↔ ∀ᶠ (x : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, f x ≠ 0

docstring: If `c` is invertible, `c • f` is differentiable at `x` if and only if `f` is.
name: differentiableAt_smul_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F} {x : E} {R : Type u_4} [Monoid R] [DistribMulAction R F] [SMulCommClass 𝕜 R F] [ContinuousConstSMul R F] (c : R) [Invertible c] : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (c • f) x ↔ DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x

docstring: A cone is a limit cone iff its extension by an isomorphism is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.extendIsoEquiv
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {C : Type u₃} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} J C} {s : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F} {X : C} (i : X ⟶ s.pt) [CategoryTheory.IsIso i] : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit s ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (s.extend i)

docstring:
An equivalent definition for prime powers: `n` is a prime power iff there is a unique prime
dividing it.
name: isPrimePow_iff_unique_prime_dvd
statement_text: {n : ℕ} : IsPrimePow n ↔ ∃! p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n

docstring:
`(ZMod n)ˣ` is cyclic iff `n` is of the form
`0`, `1`, `2`, `4`, `p ^ m`, or `2 * p ^ m`,
where `p` is an odd prime and `1 ≤ m`.
name: ZMod.isCyclic_units_iff
statement_text: (n : ℕ) : IsCyclic (ZMod n)ˣ ↔ n = 0 ∨ n = 1 ∨ n = 2 ∨ n = 4 ∨ ∃ p m, Nat.Prime p ∧ Odd p ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧ (n = p ^ m ∨ n = 2 * p ^ m)

docstring:
If `φ` is mono, it is a normal additive group homomorphism if and only if for all
`X` the image of `H(X)` in `G(X)` is a normal additive subgroup.
name: CategoryTheory.IsAddMonHom.normal_iff_normal_addMonoidHom
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v_1, u_1} C] {G : C} {H : C} [CategoryTheory.AddGrpObj G] [CategoryTheory.AddGrpObj H] {φ : H ⟶ G} [CategoryTheory.IsAddMonHom φ] [CategoryTheory.Mono φ] : CategoryTheory.IsAddMonHom.Normal φ ↔ ∀ (X : C), AddSubgroup.Normal.{v_1} (A := X ⟶ G) (AddMonoidHom.range (G := X ⟶ H) (CategoryTheory.IsAddMonHom.addMonoidHom φ X))

docstring:
The product (in the sense of `AddMonoidHom.prodMap`) of
additive group homomorphisms is strict if and only if both homomorphisms are strict.
name: AddMonoidHom.isStrictMap_prodMap_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {G' : Type u_3} {H' : Type u_4} [AddGroup G'] [AddGroup H'] [AddGroup G] [AddGroup H] {f : G →+ H} {g : G' →+ H'} [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G'] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G'] [TopologicalSpace H'] : Topology.IsStrictMap (X := G × G') (Y := H × H') ⇑(f.prodMap g) ↔ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_1, u_2} (X := G) (Y := H) ⇑f ∧ Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_3, u_4} (X := G') (Y := H') ⇑g

docstring: `m` is `s`-factored if and only if all prime divisors of `m` are in `s`.
name: Nat.mem_factoredNumbers'
statement_text: {s : Finset ℕ} {m : ℕ} : m ∈ Nat.factoredNumbers s ↔ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p ∈ s

docstring: A map is open if and only if the `Set.kernImage` of every *closed* set is closed.
name: isOpenMap_iff_closure_kernImage
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {f : X → Y} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] : IsOpenMap f ↔ ∀ {s : Set X}, closure (Set.kernImage f s) ⊆ Set.kernImage f (closure s)

docstring:
Shifting a configuration commutes with occurrences of a pattern.

Formally: a pattern `p` occurs in the shifted configuration `mulShift h x` at
position `g` if and only if it occurs in the original configuration `x` at
position `g * h`.
name: SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.Pattern.mulOccursInAt_mulShift
statement_text: {A : Type u_3} {G : Type u_4} [Inhabited A] [Monoid G] (p : SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.Pattern A G) (x : G → A) (g : G) (h : G) : p.mulOccursInAt (SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.mulShift g x) h ↔ p.mulOccursInAt x (g * h)

docstring: The class number of a number field is `1` iff the ring of integers is a PID.
name: NumberField.classNumber_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [NumberField K] : NumberField.classNumber K = 1 ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing.{u_1} (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)

docstring:
Random variables are independent iff their joint distribution is the product measure. This
is a version where the random variable `ω ↦ (Xᵢ(ω))ᵢ` is almost everywhere measurable.
See `iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_infinitePi_map₀'` for a version which only assumes that
each `Xᵢ` is almost everywhere measurable and that `ι` is countable.
name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_infinitePi_map₀
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {𝓧 : ι → Type u_3} {m𝓧 : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (𝓧 i)} {X : (i : ι) → Ω → 𝓧 i} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (mX : AEMeasurable (β := (i : ι) → 𝓧 i) (fun ω i => X i ω) P) : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (β := 𝓧) X P ↔ Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : ι) → 𝓧 i)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω i => X i ω) P) (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi (X := 𝓧) fun i => MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) P)

docstring: A constant map to a T₁ space is proper if and only if its domain is compact.
name: isProperMap_const_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T1Space Y] (y : Y) : (IsProperMap.{u_1, u_2} (Y := Y) fun (x : X) => y) ↔ CompactSpace X

docstring:
The rays given by two nonzero vectors are equal if and only if those vectors
satisfy `SameRay`.
name: ray_eq_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {v₁ : M} {v₂ : M} (hv₁ : v₁ ≠ 0) (hv₂ : v₂ ≠ 0) : Eq (α := Module.Ray R M) (rayOfNeZero R v₁ hv₁) (rayOfNeZero R v₂ hv₂) ↔ SameRay R v₁ v₂

docstring:
Two elements `a` and `b` are regular if and only if both products `a * b` and `b * a`
are regular.
name: isRegular_mul_and_mul_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semigroup R] {a : R} {b : R} : IsRegular (a * b) ∧ IsRegular (b * a) ↔ IsRegular a ∧ IsRegular b

docstring:
An integral domain is a Dedekind domain iff and only if it is
Noetherian, has dimension ≤ 1, and is integrally closed in a given fraction field.
In particular, this definition does not depend on the choice of this fraction field.
name: isDedekindDomain_iff
statement_text: (A : Type u_2) [CommRing A] (K : Type u_4) [CommRing K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] : IsDedekindDomain A ↔ IsDomain A ∧ IsNoetherianRing A ∧ Ring.DimensionLEOne A ∧ ∀ {x : K}, IsIntegral A x → ∃ y, (algebraMap A K) y = x

docstring:
Two random variables are conditionally independent iff they satisfy the almost sure equality
of conditional expectations `μ⟦f ⁻¹' s ∩ g ⁻¹' t | m'⟧ =ᵐ[μ] μ⟦f ⁻¹' s | m'⟧ * μ⟦g ⁻¹' t | m'⟧`
for all measurable sets `s` and `t` (see `condIndepFun_iff_condExp_inter_preimage_eq_mul`).
Here, this is phrased with Markov kernels associated to the conditional expectations, and the
almost sure equality is expressed as equality of the composition-product with the measure, which is
equivalent to a.e. equality. See `condIndepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map` for the a.e. equality
version with kernels.

For a random variable `f`, `(condExpKernel μ m').map f` is the law of the conditional expectation
of `f` given `m'`: almost surely, `(condExpKernel μ m').map f ω s = μ⟦f ⁻¹' s | m'⟧ ω`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.condIndepFun_iff_compProd_map_prod_eq_compProd_prod_map_map
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {β' : Type u_4} {m' : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [StandardBorelSpace Ω] {hm' : m' ≤ mΩ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Ω → β} {g : Ω → β'} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mβ' : MeasurableSpace β'} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) : ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun m' hm' f g μ ↔ Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure (Ω × β × β')) ((μ.trim hm').compProd ((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map fun ω => (f ω, g ω))) ((μ.trim hm').compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prod ((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map f) ((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map g)))

docstring:
Rotating a vector by the angle to another vector gives the second vector if and only if the
norms are equal.
name: Orientation.rotation_oangle_eq_iff_norm_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) (x : V) (y : V) : (o.rotation (o.oangle x y)) x = y ↔ ‖x‖ = ‖y‖

docstring: A map between normed spaces is linear and continuous if and only if it is bounded.
name: IsBoundedLinearMap.isLinearMap_and_continuous_iff_isBoundedLinearMap
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type u_3} [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (f : E → F) : IsLinearMap 𝕜 f ∧ Continuous f ↔ IsBoundedLinearMap 𝕜 f

docstring: A group of order `p ^ 2` is not cyclic if and only if its exponent is `p`.
name: not_isCyclic_iff_exponent_eq_prime
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Group α] {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hα : Nat.card α = p ^ 2) : ¬IsCyclic α ↔ Monoid.exponent α = p

docstring: An operator `T` is normal iff `‖T v‖ = ‖(adjoint T) v‖` for all `v`.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isStarNormal_iff_norm_eq_adjoint
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {T : E →L[𝕜] E} [CompleteSpace E] : IsStarNormal T ↔ ∀ (v : E), norm (E := E) (T v : E) = norm (E := E) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T : E →L[𝕜] E) v : E)

docstring:
A matrix is doubly stochastic if and only if it is both row and
column stochastic.
name: doublyStochastic_eq_rowStochastic_inf_colStochastic
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] : Eq (α := Submonoid (Matrix n n R)) (doublyStochastic R n) (Matrix.rowStochastic R n ⊓ Matrix.colStochastic R n)

docstring:
A correspondence `f : α → Set β` is lower hemicontinuous if and only if its *upper inverse*
(i.e., `u : Set β ↦ f ⁻¹' (Iic u)`, note that `f ⁻¹' (Iic u) = {x | f x ⊆ u}`) sends closed sets
to closed sets.
name: lowerHemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_preimage_Iic
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] {f : α → Set β} [TopologicalSpace β] : LowerHemicontinuous f ↔ ∀ (u : Set β), IsClosed u → IsClosed (f ⁻¹' Set.Iic u)

docstring:
If `P` is monotone w.r.t. restricting `domChart` and closed under congruence,
and `f` and `g` are eventually equal near `x`,
then `f` has property `P` at `x` if and only if `g` has property `P` at `x`.
name: Manifold.LiftSourceTargetPropertyAt.congr_iff_of_eventuallyEq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_4} {H : Type u_6} {G : Type u_8} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace G] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 F G} {M : Type u_10} {N : Type u_12} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : M → N} {g : M → N} {x : M} {P : (M → N) → OpenPartialHomeomorph M H → OpenPartialHomeomorph N G → Prop} (hP : Manifold.IsLocalSourceTargetProperty P) (h' : f =ᶠ[nhds x] g) : Manifold.LiftSourceTargetPropertyAt I J n f x P ↔ Manifold.LiftSourceTargetPropertyAt I J n g x P

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise scalar multiplication of `f` and
`g`, which monovary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f ∘ σ` and `g` monovary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: Monovary.sum_comp_perm_smul_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [AddCommMonoid β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module α β] [PosSMulStrictMono α β] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → β} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Monovary f g) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := β) (∑ i : ι, f (σ i) • g i) (∑ i : ι, f i • g i) ↔ Monovary (f ∘ ⇑σ) g

docstring: A linear map `T` is zero, if and only if the identity `⟪T x, x⟫_ℂ = 0` holds for all `x`.
name: inner_map_self_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ V] (T : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) : (∀ (x : V), inner ℂ (T x) x = 0) ↔ T = 0

docstring:
**Equality case of the Rearrangement Inequality**: Pointwise multiplication of `f` and `g`,
which antivary together, is unchanged by a permutation if and only if `f` and `g ∘ σ` antivary
together. Stated by permuting the entries of `g`.
name: Antivary.sum_mul_eq_sum_mul_comp_perm_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {σ : Equiv.Perm ι} {f : ι → α} {g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := α) (∑ i : ι, f i * g (σ i)) (∑ i : ι, f i * g i) ↔ Antivary f (g ∘ ⇑σ)

docstring: A set is ample iff its image under a continuous affine equivalence is.
name: AmpleSet.image_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module ℝ F] [TopologicalSpace F] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E] {s : Set E} (L : E ≃ᴬ[ℝ] F) : AmpleSet.{u_1} (F := F) (⇑L '' s) ↔ AmpleSet s

docstring:
An action of an additive monoid `M` on `α` that is continuous in the second
argument is topologically transitive if and only if any nonempty open subset `U` of `α` with
`(m +ᵥ ·) ⁻¹' U ⊆ U` for all `m : M` is dense in `α`.
name: AddAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_of_preimage_invariant
statement_text: (M : Type u_1) {α : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] [AddMonoid M] [AddAction M α] [ContinuousConstVAdd M α] : AddAction.IsTopologicallyTransitive M α ↔ ∀ {U : Set α}, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → (∀ (m : M), (fun x => m +ᵥ x) ⁻¹' U ⊆ U) → Dense U

docstring: A graph's complement is `n`-independent set free iff it is `n`-clique free.
name: SimpleGraph.indepSetFree_compl
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph α) {n : ℕ} : Gᶜ.IndepSetFree n ↔ G.CliqueFree n

docstring: The element `0` is `M`-regular if and only if `M` is trivial.
name: IsSMulRegular.zero_iff_subsingleton
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [MonoidWithZero R] [Zero M] [MulActionWithZero R M] : IsSMulRegular M 0 ↔ Subsingleton M

docstring:
Let `R` be a domain of characteristic 0, finite rank over `ℤ`, `S` be a Dedekind domain
that is a finite `R`-algebra. Let `p` be a prime of `S`, then `p` is unramified iff `e(p) = 1`.
name: Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {p : Ideal S} [p.IsPrime] [Algebra.EssFiniteType R S] [IsDomain R] [Module.Finite ℤ R] [CharZero R] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R p ↔ p.ramificationIdx R = 1

docstring:
Given `u : α → β` a uniform inducing map, a family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous iff the
family `𝓕'`, obtained by composing each function of `𝓕` by `u`, is equicontinuous.
name: IsUniformInducing.equicontinuous_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_8} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → X → α} {u : α → β} (hu : IsUniformInducing u) : Equicontinuous F ↔ Equicontinuous.{u_1, u_3, u_8} (X := X) (α := β) ((fun x => u ∘ x) ∘ F)

docstring:
A real differentiable map `f` is conformal at point `x` if and only if its
differential `fderiv ℝ f x` at that point scales every inner product by a positive scalar.
name: conformalAt_iff'
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {x : E} : ConformalAt f x ↔ ∃ c, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (u v : E), inner.{0, u_2} ℝ (E := F) ((fderiv ℝ f x) u : F) ((fderiv ℝ f x) v : F) = c * inner ℝ u v

docstring:
Given an affinely independent family of points, an affine combination lies in the
span of two points given as affine combinations if and only if it is an affine combination
with weights those of one point plus a multiple of the difference between the weights of the
two points.
name: affineCombination_mem_affineSpan_pair
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} {p : ι → P} (h : AffineIndependent k p) {w : ι → k} {w₁ : ι → k} {w₂ : ι → k} {s : Finset ι} : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → ∑ i ∈ s, w₁ i = 1 → ∑ i ∈ s, w₂ i = 1 → (Membership.mem (α := P) (γ := AffineSubspace k P) line[k, ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₁ : P), ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₂ : P)] ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w : P) ↔ ∃ r, ∀ i ∈ s, w i = r * (w₂ i - w₁ i) + w₁ i)

docstring:
For every universe `w`, `C` is filtered if and only if every finite diagram in `C` with shape
in `w` admits a cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.IsCofiltered.iff_cone_nonempty
statement_text: (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.IsCofiltered.{v, u} C ↔ ∀ {J : Type w} [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.SmallCategory J] [CategoryTheory.FinCategory J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{w, v, w, u} J C), Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F)

docstring: The order of a function `f` at a `z₀` is infinity iff `f` vanishes locally around `z₀`.
name: analyticOrderAt_eq_top
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜} : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = ⊤ ↔ ∀ᶠ (z : 𝕜) in nhds z₀, f z = 0

docstring: The cosine of the angle between two vectors is 0 if and only if the angle is π / 2.
name: InnerProductGeometry.cos_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : Real.cos (InnerProductGeometry.angle x y) = 0 ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = Real.pi / 2

docstring:
A subgroup has index two if and only if there exists `a` such that for all `b`, exactly one
of `b * a` and `b` belong to `H`.
name: Subgroup.index_eq_two_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {H : Subgroup G} : H.index = 2 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : G), Xor (b * a ∈ H) (b ∈ H)

docstring: The inverse of `f : LinearPMap` is closed if and only if `f` is closed.
name: LinearPMap.inverse_closed_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module R E] [_root_.Module R F] [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace F] {f : E →ₗ.[R] F} (hf : f.ker = ⊥) : f.inverse.IsClosed ↔ f.IsClosed

docstring: A module over a finite ring has finite dimension iff it is finite.
name: Module.finite_iff_finite
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Finite R] : Module.Finite R M ↔ Finite M

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `(a, +∞)` if and only if it contains an interval `(a, u)`
with `a < u`.
name: mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Ioi a, Set.Ioo a u ⊆ s

docstring:
An orthonormal set in a finite-dimensional `InnerProductSpace` is maximal, if and only if it
is a basis.
name: maximal_orthonormal_iff_basis_of_finiteDimensional
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {v : Set E} [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] (hv : Orthonormal.{u_1, u_2, u_2} 𝕜 (E := E) (ι := { x : E // x ∈ v }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ v))) : (∀ u ⊇ v, Orthonormal.{u_1, u_2, u_2} 𝕜 (E := E) (ι := { x : E // x ∈ u }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ u)) → u = v) ↔ ∃ b, Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := ↑v → E) (⇑b) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ v))

docstring:
A quotient `R ⧸ I` has krull dimension at most zero if and only if all minimal primes over `I`
are maximal.
name: Ideal.krullDimLE_zero_quotient_iff_forall_minimalPrimes_isMaximal
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} : Ring.KrullDimLE.{u_2} 0 (R ⧸ I) ↔ ∀ J ∈ I.minimalPrimes, J.IsMaximal

docstring:
A map between two inner product spaces is a conformal map if and only if it preserves inner
products up to a scalar factor, i.e., there exists a positive `c : ℝ` such that
`⟪f u, f v⟫ = c * ⟪u, v⟫` for all `u`, `v`.
name: isConformalMap_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (f : E →L[ℝ] F) : IsConformalMap f ↔ ∃ c, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (u v : E), inner.{0, u_2} ℝ (E := F) (f u : F) (f v : F) = c * inner ℝ u v

docstring:
In a T1Space, a set `s` is codiscreteWithin `U` iff it has locally finite complement within `U`.
More precisely: `s` is codiscreteWithin `U` iff every point `z ∈ U` has a punctured neighborhood
intersect `U \ s` in only finitely many points.
name: codiscreteWithin_iff_locallyFiniteComplementWithin
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} [T1Space X] {t : Set X} : t ∈ Filter.codiscreteWithin s ↔ ∀ z ∈ s, ∃ τ ∈ nhds z, (τ ∩ (s \ t)).Finite

docstring: A meromorphic function converges to infinity iff its order is negative.
name: tendsto_cobounded_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_neg
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (Bornology.cobounded E) ↔ meromorphicOrderAt f x < 0

docstring:
The angle between two nonzero vectors is `θ` if and only if the second vector is the first
rotated by `θ` and scaled by a positive real.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_iff_eq_pos_smul_rotation_of_ne_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (θ : Real.Angle) : o.oangle x y = θ ↔ ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ y = HSMul.hSMul (β := V) r ((o.rotation θ) x : V)

docstring: A submodule is finitely generated if and only if its `spanRank` is equal to its `spanFinrank`.
name: Submodule.fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} : p.spanRank = ↑p.spanFinrank ↔ p.FG

docstring:
`m` is `s`-factored if and only if `m ≠ 0` and its `Finset` of prime factors
is contained in `s`.
name: Nat.mem_factoredNumbers_iff_primeFactors_subset
statement_text: {s : Finset ℕ} {m : ℕ} : m ∈ Nat.factoredNumbers s ↔ m ≠ 0 ∧ m.primeFactors ⊆ s

docstring: A block diagonal matrix is Hermitian if and only if each block is Hermitian.
name: Matrix.isHermitian_blockDiagonal'_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {n : Type u_4} [AddMonoid α] [StarAddMonoid α] [DecidableEq n] {p : n → Type u_5} {M : (i : n) → Matrix.{u_5, u_5, u_1} (p i) (p i) α} : (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (m' := p) (n' := p) M).IsHermitian ↔ ∀ (i : n), (M i).IsHermitian

docstring: A `Fintype` can be given a field structure iff its cardinality is a prime power.
name: Fintype.nonempty_field_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Fintype α] : Nonempty.{u_1 + 1} (Field α) ↔ IsPrimePow (Fintype.card α)

docstring:
If `f` is any function and `g` is analytic without zero at `z₀`, then `f` is meromorphic in normal
form at `z₀` iff `g • f` is meromorphic in normal form at `z₀`.
name: meromorphicNFAt_smul_iff_right_of_analyticAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {x : 𝕜} (h₁g : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x) (h₂g : g x ≠ 0) : MeromorphicNFAt (g • f) x ↔ MeromorphicNFAt f x

docstring: Random variables are independent iff their joint distribution is the product measure.
name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_infinitePi_map
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {𝓧 : ι → Type u_3} {m𝓧 : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (𝓧 i)} {X : (i : ι) → Ω → 𝓧 i} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (mX : ∀ (i : ι), Measurable (X i)) : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (β := 𝓧) X P ↔ Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : ι) → 𝓧 i)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω i => X i ω) P) (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi (X := 𝓧) fun i => MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) P)

docstring:
The denominator in the rational expression for the `x`-coordinate of twice the point `(x, y)`
vanishes if and only if the point is equal to its negative.
name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.den_duplication_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {R : Type r} [CommRing R] {W' : WeierstrassCurve.Affine R} [IsReduced R] {x : R} {y : R} (h : W'.Equation x y) : 4 * x ^ 3 + WeierstrassCurve.b₂ W' * x ^ 2 + 2 * WeierstrassCurve.b₄ W' * x + WeierstrassCurve.b₆ W' = 0 ↔ y = W'.negY x y

docstring:
The image of an element `m : M` in `R[M]` belongs the submodule generated by
`s : Set M` if and only if `m ∈ s`.
name: AddMonoidAlgebra.of'_mem_span
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] {m : M} {s : Set M} : Membership.mem (γ := Submodule R (AddMonoidAlgebra R M)) (Submodule.span R (AddMonoidAlgebra.of' R M '' s)) (AddMonoidAlgebra.of' R M m) ↔ m ∈ s

docstring:
The underlying relation of the tripartite-from-triangles graph.

Two vertices are related iff there exists a triangle index containing them both.
name: SimpleGraph.TripartiteFromTriangles.Rel
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} (t : Finset (α × β × γ)) : α ⊕ β ⊕ γ → α ⊕ β ⊕ γ → Prop

docstring: An infinite place is not unramified (i.e. ramified) iff it is a complex place above a real place.
name: NumberField.InfinitePlace.not_isUnramified_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [Algebra k K] {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} : ¬NumberField.InfinitePlace.IsUnramified k w ↔ w.IsComplex ∧ NumberField.InfinitePlace.IsReal (w.comap (algebraMap k K))

docstring: If `h : X → Y` is a homeomorphism, `h⁻¹(s)` is σ-compact iff `s` is.
name: Homeomorph.isSigmaCompact_preimage
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {s : Set Y} (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : IsSigmaCompact.{u_1} (X := X) (⇑h ⁻¹' s) ↔ IsSigmaCompact s

docstring:
An injective family `v : ι → E` is orthonormal if and only if `Subtype.val : (range v) → E` is
orthonormal.
name: orthonormal_subtype_range
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {ι : Type u_4} {v : ι → E} (hv : Function.Injective v) : Orthonormal.{u_1, u_2, u_2} 𝕜 (E := E) (ι := { x : E // x ∈ Set.range v }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range v)) ↔ Orthonormal 𝕜 v

docstring:
Helper lemma for `codiscreteWithin_iff_locallyFiniteComplementWithin`: A set `s` is
`codiscreteWithin U` iff every point `z ∈ U` has a punctured neighborhood that does not intersect
`U \ s`.
name: codiscreteWithin_iff_locallyEmptyComplementWithin
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {t : Set X} : t ∈ Filter.codiscreteWithin s ↔ ∀ z ∈ s, ∃ τ ∈ nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ, τ ∩ (s \ t) = ∅

docstring:
The comparison morphism for the product of `f`. This is an iso iff `G` preserves the product
of `f`, see `PreservesProduct.ofIsoComparison`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.piComparison
statement_text: {β : Type w} {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v₂, u, u₂} C D) (f : β → C) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasProduct.{w, v, u} f] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasProduct.{w, v₂, u₂} (C := D) fun (b : β) => G.obj (f b)] : G.obj (CategoryTheory.Limits.piObj.{w, v, u} f) ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.piObj.{w, v₂, u₂} fun (b : β) => G.obj (f b)

docstring:
Canonical form of the **equality case of Jensen's equality**.

For a strictly convex function `f` and nonnegative weights `w`, we have
`f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i)` if and only if the points `p` with nonzero
weight are all equal (and in fact all equal to their center of mass w.r.t. `w`).
name: StrictConvexOn.map_sum_eq_iff'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] [IsStrictOrderedModule 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} {t : Finset ι} {w : ι → 𝕜} {p : ι → E} (hf : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f) (h₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (h₁ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hmem : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s) : f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i) ↔ ∀ j ∈ t, w j ≠ 0 → p j = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i

docstring: A point belongs to the closure of `s` iff its infimum distance to this set vanishes.
name: Metric.mem_closure_iff_infDist_zero
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoMetricSpace α] {s : Set α} {x : α} (h : s.Nonempty) : x ∈ closure s ↔ Metric.infDist x s = 0

docstring: The symbol `J(a | b)` vanishes iff `a` and `b` are not coprime (assuming `b ≠ 0`).
name: jacobiSym.eq_zero_iff_not_coprime
statement_text: {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} [NeZero b] : jacobiSym a b = 0 ↔ a.gcd ↑b ≠ 1

docstring:
Two stochastic processes have same law iff they have the same
finite-dimensional distributions.
name: ProbabilityTheory.map_eq_iff_forall_finset_map_restrict_eq
statement_text: {T : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {𝓧 : T → Type u_3} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mα : (t : T) → MeasurableSpace (𝓧 t)} {X : (t : T) → Ω → 𝓧 t} {Y : (t : T) → Ω → 𝓧 t} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (hX : AEMeasurable (β := (x : T) → 𝓧 x) (fun ω x => X x ω) P) (hY : AEMeasurable (β := (x : T) → 𝓧 x) (fun ω x => Y x ω) P) : Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure ((x : T) → 𝓧 x)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω x => X x ω) P) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω x => Y x ω) P) ↔ ∀ (I : Finset T), Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : ↥I) → 𝓧 ↑i)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => I.restrict (π := 𝓧) fun x => X x ω) P) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => I.restrict (π := 𝓧) fun x => Y x ω) P)

docstring: Congruence holds if and only if all distances are the same.
name: congruent_iff_dist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Congruent v₁ v₂ ↔ ∀ (i₁ i₂ : ι), dist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = dist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
If `f = g` on some neighbourhood of `x`,
then `f` is a submersion at `x` if and only if `g` is a submersion at `x`.
name: Manifold.IsSubmersionAt.congr_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E'' : Type u_3} {H : Type u_7} {G : Type u_9} {E : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E''] [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace G] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E'' G} {M : Type u_11} {N : Type u_13} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : M → N} {g : M → N} {x : M} (hfg : f =ᶠ[nhds x] g) : Manifold.IsSubmersionAt I J n f x ↔ Manifold.IsSubmersionAt I J n g x

docstring:
A linear map is an idempotent if and only if it equals the projection
onto its range along its kernel.
name: LinearMap.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_projection_range_ker
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module R E] {T : E →ₗ[R] E} : IsIdempotentElem T ↔ ∃ (h : IsCompl T.range T.ker), T = T.range.projection T.ker h

docstring:
`Cofork.ofπ π w` is a colimit cocone if and only if `Fork.ofι π.op w'` in the opposite
category is a limit cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.isColimitOfπEquivIsLimitOp
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {P : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} (π : Y ⟶ P) (π' : Y ⟶ P) (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f π = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g π) (w' : Eq.{v₁ + 1} (α := Opposite.op P ⟶ Opposite.op X) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp π'.op f.op) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp π'.op g.op)) (h : π = π') : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.ofπ π w) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.{0, v₁, 0, u₁} (C := Cᵒᵖ) (F := CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair f.op g.op) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι π'.op w')

docstring: A right transversal is finite iff the subgroup has finite index.
name: Subgroup.IsComplement.finite_right_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {H : Subgroup G} {T : Set G} (h : Subgroup.IsComplement (↑H) T) : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑T ↔ H.FiniteIndex

docstring: A (right) adjoint square has a lifting if and only if the original square has a lifting.
name: CategoryTheory.CommSq.right_adjoint_hasLift_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {A : C} {B : C} {X : D} {Y : D} {i : A ⟶ B} {p : X ⟶ Y} {u : G.obj A ⟶ X} {v : G.obj B ⟶ Y} (sq : CategoryTheory.CommSq u (G.map i) p v) (adj : G ⊣ F) : ⋯.HasLift ↔ sq.HasLift

docstring: Two sets are at zero Hausdorff edistance if and only if they have the same closure.
name: Metric.hausdorffEDist_zero_iff_closure_eq_closure
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] {s : Set α} {t : Set α} : Metric.hausdorffEDist s t = 0 ↔ closure s = closure t

docstring:
A topological space is σ-compact iff there exists a countable collection of compact
subspaces that cover the entire space.
name: SigmaCompactSpace_iff_exists_compact_covering
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : SigmaCompactSpace X ↔ ∃ K, (∀ (n : ℕ), IsCompact (K n)) ∧ Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := Set X) (⋃ n, K n) Set.univ

docstring:
if `f` is integrable, then `f + g` is integrable iff `g` is.
See `integrable_add_iff_integrable_right'` for the same statement with `fun x ↦ f x + g x` instead
of `f + g`.
name: MeasureTheory.integrable_add_iff_integrable_right
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [NormedAddCommGroup β] {f : α → β} {g : α → β} (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (f + g) μ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable g μ

docstring: In a cyclic group, `H = K` iff `H.index = K.index`.
name: IsCyclic.subgroup_eq_iff_index_eq
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [IsCyclic G] {H : Subgroup G} {K : Subgroup G} : H = K ↔ H.index = K.index

docstring:
In the 1-dimensional case, a set is Presburger arithmetic definable in `ℕ` if and only if it
is ultimately periodic, i.e. periodic after some number `k`.
name: FirstOrder.Language.presburger.definable₁_iff_ultimately_periodic
statement_text: {A : Set ℕ} {s : Set ℕ} : A.Definable₁ FirstOrder.Language.presburger s ↔ ∃ k, ∃ p > 0, ∀ x ≥ k, x ∈ s ↔ x + p ∈ s

docstring:
A quasi-compact morphism is a (locally-closed) immersion if and only if it can be factored into
an open immersion followed by a closed immersion.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsImmersion.isImmersion_iff_exists_of_quasiCompact
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ Y} [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact f] : AlgebraicGeometry.IsImmersion f ↔ ∃ Z g₁ g₂, AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion g₁ ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion g₂ ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g₁ g₂ = f

docstring:
If `G` is a topological group and `H` a finite-index subgroup, then `G` is topologically
discrete iff `H` is.
name: Subgroup.discreteTopology_iff_of_finiteIndex
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G] {H : Subgroup G} [H.FiniteIndex] : DiscreteTopology.{u_1} ↥H ↔ DiscreteTopology G

docstring:
An additive subgroup has index dividing 2 if and only if there exists `a` such
that for all `b`, at least one of `b + a` and `b` belongs to `H`.
name: AddSubgroup.index_dvd_two_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} : H.index ∣ 2 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : G), b + a ∈ H ∨ b ∈ H

docstring: A presheaf on a category which is `FinitaryExtensive` is a sheaf iff it preserves finite products.
name: CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_preservesFiniteProducts
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.FinitaryPreExtensive.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.FinitaryExtensive.{v_1, u_1} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} Cᵒᵖ D) : CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf (CategoryTheory.extensiveTopology C) F ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteProducts F

docstring:
A sequence `[r₁, …, rₙ]` is weakly regular on `M` iff `rᵢ` is regular on
`M⧸(r₁, …, rᵢ₋₁)M` for all `1 ≤ i ≤ n`.
name: RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} (M : Type u_3) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] (rs : List R) : Prop

docstring: A map is a homeomorphism iff it is continuous and has a continuous inverse.
name: isHomeomorph_iff_exists_inverse
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsHomeomorph f ↔ Continuous f ∧ ∃ g, Function.LeftInverse g f ∧ Function.RightInverse g f ∧ Continuous g

docstring: A product is regular if and only if the factors are.
name: isRegular_mul_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemigroup R] {a : R} {b : R} : IsRegular (a * b) ↔ IsRegular a ∧ IsRegular b

docstring:
Adding an edge results in an acyclic graph iff the original graph was acyclic and
the edge connects vertices that previously had no path between them.
name: SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_sup_fromEdgeSet_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {u : V} {v : V} : (G ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge u v).IsAcyclic ↔ G.IsAcyclic ∧ (G.Reachable u v → u = v ∨ G.Adj u v)

docstring:
An additive monoid is finitely generated iff there exists a surjective
homomorphism from a `FreeAddMonoid` on finitely many generators.
name: AddMonoid.fg_iff_exists_freeAddMonoid_hom_surjective
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [AddMonoid M] : AddMonoid.FG M ↔ ∃ S, ∃ (_ : S.Finite), ∃ φ, Function.Surjective (α := FreeAddMonoid ↑S) (β := M) ⇑φ

docstring: `P` is a sheaf for `R`, iff the fork given by `w` is an equalizer.
name: CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.sheaf_condition
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type (max v u))) {X : C} (R : CategoryTheory.Presieve.{v, u} X) [R.HasPairwisePullbacks] : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor P R ↔ Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (F := CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair (Y := CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.SecondObj P R) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.firstMap P R) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Presieve.secondMap P R)) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.forkMap P R) ⋯))

docstring: The polynomial `p` is primitive if and only if the coefficients of `p` generate the whole ring.
name: Polynomial.isPrimitive_iff_contentIdeal_eq_top
statement_text: {R : Type u_3} [CommSemiring R] [IsBezout R] (p : Polynomial R) : p.IsPrimitive ↔ p.contentIdeal = ⊤

docstring:
A scheme is locally Noetherian if and only if it is covered by affine opens whose sections
are Noetherian rings.

See [Har77], Proposition II.3.2.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyNoetherian_iff_of_iSup_eq_top
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {ι : Sort u_1} {S : ι → ↑X.affineOpens} (hS : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := X.Opens) (⨆ i, ↑(S i)) ⊤) : AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian X ↔ ∀ (i : ι), IsNoetherianRing.{u_2} ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ↑(S i)))

docstring:
Right addition is strictly monotone if and only if it is monotone and
right-cancellative.
name: addRightStrictMono_iff_addRightMono_and_isRightCancelAdd
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Add α] [LinearOrder α] : AddRightStrictMono α ↔ AddRightMono α ∧ IsRightCancelAdd α

docstring:
A vector is in the direction of a nonempty affine subspace if and only if it is the subtraction
of two vectors in the subspace.
name: AffineSubspace.mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace k P} (h : (↑s).Nonempty) (v : V) : v ∈ s.direction ↔ ∃ p₁ ∈ s, ∃ p₂ ∈ s, v = p₁ -ᵥ p₂

docstring:
The inner product of two vectors is negative if and only if the angle between them exceeds
`π / 2`.
name: InnerProductGeometry.inner_neg_iff_pi_div_two_lt_angle
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : inner ℝ x y < 0 ↔ Real.pi / 2 < InnerProductGeometry.angle x y

docstring:
A splitting of an extension `S` is `N`-conjugate to another iff there exists `n : N` such
that the section homomorphism is a conjugate of the other section homomorphism by `S.inl n`.
name: AddGroupExtension.IsAddConj
statement_text: {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [AddGroup N] [AddGroup E] [AddGroup G] (S : AddGroupExtension N E G) (s : S.Splitting) (s' : S.Splitting) : Prop

docstring: A graph is 2-edge-connected iff it has no bridge.
name: SimpleGraph.isEdgeConnected_two_iff_forall_not_isBridge
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} : G.IsEdgeConnected 2 ↔ ∀ (e : Sym2 V), ¬G.IsBridge e

docstring:
If `i` is an `F`-algebra homomorphism from `E` to `K`, then `i x` is contained in
`algebraicClosure F K` if and only if `x` is contained in `algebraicClosure F E`.
name: map_mem_algebraicClosure_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {K : Type u_3} [Field K] [Algebra F K] (i : E →ₐ[F] K) {x : E} : Membership.mem (α := K) (γ := IntermediateField F K) (algebraicClosure F K) (i x : K) ↔ Membership.mem (γ := IntermediateField F E) (algebraicClosure F E) x

docstring: Given a closed set `s`, a point belongs to `s` iff its infimum distance to this set vanishes.
name: IsClosed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoMetricSpace α] {s : Set α} {x : α} (h : IsClosed s) (hs : s.Nonempty) : x ∉ s ↔ 0 < Metric.infDist x s

docstring: `Aᵀ` has orthogonal columns iff `A` has orthogonal rows.
name: Matrix.transpose_hasOrthogonalCols_iff_hasOrthogonalRows
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] (A : Matrix m n α) [Fintype n] : A.transpose.HasOrthogonalCols ↔ A.HasOrthogonalRows

docstring:
Let `F : C₀ ⥤ C` be a dense subsite, and assume we have a family
`data : ∀ X, F.OneHypercoverDenseData J₀ J X`.
This lemma shows that `G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A` is a sheaf iff `F.op F.op ⋙ G : C₀ᵒᵖ ⥤ A`
is a sheaf and for any `X : C`, the multifork for `G` and the `1`-hypercover
given by `data X` is a limit.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.OneHypercoverDenseData.isSheaf_iff
statement_text: {C₀ : Type u₀} {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₀, u₀} C₀] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₀, v, u₀, u} C₀ C} {J₀ : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v₀, u₀} C₀} {J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C} {A : Type u'} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v', u'} A] [CategoryTheory.Functor.IsDenseSubsite J₀ J F] (data : (X : C) → CategoryTheory.Functor.OneHypercoverDenseData.{u_1, v₀, v, u₀, u} F J₀ J X) (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v', u, u'} Cᵒᵖ A) : CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf J G ↔ CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf J₀ (F.op.comp G) ∧ ∀ (X : C), Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit ((data X).toOneHypercover.multifork G))

docstring: For digraphs `G`, `H`, `G ≤ H` iff `∀ a b, G.Adj a b → H.Adj a b`.
name: Digraph.instLE
statement_text: {V : Type u_2} : LE (Digraph V)

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is strictly below the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a b < slope f c b`.
name: map_lt_lineMap_iff_slope_lt_slope_right
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < (1 - r) * (b - a)) : f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) < (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ↔ slope f a b < slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b

docstring:
If `F ≤ E` are two intermediate fields of `L / K` such that `[E : K]` is finite,
then `F = E` iff `[F : K] = [E : K]`.
name: IntermediateField.eq_iff_finrank_eq_of_le
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] {F : IntermediateField K L} {E : IntermediateField K L} [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} K ↥E] (h_le : F ≤ E) : F = E ↔ Module.finrank.{u_1, u_2} K ↥F = Module.finrank.{u_1, u_2} K ↥E

docstring: A filter lies below the neighborhood filter at `x` iff it contains every open set around `x`.
name: le_nhds_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} {f : Filter X} : f ≤ nhds x ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), x ∈ s → IsOpen s → s ∈ f

docstring:
A map is open if and only if the `Set.kernImage` of every *closed* set is closed.

One way to understand this result is that `f : X → Y` is open if and only if its fibers vary in a
**lower hemicontinuous** way: for any open subset `U ⊆ X`, the set of all `y ∈ Y` such that
`(f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ U).Nonempty` is open in `Y`. See `isOpenMap_iff_lowerHemicontinuous`.
name: isOpenMap_iff_kernImage
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {f : X → Y} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] : IsOpenMap f ↔ ∀ {u : Set X}, IsClosed u → IsClosed (Set.kernImage f u)

docstring: A matrix is Hadamard iff its negation is.
name: Matrix.IsHadamard.neg_iff
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Ring R] [StarRing R] {A : Matrix n n R} : (-A).IsHadamard ↔ A.IsHadamard

docstring:
if `f` is integrable, then `fun x ↦ g x + f x` is integrable iff `g` is.
See `integrable_add_iff_integrable_left'` for the same statement with `g + f` instead
of `fun x ↦ g x + f x`.
name: MeasureTheory.integrable_add_iff_integrable_left'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [NormedAddCommGroup β] {f : α → β} {g : α → β} (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ) : MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_2, u_1} (ε := β) (fun x => g x + f x) μ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable g μ

docstring:
Given a point in an affine subspace, a result of subtracting that point on the left is in the
direction if and only if the other point is in the subspace.
name: AffineSubspace.vsub_left_mem_direction_iff_mem
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) (p₂ : P) : p -ᵥ p₂ ∈ s.direction ↔ p₂ ∈ s

docstring: The minimal distance to a set `s` is `< r` iff there exists a point in `s` at distance `< r`.
name: Metric.infDist_lt_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} [PseudoMetricSpace α] {s : Set α} {x : α} {r : ℝ} (hs : s.Nonempty) : Metric.infDist x s < r ↔ ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y < r

docstring: `LinearMap.normDet` vanishes iff the map is not injective.
name: LinearMap.normDet_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup U] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 U] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 U] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] {f : U →ₗ[𝕜] V} : f.normDet = 0 ↔ f.ker ≠ ⊥

docstring: A property holds on a residual (comeagre) set if and only if it holds on some dense `Gδ` set.
name: eventually_residual
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [BaireSpace X] {p : X → Prop} : (∀ᶠ (x : X) in residual X, p x) ↔ ∃ t, IsGδ t ∧ Dense t ∧ ∀ x ∈ t, p x

docstring: An action is `1`-pretransitive iff it is pretransitive.
name: MulAction.oneEmbedding_isPretransitive_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G α] {one : Type u_5} [Unique one] : MulAction.IsPretransitive G (one ↪ α) ↔ MulAction.IsPretransitive G α

docstring:
Eta-expanded form of `analyticAt_iff_analytic_mul`

---

A function is analytic at a point iff it is analytic after multiplication
with a non-vanishing analytic function.
name: analyticAt_iff_analytic_fun_mul
