docstring:
`p ∈ M` is a boundary point of a manifold `M` if and only if its image in the extended chart
lies on the boundary of the model space.
name: ModelWithCorners.IsBoundaryPoint
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] (x : M) : Prop

docstring: A set in `StrongDual 𝕜 E` is bounded iff its image in `WeakDual 𝕜 E` is bounded.
name: WeakDual.isBounded_toWeakDual_preimage_iff_isBounded
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {s : Set (WeakDual 𝕜 E)} : Bornology.IsBounded (α := StrongDual 𝕜 E) (⇑StrongDual.toWeakDual ⁻¹' s) ↔ Bornology.IsBounded s

docstring: A continuous linear map is zero iff its norm vanishes.
name: ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} {ι : Type v} {E : ι → Type wE} {G : Type wG} [Fintype ι] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [(i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [(i : ι) → NormedSpace.{u, wE} 𝕜 (E i)] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] {f : ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E G} : ‖f‖ = 0 ↔ f = 0

docstring: A rotation of a nonzero vector equals that vector if and only if the angle is zero.
name: Orientation.rotation_eq_self_iff_angle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (θ : Real.Angle) : (o.rotation θ) x = x ↔ θ = 0

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is non-strictly above the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f c b ≤ slope f a b`.
name: lineMap_le_map_iff_slope_le_slope_right
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < (1 - r) * (b - a)) : (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ≤ f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ↔ slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b ≤ slope f a b

docstring:
A finite-dimensional space has zero `finrank` iff it is a subsingleton.
This is the `finrank` version of `rank_zero_iff`.
name: Module.finrank_zero_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Finite R M] [IsDomain R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] : Module.finrank R M = 0 ↔ Subsingleton M

docstring:
`CharacterModule M` is an injective module iff `M` is flat.
See [Lambek_1964] for a self-contained proof.
name: Module.Flat.iff_characterModule_injective
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Small.{v, u} R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ Module.Injective.{u, v} R (CharacterModule M)

docstring:
A simplicial set `X` has dimension `< d` iff for any `n : ℕ`
such that `d ≤ n`, all `n`-simplices are degenerate.
name: SSet.HasDimensionLT
statement_text: (X : _root_.SSet) (d : ℕ) : Prop

docstring:
The images of two vectors under a linear equivalence are on the same ray if and only if the
original vectors are on the same ray.
name: SameRay.sameRay_map_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid N] [_root_.Module R N] {x : M} {y : M} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : SameRay.{u_1, u_3} R (M := N) (e x : N) (e y : N) ↔ SameRay R x y

docstring: In a cyclic group, if `H` is finite then `H ≤ K` iff `Nat.card H ∣ Nat.card K`.
name: IsCyclic.subgroup_le_iff_card_dvd
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [IsCyclic G] {H : Subgroup G} {K : Subgroup G} [Finite.{u_2 + 1} ↥H] : H ≤ K ↔ Nat.card.{u_2} ↥H ∣ Nat.card.{u_2} ↥K

docstring:
If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` moves `h +ᵥ x` iff `g` moves `x`.
This is equivalent to say that the set `(fixedBy α g)ᶜ` is fixed by `h`.
name: AddAction.movedBy_mem_fixedBy_of_addCommute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : AddCommute g h) : Membership.mem (γ := Set (Set α)) (AddAction.fixedBy (Set α) h) (AddAction.fixedBy α g)ᶜ

docstring:
A property of morphisms `P` in `C` is local at the source with respect to the precoverage `K` if
it respects isomorphisms, and:
`P` holds for `f : X ⟶ Y` if and only if it holds for the restrictions of `f` to `Uᵢ` for a
`0`-hypercover `{Uᵢ}` of `X` in the precoverage `K`.
name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtSource
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.{v, u} C) (K : CategoryTheory.Precoverage.{v, u} C) : Prop

docstring:
`f : α → β` is called **locally Lipschitz continuous** on `s` iff every point `x` of `s`
has a neighbourhood within `s` on which `f` is Lipschitz.
name: LocallyLipschitzOn
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] (s : Set α) (f : α → β) : Prop

docstring: A function `-f` is strictly convex iff `f` is strictly concave.
name: neg_strictConvexOn_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {β : Type u_5} [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommGroup β] [PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [SMul 𝕜 E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 β] {s : Set E} {f : E → β} : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s (-f) ↔ StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f

docstring:
A nonzero vector is in the same ray as a multiple of itself if and only if that multiple
is positive.
name: sameRay_smul_right_iff_of_ne
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] {v : M} (hv : v ≠ 0) {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) : SameRay R v (r • v) ↔ 0 < r

docstring:
Given a limiting pullback cone, the fork in `SingleEqualizerCondition` is limiting iff the diagram
in `Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isLimit_coverage` is limiting.
name: CategoryTheory.regularTopology.isLimit_forkOfι_equiv
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} Cᵒᵖ D) {X : C} {B : C} (π : X ⟶ B) (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone π π) (hc : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι (P.map π.op) ⋯) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (J := (CategoryTheory.Presieve.category.{v_1, u_1} (C := C) (X := B) (CategoryTheory.Sieve.arrows (CategoryTheory.Sieve.ofArrows (fun (x : Unit) => X) fun x => π)))ᵒᵖ) (P.mapCone (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.op (CategoryTheory.Presieve.cocone (CategoryTheory.Sieve.arrows (CategoryTheory.Sieve.ofArrows (fun (x : Unit) => X) fun x => π)))))

docstring:
The angle between three points is zero if and only if one of the first and third points is
weakly between the other two, and not equal to the second.
name: EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_zero_iff_ne_and_wbtw
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0 ↔ p₁ ≠ p₂ ∧ Wbtw ℝ p₂ p₁ p₃ ∨ p₃ ≠ p₂ ∧ Wbtw ℝ p₂ p₃ p₁

docstring: An object of `Rep k G` is zero iff the underlying `k`-module is zero.
name: Rep.isZero_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u} {G : Type v} [Ring k] [Monoid G] (M : Rep.{u_1, u, v} k G) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero M ↔ Subsingleton.{u_1 + 1} ↑M

docstring: A space is `T5Space` iff it is hereditarily `T4Space`.
name: t5Space_iff_forall_t4Space
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : T5Space X ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), T4Space.{u_1} ↑s

docstring:
Two vertices are adjacent iff there is an edge between them. The
condition `v ≠ w` ensures they are different endpoints of the edge,
which is necessary since when `v = w` the existential
`∃ (e ∈ G.edgeSet), v ∈ e ∧ w ∈ e` is satisfied by every edge
incident to `v`.
name: SimpleGraph.adj_iff_exists_edge
statement_text: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V} {w : V} : G.Adj v w ↔ v ≠ w ∧ ∃ e ∈ G.edgeSet, v ∈ e ∧ w ∈ e

docstring: A sum is infinite iff one term is infinite.
name: WithBot.sum_eq_bot_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → WithBot M} : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := WithBot M) (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊥ ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i = ⊥

docstring: A quotient of a projective module is projective iff it is a direct summand.
name: Module.Projective.iff_split_of_projective
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {P : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid P] [_root_.Module R P] {M : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.Projective R M] (s : M →ₗ[R] P) (hs : Function.Surjective.{u_3 + 1, u_2 + 1} (α := M) (β := P) ⇑s) : Module.Projective R P ↔ ∃ i, s ∘ₗ i = LinearMap.id

docstring:
The inner product of two vectors, divided by the product of their
norms, has value 1 if and only if they are nonzero and one is
a positive multiple of the other.
name: real_inner_div_norm_mul_norm_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (x : F) (y : F) : inner ℝ x y / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) = 1 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ y = r • x

docstring:
An ideal `I` equals its Jacobson radical if and only if every element outside `I`
also lies outside of a maximal ideal containing `I`.
name: Ideal.eq_jacobson_iff_notMem
statement_text: {R : Type u} [Ring R] {I : Ideal R} : I.jacobson = I ↔ ∀ x ∉ I, ∃ M, (I ≤ M ∧ M.IsMaximal) ∧ x ∉ M

docstring:
An equivalence relation on `Σ i, D.U i` that holds iff `𝖣.ι i x = 𝖣.ι j y`.
See `TopCat.GlueData.ι_eq_iff_rel`.
name: TopCat.GlueData.Rel
statement_text: (D : TopCat.GlueData) (a : (i : D.J) × ↑(D.U i)) (b : (i : D.J) × ↑(D.U i)) : Prop

docstring: The domain of a final functor is connected if and only if its codomain is connected.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.isConnected_iff_of_final
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v₂, u, u₂} C D) [F.Final] : CategoryTheory.IsConnected.{v, u} C ↔ CategoryTheory.IsConnected.{v₂, u₂} D

docstring:
A family is linearly independent if and only if all of its finite subfamily is
linearly independent.
name: linearIndependent_iff_finset_linearIndependent
statement_text: {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] : LinearIndependent R v ↔ ∀ (s : Finset ι), LinearIndependent (ι := ↥s) R (v ∘ Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ s))

docstring:
If a subgroup is generated by transpositions, then a transposition `swap x y` lies in the
subgroup if and only if `x` lies in the same orbit as `y`.
name: swap_mem_closure_isSwap
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} [DecidableEq α] {S : Set (Equiv.Perm α)} (hS : ∀ f ∈ S, f.IsSwap) {x : α} {y : α} : Membership.mem (γ := Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α)) (Subgroup.closure S) (Equiv.swap x y) ↔ x ∈ MulAction.orbit (↥(Subgroup.closure S)) y

docstring:
`forbidden F` is the set of configurations that avoid every pattern in `F`.

Formally: `x ∈ forbidden F` if and only if for every pattern `p ∈ F` and every
monoid element `g : G`, the pattern `p` does not occur in `x` at position `g`.

Intuitively, `forbidden F` is the shift space defined by declaring the finite set
(or family) of patterns `F` to be *forbidden*. A configuration belongs to the subshift if and only
it avoids all the forbidden patterns.
name: SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.forbidden
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [Inhabited A] [AddMonoid G] (F : Set (SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.Pattern A G)) : Set (G → A)

docstring:
The order of a formal power series `φ` is the greatest `n : ℕ∞`
such that `X^n` divides `φ`. The order is `⊤` if and only if `φ = 0`.
name: PowerSeries.order
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (φ : PowerSeries R) : ℕ∞

docstring: In an additive cyclic group, if `H` is finite then `H ≤ K` iff `Nat.card H ∣ Nat.card K`.
name: IsAddCyclic.addSubgroup_le_iff_card_dvd
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] {H : AddSubgroup G} {K : AddSubgroup G} [Finite.{u_2 + 1} ↥H] : H ≤ K ↔ Nat.card.{u_2} ↥H ∣ Nat.card.{u_2} ↥K

docstring:
A function is `C^(n + 1)` on a domain with unique derivatives if and only if it is
differentiable there, and its derivative (expressed with `fderivWithin`) is `C^n`.
name: contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderivWithin
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hs : UniqueDiffOn 𝕜 s) : ContDiffOn 𝕜 (n + 1) f s ↔ DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s ∧ (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f s) ∧ ContDiffOn 𝕜 (F := E →L[𝕜] F) n (fderivWithin 𝕜 f s) s

docstring:
An object `X` has `𝟙 X = 0` if and only if it is isomorphic to the zero object.

Because `X ≅ 0` contains data (even if a subsingleton), we express this `↔` as an `≃`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.idZeroEquivIsoZero
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v, u} C] (X : C) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X = 0 ≃ (X ≅ 0)

docstring: The power of a point is negative if and only if the point lies inside the sphere.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.power_neg_iff_dist_center_lt_radius
statement_text: {P : Type u_2} [MetricSpace P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p : P} (hr : 0 ≤ s.radius) : s.power p < 0 ↔ dist p s.center < s.radius

docstring:
**Gauss's Lemma** for `ℤ` states that a primitive integer polynomial is irreducible iff it is
irreducible over `ℚ`.
name: Polynomial.IsPrimitive.Int.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_cast
statement_text: {p : Polynomial ℤ} (hp : p.IsPrimitive) : Irreducible p ↔ Irreducible (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) p)

docstring:
Let `X` be a topological space, `𝔖` a family of compact subsets of `X`,
`α` a uniform space, `F : ι → (X → α)` a family equicontinuous on each `K ∈ 𝔖`, and `ℱ` a filter
on `ι`. Then, `F` tends to `f : X → α` along `ℱ` *uniformly on each `K ∈ 𝔖`* iff it tends to `f`
*pointwise on `⋃₀ 𝔖`* along `ℱ`.
name: EquicontinuousOn.tendsto_uniformOnFun_iff_pi'
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {𝔖 : Set (Set X)} (𝔖_compact : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, IsCompact K) (F_eqcont : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, EquicontinuousOn F K) (ℱ : Filter ι) (f : X → α) : Filter.Tendsto (β := UniformOnFun X α 𝔖) (⇑(UniformOnFun.ofFun 𝔖) ∘ F : ι → UniformOnFun X α 𝔖) ℱ (nhds ((UniformOnFun.ofFun 𝔖) f) : Filter (UniformOnFun X α 𝔖)) ↔ Filter.Tendsto ((⋃₀ 𝔖).domRestrict (π := fun a => α) ∘ F) ℱ (nhds ((⋃₀ 𝔖).domRestrict (π := fun a => α) f))

docstring:
Given `x : M'`, `M'` a localization of `M` via `f`, `IsInteger f x` iff `x` is in the image of
the localization map `f`.
name: IsLocalizedModule.IsInteger
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {M' : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid M'] [_root_.Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (x : M') : Prop

docstring:
The neighborhood filter of a Lindelöf set is disjoint with a filter `l` with the countable
intersection property if and only if the neighborhood filter of each point of this set
is disjoint with `l`.
name: IsLindelof.disjoint_nhdsSet_left
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter X} [CountableInterFilter l] (hs : IsLindelof s) : Disjoint (nhdsSet s) l ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, Disjoint (nhds x) l

docstring:
`t ∈ ∂^k 𝒜` iff `t` is exactly `k` elements less than something in `𝒜`.

See also `Finset.mem_shadow_iterate_iff_exists_sdiff`.
name: Finset.mem_shadow_iterate_iff_exists_mem_card_add
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} {k : ℕ} : t ∈ Finset.shadow^[k] 𝒜 ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, t ⊆ s ∧ s.card = t.card + k

docstring: A continuous linear operator is self-adjoint iff it is equal to its adjoint.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] {A : E →L[𝕜] E} : IsSelfAdjoint A ↔ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A = A

docstring:
The oriented angle between two nonzero vectors is zero if and only if the unoriented angle
is zero.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : o.oangle x y = 0 ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = 0

docstring: A Killing Lie algebra is simple if and only if its root system is irreducible.
name: LieAlgebra.IsKilling.isSimple_iff_isIrreducible
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [LieAlgebra.IsKilling K L] {H : LieSubalgebra K L} [H.IsCartanSubalgebra] [LieModule.IsTriangularizable K (↥H) L] : RootPairing.IsIrreducible (ι := ↥(LieSubalgebra.root : Finset (LieModule.Weight K (↥H) L))) (LieAlgebra.IsKilling.rootSystem H) ↔ LieAlgebra.IsSimple K L

docstring: An integral domain is a DVR iff it's a PID with a unique non-zero prime ideal.
name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.iff_pid_with_one_nonzero_prime
statement_text: (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] : IsDiscreteValuationRing R ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing R ∧ ∃! P : Ideal R, P ≠ ⊥ ∧ P.IsPrime

docstring:
An odd prime `p` is a square in `F` iff the quadratic character of `ZMod p` does not
take the value `-1` on `χ₄#F * #F`.
name: FiniteField.isSquare_odd_prime_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [Field F] [Fintype F] (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hp : p ≠ 2) : IsSquare.{u_1} (α := F) ↑p ↔ (quadraticChar (ZMod p)) (HMul.hMul (α := ZMod p) ↑(ZMod.χ₄ ↑(Fintype.card F)) ↑(Fintype.card F)) ≠ -1

docstring:
A square matrix is doubly stochastic iff all entries are nonnegative, and left or right
multiplication by the vector of all 1s gives the vector of all 1s.
name: doublyStochastic
statement_text: (R : Type u_3) (n : Type u_4) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] : Submonoid (Matrix n n R)

docstring:
Let `K` be a normed field. If a normed division ring `L` is a normed `K`-algebra,
then `L` is ultrametric (i.e. the norm on `L` is nonarchimedean) if and only if `K` is.
name: IsUltrametricDist.normedAlgebra_iff
statement_text: (K : Type u_1) (L : Type u_2) [NormedField K] [NormedDivisionRing L] [NormedAlgebra K L] : IsUltrametricDist L ↔ IsUltrametricDist K

docstring:
If `f` is nonnegative a.e.-everywhere and it is integrable on the unordered interval
`Set.uIoc a b`, then its integral over `a..b` is positive if and only if `a < b` and the
measure of `Function.support f ∩ Set.Ioc a b` is positive.
name: intervalIntegral.integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae
statement_text: {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} {b : ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ} (hf : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) (hfi : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) : 0 < ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x ∂μ ↔ a < b ∧ 0 < μ (Function.support f ∩ Set.Ioc a b)

docstring: Two vectors with equal norms are equal if and only if they have zero angle between them.
name: Orientation.eq_iff_oangle_eq_zero_of_norm_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (h : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖) : x = y ↔ o.oangle x y = 0

docstring:
If `L/K/F` is a field tower where `L/F` is normal, then
`K` is normal over `F` if and only if `σ(K) = K` for every `σ ∈ K →ₐ[F] L`.
name: IntermediateField.normal_iff_forall_fieldRange_eq
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} {L : Type u_3} [Field F] [Field L] [Algebra F L] [Normal F L] {K : IntermediateField F L} : Normal.{u_1, u_3} F ↥K ↔ ∀ (σ : ↥K →ₐ[F] L), σ.fieldRange = K

docstring:
An integral domain is a Dedekind domain iff it is Noetherian and
the localization at every nonzero prime is a discrete valuation ring.
name: isDedekindDomain_iff_isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] : IsDedekindDomain A ↔ IsNoetherian A A ∧ ∀ (P : Ideal A), P ≠ ⊥ → ∀ (x : P.IsPrime), IsDiscreteValuationRing.{u_1} (Localization.AtPrime P)

docstring:
An element is right-regular if and only if multiplying it on the right with a right-regular
element is right-regular.
name: mul_isRightRegular_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semigroup R] {a : R} (b : R) (ha : IsRightRegular a) : IsRightRegular (b * a) ↔ IsRightRegular b

docstring:
Kaplansky's criterion: an integral domain is a UFD if and only if every nonzero prime ideal
contains a prime element.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_mem_of_isPrime
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R] : UniqueFactorizationMonoid R ↔ ∀ (I : Ideal R), I ≠ ⊥ → I.IsPrime → ∃ x ∈ I, Prime x

docstring: When `p ∤ a`, then `legendreSym p a = 1` iff `a` is a square mod `p`.
name: legendreSym.eq_one_iff
statement_text: (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℤ} (ha0 : ↑a ≠ 0) : legendreSym p a = 1 ↔ IsSquare (α := ZMod p) ↑a

docstring: A topological space is σ-compact iff `univ` is σ-compact.
name: isSigmaCompact_univ_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : IsSigmaCompact.{u_1} (X := X) Set.univ ↔ SigmaCompactSpace X

docstring: `x ∈ b.flag k` iff `b.repr x i = 0` for `k ≤ i.castSucc`.
name: Module.Basis.mem_flag_iff_repr_eq_zero
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M) {k : Fin (n + 1)} {x : M} : x ∈ b.flag k ↔ ∀ (i : Fin n), k ≤ i.castSucc → (b.repr x : Fin n →₀ R) i = 0

docstring:
A set of natural numbers has a Frobenius number iff their gcd is 1; if 1 is in the set,
the Frobenius number is -1, so the Frobenius number doesn't exist as a natural number.
[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coin_problem#Statement) seems to attribute this to
Issai Schur, but [Schur's theorem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schur%27s_theorem#Combinatorics)
is a more precise statement about asymptotics of the number of ℕ-linear combinations, and the
existence of the Frobenius number for a set with gcd 1 is probably well known before that.
name: exists_frobeniusNumber_iff
statement_text: {s : Set ℕ} : (∃ n, FrobeniusNumber n s) ↔ Nat.setGcd s = 1 ∧ 1 ∉ s

docstring:
Multiplication on the left by `m` tends to `𝓝 m` if and only if multiplication on the right
does, provided the elements are eventually selfadjoint along the filter `l`.
name: CStarAlgebra.tendsto_mul_left_iff_tendsto_mul_right
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] {l : Filter A} (hl : ∀ᶠ (x : A) in l, IsSelfAdjoint x) : (∀ (m : A), Filter.Tendsto (fun x => m * x) l (nhds m)) ↔ ∀ (m : A), Filter.Tendsto (fun x => x * m) l (nhds m)

docstring: `m` is `n`-smooth if and only if all prime divisors of `m` are less than `n`.
name: Nat.mem_smoothNumbers'
statement_text: {n : ℕ} {m : ℕ} : m ∈ n.smoothNumbers ↔ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p < n

docstring: A set is meagre iff it is a countable union of nowhere dense sets.
name: isMeagre_iff_eq_countable_union_isNowhereDense
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsMeagre s ↔ ∃ S, (∀ t ∈ S, IsNowhereDense t) ∧ S.Countable ∧ s = ⋃₀ S

docstring: The eigenvalues of a Hermitian matrix `A` are all zero iff `A = 0`.
name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [RCLike 𝕜] {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} [DecidableEq n] (hA : A.IsHermitian) : hA.eigenvalues = 0 ↔ A = 0

docstring: Complement to a singleton is dense if and only if the singleton is not an open set.
name: dense_compl_singleton_iff_not_open
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} : Dense (X := X) {x}ᶜ ↔ ¬IsOpen (X := X) {x}

docstring:
A prime `p` does not divide `discr K` if and only if `p` (as the ideal `span {p}`) is
unramified in the ring of integers `𝒪`.

Also see `not_dvd_discr_iff_forall_liesOver` and `not_dvd_discr_iff_forall_mem` for variants
whose RHS does not use `Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn`.
name: NumberField.not_dvd_discr_iff_isUnramifiedIn
statement_text: (K : Type u_1) (𝒪 : Type u_2) [Field K] [NumberField K] [CommRing 𝒪] [Algebra 𝒪 K] [IsIntegralClosure 𝒪 ℤ K] {p : ℤ} (hp : Prime p) : ¬p ∣ NumberField.discr K ↔ Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn (R := ℤ) 𝒪 (Ideal.span {p})

docstring:
A vector lies in the `vectorSpan` of two points if and only if it is a multiple of their
difference.
name: mem_vectorSpan_pair
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {v : V} : Membership.mem (γ := Submodule k V) (vectorSpan k (P := P) {p₁, p₂}) v ↔ ∃ r, r • (p₁ -ᵥ p₂) = v

docstring: A sum is `M`-regular if and only if the summands are.
name: IsVAddRegular.add_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {a : R} {b : R} [AddCommSemigroup R] [VAdd R M] [VAddAssocClass R R M] : IsVAddRegular M (a + b) ↔ IsVAddRegular M a ∧ IsVAddRegular M b

docstring:
An orthogonal family of subspaces of `E` satisfies `DirectSum.IsInternal` (that is,
they provide an internal direct sum decomposition of `E`) if and only if their span has trivial
orthogonal complement.
name: OrthogonalFamily.isInternal_iff_of_isComplete
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {ι : Type u_4} [DecidableEq ι] {V : ι → Submodule 𝕜 E} (hV : OrthogonalFamily.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_2} 𝕜 (E := E) (fun (i : ι) => ↥(V i)) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) (hc : IsComplete ↑(iSup V)) : DirectSum.IsInternal V ↔ (iSup V)ᗮ = ⊥

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c`, the point `(c, f c)` is non-strictly below the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a c ≤ slope f a b`.
name: map_le_lineMap_iff_slope_le_slope_left
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < r * (b - a)) : f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ≤ (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ↔ slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ≤ slope f a b

docstring: A space is a `T5Space` iff all its open subspaces are `T4Space`.
name: t5Space_iff_forall_isOpen_t4Space
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : T5Space X ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), IsOpen s → T4Space.{u_1} ↑s

docstring:
A pullback cone is a limit cone in `Cᵒᵖ` if and only if the corresponding pushout cocone
in `C` is a colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.isLimitEquivIsColimitUnop
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : Cᵒᵖ} {Y : Cᵒᵖ} {Z : Cᵒᵖ} {f : X ⟶ Z} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.{v₁, u₁} (C := Cᵒᵖ) (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) f g) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c.unop

docstring:
A pointed cone is salient iff the intersection of the cone with its negative
is the set `{0}`.
name: PointedCone.salient_iff_inter_neg_eq_singleton
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module R E] (C : PointedCone R E) : (↑C).Salient ↔ ↑C ∩ -↑C = {0}

docstring:
Two morphisms are conjugate via eqToHom if and only if they are heterogeneously equal.
Note this used to be in the Functor namespace, where it doesn't belong.
name: CategoryTheory.conj_eqToHom_iff_heq
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {W : C} {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} (f : W ⟶ X) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : W = Y) (h' : X = Z) : f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.eqToHom h) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (CategoryTheory.eqToHom ⋯)) ↔ f ≍ g

docstring:
`extremalNumber (card V) H` is at most `x` if and only if every `H`-free simple graph `G` has
at most `x` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.extremalNumber_le_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [Fintype V] (H : SimpleGraph W) (m : ℕ) : SimpleGraph.extremalNumber (Fintype.card V) H ≤ m ↔ ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph V⦄ [inst_1 : DecidableRel G.Adj], H.Free G → G.edgeFinset.card ≤ m

docstring:
Let `G` be a complete nonarchimedean additive abelian group. Then a function
`f : α → G` is unconditionally summable if and only if it tends to zero on the filter of cofinite
sets.
name: NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_iff_tendsto_cofinite_zero
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup G] [UniformSpace G] [IsUniformAddGroup G] [NonarchimedeanAddGroup G] [CompleteSpace G] (f : α → G) : Summable f ↔ Filter.Tendsto f Filter.cofinite (nhds 0)

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is strictly above the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f c b < slope f a b`.
name: lineMap_lt_map_iff_slope_lt_slope_right
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < (1 - r) * (b - a)) : (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r < f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ↔ slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b < slope f a b

docstring: A monoid object `M` is commutative if and only if `X ⟶ M` is commutative for all `X`.
name: CategoryTheory.isCommMonObj_iff_isMulCommutative
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u_1} C] (M : C) [CategoryTheory.MonObj M] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u_1} C] : CategoryTheory.IsCommMonObj.{v, u_1} M ↔ ∀ (X : C), IsMulCommutative.{v} (X ⟶ M)

docstring: A function is continuous on a union of open sets `s i` iff it is continuous on each `s i`.
name: continuousOn_iUnion_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β} {ι : Type u_5} {s : ι → Set α} (hs : ∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (s i)) : ContinuousOn f (⋃ i, s i) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ContinuousOn f (s i)

docstring: The `spanPoints` of a set is nonempty if and only if that set is.
name: spanPoints_nonempty
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (s : Set P) : (spanPoints k s).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty

docstring: A function is `C^k` on a union of open sets `s i` iff it is `C^k` on each `s i`.
name: contDiffOn_iUnion_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {ι : Type u_5} {s : ι → Set E} (hs : ∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (s i)) : ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f (⋃ i, s i) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f (s i)

docstring: `p` is `f` invariant if and only if `Set.MapsTo f p p`.
name: Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule_iff_mapsTo
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] (f : Module.End R M) {p : Submodule R M} : p ∈ f.invtSubmodule ↔ Set.MapsTo ⇑f ↑p ↑p

docstring:
An action of a topological group on a finite set is continuous if and only if it is trivial
when restricted to some open subgroup.
name: Action.exists_openSubgroup_of_isContinuous_of_finite
statement_text: {G : Type u_4} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] {J : Type u_5} [Finite J] (obj : J → Action FintypeCat G) (property : ∀ (j : J), Action.isContinuous FintypeCat (FV := fun X Y => TypeCat.Fun X.obj Y.obj) (CV := fun X => X.obj) G (obj j)) : ∃ H, ∀ (j : J), Action.trivialOnSet FintypeCat (↑H) (obj j)

docstring:
Let `G` be a complete nonarchimedean multiplicative abelian group. Then a function `f : α → G`
is unconditionally multipliable if and only if it tends to one on the filter of cofinite sets.
name: NonarchimedeanGroup.multipliable_iff_tendsto_cofinite_one
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [CommGroup G] [UniformSpace G] [IsUniformGroup G] [NonarchimedeanGroup G] [CompleteSpace G] (f : α → G) : Multipliable f ↔ Filter.Tendsto f Filter.cofinite (nhds 1)

docstring: An object `X` is initial iff for every `Y` there is a unique morphism `X ⟶ Y`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isInitialEquivUnique
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{0, v₁, 0, u₁} (CategoryTheory.Discrete PEmpty.{1}) C) (Y : C) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit { pt := Y, ι := { app := fun X => id (CategoryTheory.Discrete.casesOn (motive := fun x => F.obj x ⟶ Y) X fun as => ⋯.elim), naturality := ⋯ : CategoryTheory.NatTrans F (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Functor.const (CategoryTheory.Discrete PEmpty.{1})) Y) } : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F } ≃ ((X : C) → Unique (Y ⟶ X))

docstring:
An algebraic extension is purely inseparable if and only if all of its finite-dimensional
subextensions are purely inseparable.
name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_fd_isPurelyInseparable
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] : IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ ∀ (L : IntermediateField F E), FiniteDimensional.{u, v} F ↥L → IsPurelyInseparable.{u, v} F ↥L

docstring:
A map is closed if and only if the `Set.kernImage` of every *open* set is open.

One way to understand this result is that `f : X → Y` is closed if and only if its fibers vary in an
**upper hemicontinuous** way: for any open subset `U ⊆ X`, the set of all `y ∈ Y` such that
`f ⁻¹' {y} ⊆ U` is open in `Y`. See `isClosedMap_iff_upperHemicontinuous`.
name: isClosedMap_iff_kernImage
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {f : X → Y} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] : IsClosedMap f ↔ ∀ {u : Set X}, IsOpen u → IsOpen (Set.kernImage f u)

docstring:
Two elements are related by a congruence relation `c` iff they are represented by the same
element of the quotient by `c`.
name: Con.eq
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Mul M] (c : Con M) {a : M} {b : M} : Eq (α := c.Quotient) ↑a ↑b ↔ c a b

docstring:
Two Gaussian measures are equal if and only if they have same mean and same covariance. This is
`IsGaussian.ext_iff_covarianceBilinDual` specialized to Hilbert spaces.
name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian.ext_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian μ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian ν] : μ = ν ↔ Eq (α := E) (∫ (x : E), id x ∂μ) (∫ (x : E), id x ∂ν) ∧ Eq (α := E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ProbabilityTheory.covarianceBilin μ) (ProbabilityTheory.covarianceBilin ν)

docstring:
An algebra is finitely generated if and only if it is a quotient
of a polynomial ring whose variables are indexed by a fintype.
name: Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_freeAlgebra'
statement_text: {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] : Algebra.FiniteType R A ↔ ∃ ι x f, Function.Surjective (α := FreeAlgebra R ι) (β := A) ⇑f

docstring:
An a.e. monotone strongly adapted process `f` with uniformly bounded differences converges to
`+∞` if and only if its predictable part also converges to `+∞`.
name: MeasureTheory.tendsto_sum_indicator_atTop_iff
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_2} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {R : NNReal} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hfmono : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), f n ω ≤ f (n + 1) ω) (hf : MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted (β := fun i => ℝ) ℱ f) (hint : ∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (f n) μ) (hbdd : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), |f (n + 1) ω - f n ω| ≤ ↑R) : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (β := ℝ) (fun (n : ℕ) => f n ω) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ↔ Filter.Tendsto (β := ℝ) (fun (n : ℕ) => MeasureTheory.predictablePart f ℱ μ n ω) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

docstring:
`G` is bipartite in sets `s` and `t` iff `s` and `t` are disjoint and if vertices `v` and `w`
are adjacent in `G` then `v ∈ s` and `w ∈ t`, or `v ∈ t` and `w ∈ s`.
name: SimpleGraph.IsBipartiteWith
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Set V) (t : Set V) : Prop

docstring:
**Equational criterion for flatness**, alternate form.

A module $M$ is flat if and only if for all finite free modules $R^l$,
all $f \in R^l$, and all linear maps $x \colon R^l \to M$ such that $x(f) = 0$, there
exist a finite free module $R^k$ and linear maps $a \colon R^l \to R^k$ and
$y \colon R^k \to M$ such that $x = y \circ a$ and $a(f) = 0$.
name: Module.Flat.iff_forall_exists_factorization
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ {l : ℕ} {f : Fin l →₀ R} {x : (Fin l →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M}, x f = 0 → ∃ k a y, x = y ∘ₗ a ∧ a f = 0

docstring:
The oriented angle between two vectors is `π` if and only if they are nonzero and the first is
on the same ray as the negation of the second.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_pi_iff_sameRay_neg
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y = ↑Real.pi ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ SameRay ℝ x (-y)

docstring:
Let `O` be the integers of the valuation `v` on some commutative ring `R`. For every element `x` in
`O`, `x` is a unit in `O` if and only if the image of `x` in `R` is a unit and has valuation 1.
name: Valuation.Integers.isUnit_of_one
statement_text: {R : Type u} {Γ₀ : Type v} [CommRing R] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation R Γ₀} {O : Type w} [CommRing O] [Algebra O R] (hv : v.Integers O) {x : O} (hx : IsUnit.{u} (M := R) ((algebraMap O R) x : R)) (hvx : v ((algebraMap O R) x : R) = 1) : IsUnit x

docstring:
Two maps `f : M →ₗ[R] N` and `g : N →ₗ[R] P` are exact if and only if the induced maps
`LinearMap.range f → N → LinearMap.range g` are exact.

statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} {P : Type u_6} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R N] [_root_.Module R P] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} {g : N →ₗ[R] P} : Function.Exact.{u_2, u_4, u_6} (M := M) (N := N) (P := P) ⇑f ⇑g ↔ Function.Exact.{u_4, u_4, u_6} (M := ↥f.range) (N := N) (P := ↥g.range) ⇑f.range.subtype ⇑g.rangeRestrict

docstring:
A meromorphic function has only removable singularities if and only if the logarithmic counting
function for its pole divisor is asymptotically bounded.

docstring:
If `f : ι → G × G` converges to the uniformity, then any `g : ι → G × G`

name: IsLieAbelian
statement_text: (L : Type v) [Bracket L L] [Zero L] : Prop

docstring:
An integral domain is a Dedekind domain if and only if it is

In particular, this definition does not depend on the choice of this fraction field.
name: isDedekindRing_iff

docstring:
Compatibility with scalar multiplication. Note this assumes `𝕜` is a division ring in order to
ensure that for `c ≠ 0`, `c • f` is integrable iff `f` is. For scalar multiplication by more
general rings assuming integrability, see `IntervalIntegrable.integral_smul`.
name: intervalIntegral.integral_smul

docstring:
If `2` is invertible in the coefficient ring,
a quadratic map is nondegenerate iff its radical is 0.

statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {P : Type u_4} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup P] [CommRing R] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R P] {Q : QuadraticMap R M P} [Invertible 2] : QuadraticMap.Nondegenerate.{u_1, u_2, u_4} (R := R) (M := M) (P := P) (Q := Q) ↔ Q.radical = ⊥

docstring: A function to 𝕜 is meromorphic in normal form on `U` iff its inverse is.
name: meromorphicNFOn_fun_inv

docstring: If A ≠ B and C ≠ B then ∠ABC = π if and only if (dist A C) = (dist A B) + (dist B C).

statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} (hp₁p₂ : p₁ ≠ p₂) (hp₃p₂ : p₃ ≠ p₂) : dist p₁ p₃ = dist p₁ p₂ + dist p₃ p₂ ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi

docstring:
`t ∈ ∂^k 𝒜` iff `t` is exactly `k` elements less than something from `𝒜`.

An element of a ring is algebraic over the ring `A` iff it is algebraic
over the field of fractions of `A`.

are.

docstring:
A rational number is a square if and only if it is nonnegative,
and has even `p`-adic valuation for all `p`.

docstring:
A field extension `E / F` is purely inseparable if and only if the relative perfect closure of

docstring:
In a complete space, a function is integrable if and only if its integral sums form a Cauchy
net. Here we restate this fact in terms of `∀ ε > 0, ∃ r, ...`.
name: BoxIntegral.integrable_iff_cauchy_basis
statement_text: {ι : Type u} {E : Type v} {F : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι} [Fintype ι] {l : BoxIntegral.IntegrationParams} {f : (ι → ℝ) → E} {vol : BoxIntegral.BoxAdditiveMap ι (E →L[ℝ] F) ⊤} [CompleteSpace F] : BoxIntegral.Integrable I l f vol ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ r, (∀ (c : NNReal), l.RCond (r c)) ∧ ∀ (c₁ c₂ : NNReal) (π₁ π₂ : BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition I), l.MemBaseSet I c₁ (r c₁) π₁ → π₁.IsPartition → l.MemBaseSet I c₂ (r c₂) π₂ → π₂.IsPartition → dist (BoxIntegral.integralSum f vol π₁) (BoxIntegral.integralSum f vol π₂) ≤ ε

docstring:
When all four morphisms in a square are left adjoints, the mates operation can be iterated:
```
         l₁                  r₁                  r₁
      a --→ b             a ←-- b             a ←-- b
   f₁ ↓  ↗  ↓  f₂      f₁ ↓  ↘  ↓ f₂       u₁ ↑  ↙  ↑ u₂
      c --→ d             c ←-- d             c ←-- d
         l₂                  r₂                  r₂
```
In this case the iterated mate equals the conjugate of the original 2-morphism and is thus an
isomorphism if and only if the original 2-morphism is. This explains why some Beck-Chevalley
2-morphisms are isomorphisms.
name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv
statement_text: {B : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Bicategory.{w, v, u} B] {a : B} {b : B} {c : B} {d : B} {f₁ : a ⟶ c} {u₁ : c ⟶ a} {f₂ : b ⟶ d} {u₂ : d ⟶ b} {l₁ : a ⟶ b} {r₁ : b ⟶ a} {l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adjunction l₁ r₁) (adj₂ : CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adjunction l₂ r₂) (adj₃ : CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adjunction f₁ u₁) (adj₄ : CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adjunction f₂ u₂) (α : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f₁ l₂ ⟶ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp l₁ f₂) : Eq (α := CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp u₂ r₁ ⟶ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp r₂ u₁) ((CategoryTheory.Bicategory.mateEquiv adj₄ adj₃) ((CategoryTheory.Bicategory.mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂) α : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp r₁ f₁ ⟶ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f₂ r₂) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp u₂ r₁ ⟶ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp r₂ u₁) ((CategoryTheory.Bicategory.conjugateEquiv (adj₁.comp adj₄) (adj₃.comp adj₂)) α : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp u₂ r₁ ⟶ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp r₂ u₁)

docstring:
A sequence of functions `Fₙ` converges uniformly on a set `s` to a limiting function `f` w.r.t.
filter `p` iff the function `(n, x) ↦ (f x, Fₙ x)` converges along `p ×ˢ 𝓟 s` to the uniformity.
In other words: one knows nothing about the behavior of `x` in this limit besides it being in `s`.
name: tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendsto
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_4} [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → α → β} {f : α → β} {s : Set α} {p : Filter ι} : TendstoUniformlyOn F f p s ↔ Filter.Tendsto (fun q => (f q.2, F q.1 q.2)) (p ×ˢ Filter.principal s) (uniformity β)

docstring:
Suppose `X Y : SheafedSpace C`, where `C` is a concrete category,
whose forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, preserves limits and filtered colimits.
Then a morphism `X ⟶ Y` that is a topological open embedding
is an open immersion iff every stalk map is an iso.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.of_stalk_iso
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimits.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimits.{v, u} C] {FC : C → C → Type u_1} {CC : C → Type v} [(X Y : C) → FunLike.{u_1 + 1, v + 1, v + 1} (FC X Y) (CC X) (CC Y)] [CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory C FC (CC := CC)] [CategoryTheory.Functor.ReflectsIsomorphisms (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimits (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFilteredColimits (CategoryTheory.forget C (FC := FC) (CC := CC))] {X : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafedSpace.{u, v, v} C} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafedSpace.{u, v, v} C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : Topology.IsOpenEmbedding (X := ↑↑X.toPresheafedSpace) (Y := ↑↑Y.toPresheafedSpace) ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := fun X Y => C(↑X, ↑Y)) (CC := TopCat.carrier) f.hom.base)) [∀ (x : ↑↑X.toPresheafedSpace), CategoryTheory.IsIso (X := Y.presheaf.stalk ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := fun X Y => C(↑X, ↑Y)) (CC := TopCat.carrier) f.hom.base) x)) (AlgebraicGeometry.PresheafedSpace.Hom.stalkMap f.hom x)] : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion f

docstring: A preadditive category is pseudoabelian iff all idempotent endomorphisms have a kernel.
name: CategoryTheory.Idempotents.isIdempotentComplete_iff_idempotents_have_kernels
statement_text: (C : Type u_1) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v_1, u_1} C] : CategoryTheory.IsIdempotentComplete.{v_1, u_1} C ↔ ∀ (X : C) (p : X ⟶ X), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p p = p → CategoryTheory.Limits.HasKernel p

docstring:
A scheme is Noetherian if and only if it is covered by finitely many affine opens whose
sections are Noetherian rings.

statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {ι : Sort u_1} [Finite ι] {S : ι → ↑X.affineOpens} (hS : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := X.Opens) (⨆ i, ↑(S i)) ⊤) : AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian X ↔ ∀ (i : ι), IsNoetherianRing.{u_2} ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ↑(S i)))

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous at `x₀` within `S` iff `range 𝓕` is equicontinuous
at `x₀` within `S`, i.e the family `(↑) : range F → X → α` is equicontinuous at `x₀` within `S`.
name: equicontinuousWithinAt_iff_range

docstring:

docstring:

docstring:
Let `E` be a pre-`0`-hypercover with pairwise pullbacks. If `∐ᵢ Eᵢ` is a universal coproduct
and the presheaf `F` preserves products, then the multifork associated to the single object
`0`-hypercover `{ ∐ᵢ Eᵢ ⟶ S }` is exact if and only if the multifork for `E` is exact.
name: CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover.isLimitSigmaOfIsColimitEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {A : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} A] {S : C} (E : CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover.{w, v_1, u_1} S) [E.HasPullbacks] {c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.{w, v_1, u_1} E.X} (hc : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c) (huniv : CategoryTheory.IsUniversalColimit c) [(E.sigmaOfIsColimit hc).HasPullbacks] [∀ (i : E.I₀), CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullback (E.f i) ((E.sigmaOfIsColimit hc).f PUnit.unit)] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} Cᵒᵖ A) [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimit.{w, w, v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} (J := CategoryTheory.Discrete E.toPreOneHypercover.I₀) (CategoryTheory.Discrete.functor fun i => Opposite.op (E.toPreOneHypercover.X i)) F] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimit.{w, w, v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} (J := CategoryTheory.Discrete E.toPreOneHypercover.I₁') (CategoryTheory.Discrete.functor fun i => Opposite.op (E.toPreOneHypercover.Y' i)) F] : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit ((E.sigmaOfIsColimit hc).toPreOneHypercover.multifork F) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (E.toPreOneHypercover.multifork F)

docstring: `G.IsBipartite` if and only if `G.IsBipartiteWith s t`.
name: SimpleGraph.isBipartite_iff_exists_isBipartiteWith
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} : G.IsBipartite ↔ ∃ s t, G.IsBipartiteWith s t

for the Zariski topology and satisfies the sheaf property for all single object coverings
`{ f : Spec S ⟶ Spec R }` where `f` satisfies `P`.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSheaf_type_propQCTopology_iff
statement_text: {P : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsMultiplicative] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u, u_1, u + 1, u_1 + 1} AlgebraicGeometry.Schemeᵒᵖ (Type u_1)) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsZariskiLocalAtSource P] : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.propQCTopology P) F ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.zariskiTopology F ∧ ∀ {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S), P (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map f) → AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map f) → CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor F (CategoryTheory.Presieve.singleton (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map f))

docstring:

then `f` is an immersion at `x` if and only if `g` is an immersion at `x`.
name: Manifold.IsImmersionAtOfComplement.congr_iff_of_eventuallyEq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {E'' : Type u} {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E''] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {H : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace H] {G : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace G] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E'' G} {M : Type u_11} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {N : Type u_13} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : M → N} {g : M → N} {x : M} (hfg : f =ᶠ[nhds x] g) : Manifold.IsImmersionAtOfComplement F I J n f x ↔ Manifold.IsImmersionAtOfComplement F I J n g x

docstring:
The inner product between two vectors is zero if and only if the first vector is zero or
the second is a multiple of a `π / 2` rotation of that vector.
name: Orientation.inner_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_smul_rotation_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : inner ℝ x y = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∨ ∃ r, HSMul.hSMul (β := V) r ((o.rotation ↑(Real.pi / 2)) x : V) = y

docstring: A subring `t` includes `closure s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: Subring.closure_le

docstring:

a colimit cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.isLimitEquivIsColimitOp

docstring:
The induced property by a local property `P`: it is satisfied for `f` at `x` iff there exist
charts `φ` and `ψ` of `M` and `N` around `x` and `f x`, respectively, such that `f` satisfies `P`
w.r.t. `φ` and `ψ`.

The motivating examples are smooth immersions and submersions: the corresponding condition is that
`f` look like the inclusion `u ↦ (u, 0)` (resp. a projection `(u, v) ↦ u`)
in the charts `φ` and `ψ`.
name: Manifold.LiftSourceTargetPropertyAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_4} {H : Type u_6} {G : Type u_8} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace G] (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) (J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 F G) {M : Type u_10} {N : Type u_12} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (f : M → N) (x : M) (P : (M → N) → OpenPartialHomeomorph M H → OpenPartialHomeomorph N G → Prop) : Prop

docstring:
**Łoś's Theorem**: A sentence is true in an ultraproduct if and only if the set of structures
it is true in is in the ultrafilter.
name: FirstOrder.Language.Ultraproduct.sentence_realize
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {M : α → Type u_2} {u : Ultrafilter α} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [(a : α) → FirstOrder.Language.Structure.{u, v, u_2} L (M a)] [∀ (a : α), Nonempty.{u_2 + 1} (M a)] (φ : L.Sentence) : (↑u).Product M ⊨ φ ↔ ∀ᶠ (a : α) in ↑u, FirstOrder.Language.Sentence.Realize.{u, v, u_2} (M a) φ

docstring:
If `x` in a `R' = S⁻¹ R`-module `M'`, then for a submodule `N'` of `M'`,
`s • x ∈ N'` if and only if `x ∈ N'` for some `s` in S.
name: IsLocalization.smul_mem_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_4} [CommSemiring R] {S : Submonoid R} {R' : Type u_5} [CommSemiring R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsLocalization S R'] {M' : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M'] [_root_.Module R' M'] [_root_.Module R M'] [IsScalarTower R R' M'] {N' : Submodule R' M'} {x : M'} {s : ↥S} : s • x ∈ N' ↔ x ∈ N'

docstring: A function `f` is differentiable at `conj z` iff `star ∘ f ∘ conj` is differentiable at `z`.
name: differentiableAt_star_conj_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [StarRing 𝕜] {F : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [StarAddMonoid F] [StarModule 𝕜 F] [ContinuousStar F] {x : 𝕜} [NormedStarGroup 𝕜] {f : 𝕜 → F} : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (star ∘ f ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜)) x ↔ DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f ((starRingEnd 𝕜) x)

docstring:
A finite group `G` is a Z-group if and only if `G` is isomorphic to a semidirect product of two
cyclic subgroups of coprime order.
name: isZGroup_iff_exists_mulEquiv
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] [Finite G] : IsZGroup G ↔ ∃ N H φ x, IsCyclic.{u_1} ↥H ∧ IsCyclic.{u_1} ↥N ∧ (Nat.card.{u_1} ↥N).Coprime (Nat.card.{u_1} ↥H)

docstring: A functor between Cartesian monoidal categories is monoidal iff it preserves finite products.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.Monoidal.nonempty_monoidal_iff_preservesFiniteProducts
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v₂, u₂} D] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) : Nonempty F.Monoidal ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteProducts F

docstring: In a monoid, an element `a` divides an element `b` iff all associates of `a` divide `b`.
name: Units.mul_right_dvd
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Monoid α] {a : α} {b : α} {u : αˣ} : a * ↑u ∣ b ↔ a ∣ b

docstring: Congruence holds if and only if all non-negative distances are the same.
name: congruent_iff_nndist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Congruent v₁ v₂ ↔ ∀ (i₁ i₂ : ι), nndist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = nndist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous at `x₀` iff `range 𝓕` is equicontinuous at `x₀`,
i.e the family `(↑) : range F → X → α` is equicontinuous at `x₀`.
name: equicontinuousAt_iff_range
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {x₀ : X} : EquicontinuousAt F x₀ ↔ EquicontinuousAt (ι := { x : X → α // x ∈ Set.range F }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range F)) x₀

docstring: If `X` and `Y` are isomorphic, then `X` is terminal iff `Y` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.equivOfIso
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v₁, u₁} X ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v₁, u₁} Y

docstring: Two permutations `f g : Perm α` have the same cycle factors iff they are the same.
name: Equiv.Perm.cycleFactorsFinset_injective
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] : Function.Injective.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} (α := Equiv.Perm α) Equiv.Perm.cycleFactorsFinset

docstring: A closed set is nowhere dense iff its interior is empty.
name: IsClosed.isNowhereDense_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} (hs : IsClosed s) : IsNowhereDense s ↔ interior s = ∅

docstring:
The integral of a function taking values in a finite-dimensional space
against `geometricMeasure p` is given by its sum weighted by `(1 - p) ^ n * p`. This version
does not require integrability, as the integral exists if and only if the sum exists, and otherwise
they are both defined to be zero.

See `integral_geometricMeasure'` with a general codomain which assumes integrability.
name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_geometricMeasure
statement_text: {p : ↑unitInterval} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hp : p ≠ 0) (f : ℕ → E) : Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := E) (∫ (n : ℕ), f n ∂ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) (∑' (n : ℕ), ((1 - ↑p) ^ n * ↑p) • f n)

docstring:
A point `c` belongs the perpendicular bisector of `[p₁, p₂]` iff `c -ᵥ midpoint ℝ p₁ p₂` is
orthogonal to `p₂ -ᵥ p₁`.
name: AffineSubspace.mem_perpBisector_iff_inner_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {c : P} {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} : Membership.mem (γ := AffineSubspace ℝ P) (AffineSubspace.perpBisector p₁ p₂) c ↔ inner ℝ (c -ᵥ midpoint ℝ p₁ p₂) (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) = 0

docstring:
With `z ≤ w` iff `w - z` is real and nonnegative, `ℝ` and `ℂ` are star ordered rings.
(That is, a star ring in which the nonnegative elements are those of the form `star z * z`.)

Note this is only an instance with `open scoped ComplexOrder`.
name: RCLike.toStarOrderedRing
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [RCLike K] : StarOrderedRing K

docstring: A module is Artinian iff every nonempty set of submodules has a minimal submodule among them.
name: set_has_minimal_iff_artinian
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] : (∀ (a : Set (Submodule R M)), a.Nonempty → ∃ M' ∈ a, ∀ I ∈ a, ¬I < M') ↔ IsArtinian R M

docstring: A nilpotent p-group is non-cyclic iff it has two distinct subgroups of index `p`.
name: IsPGroup.not_isCyclic_iff_exists_ne_index_eq_prime
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [Group.IsNilpotent G] [IsCoatomic.{u_1} (Subgroup G)] (hG : IsPGroup p G) : ¬IsCyclic G ↔ ∃ H₁ H₂, H₁ ≠ H₂ ∧ H₁.index = p ∧ H₂.index = p

docstring: For any `w`, the Fourier integral is convergent iff `f` is integrable.
name: VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [CommRing 𝕜] {V : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module 𝕜 V] [MeasurableSpace V] {W : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup W] [_root_.Module 𝕜 W] {E : Type u_4} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [TopologicalSpace 𝕜] [IsTopologicalRing 𝕜] [TopologicalSpace V] [BorelSpace V] [TopologicalSpace W] {e : AddChar 𝕜 Circle} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure V} {L : V →ₗ[𝕜] W →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (he : Continuous (X := 𝕜) (Y := Circle) ⇑e) (hL : Continuous (Y := 𝕜) fun (p : V × W) => (L p.1 : W →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) p.2) {f : V → E} (w : W) : MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_4, u_2} (ε := E) (fun v => HSMul.hSMul (α := Circle) (e (-(L v : W →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) w) : Circle) (f v)) μ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ

docstring: A space is preirreducible iff all nonempty open sets are dense.
name: preirreducibleSpace_iff_open_dense
statement_text: (X : Type u_3) [TopologicalSpace X] : PreirreducibleSpace X ↔ ∀ ⦃U : Set X⦄, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → Dense U

docstring:
A vector addition is cancellative if it is pointwise injective on the left and right.

A group action is cancellative in this sense if and only if it is **free**.
See `isCancelVAdd_iff_eq_zero_of_vadd_eq` for a more familiar condition.
name: IsCancelVAdd
statement_text: (G : Type u_9) (P : Type u_10) [VAdd G P] : Prop

docstring:
A Grothendieck topology associated to the category of all types.
A sieve is a covering iff it is jointly surjective.
name: CategoryTheory.typesGrothendieckTopology
statement_text: : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology (Type u)

docstring:
`γ` is an integral curve for `v` at `t₀` iff `γ` is an integral curve on some interval
containing `t₀`.
name: isIntegralCurveAt_iff_exists_pos
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {γ : ℝ → E} {v : ℝ → E → E} {t₀ : ℝ} : IsIntegralCurveAt γ v t₀ ↔ ∃ ε > 0, IsIntegralCurveOn γ v (Metric.ball t₀ ε)

docstring:
If two left extensions `E` and `E'` are isomorphic, `E` is a pointwise
left Kan extension iff `E'` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.LeftExtension.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionEquivOfIso
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} {H : Type u_4} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_4, u_4} H] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_4, u_1, u_4} C H} {E : L.LeftExtension F} {E' : L.LeftExtension F} (e : E ≅ E') : E.IsPointwiseLeftKanExtension ≃ E'.IsPointwiseLeftKanExtension

docstring: A set `s` is closed and nowhere dense iff its complement `sᶜ` is open and dense.
name: isClosed_isNowhereDense_iff_compl
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsClosed s ∧ IsNowhereDense s ↔ IsOpen sᶜ ∧ Dense sᶜ

docstring:
Two vectors are in the same ray, or they are nonzero and the first is in the same ray as the
negation of the second, if and only if they are not linearly independent.
name: sameRay_or_ne_zero_and_sameRay_neg_iff_not_linearIndependent
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] {x : M} {y : M} : SameRay R x y ∨ x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ SameRay R x (-y) ↔ ¬LinearIndependent R ![x, y]

docstring:
A positive solution is a generator (up to sign) of the group of all solutions to the
Pell equation `x^2 - d*y^2 = 1` if and only if it is a fundamental solution.
name: Pell.pos_generator_iff_fundamental
statement_text: {d : ℤ} (a : Pell.Solution₁ d) : (1 < a.x ∧ 0 < a.y ∧ ∀ (b : Pell.Solution₁ d), ∃ n, b = a ^ n ∨ b = -a ^ n) ↔ Pell.IsFundamental a

docstring: A simple graph-valued map is measurable iff all induced adjacency maps are measurable.
name: SimpleGraph.measurable_iff_adj
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {G : Ω → SimpleGraph V} : Measurable G ↔ ∀ (u v : V), Measurable (β := Prop) fun (ω : Ω) => (G ω).Adj u v

docstring:
A map from a compact space to a T2 space is a homeomorphism iff it is continuous and
bijective.
name: isHomeomorph_iff_continuous_bijective
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} [CompactSpace X] [T2Space Y] : IsHomeomorph f ↔ Continuous f ∧ Function.Bijective f

docstring:
A set `s` is closed iff for every point `x`, if there is a point `y` close to `x` that belongs
to `s` then `x` is in `s`.
name: isClosed_iff_frequently
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsClosed s ↔ ∀ (x : X), (∃ᶠ (y : X) in nhds x, y ∈ s) → x ∈ s

docstring:
Given an affinely independent family of points, a weighted subtraction lies in the
`vectorSpan` of two points given as affine combinations if and only if it is a weighted
subtraction with weights a multiple of the difference between the weights of the two points.
name: weightedVSub_mem_vectorSpan_pair
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} {p : ι → P} (h : AffineIndependent k p) {w : ι → k} {w₁ : ι → k} {w₂ : ι → k} {s : Finset ι} (hw : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 0) (hw₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₁ i = 1) (hw₂ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₂ i = 1) : Membership.mem (α := V) (γ := Submodule k V) (vectorSpan k (P := P) (insert (α := P) ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₁ : P) (singleton (α := P) ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₂ : P)))) ((s.weightedVSub p) w : V) ↔ ∃ r, ∀ i ∈ s, w i = r * (w₁ i - w₂ i)

docstring:
Let `X` be a topological space, `𝔖` a family of compact subsets of `X` and
`α` a uniform space. An equicontinuous subset of `X → α` is closed in the topology of uniform
convergence on all `K ∈ 𝔖` iff it is closed in the topology of pointwise convergence on `⋃₀ 𝔖`.
name: EquicontinuousOn.isClosed_range_pi_of_uniformOnFun'
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {𝔖 : Set (Set X)} (𝔖_compact : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, IsCompact K) (F_eqcont : ∀ K ∈ 𝔖, EquicontinuousOn F K) (H : IsClosed (X := UniformOnFun X α 𝔖) (Set.range (⇑(UniformOnFun.ofFun 𝔖) ∘ F))) : IsClosed (Set.range ((⋃₀ 𝔖).domRestrict (π := fun a => α) ∘ F))

docstring:
If `F ≤ E` are two intermediate fields of `L / K` such that `[L : F]` is finite,
then `F = E` iff `[L : F] = [L : E]`.
name: IntermediateField.eq_iff_finrank_eq_of_le'
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] {F : IntermediateField K L} {E : IntermediateField K L} [FiniteDimensional (↥F) L] (h_le : F ≤ E) : F = E ↔ Module.finrank (↥F) L = Module.finrank (↥E) L

docstring:
The (Loewner) partial order on continuous linear maps on a Hilbert space determined by
`f ≤ g` if and only if `g - f` is a positive linear map (in the sense of
`ContinuousLinearMap.IsPositive`). With this partial order, the continuous linear maps form a
`StarOrderedRing`.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.instLoewnerPartialOrder
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] : PartialOrder (E →L[𝕜] E)

docstring:
A set in a σ-finite space has positive measure if and only if its intersection with
some member of the countable family of finite measure spanning sets has positive measure.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.exists_measure_inter_spanningSets_pos
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] (s : Set α) : (∃ n, 0 < μ (s ∩ MeasureTheory.spanningSets μ n)) ↔ 0 < μ s

docstring:
A set `s` is compact if and only if for every family of closed sets whose intersection is
disjoint from `s`, there exists a finite subfamily whose intersection is disjoint from `s`.
name: isCompact_iff_finite_subfamily_closed
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsCompact s ↔ ∀ {ι : Type u} (t : ι → Set X), (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (t i)) → Disjoint s (⋂ i, t i) → ∃ u, Disjoint s (⋂ i ∈ u, t i)

docstring: The leading term in a multivariate polynomial is zero if and only if this polynomial is zero.
name: MonomialOrder.leadingTerm_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {σ : Type u_1} {m : MonomialOrder.{u_1, u_3} σ} {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : m.leadingTerm p = 0 ↔ p = 0

docstring:
`v ∈ Kᗮ` if and only if `⟪v, u⟫ = 0` for all `u ∈ K`.
Variation of `mem_orthogonal` with the inner product reversed.
name: Submodule.mem_orthogonal'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) (v : E) : v ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ u ∈ K, inner 𝕜 v u = 0

docstring:
The Frobenius morphism for an adjunction `L ⊣ F` at `A` is given by the morphism

    L(FA ⨯ B) ⟶ LFA ⨯ LB ⟶ A ⨯ LB

natural in `B`, where the first morphism is the product comparison and the latter uses the counit
of the adjunction.

We will show that if `C` and `D` are Cartesian closed, then this morphism is an isomorphism for all
`A` iff `F` is a Cartesian closed functor, i.e. it preserves exponentials.
name: CategoryTheory.frobeniusMorphism
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {D : Type u'} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u'} D] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u'} D] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v, u, u'} C D) {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v, u', u} D C} (h : L ⊣ F) (A : C) : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft (F.obj A)) L L (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft A)

docstring: A permutation is a product of transpositions if and only if it has finite support.
name: mem_closure_isSwap'
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} [DecidableEq α] {f : Equiv.Perm α} : Membership.mem (γ := Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α)) (Subgroup.closure {σ | σ.IsSwap}) f ↔ (MulAction.fixedBy α f)ᶜ.Finite

docstring:
The characteristic function of a measure is a product of
characteristic functions if and only if it is a product measure.
This is the version for Banach spaces, see `charFun_eq_pi_iff`
for the Hilbert space version.
name: MeasureTheory.charFunDual_eq_pi_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {E : ι → Type u_5} [(i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [(i : ι) → NormedSpace ℝ (E i)] {mE : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (E i)} [∀ (i : ι), BorelSpace.{u_5} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), SecondCountableTopology.{u_5} (E i)] [∀ (i : ι), CompleteSpace.{u_5} (E i)] {μ : (i : ι) → MeasureTheory.Measure (E i)} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : ι) → E i)} [∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] : (∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ ((i : ι) → E i)), MeasureTheory.charFunDual ν L = ∏ i : ι, MeasureTheory.charFunDual (μ i) (ContinuousLinearMap.comp (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) L (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ E i))) ↔ ν = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (α := E) μ

docstring:
A ring homomorphism between local rings is a local ring hom iff it reflects units,
i.e. any preimage of a unit is still a unit.
name: IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [IsLocalRing R] [CommSemiring S] [IsLocalRing S] (f : R →+* S) : [IsLocalHom (R := R) (S := S) f, ⇑f '' ↑(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ⊆ ↑(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S), LE.le (α := Ideal S) (Ideal.map f (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S), LE.le (α := Ideal R) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (Ideal.comap f (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)), Eq (α := Ideal R) (Ideal.comap f (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)].TFAE

docstring:
If `f : X → Z` is a surjective Borel measurable map from a standard Borel space
to a countably separated measurable space,
then for any measurable space `α` and `g : Z → α`, the composition
`g ∘ f` is measurable if and only if `g` is measurable.
name: Measurable.measurable_comp_iff_of_surjective
statement_text: {X : Type u_3} {Z : Type u_5} {β : Type u_6} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] {f : X → Z} (hf : Measurable f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) {g : Z → β} : Measurable (g ∘ f) ↔ Measurable g

docstring:
A morphism `g : X ⟶ Y` is epi with an injective kernel iff there exists a morphism
`f : I ⟶ X` with `I` injective such that `f ≫ g = 0` and
the short complex `I ⟶ X ⟶ Y` has a splitting.
name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.epiWithInjectiveKernel_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{v_1, u_1} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (g : X ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.Abelian.epiWithInjectiveKernel g ↔ ∃ I, ∃ (_ : CategoryTheory.Injective.{v_1, u_1} I), ∃ f, ∃ (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g = 0), Nonempty.{v_1 + 1} { X₁ := I, X₂ := X, X₃ := Y, f := f, g := g, zero := w : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.{v_1, u_1} C }.Splitting

docstring:
Suppose an indexed family of points is given, along with a subset
of the index type.  A point can be expressed as an
`affineCombination` using a `Finset` lying within that subset and
with sum of weights 1 if and only if it can be expressed an
`affineCombination` with sum of weights 1 for the corresponding
indexed family whose index type is the subtype corresponding to that
subset.
name: Finset.eq_affineCombination_subset_iff_eq_affineCombination_subtype
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} {p0 : P} {s : Set ι} {p : ι → P} : (∃ fs, ↑fs ⊆ s ∧ ∃ w, ∑ i ∈ fs, w i = 1 ∧ p0 = (Finset.affineCombination k fs p) w) ↔ ∃ fs w, ∑ i ∈ fs, w i = 1 ∧ p0 = (Finset.affineCombination k fs fun i => p ↑i) w

docstring:
Let `S` be a Dedekind domain that is torsion-free over a domain `R`, and let `p ≠ ⊥` be an
ideal of `R`. Then `p` is unramified in `S` if and only if `S` is unramified at every maximal
ideal `P` of `S` lying over `p`.

See `Algebra.isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_of_isDedekindDomain` if `R` is of characteristic zero.
name: Algebra.isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_of_isDedekindDomain'
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsDomain R] [IsDedekindDomain S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S] {p : Ideal R} (hp : p ≠ ⊥) : Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn S p ↔ ∀ (P : Ideal S) (x : P.IsMaximal), P.LiesOver p → Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P

docstring:
A sequence of functions `Fₙ` converges uniformly on a filter `p'` to a limiting function `f` w.r.t.
filter `p` iff the function `(n, x) ↦ (f x, Fₙ x)` converges along `p ×ˢ p'` to the uniformity.
In other words: one knows nothing about the behavior of `x` in this limit besides it being in `p'`.
name: tendstoUniformlyOnFilter_iff_tendsto
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_4} [UniformSpace β] {F : ι → α → β} {f : α → β} {p : Filter ι} {p' : Filter α} : TendstoUniformlyOnFilter F f p p' ↔ Filter.Tendsto (fun q => (f q.2, F q.1 q.2)) (p ×ˢ p') (uniformity β)

docstring:
`v ∈ Kᗮ` if and only if `re ⟪u, v⟫ = 0` for all `u ∈ K`; it suffices to check only the
real part of the inner product is zero.
name: ClosedSubmodule.mem_orthogonal_iff_re_inner_eq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_4} {E : Type u_5} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {K : ClosedSubmodule 𝕜 E} {v : E} : v ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ u ∈ K, RCLike.re (inner 𝕜 u v) = 0

docstring:
In a finite-dimensional inner product space,
a set of measures `S` is tight if and only if the function `r ↦ ⨆ μ ∈ S, μ {x | r < |⟪y, x⟫|}`
tends to `0` at infinity for all `y`.
name: MeasureTheory.isTightMeasureSet_iff_inner_tendsto
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {S : Set (MeasureTheory.Measure E)} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (𝕜 : Type u_2) [RCLike 𝕜] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] : MeasureTheory.IsTightMeasureSet S ↔ ∀ (y : E), Filter.Tendsto (fun (r : ℝ) => ⨆ μ ∈ S, μ {x | r < ‖inner 𝕜 y x‖}) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

docstring:
If `E / F` is algebraic, then an intermediate field of `E / F` contains the
separable closure of `F` in `E` if and only if `E` is purely inseparable over it.
name: separableClosure_le_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (L : IntermediateField F E) : separableClosure F E ≤ L ↔ IsPurelyInseparable (↥L) E

docstring:
The characteristic function of a measure is a product of
characteristic functions if and only if it is a product measure.
This is `charFunDual_eq_prod_iff` for `WithLp`.
See `charFun_eq_prod_iff` for the Hilbert space version.
name: MeasureTheory.charFunDual_eq_prod_iff'
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {mF : MeasurableSpace F} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure F} [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] (p : ENNReal) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] [BorelSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology F] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] {ξ : MeasureTheory.Measure (E × F)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ξ] : (∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ (WithLp p (E × F))), MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace p (E × F)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (WithLp.toLp p) ξ) L = MeasureTheory.charFunDual μ (L ∘SL ↑(ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F)) ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E F) * MeasureTheory.charFunDual ν (L ∘SL ↑(ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F)) ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E F)) ↔ ξ = μ.prod ν

docstring:
For subgraphs `G₁`, `G₂`, `G₁ ≤ G₂` iff `G₁.verts ⊆ G₂.verts` and
`∀ a b, G₁.adj a b → G₂.adj a b`.
name: SimpleGraph.Subgraph.instPartialOrder
statement_text: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} : PartialOrder G.Subgraph

docstring:
This is stated as a lemma to prevent class search from forming a loop since a sheaf morphism is
monic if and only if it is monic as a presheaf morphism (under suitable assumption).
name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.Hom.mono_of_presheaf_mono
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v₁, u₁} C) (A : Type u₂) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} A] {F : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} J A} {G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} J A} (f : F ⟶ G) [CategoryTheory.Mono f.hom] : CategoryTheory.Mono f

docstring:
A square matrix is row stochastic iff all entries are nonnegative, and right
multiplication by the vector of all 1s gives the vector of all 1s.
name: Matrix.rowStochastic
statement_text: (R : Type u_3) (n : Type u_4) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] : Submonoid (Matrix n n R)

docstring:
A commutative algebra is finitely generated if and only if it is a quotient
of a polynomial ring whose variables are indexed by a fintype.
name: Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial'
statement_text: {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] : Algebra.FiniteType R S ↔ ∃ ι x f, Function.Surjective (α := MvPolynomial ι R) (β := S) ⇑f

docstring: An action is preprimitive iff it is `1`-preprimitive.
name: AddAction.is_zero_preprimitive_iff
statement_text: (M : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [AddGroup M] [AddAction M α] : AddAction.IsMultiplyPreprimitive M α 1 ↔ AddAction.IsPreprimitive M α

docstring: Two paths are equal in the fundamental groupoid if and only if they are homotopic.
name: FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath_eq_iff_homotopic
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {x₀ : X} {x₁ : X} (f : Path x₀ x₁) (g : Path x₀ x₁) : FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk f) = FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk g) ↔ f.Homotopic g

docstring: Functions are harmonic iff their compositions with continuous linear equivalences are harmonic.
name: InnerProductSpace.harmonicOnNhd_comp_CLE_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {G : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] {f : E → F} {s : Set E} (l : F ≃L[ℝ] G) : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd.{u_1, u_3} (F := G) (⇑l ∘ f) s ↔ InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd f s

docstring: A subgraph of a connected graph is maximal acyclic iff it is a tree.
name: SimpleGraph.Connected.maximal_le_isAcyclic_iff_isTree
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {T : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.Connected) (hT : T ≤ G) : Maximal (fun H => H ≤ G ∧ H.IsAcyclic) T ↔ T.IsTree

docstring:
If `f` is an affine map, then its linear part is a closed embedding iff `f` is a closed
embedding.
name: AffineMap.isClosedEmbedding_linear_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} {Q : Type u_5} [AddCommGroup V] [TopologicalSpace V] [AddTorsor V P] [TopologicalSpace P] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor P] [AddCommGroup W] [TopologicalSpace W] [AddTorsor W Q] [TopologicalSpace Q] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor Q] [Ring R] [_root_.Module R V] [_root_.Module R W] {f : P →ᵃ[R] Q} : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.{u_2, u_4} (X := V) (Y := W) ⇑f.linear ↔ Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.{u_3, u_5} (X := P) (Y := Q) ⇑f

docstring:
If `g : ι → G × G` converges to the uniformity, then any `f : ι → G × G`
converges to the uniformity iff `f + g` does. This is often useful when `g` is valued in the
diagonal, in which case its convergence is automatic.
name: Filter.Tendsto.uniformity_add_iff_left
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [UniformSpace α] [AddGroup α] [IsUniformAddGroup α] {ι : Type u_3} {f : ι → α × α} {g : ι → α × α} {l : Filter ι} (hg : Filter.Tendsto g l (uniformity α)) : Filter.Tendsto (f + g) l (uniformity α) ↔ Filter.Tendsto f l (uniformity α)

docstring:
The span of a set of points is contained in a subspace if and only if the set of points is
contained in the subspace.
name: Projectivization.Subspace.span_le_subspace_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {S : Set (Projectivization K V)} {W : Projectivization.Subspace K V} : Projectivization.Subspace.span S ≤ W ↔ S ⊆ ↑W

docstring: A reflexive cofork is a colimit cocone if and only if the underlying cofork is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.ReflexiveCofork.isColimitEquiv
