statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{0, v, 0, u} CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingReflexivePair C) (G : CategoryTheory.Limits.ReflexiveCofork F) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit G.toCofork ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit G

docstring:
Composing a basis with a linear equiv gives the same orientation if and only if the
determinant is positive.
name: Module.Basis.orientation_comp_linearEquiv_eq_iff_det_pos
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {ι : Type u_3} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (e : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) : Eq (α := Orientation R M ι) (e.map f).orientation e.orientation ↔ 0 < LinearMap.det ↑f

docstring:
If `f : ι → G × G` converges to the uniformity, then any `g : ι → G × G` converges to the
uniformity iff `f * g` does. This is often useful when `f` is valued in the diagonal,
in which case its convergence is automatic.
name: Filter.Tendsto.uniformity_mul_iff_right
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [UniformSpace α] [Group α] [IsUniformGroup α] {ι : Type u_3} {f : ι → α × α} {g : ι → α × α} {l : Filter ι} (hf : Filter.Tendsto f l (uniformity α)) : Filter.Tendsto (f * g) l (uniformity α) ↔ Filter.Tendsto g l (uniformity α)

docstring:
Similarity holds if and only if all extended distances between points with different
indices are proportional.
name: similar_iff_exists_pairwise_edist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoEMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoEMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ Pairwise fun (i₁ : ι) i₂ => edist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = ↑r * edist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
`y` is a conjugate root of `x` over `K` if and only if `y` is a root of the minimal polynomial of
`x`. This is variant of `isConjRoot_iff_aeval_eq_zero`.
name: isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_aroots
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {S : Type u_4} [CommRing S] [Field K] [Algebra K S] [IsDomain S] {x : S} {y : S} (h : IsIntegral K x) : IsConjRoot K x y ↔ y ∈ Polynomial.aroots (minpoly K x) S

docstring:
A map between metric spaces is a uniform embedding if and only if the distance between `f x`
and `f y` is controlled in terms of the distance between `x` and `y` and conversely.
name: Metric.isUniformEmbedding_iff'
statement_text: {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} [MetricSpace γ] [PseudoMetricSpace β] {f : γ → β} : IsUniformEmbedding f ↔ (∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ {a b : γ}, dist a b < δ → dist (f a) (f b) < ε) ∧ ∀ δ > 0, ∃ ε > 0, ∀ {a b : γ}, dist (f a) (f b) < ε → dist a b < δ

docstring: An element of an algebra over a field is algebraic if and only if it is integral.
name: isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral
statement_text: {K : Type u} {A : Type v} [Field K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {x : A} : IsAlgebraic K x ↔ IsIntegral K x

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous on `S` iff `range 𝓕` is equicontinuous on `S`,
i.e the family `(↑) : range F → X → α` is equicontinuous on `S`.
name: equicontinuousOn_iff_range
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {S : Set X} : EquicontinuousOn F S ↔ EquicontinuousOn (ι := { x : X → α // x ∈ Set.range F }) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ Set.range F)) S

docstring: The element `0` is right-regular if and only if `R` is trivial.
name: isRightRegular_zero_iff_subsingleton
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [MulZeroClass R] : IsRightRegular 0 ↔ Subsingleton R

docstring:
A property of morphisms `P` in `C` is local at the target with respect to the precoverage `K` if
it respects isomorphisms, and:
`P` holds for `f : X ⟶ Y` if and only if it holds for the restrictions of `f` to `Uᵢ` for a
`0`-hypercover `{Uᵢ}` of `Y` in the precoverage `K`.
name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtTarget
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.{v, u} C) (K : CategoryTheory.Precoverage.{v, u} C) : Prop

docstring: Twice angles with two vectors are zero if and only if the spans of two vectors are equal.
name: Orientation.two_zsmul_oangle_eq_zero_iff_span_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : 2 • o.oangle x y = 0 ↔ Eq (α := Submodule ℝ V) (ℝ ∙ x) (ℝ ∙ y)

docstring: The sum of a locally finite collection of sections is `C^k` iff each section is.
name: ContMDiff.sum_section_of_locallyFinite
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {V : M → Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace (Bundle.TotalSpace F V)] [(x : M) → TopologicalSpace (V x)] [FiberBundle F V] [(x : M) → AddCommGroup (V x)] [(x : M) → _root_.Module.{u_1, u_6} 𝕜 (V x)] [VectorBundle 𝕜 F V] {ι : Type u_7} {t : ι → (x : M) → V x} (ht : LocallyFinite.{u_7, u_4} (X := M) fun (i : ι) => {x | t i x ≠ 0}) (ht' : ∀ (i : ι), ContMDiff I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n fun (x : M) => ⟨x, t i x⟩) : ContMDiff I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n fun (x : M) => ⟨x, ∑' (i : ι), t i x⟩

docstring:
A space is simply connected iff it is path connected, and there is at most one path
up to homotopy between any two points.
name: simply_connected_iff_paths_homotopic
statement_text: {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace Y] : SimplyConnectedSpace Y ↔ PathConnectedSpace Y ∧ ∀ (x y : Y), Subsingleton.{u_2 + 1} (Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y)

docstring: If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` moves `(j • h) +ᵥ x` iff `g` moves `x`.
name: AddAction.vadd_zsmul_movedBy_eq_of_addCommute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : AddCommute g h) (j : ℤ) : j • h +ᵥ (AddAction.fixedBy α g)ᶜ = (AddAction.fixedBy α g)ᶜ

docstring:
A vector field on a vector space is `C^n` in the manifold sense iff it is `C^n` in the vector
space sense.
name: contMDiffWithinAt_vectorSpace_iff_contDiffWithinAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {V : (x : E) → TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E) x} {s : Set E} {x : E} : ContMDiffWithinAt (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E) (ModelWithCorners.tangent (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace (B := E) E (TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E))) n (fun x => ⟨x, V x⟩) s x ↔ ContDiffWithinAt 𝕜 n V s x

docstring:
In a unital `ℝ`-algebra `A` with a continuous functional calculus, an element `a : A` is larger
than some `algebraMap ℝ A r` if and only if every element of the `ℝ`-spectrum is positive.
name: CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace A] [Ring A] [StarRing A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [Algebra ℝ A] [NonnegSpectrumClass ℝ A] [Nontrivial A] [ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint] (a : A) (ha : autoParam (IsSelfAdjoint a) CFC.exists_pos_algebraMap_le_iff._auto_1) : (∃ r > 0, (algebraMap ℝ A) r ≤ a) ↔ ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ a, 0 < x

docstring:
An indexed set of vectors is linearly dependent iff there is a nontrivial
`Finsupp.linearCombination` of the vectors that is zero.
name: linearDepOn_iff'
statement_text: {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {s : Set ι} {M : Type u_4} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {v : ι → M} : ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∃ f, Membership.mem (γ := Submodule R (ι →₀ R)) (Finsupp.supported R R s) f ∧ (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) f = 0 ∧ f ≠ 0

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is strictly below the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a c < slope f c b`.
name: map_lt_lineMap_iff_slope_lt_slope
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (hab : a < b) (h₀ : 0 < r) (h₁ : r < 1) : f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) < (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ↔ slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) < slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b

docstring:
`t` is in the upper shadow of `𝒜` iff there is a `s ∈ 𝒜` from which we can remove one element
to get `t`.
name: Finset.mem_upShadow_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} : t ∈ 𝒜.upShadow ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, ∃ a ∉ s, insert a s = t

docstring:
If the order of a meromorphic function is negative, then this function converges to infinity
at this point. See also the iff version `tendsto_cobounded_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_neg`.
name: tendsto_cobounded_of_meromorphicOrderAt_neg
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (ho : meromorphicOrderAt f x < 0) : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (Bornology.cobounded E)

docstring:
A property of objects `P.op` is closed under extensions iff `P` is, since a short
complex in `Cᵒᵖ` is short exact iff the corresponding short complex in `C` is.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isClosedUnderExtensions_op_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} C) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions.{v, u} P.op ↔ P.IsClosedUnderExtensions

docstring:
The topology on `Filter α` is generated by the sets `Set.Iic (𝓟 s) = {l : Filter α | s ∈ l}`,
`s : Set α`. A set `s : Set (Filter α)` is open if and only if it is a union of a family of these
basic open sets, see `Filter.isOpen_iff`.
name: Filter.instTopologicalSpace
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} : TopologicalSpace (Filter α)

docstring:
The vertices `v, w₁, w₂` form an `IsPathGraph3Compl` in `G` iff `w₁w₂` is the only edge present
between these three vertices. It is a witness to the non-complete-multipartite-ness of `G` (see
`not_isCompleteMultipartite_iff_exists_isPathGraph3Compl`). This structure is an explicit way of
saying that the induced graph on `{v, w₁, w₂}` is the complement of `P3`.
name: SimpleGraph.IsPathGraph3Compl
statement_text: {α : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph α) (v : α) (w₁ : α) (w₂ : α) : Prop

docstring:
If `f : R → ℝ` is a nonnegative, multiplicatively bounded, subadditive function that preserves
zero and negation, then `seminormFromBounded' f` is a norm if and only if `f⁻¹' {0} = {0}`.
name: seminormFromBounded_is_norm_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {f : R → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (f_zero : f 0 = 0) (f_nonneg : 0 ≤ f) (f_mul : ∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) (f_add : ∀ (a b : R), f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) (f_neg : ∀ (x : R), f (-x) = f x) : (∀ (x : R), (seminormFromBounded f_zero f_nonneg f_mul f_add f_neg).toFun x = 0 → x = 0) ↔ f ⁻¹' {0} = {0}

docstring:
`t` is in the shadow of `𝒜` iff there is a `s ∈ 𝒜` from which we can remove one element to
get `t`.
name: Finset.mem_shadow_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} : t ∈ 𝒜.shadow ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, ∃ a ∈ s, s.erase a = t

docstring:
A binary bicone is a colimit cocone if and only if the corresponding bicone is a colimit
cocone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryBicone.toBiconeIsColimit
statement_text: {C : Type uC} [CategoryTheory.Category.{uC', uC} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{uC', uC} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (b : CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryBicone.{uC', uC} X Y) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit b.toBicone.toCocone ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit b.toCocone

docstring:
A subgroup has index dividing 2 if and only if there exists `a` such that for all `b`, at least
one of `b * a` and `b` belongs to `H`.
name: Subgroup.index_dvd_two_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {H : Subgroup G} : H.index ∣ 2 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : G), b * a ∈ H ∨ b ∈ H

docstring: A linear map is strict if and only if its `rangeRestrict` is an open quotient map.
name: LinearMap.isStrictMap_iff_isOpenQuotientMap_rangeRestrict
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [Ring R] [Ring S] {σ : R →+* S} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module S N] {f : M →ₛₗ[σ] N} [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace N] [IsTopologicalAddGroup M] [RingHomSurjective σ] : Topology.IsStrictMap.{u_3, u_4} (X := M) (Y := N) ⇑f ↔ IsOpenQuotientMap.{u_3, u_4} (X := M) (Y := ↥f.range) ⇑f.rangeRestrict

docstring:
Note that `b ∈ (s.filter (fun ab => Prod.fst ab = a)).image Prod.snd` iff `(a, b) ∈ s` so
we can simplify the right-hand side of this lemma. However the form stated here is more useful for
iterating this lemma, e.g., if we have `f : α × β × γ → M`.
name: finprod_mem_finset_product'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [CommMonoid M] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset (α × β)) (f : α × β → M) : Eq.{u_5 + 1} (α := M) (∏ᶠ (ab : α × β) (_ : ab ∈ s), f ab) (∏ᶠ (a : α) (b : β) (_ : b ∈ Finset.image Prod.snd ({ab ∈ s | ab.1 = a})), f (a, b))

docstring: A sum is finite iff all summands are finite.
name: ENat.sum_ne_top
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℕ∞} : Ne (α := ℕ∞) (∑ a ∈ s, f a) ⊤ ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, f a ≠ ⊤

docstring: A function is `C^k` on two open sets iff it is `C^k` on their union.
name: contMDiffOn_union_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] {E' : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] {H' : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H'] {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'} {M' : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H M] [ChartedSpace H' M'] {f : M → M'} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {s : Set M} {t : Set M} (hs : IsOpen s) (ht : IsOpen t) : ContMDiffOn I I' n f (s ∪ t) ↔ ContMDiffOn I I' n f s ∧ ContMDiffOn I I' n f t

docstring: An iff variation on `ordinaryHypergeometricSeries_eq_zero_of_nonpos_int` for `[RCLike 𝕂]`.
name: ordinaryHypergeometricSeries_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕂 : Type u_1} (𝔸 : Type u_2) [RCLike 𝕂] [NormedDivisionRing 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra 𝕂 𝔸] (a : 𝕂) (b : 𝕂) (c : 𝕂) (n : ℕ) : ordinaryHypergeometricSeries 𝔸 a b c n = 0 ↔ ∃ k < n, ↑k = -a ∨ ↑k = -b ∨ ↑k = -c

docstring:
A set `s` is in the neighbourhood of `a` iff there is some basis set `t`, which
contains `a` and is itself contained in `s`.
name: TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis.mem_nhds_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] {a : α} {s : Set α} {b : Set (Set α)} (hb : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis b) : s ∈ nhds a ↔ ∃ t ∈ b, a ∈ t ∧ t ⊆ s

docstring: The cosine of the angle between three points is 1 if and only if the angle is 0.
name: EuclideanGeometry.cos_eq_one_iff_angle_eq_zero
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃) = 1 ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = 0

docstring: The identity is a semiconjugacy from `ϕ` to `ψ` if and only if `ϕ` and `ψ` are equal.
name: Flow.isSemiconjugacy_id_iff_eq
statement_text: {τ : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace τ] [TopologicalSpace α] [AddMonoid τ] (ϕ : Flow τ α) (ψ : Flow τ α) : Flow.IsSemiconjugacy id ϕ ψ ↔ ϕ = ψ

docstring: A commutative ring `R` is Artinian if and only if `Spec R` is an Artinian scheme.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isLocallyArtinianScheme_Spec
statement_text: {R : CommRingCat} : AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyArtinian.{u_1} (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec R) ↔ IsArtinianRing.{u_1} ↑R

docstring:
Given a formally smooth `R`-algebra `P` and a surjective algebra homomorphism `f : P →ₐ[R] A`
with kernel `I` (typically a presentation `R[X] → A`),
`A` is formally smooth iff the `P`-linear map `I/I² → A ⊗[P] Ω[P⁄R]` is split injective.
Also see `Algebra.Extension.formallySmooth_iff_split_injection`
for the version in terms of `Extension`.
name: Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_split_injection
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] {P : Type u_2} [CommRing P] [Algebra R P] [Algebra.FormallySmooth R P] [Algebra P A] [IsScalarTower R P A] (hf : Function.Surjective.{u_2 + 1, v + 1} (α := P) (β := A) ⇑(algebraMap P A)) : Algebra.FormallySmooth R A ↔ ∃ l, l ∘ₗ KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor R P A = LinearMap.id

docstring: A Hermitian matrix is positive-definite if and only if its eigenvalues are positive.
name: Matrix.IsHermitian.posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {𝕜 : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [RCLike 𝕜] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} [DecidableEq n] (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A.PosDef ↔ ∀ (i : n), 0 < hA.eigenvalues i

docstring: A `NonUnitalSubring` `t` includes `closure s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: NonUnitalSubring.closure_le
statement_text: {R : Type u} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] {s : Set R} {t : NonUnitalSubring R} : NonUnitalSubring.closure s ≤ t ↔ s ⊆ ↑t

docstring:
In a short exact sequence of abelian groups, the middle group is finite iff the first and last
are.
name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.ab_finite_iff
statement_text: {S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex Ab} (hS : S.ShortExact) : Finite.{u + 1} ↑S.X₂ ↔ Finite.{u + 1} ↑S.X₁ ∧ Finite.{u + 1} ↑S.X₃

docstring:
If `f = g` on some neighbourhood of `x`,
then `f` is an immersion at `x` if and only if `g` is an immersion at `x`.
name: Manifold.IsImmersionAt.congr_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {E'' : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E''] {H : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace H] {G : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace G] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E'' G} {M : Type u_11} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {N : Type u_13} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : M → N} {g : M → N} {x : M} (hfg : f =ᶠ[nhds x] g) : Manifold.IsImmersionAt I J n f x ↔ Manifold.IsImmersionAt I J n g x

docstring:
A function is `C^n` within a set at a point iff it is `C^m` within this set at this point, for
any `m ≤ n` which is different from `∞`. This result is useful because, when `m ≠ ∞`, being
`C^m` extends locally to a neighborhood, giving flexibility for local proofs.
name: contMDiffWithinAt_iff_le_ne_infty
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {E' : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] {H' : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H'] {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'} {M' : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M'] {f : M → M'} {s : Set M} {x : M} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} : ContMDiffWithinAt I I' n f s x ↔ ∀ m ≤ n, m ≠ ↑⊤ → ContMDiffWithinAt I I' m f s x

docstring:
If `G` is finite and `k` an algebraically closed field of characteristic `0`,
then an object of `FDRep k G` is simple if and only if its character has norm `1`.
name: FDRep.simple_iff_char_is_norm_one
statement_text: {k : Type u} [Field k] {G : Type u} [Group G] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] [Fintype G] (V : FDRep k G) : CategoryTheory.Simple V ↔ Eq.{u + 1} (α := k) (∑ g : G, V.character g * V.character g⁻¹) ↑(Nat.card G)

docstring:
`zarankiewicz m n s t` is greater than `x` if and only if there
exists a `completeBipartiteGraph α β`-free bipartite graph `G` with more than `x` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.lt_zarankiewicz_iff_of_nonneg
statement_text: {m : ℕ} {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ} {t : ℕ} {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] {R : Type u_5} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [FloorSemiring R] (hm : Fintype.card V = m) (hn : Fintype.card W = n) (hs : Fintype.card α = s) (ht : Fintype.card β = t) {x : R} (h : 0 ≤ x) : x < ↑(SimpleGraph.zarankiewicz m n s t) ↔ ∃ G x_1, G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W ∧ (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G ∧ x < ↑G.edgeFinset.card

docstring:
A point `x` is in the support of measure `μ` iff any neighborhood of `x` contains a
subset with positive measure.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.mem_support_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} {x : X} : x ∈ μ.support ↔ ∃ᶠ (u : Set X) in (nhds x).smallSets, 0 < μ u

docstring:
Let `A` be an essentially of finite type `R`-algebra, `q` be a prime over `p`.
Then `A` is unramified at `p` if and only if `κ(q)/κ(p)` is separable, and `pS_q = qS_q`.
name: Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_map_eq
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.EssFiniteType R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] [Algebra.{u_1, u_2} (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} R (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)] : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R q ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable.{u_1, u_2} p.ResidueField q.ResidueField ∧ Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := Ideal (Localization.AtPrime q)) (Ideal.map (F := RingHom.{u_1, u_2} R (Localization.AtPrime q)) (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)) p) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))

docstring:
A property of objects `P.op` is closed under subobjects iff `P` is closed under
quotients, since monomorphisms in `Cᵒᵖ` correspond to epimorphisms in `C`.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isClosedUnderSubobjects_op_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} C) : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderSubobjects.{v, u} P.op ↔ P.IsClosedUnderQuotients

docstring:
A set is affinely independent if and only if the differences from
a base point in that set are linearly independent.
name: affineIndependent_set_iff_linearIndependent_vsub
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} {p₁ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ s) : (AffineIndependent k (P := P) fun (p : ↑s) => ↑p) ↔ LinearIndependent k (M := V) fun (v : ↑((fun p => p -ᵥ p₁) '' (s \ {p₁}))) => ↑v

docstring:
A function is partial recursive if and only if there is a code implementing it. Therefore,
`eval` is a **universal partial recursive function**.
name: Nat.Partrec.Code.exists_code
statement_text: {f : ℕ →. ℕ} : Nat.Partrec f ↔ ∃ c, c.eval = f

docstring: A subalgebra is algebraic if and only if it is algebraic as an algebra.
name: Subalgebra.isAlgebraic_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : Subalgebra R A) : S.IsAlgebraic ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic.{u, v} R ↥S

docstring:
The defining property of the weak operator topology: a function `f` tends to
`A : E →WOT[𝕜] F` along filter `l` iff `⟪y, (f a) x⟫` tends to `⟪y, A x⟫` along the same filter.
name: ContinuousLinearMapWOT.tendsto_iff_forall_inner_apply_tendsto
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [TopologicalSpace E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F] {α : Type u_4} {l : Filter α} {f : α → E →WOT[𝕜] F} {A : E →WOT[𝕜] F} : Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds A) ↔ ∀ (x : E) (y : F), Filter.Tendsto (fun a => inner 𝕜 y ((f a) x)) l (nhds (inner 𝕜 y (A x)))

docstring:
If `i` is an `F`-algebra homomorphism from `E` to `K`, then `i x` is contained in
`separableClosure F K` if and only if `x` is contained in `separableClosure F E`.
name: map_mem_separableClosure_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {K : Type w} [Field K] [Algebra F K] (i : E →ₐ[F] K) {x : E} : Membership.mem (α := K) (γ := IntermediateField F K) (separableClosure F K) (i x : K) ↔ Membership.mem (γ := IntermediateField F E) (separableClosure F E) x

docstring:
Two elements are related by a congruence relation `c` iff they are represented by the same
element of the quotient by `c`.
name: RingCon.eq
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Add R] [Mul R] (c : RingCon R) {a : R} {b : R} : Eq (α := c.Quotient) ↑a ↑b ↔ c a b

docstring:
`extremalNumber (card V) H` is greater than `x` if and only if there exists a `H`-free simple
graph `G` with more than `x` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.lt_extremalNumber_iff_of_nonneg
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [Fintype V] {R : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [FloorSemiring R] (H : SimpleGraph W) {m : R} (h : 0 ≤ m) : m < ↑(SimpleGraph.extremalNumber (Fintype.card V) H) ↔ ∃ G x, H.Free G ∧ m < ↑G.edgeFinset.card

docstring: `A.toMatrix` is positive semi-definite if and only if `A` is positive.
name: LinearMap.posSemidef_toMatrix_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {ι : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) : Matrix.PosSemidef.{u_4, u_1} (n := ι) (R := 𝕜) ((LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis) A) ↔ A.IsPositive

docstring: An unbounded operator is closed iff its graph is closed.
name: LinearPMap.IsClosed
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup F] [_root_.Module R E] [_root_.Module R F] [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace F] (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) : Prop

docstring:
A monotone function is continuous to the right at a point if and only if its right
limit coincides with the value of the function.
name: Monotone.continuousWithinAt_Ioi_iff_rightLim_eq
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] {f : α → β} (hf : Monotone f) {x : α} [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] : ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Ioi x) x ↔ Function.rightLim f x = f x

docstring:
A finite flat locally finitely presented morphism is surjective if and only if its rank
function is at least `1` everywhere.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.one_le_finrank_iff_surjective
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat f] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite f] : 1 ≤ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.finrank f ↔ AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective f

docstring:
`zarankiewicz m n s t` is at most `x` if and only if every
`completeBipartiteGraph α β`-free bipartite graph `G` has at most `x` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.zarankiewicz_le_iff
statement_text: {m : ℕ} {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ} {t : ℕ} {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (hm : Fintype.card V = m) (hn : Fintype.card W = n) (hs : Fintype.card α = s) (ht : Fintype.card β = t) (x : ℕ) : SimpleGraph.zarankiewicz m n s t ≤ x ↔ ∀ ⦃G : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W)⦄ [inst_4 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G ≤ completeBipartiteGraph V W → (completeBipartiteGraph α β).Free G → G.edgeFinset.card ≤ x

docstring: `v ∈ Kᗮ` if and only if `⟪u, v⟫ = 0` for all `u ∈ K`.
name: Submodule.mem_orthogonal
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) (v : E) : v ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ u ∈ K, inner 𝕜 u v = 0

docstring:
If `f` is meromorphic at `x`, then `f + g` is meromorphic at `x` if and only if `g` is meromorphic
at `x`.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicAt_add_iff_meromorphicAt₁
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : MeromorphicAt (f + g) x ↔ MeromorphicAt g x

docstring:
For prime `p`, `g` lies in the additive `p`-primary component iff its additive
order is a power of `p`.
name: AddCommMonoid.mem_primaryComponent_iff_addOrderOf
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid G] {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := AddSubmonoid G) (AddCommMonoid.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ n, addOrderOf g = p ^ n

docstring: Sets of a subtype are complete iff their image under the coercion is complete.
name: Subtype.isComplete_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} [UniformSpace α] {p : α → Prop} {s : Set { x : α // p x }} : IsComplete s ↔ IsComplete (Subtype.val (p := fun x => p x) '' s)

docstring:
A point `p` is equidistant to two affine subspaces (typically lines, for this version of the
lemma) if and only if the oriented angles at a point `p'` in their intersection between `p` and
its orthogonal projections onto the subspaces are equal.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_orthogonalProjection_eq_iff_oangle_eq
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p : P} {p' : P} {s₁ : AffineSubspace ℝ P} {s₂ : AffineSubspace ℝ P} (hp'₁ : p' ∈ s₁) (hp'₂ : p' ∈ s₂) : Ne.{u_2 + 1} (α := P) ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₁) p) ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₂) p) → ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₁) p) ≠ p' → ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₂) p) ≠ p' → (dist p ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₁) p) = dist p ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₂) p) ↔ EuclideanGeometry.oangle (↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₁) p)) p' p = EuclideanGeometry.oangle p p' ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s₂) p))

docstring:
In a strictly convex space, two vectors `x`, `y` are not in the same ray if and only if the
triangle inequality for `x` and `y` is strict.
name: not_sameRay_iff_norm_add_lt
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [StrictConvexSpace ℝ E] {x : E} {y : E} : ¬SameRay ℝ x y ↔ ‖x + y‖ < ‖x‖ + ‖y‖

docstring:
An `R`-algebra `A` is formally etale iff "for every `R`-algebra `B`,
every square-zero ideal `I : Ideal B` and `f : A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I`, there exists
a unique lift `A →ₐ[R] B`".
name: Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_comp_bijective
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] : Algebra.FormallyEtale R A ↔ ∀ ⦃B : Type (max u v)⦄ [inst_3 : CommRing B] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (I : Ideal B), I ^ 2 = ⊥ → Function.Bijective (α := A →ₐ[R] B) (β := A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I) (AlgHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I))

docstring:
**Geometric mean theorem** (or right triangle altitude theorem), if-and-only-if form: if
`p₄` lies strictly between `p₁` and `p₃` and `∠ p₁ p₄ p₂` is a right angle (so that `p₄` is the
foot of the altitude from `p₂` in the triangle `p₁ p₂ p₃`), then the square of `dist p₂ p₄`
equals the product of `dist p₁ p₄` and `dist p₃ p₄` if and only if the angle at `p₂` is a right
angle.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_eq_dist_mul_dist_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} {p₄ : P} (hf : Sbtw ℝ p₁ p₄ p₃) (hc : EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₄ p₂ = Real.pi / 2) : dist p₂ p₄ ^ 2 = dist p₁ p₄ * dist p₃ p₄ ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi / 2

docstring:
A set is a neighborhood of `a` within `[a, +∞)` if and only if it contains an interval `[a, u)`
with `a < u`.
name: mem_nhdsGE_iff_exists_Ico_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ici a) ↔ ∃ u ∈ Set.Ioi a, Set.Ico a u ⊆ s

docstring:
`f : α → β` is called **locally Lipschitz continuous** iff every point `x`
has a neighbourhood on which `f` is Lipschitz.
name: LocallyLipschitz
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] (f : α → β) : Prop

docstring:
If `w` is a nontorsion weight function, then the finitely supported function `m : σ →₀ ℕ`
has weighted degree zero if and only if `∀ x : σ, m x = 0`.
name: MvPolynomial.weightedDegree_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {M : Type u_2} {σ : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] {w : σ → M} [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (hw : MvPolynomial.NonTorsionWeight w) {m : σ →₀ ℕ} : (Finsupp.weight w) m = 0 ↔ ∀ (x : σ), m x = 0

docstring:
A correspondence `f : α → Set β` is lower hemicontinuous if and only if its *lower inverse*
(i.e., `u : Set β ↦ (f ⁻¹' (Iic uᶜ))ᶜ`, note that `f ⁻¹' (Iic u) = {x | (f x ∩ u).Nonempty}`)
sends open sets to open sets.
name: lowerHemicontinuous_iff_isOpen_compl_preimage_Iic_compl
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] {f : α → Set β} [TopologicalSpace β] : LowerHemicontinuous f ↔ ∀ (u : Set β), IsOpen u → IsOpen (f ⁻¹' Set.Iic uᶜ)ᶜ

docstring: A product of ideals in an integral domain is zero if and only if one of the terms is zero.
name: Ideal.multiset_prod_eq_bot
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R] {s : Multiset (Ideal R)} : s.prod = ⊥ ↔ ⊥ ∈ s

docstring: A graph is 2-edge-connected iff it remains preconnected after removing any edge.
name: SimpleGraph.isEdgeConnected_two_iff_forall_preconnected
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} : G.IsEdgeConnected 2 ↔ ∀ (e : Sym2 V), (G.deleteEdges {e}).Preconnected

docstring:
`a ≡ b [PMOD p]` means that `b` is congruent to `a` modulo `p`.

If `a`, `b` are elements of an additive group,
then `a ≡ b [PMOD p]` iff `m • p = b - a` for some `m : ℤ`, see `modEq_iff_zsmul` below.
For additive commutative monoid, the definition is given by `modEq_iff_nsmul`.

Equivalently (as shown in `Algebra.Order.ToIntervalMod`), `b` does not lie in the open interval
`(a, a + p)` modulo `p`, or `toIcoMod hp a` disagrees with `toIocMod hp a` at `b`, or
`toIcoDiv hp a` disagrees with `toIocDiv hp a` at `b`.
name: AddCommGroup.ModEq
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] (p : M) (a : M) (b : M) : Prop

docstring: The Schnirelmann density of `A` containing `0` is `1` if and only if `A` is the naturals.
name: schnirelmannDensity_eq_one_iff_of_zero_mem
statement_text: {A : Set ℕ} [DecidablePred fun (x : ℕ) => x ∈ A] (hA : 0 ∈ A) : schnirelmannDensity A = 1 ↔ A = Set.univ

docstring:
A symmetric linear map `T` is zero if and only if `⟪T x, x⟫_ℝ = 0` for all `x`.
See `inner_map_self_eq_zero` for the complex version without the symmetric assumption.
name: LinearMap.IsSymmetric.inner_map_self_eq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (hT : LinearMap.IsSymmetric.{u_1, u_2} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) T) : (∀ (x : E), inner 𝕜 (T x) x = 0) ↔ T = 0

docstring: A function is `C^k` on a union of open sets `s i` iff it is `C^k` on each `s i`.
name: contMDiffOn_iUnion_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] {E' : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] {H' : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H'] {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'} {M' : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H M] [ChartedSpace H' M'] {f : M → M'} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {ι : Type u_11} {s : ι → Set M} (hs : ∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (s i)) : ContMDiffOn I I' n f (⋃ i, s i) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ContMDiffOn I I' n f (s i)

docstring: A function tendsto 0 along the cofinite filter iff it has finite support.
name: tendsto_cofinite_pure_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {f : α → β} [Zero β] : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.cofinite (pure 0) ↔ Function.HasFiniteSupport f

docstring: The class number of a function field is `1` iff the ring of integers is a PID.
name: FunctionField.classNumber_eq_one_iff
statement_text: (Fq : Type u_1) (F : Type u_2) [Field Fq] [Fintype Fq] [Field F] [Algebra.{u_1, u_2} (Polynomial Fq) F] [Algebra.{u_1, u_2} (RatFunc Fq) F] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} (Polynomial Fq) (RatFunc Fq) F] [FunctionField Fq F] [Algebra.IsSeparable.{u_1, u_2} (RatFunc Fq) F] : FunctionField.classNumber Fq F = 1 ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing.{u_2} ↥(FunctionField.ringOfIntegers Fq F)

docstring:
In a strictly convex space, two vectors `x`, `y` are in the same ray if and only if the triangle
inequality for `x` and `y` becomes an equality.
name: sameRay_iff_norm_add
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [StrictConvexSpace ℝ E] {x : E} {y : E} : SameRay ℝ x y ↔ ‖x + y‖ = ‖x‖ + ‖y‖

docstring: A group is finitely generated if and only if it admits a finite generating family.
name: Group.fg_iff_nonempty_finite_generators
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] : Group.FG G ↔ ∃ n, Nonempty.{max 1 (u_1 + 1)} (Group.Generators G (Fin n))

docstring:
`f : M → N` is a **`C^n` local diffeomorphism** iff it is a local diffeomorphism
at each `x ∈ M`.
name: IsLocalDiffeomorph
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {H₁ : Type u_5} [TopologicalSpace H₁] {H₂ : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H₂] (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H₁) (J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 F H₂) {M : Type u_8} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H₁ M] {N : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace H₂ N] (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (f : M → N) : Prop

docstring:
A sheaf morphism is an isomorphism iff it becomes one after pulling back along each
element of a covering family.
name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isIso_iff_of_coversTop
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {K : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v_1, u_1} C} {A : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} A] {ι : Type u_3} {X : ι → C} (hX : K.CoversTop X) {F : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} K A} {G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} K A} (f : F ⟶ G) : CategoryTheory.IsIso f ↔ ∀ (i : ι), CategoryTheory.IsIso (C := CategoryTheory.Sheaf (C := CategoryTheory.Over.{v_1, u_1} (X i)) (K.over (X i)) A) (X := CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (K.overPullback A (X i)) F) (CategoryTheory.Functor.map (K.overPullback A (X i)) f)

docstring: Star projection operators are equal iff their range are.
name: LinearMap.IsStarProjection.ext_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {S : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (hS : IsStarProjection S) (hT : IsStarProjection T) : S = T ↔ S.range = T.range

docstring: A meromorphic function converges to zero iff its order is positive.
name: tendsto_zero_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_pos
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds 0) ↔ 0 < meromorphicOrderAt f x

docstring:
Two homomorphisms `G →+ G'` of additive groups are equal if and only if they agree
on a generator of `G`.
name: AddMonoidHom.eq_iff_eq_on_generator
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} {G' : Type u_3} [AddGroup G] [AddGroup G'] {g : G} (hg : ∀ (x : G), Membership.mem (γ := AddSubgroup G) (AddSubgroup.zmultiples g) x) (f₁ : G →+ G') (f₂ : G →+ G') : f₁ = f₂ ↔ Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := G') (f₁ g : G') (f₂ g : G')

docstring: The results of applying `domDomCongr` to two maps are equal if and only if those maps are.
name: AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_eq_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid N] [_root_.Module R N] {ι : Type u_7} {ι' : Type u_8} (σ : ι ≃ ι') (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) (g : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) : AlternatingMap.domDomCongr σ f = AlternatingMap.domDomCongr σ g ↔ f = g

docstring:
A monic irreducible polynomial over a field `F` of exponential characteristic `q` has
separable degree one if and only if it is of the form `Polynomial.expand F (q ^ n) (X - C y)`
for some `n : ℕ` and `y : F`.
name: Irreducible.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_of_monic'
statement_text: {F : Type u} [Field F] {f : Polynomial F} (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] (hm : f.Monic) (hi : Irreducible f) : f.natSepDegree = 1 ↔ ∃ n y, f = (Polynomial.expand F (q ^ n)) (HSub.hSub (α := Polynomial F) (β := Polynomial F) Polynomial.X (Polynomial.C y : Polynomial F))

docstring:
An integer `n` is divisible by `ζ - 1` in `𝓞 K` if and only if it is divisible by `p`,
where `ζ` is a primitive `p`-th root of unity.
name: IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.zeta_sub_one_dvd_intCast_iff'
statement_text: (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} ℚ K] {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) {n : ℤ} : hζ.toInteger - 1 ∣ ↑n ↔ ↑p ∣ n

docstring: Matrices `A` and `B` are equal iff `(x * A).trace = (x * B).trace` for all `x`.
name: Matrix.ext_iff_trace_mul_left
statement_text: {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {R : Type u_6} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [NonAssocSemiring R] {A : Matrix m n R} {B : Matrix m n R} : A = B ↔ ∀ (x : Matrix n m R), (x * A).trace = (x * B).trace

docstring:
An action of a monoid `M` on `α` is topologically transitive if and only if for any nonempty
open subset `U` of `α` the union of the preimages of `U` over the elements of `M` is dense in `α`.
name: MulAction.isTopologicallyTransitive_iff_dense_iUnion_preimage
statement_text: (M : Type u_1) {α : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] [Monoid M] [MulAction M α] : MulAction.IsTopologicallyTransitive M α ↔ ∀ {U : Set α}, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → Dense.{u_2} (X := α) (⋃ m, (fun x => m • x) ⁻¹' U)

docstring: A point is in the inf of two affine subspaces if and only if it is in both of them.
name: AffineSubspace.mem_inf_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (p : P) (s₁ : AffineSubspace k P) (s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : p ∈ s₁ ⊓ s₂ ↔ p ∈ s₁ ∧ p ∈ s₂

docstring:
`p` is a Taylor series of `f` up to `n+1` if and only if `p.shift` is a Taylor series up to `n`
for `p 1`, which is a derivative of `f`. Version for `n : ℕ∞ω`.
name: hasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn_succ_iff_right
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} : HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn (n + 1) f p s ↔ (∀ x ∈ s, (p x 0).curry0 = f x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivWithinAt (fun y => p y 0) ((p x 1).curryLeft (Ei := fun _i => E)) s x) ∧ HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn (𝕜 := 𝕜) (F := E →L[𝕜] F) n (fun x => (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 𝕜 E F) (p x 1)) (fun x => (p x).shift) s

docstring:
If the pre-`0`-hypercover `E` has pairwise pullbacks, then the multifork associated to the
full saturated pre-`1`-hypercover is exact if and only if the minimal one given by taking
the pairwise pullbacks is exact.
name: CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover.isLimitSaturateEquivOfHasPullbacks
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {A : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} A] {S : C} (E : CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover S) [E.HasPullbacks] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} Cᵒᵖ A) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (E.saturate.multifork F) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (E.toPreOneHypercover.multifork F)

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `c < b`, the point `(c, f c)` is non-strictly below the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a b ≤ slope f c b`.
name: map_le_lineMap_iff_slope_le_slope_right
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < (1 - r) * (b - a)) : f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ≤ (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r ↔ slope f a b ≤ slope f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) b

docstring: `P.universally` holds for a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` iff `P` holds for all `X ×[Y] Y' ⟶ Y'`.
name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.universally
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.{v, u} C) : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.{v, u} C

docstring:
We call *occurrence set* for pattern `p` and position `g` the set of configurations
in which a pattern `p` occurs at position `g`.

This proves that it is exactly the cylinder corresponding to the
pattern obtained by translating `p` by `g`.

Equivalently, `p.mulOccursInAt x g` iff on every translated site
`g * w` (with `w ∈ p.support`)
the configuration `x` agrees with the translated pattern `Pattern.mulShift p g`.
name: SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.mulOccursInAt_eq_cylinder
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [Inhabited A] {G : Type u_2} [Monoid G] [IsLeftCancelMul G] (p : SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.Pattern A G) (g : G) : {x | p.mulOccursInAt x g} = SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.cylinder (Finset.image (fun x => g * x) p.support) (p.mulShift g)

docstring: `dim R ≤ n` if and only if the height of all prime ideals is less than `n`.
name: ringKrullDim_le_iff_height_le
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (n : WithBot ℕ∞) : ringKrullDim R ≤ n ↔ ∀ ⦃p : Ideal R⦄, p.IsPrime → ↑p.height ≤ n

docstring:
An object property is local if it holds for `X` if and only if it holds for all `Uᵢ` where
`{Uᵢ}` is a `K`-cover of `X`.
name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsLocal
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, u} C) (K : CategoryTheory.Precoverage.{v, u} C) : Prop

docstring:
A category has coequalizers of reflexive pairs if and only if it has all colimits indexed by the
walking reflexive pair.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.hasReflexiveCoequalizers_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfShape.{0, 0, v, u} CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingReflexivePair C ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.HasReflexiveCoequalizers.{v, u} C

docstring: The extended distance between vertices is equal to `1` if and only if these vertices are adjacent.
name: SimpleGraph.edist_eq_one_iff_adj
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} {u : V} {v : V} : G.edist u v = 1 ↔ G.Adj u v

docstring: A set is a neighborhood of `a` if and only if it contains an interval `(l, u)` containing `a`.
name: mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α] {a : α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ nhds a ↔ ∃ l u, a ∈ Set.Ioo l u ∧ Set.Ioo l u ⊆ s

docstring:
If every localization of `R` at a maximal ideal is a valuation ring then an `R`-module
is flat iff it has no torsion.
name: Module.Flat.flat_iff_torsion_eq_bot_of_valuationRing_localization_isMaximal
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [IsDomain R] (h : ∀ (P : Ideal R) [inst_4 : P.IsMaximal], ValuationRing.{u_1} (Localization (M := R) P.primeCompl)) : Module.Flat R M ↔ Eq (α := Submodule R M) (Submodule.torsion R M) ⊥

docstring:
A relation is an isomorphism in `RelCat` iff it is the image of an isomorphism in
`Type u`.
name: CategoryTheory.RelCat.rel_iso_iff
statement_text: {X : CategoryTheory.RelCat} {Y : CategoryTheory.RelCat} (r : X ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.IsIso r ↔ ∃ f, CategoryTheory.RelCat.graphFunctor.map f.hom = r

docstring: A meromorphic function converges to a limit iff its order is nonnegative.
name: tendsto_nhds_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : (∃ c, Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds c)) ↔ 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt f x

docstring:
A submodule has dimension `1` if and only if there is a
single non-zero vector in the submodule such that the submodule is contained in
its span.
name: rank_submodule_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Ring K] [StrongRankCondition K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (s : Submodule K V) [Module.Free.{u, v} K ↥s] : Module.rank K ↥s = 1 ↔ ∃ v₀ ∈ s, v₀ ≠ 0 ∧ s ≤ K ∙ v₀

docstring:
The **Jacobian criterion** for smoothness of local algebras.
Suppose `S` is a local `R`-algebra, and `0 → I → P → S → 0` is a presentation such that
`P` is formally-smooth over `R`, `Ω[P⁄R]` is finite free over `P`,
(typically satisfied when `P` is the localization of a polynomial ring of finite type)
and `I` is finitely generated.
Then `S` is formally smooth iff `k ⊗ₛ I/I² → k ⊗ₚ Ω[P/R]` is injective,
where `k` is the residue field of `S`.
name: Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_injective_lTensor_residueField
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] [Algebra R S] (P : Algebra.Extension.{u, u_1, u_2} R S) [Algebra.FormallySmooth.{u_1, u} R P.Ring] [Module.Free.{u, u} P.Ring Ω[P.Ring⁄R]] [Module.Finite.{u, u} P.Ring Ω[P.Ring⁄R]] (h' : P.ker.FG) : Algebra.FormallySmooth R S ↔ Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct.{u_2, u_2, u} S (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S) P.Cotangent) (β := TensorProduct S (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S) P.CotangentSpace) ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S) P.cotangentComplex)

docstring:
A function `f : M → N` between `C^n` manifolds is `C^n` at `x` if and only if it is continuous
at `x` and its composition `φ ∘ f` with a `C^n` immersion `φ : N → N'` at `f x` is `C^n` at `x`.
name: ContMDiffAt.iff_comp_isImmersionAtOfComplement
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {E''' : Type u_4} {E'' : Type u} {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E''] [NormedAddCommGroup E'''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'''] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {H : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace H] {G : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace G] {G' : Type u_10} [TopologicalSpace G'] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E'' G} {J' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E''' G'} {M : Type u_11} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {N : Type u_13} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {N' : Type u_14} [TopologicalSpace N'] [ChartedSpace G' N'] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {x : M} {f : M → N} {φ : N → N'} (hφ : Manifold.IsImmersionAtOfComplement F J J' n φ (f x)) : ContMDiffAt I J n f x ↔ ContinuousAt f x ∧ ContMDiffAt I J' n (φ ∘ f) x

docstring:
`zpowers (g ^ i) ≤ zpowers (g ^ j)` iff `j.gcd (orderOf g) ∣ i.gcd (orderOf g)`.
This characterizes inclusion of cyclic subgroups of a group generated by integer powers of a
single element.
name: Subgroup.zpowers_le_zpowers_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_2} [Group G] (g : G) (i : ℤ) (j : ℤ) : LE.le (α := Subgroup G) (Subgroup.zpowers (g ^ i)) (Subgroup.zpowers (g ^ j)) ↔ j.gcd ↑(orderOf g) ∣ i.gcd ↑(orderOf g)

docstring:
An additive action is pretransitive if and only if the quotient by
`AddAction.orbitRel` is a subsingleton.
name: AddAction.pretransitive_iff_subsingleton_quotient
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] : AddAction.IsPretransitive G α ↔ Subsingleton.{u_2 + 1} (AddAction.orbitRel.Quotient G α)

docstring:
If `f` is meromorphic at `x`, then `f + g` is meromorphic at `x` if and only if `g` is meromorphic
at `x`.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicAt_fun_add_iff_meromorphicAt₁
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : MeromorphicAt.{u_1, u_3} (E := E) (fun z => f z + g z) x ↔ MeromorphicAt g x

docstring:
The comap of a cone `F` under a surjective linear map is a face of the
comap of another cone `F` if and only if `F` is a face of `C`.
name: PointedCone.isFaceOf_comap_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {C : PointedCone R M} {F : PointedCone R M} [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R N] {f : N →ₗ[R] M} (hf : Function.Surjective.{u_3 + 1, u_2 + 1} (α := N) (β := M) ⇑f) : (PointedCone.comap f F).IsFaceOf (PointedCone.comap f C) ↔ F.IsFaceOf C

docstring: [Stacks Tag 00JB](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00JB) (A ring is Artinian if and only if it has finite length as a module over itself.
name: instIsNoetherianRingOfIsArtinianRing
statement_text: (R : Type u_2) [Ring R] [IsArtinianRing R] : IsNoetherianRing R

docstring: A semiring `R` satisfies the strong rank condition, iff we cannot embed `R^(ℕ)` in some `Rⁿ`.
name: strongRankCondition_iff_forall_not_injective
statement_text: (R : Type u) [Semiring R] : StrongRankCondition R ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : (ℕ →₀ R) →ₗ[R] Fin n → R), ¬Function.Injective (α := ℕ →₀ R) (β := Fin n → R) ⇑f

docstring: An idempotent operator is positive if and only if it is self-adjoint.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isPositive_iff_isSelfAdjoint
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] {p : E →L[𝕜] E} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : p.IsPositive ↔ IsSelfAdjoint p

docstring:
`f : X ⟶ Y` is a monomorphism iff for all `Z`, composition of morphisms `Z ⟶ X` with `f`
is injective.
name: CategoryTheory.mono_iff_forall_injective
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (f : Y ⟶ X) : CategoryTheory.Mono f ↔ ∀ (Z : C), Function.Injective (β := Z ⟶ X) fun (g : Z ⟶ Y) => CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g f

docstring: A continuous even function has bounded range if and only if `f =O[atTop] 1`.
name: Continuous.isBounded_range_iff_isBigO_atTop_of_even
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {β : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace β] [LinearOrder β] [OrderClosedTopology β] [CompactIccSpace β] [NoMaxOrder β] [NoMinOrder β] [AddCommGroup β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] {f : β → E} (hf : Continuous f) (heven : Function.Even f) : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range f) ↔ f =O[Filter.atTop] 1

docstring:
A simplicial set `X` is a Kan complex iff for any `n : ℕ`, `i : Fin (n + 2)`,
and any family of morphisms `Δ[n] ⟶ Z` for all `j ≠ i` that is compatible
(in the sense that it extends to a morphism `Λ[n + 1, i] ⟶ X`), there
exists a morphism `Δ[n + 1] ⟶ Z` which induces the given family of morphisms
on the faces `j ≠ i`.
name: SSet.KanComplex.iff
statement_text: {Z : _root_.SSet} : Z.KanComplex ↔ ∀ ⦃n : ℕ⦄ ⦃i : Fin (n + 2)⦄ (f : (j : Fin (n + 2)) → j ≠ i → (SSet.stdSimplex.obj { len := n : SimplexCategory } ⟶ Z)), SSet.horn.IsCompatible f → ∃ φ, ∀ (j : Fin (n + 2)) (hj : j ≠ i), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (SSet.stdSimplex.δ j) φ = f j hj

docstring:
An additive group is finitely generated iff there exists a surjective homomorphism
from a `FreeAddGroup` on an arbitrary finite type `α` to the group.
name: AddGroup.fg_iff_exists_freeAddGroup_hom_surjective_finite
statement_text: {G : Type u_3} [AddGroup G] : AddGroup.FG G ↔ ∃ α, ∃ (_ : Finite α), ∃ φ, Function.Surjective (α := FreeAddGroup α) (β := G) ⇑φ

docstring: A point is in the affine span of a single point if and only if they are equal.
name: AffineSubspace.affineSpan_singleton
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] (x : P) : Eq (α := AffineSubspace k P) (affineSpan k {x}) {x}

docstring: Elements of ordered additive commutative groups are nonnegative iff their untop₀ is nonnegative.
name: WithTop.untop₀_nonneg
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup α] [PartialOrder α] {a : WithTop α} : 0 ≤ a.untop₀ ↔ 0 ≤ a

docstring:
Let `R` be a Noetherian domain. Then `R` is a UFD if and only if every height `1` prime ideal is
principal.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_forall_isPrincipal_of_height_eq_one
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] : UniqueFactorizationMonoid R ↔ ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 → Submodule.IsPrincipal p

docstring: X is a Lindelöf space iff every open cover has a countable subcover.
name: LindelofSpace
statement_text: (X : Type u_2) [TopologicalSpace X] : Prop

docstring:
A matrix is Hermitian iff the corresponding linear map on the Euclidean space is
symmetric.
name: Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {n : Type u_3} {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] : LinearMap.IsSymmetric (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n) (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A) ↔ A.IsHermitian

docstring: If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` fixes `(h ^ j) • x` iff `g` fixes `x`.
name: MulAction.smul_zpow_fixedBy_eq_of_commute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [Group G] [MulAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : Commute g h) (j : ℤ) : h ^ j • MulAction.fixedBy α g = MulAction.fixedBy α g

docstring:
In a nontrivial real normed space, a sphere is nonempty if and only if its radius is
nonnegative.
name: NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NontrivialTopology E] {x : E} {r : ℝ} : (Metric.sphere x r).Nonempty ↔ 0 ≤ r

docstring: A filter is disjoint from the cocompact filter if and only if it contains a compact set.
name: Filter.disjoint_cocompact_right
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : Filter X) : Disjoint f (Filter.cocompact X) ↔ ∃ K ∈ f, IsCompact K

docstring: A ring of characteristic zero is not a `ℚ`-algebra iff it has mixed characteristic for some `p`.
name: isEmpty_algebraRat_iff_mixedCharZero
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] [CharZero R] : IsEmpty.{max (u_1 + 1) 1} (Algebra ℚ R) ↔ ∃ p > 0, MixedCharZero R p

docstring: A set system is a compact system iff adding `univ` gives a compact system.
name: isCompactSystem_insert_univ_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {S : Set (Set α)} : IsCompactSystem (insert Set.univ S) ↔ IsCompactSystem S

docstring:
If `g` and `h` commute, then `g` fixes `h +ᵥ x` iff `g` fixes `x`.
This is equivalent to say that the set `fixedBy α g` is fixed by `h`.
name: AddAction.fixedBy_mem_fixedBy_of_addCommute
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [AddAction G α] {g : G} {h : G} (comm : AddCommute g h) : Membership.mem (γ := Set (Set α)) (AddAction.fixedBy (Set α) h) (AddAction.fixedBy α g)

docstring:
A periodic function is interval integrable over one full period if and only if it is interval
integrable over any other full period.

Special case of `Function.Periodic.intervalIntegrable`.
name: Function.Periodic.intervalIntegrable_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {f : ℝ → E} {T : ℝ} {t₁ : ℝ} {t₂ : ℝ} (hf : Function.Periodic f T) : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume t₁ (t₁ + T) ↔ IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume t₂ (t₂ + T)

docstring:
A nonzero element of a `UniqueFactorizationMonoid` divides a nonzero element iff its
`multiplicity` at every prime is at most that of the other.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_iff_multiplicity_le
statement_text: {R : Type u_2} [CommMonoidWithZero R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {a : R} {b : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : a ∣ b ↔ ∀ (p : R), Prime p → multiplicity p a ≤ multiplicity p b

docstring:
Given a point in an affine subspace, a vector is in its direction if and only if it results from
subtracting that point on the left.
name: AffineSubspace.mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub_left
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) (v : V) : v ∈ s.direction ↔ ∃ p₂ ∈ s, v = p -ᵥ p₂

docstring:
A function is `C^n` within a set at a point, for `n : ℕ`, if and only if it is `C^n` on
a neighborhood of this point.
name: contDiffWithinAt_iff_contDiffOn_nhds
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {x : E} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hn : n ≠ ↑⊤) : ContDiffWithinAt 𝕜 n f s x ↔ ∃ u ∈ nhdsWithin x (insert x s), ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f u

docstring: `M` is a scalar matrix if and only if it commutes with every `single`.
name: Matrix.mem_range_scalar_iff_commute_single'
statement_text: {n : Type u_3} {α : Type u_7} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] [Semiring α] {M : Matrix n n α} : Membership.mem (γ := Set (Matrix n n α)) (Set.range (ι := α) ⇑(Matrix.scalar n)) M ↔ ∀ (i j : n), Commute (Matrix.single i j 1) M

docstring: A space is completely normal iff it is hereditarily normal.
name: completelyNormalSpace_iff_forall_normalSpace
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] : CompletelyNormalSpace X ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), NormalSpace.{u_1} ↑s

docstring: A family of continuous linear maps is continuous on `s` iff all its applications are.
name: continuousOn_clm_apply
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {f : X → E →L[𝕜] F} {s : Set X} : ContinuousOn f s ↔ ∀ (y : E), ContinuousOn.{u_1, w} (Y := F) (fun x => (f x) y) s

docstring: A subgroup is finitely generated if and only if it is finitely generated as a submonoid.
name: Subgroup.fg_iff_submonoid_fg
statement_text: {G : Type u_3} [Group G] (P : Subgroup G) : P.FG ↔ P.FG

docstring:
A partial function `f` is partial recursive if and only if it is recursive in
every partial function `g`.
name: partrec_iff_forall_recursiveIn_singleton
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable σ] {f : α →. σ} : Partrec f ↔ ∀ (g : ℕ →. ℕ), RecursiveIn {g} f

docstring:
Two random variables are independent if and only if their joint characteristic function is equal
to the product of the characteristic functions. This is `indepFun_iff_charFunDual_prod` for
`WithLp`. See `indepFun_iff_charFun_prod` for the Hilbert space version.
name: ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_charFunDual_prod'
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (p : ENNReal) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] {mF : MeasurableSpace F} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [CompleteSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology F] {X : Ω → E} {Y : Ω → F} [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace E] (hX : AEMeasurable X P) (hY : AEMeasurable Y P) : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P ↔ ∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ (WithLp p (E × F))), MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := WithLp.measurableSpace p (E × F)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp p (X ω, Y ω)) P) L = MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := mE) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map X P) (L ∘SL ↑(ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F)) ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E F) * MeasureTheory.charFunDual (mE := mF) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map Y P) (L ∘SL ↑(ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F)) ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E F)

docstring:
An analytic function `f` has finite analytic order `n` at `z₀` if and only if its first
`n` iterated derivatives (including `f` itself) vanish at `z₀` and the `n`-th iterated derivative is
non-zero.
name: analyticOrderAt_eq_nat_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CharZero 𝕜] [CompleteSpace E] {z₀ : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) {n : ℕ} : analyticOrderAt f z₀ = ↑n ↔ (∀ k < n, iteratedDeriv k f z₀ = 0) ∧ iteratedDeriv n f z₀ ≠ 0

docstring:
Note that `b ∈ (s.filter (fun ab => Prod.fst ab = a)).image Prod.snd` iff `(a, b) ∈ s` so
we can simplify the right-hand side of this lemma. However the form stated here is more
useful for iterating this lemma, e.g., if we have `f : α × β × γ → M`.
name: finsum_mem_finset_product'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [AddCommMonoid M] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset (α × β)) (f : α × β → M) : Eq.{u_5 + 1} (α := M) (∑ᶠ (ab : α × β) (_ : ab ∈ s), f ab) (∑ᶠ (a : α) (b : β) (_ : b ∈ Finset.image Prod.snd ({ab ∈ s | ab.1 = a})), f (a, b))

docstring:
If `E / F` is an algebraic extension, then the separable closure of `F` in `E` is
equal to `F` if and only if `E / F` is purely inseparable.
name: separableClosure.eq_bot_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] : Eq (α := IntermediateField F E) (separableClosure F E) ⊥ ↔ IsPurelyInseparable F E

docstring:
An additive group is nilpotent if and only if its lower central series eventually
reaches the trivial additive subgroup.
name: AddSubgroup.nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] : AddGroup.IsNilpotent G ↔ ∃ n, Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := AddSubgroup G) (AddSubgroup.lowerCentralSeries ⊤ n) ⊥

docstring: A sum is infinite iff one term is infinite.
name: WithTop.sum_eq_top
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → WithTop M} : Eq.{u_2 + 1} (α := WithTop M) (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊤ ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i = ⊤

docstring:
A matrix acts trivially on `ℍ` iff it belongs to the center of `GL(2, ℝ)`,
i.e., it's a diagonal matrix.
name: UpperHalfPlane.forall_smul_eq_self_iff_mem_center
statement_text: {g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ} : (∀ (z : UpperHalfPlane), g • z = z) ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) (Subgroup.center (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) g

docstring:
A finite matrix `M : Matrix n n R` is positive semidefinite iff it is
Hermitian and `xᴴ * M * x` is nonnegative for all `x`.
name: Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec
statement_text: {n : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R] [Fintype n] {M : Matrix n n R} : M.PosSemidef ↔ M.IsHermitian ∧ ∀ (x : n → R), 0 ≤ star x ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec x

docstring: An affine subspace contains zero if and only if it equals its directions.
name: AffineSubspace.direction_eq_self_iff_zero_mem
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] {s : AffineSubspace k V} : ↑s.direction = s ↔ 0 ∈ s

docstring:
For a prime ideal `p` of `R`, `p` extended to `S` and
restricted back to `R` is `p` if and only if `p` is the restriction of a prime in `S`.
name: Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_iff_of_isPrime
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_2} [CommSemiring S] {f : R →+* S} (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] : Ideal.comap f (Ideal.map f p) = p ↔ ∃ q, q.IsPrime ∧ Ideal.comap f q = p

docstring:
If two right extensions `E` and `E'` are isomorphic, `E` is a pointwise
right Kan extension at `Y` iff `E'` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.RightExtension.isPointwiseRightKanExtensionAtEquivOfIso
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} {H : Type u_4} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_4, u_4} H] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_4, u_1, u_4} C H} {E : L.RightExtension F} {E' : L.RightExtension F} (e : E ≅ E') (Y : D) : E.IsPointwiseRightKanExtensionAt Y ≃ E'.IsPointwiseRightKanExtensionAt Y

docstring: A graph on `n` vertices is a tree iff it is acyclic and has exactly `n - 1` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.isTree_iff_isAcyclic_and_ncard_edgeSet_add_one_eq_card
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} [Finite V] : G.IsTree ↔ G.IsAcyclic ∧ G.edgeSet.ncard + 1 = Nat.card V

docstring: If `f` is an affine map, then its linear part is an embedding iff `f` is an embedding.
name: AffineMap.isEmbedding_linear_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} {Q : Type u_5} [AddCommGroup V] [TopologicalSpace V] [AddTorsor V P] [TopologicalSpace P] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor P] [AddCommGroup W] [TopologicalSpace W] [AddTorsor W Q] [TopologicalSpace Q] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor Q] [Ring R] [_root_.Module R V] [_root_.Module R W] {f : P →ᵃ[R] Q} : Topology.IsEmbedding.{u_2, u_4} (X := V) (Y := W) ⇑f.linear ↔ Topology.IsEmbedding.{u_3, u_5} (X := P) (Y := Q) ⇑f

docstring: A variant of `IsConjRoot.iff_eq_zero`. `0` is a conjugate root of `x` if and only if `x = 0`.
name: isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero'
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {S : Type u_4} [CommRing S] [Field K] [Algebra K S] [IsDomain S] {x : S} : IsConjRoot K x 0 ↔ x = 0

docstring:
The minimal polynomial of an element of `E / F` of exponential characteristic `q` has
separable degree one if and only if the minimal polynomial is of the form
`X ^ (q ^ n) - C y` for some `n : ℕ` and `y : F`.
name: minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_eq_X_pow_sub_C
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Ring E] [IsDomain E] [Algebra F E] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] {x : E} : Polynomial.natSepDegree (minpoly F x) = 1 ↔ ∃ n y, minpoly F x = HSub.hSub (β := Polynomial F) (HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial F) Polynomial.X (q ^ n)) (Polynomial.C y : Polynomial F)

docstring:
**La Hire's theorem**: `p₁` lies on the polar of `p₂` if and only if `p₂` lies on the polar of
`p₁`.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mem_polar_iff_mem_polar
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ≠ s.center) (hp₂ : p₂ ≠ s.center) : Membership.mem (γ := AffineSubspace ℝ P) (s.polar p₂) p₁ ↔ Membership.mem (γ := AffineSubspace ℝ P) (s.polar p₁) p₂

docstring: Random variables are independent iff their joint density is a product of marginal densities.
name: MeasureTheory.pdf.indepFun_iff_pdf_prod_eq_pdf_mul_pdf
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace E] {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {ℙ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} {F : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace F] {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure F} {X : Ω → E} {Y : Ω → F} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ℙ] [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite ν] [MeasureTheory.HasPDF (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) ℙ (μ.prod ν)] : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y ℙ ↔ MeasureTheory.pdf (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) ℙ (μ.prod ν) =ᵐ[μ.prod ν] fun z => MeasureTheory.pdf X ℙ μ z.1 * MeasureTheory.pdf Y ℙ ν z.2

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `f ⊗ 𝟙 M` is injective whenever `f` is an injective linear map
in a universe that `R` fits in.
name: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMapₛ
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Small.{v', u} R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' : Type v'⦄ [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_5 : AddCommMonoid N'] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), Function.Injective (α := N) (β := N') ⇑f → Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R N M) (β := TensorProduct R N' M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f)

docstring:
`t` is in the upper shadow of `𝒜` iff `t` is exactly `k` elements less than something from `𝒜`.

See also `Finset.mem_upShadow_iff_exists_mem_card_add`.
name: Finset.mem_upShadow_iterate_iff_exists_sdiff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} {k : ℕ} : t ∈ Finset.upShadow^[k] 𝒜 ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, s ⊆ t ∧ (t \ s).card = k

docstring:
If `f : R → ℝ` is a nonnegative, multiplicatively bounded function, then
`seminormFromBounded' f x = 0` if and only if `f x = 0`.
name: seminormFromBounded_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {f : R → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (f_nonneg : 0 ≤ f) (f_mul : ∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) (x : R) : seminormFromBounded' f x = 0 ↔ f x = 0

docstring:
If `R` and `T` are isomorphic commutative rings and `S` is an `R`-algebra and a `T`-algebra in
a compatible way, then an element `a ∈ S` is integral over `R` if and only if it is integral
over `T`.
name: RingEquiv.isIntegral_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_5} {S : Type u_6} {T : Type u_7} [CommRing R] [Ring S] [CommRing T] [Algebra R S] [Algebra T S] (φ : R ≃+* T) (h : Eq (α := R →+* S) (RingHom.comp (algebraMap T S) φ.toRingHom) (algebraMap R S)) (a : S) : IsIntegral R a ↔ IsIntegral T a

docstring: A set is analytic if and only if it is the continuous image of some Polish space.
name: MeasureTheory.analyticSet_iff_exists_polishSpace_range
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s ↔ ∃ β h, ∃ (_ : PolishSpace β), ∃ f, Continuous f ∧ Set.range f = s

docstring:
The **Compactness Theorem of first-order logic**: A theory is satisfiable if and only if it is
finitely satisfiable.
name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.isSatisfiable_iff_isFinitelySatisfiable
statement_text: {L : FirstOrder.Language} {T : L.Theory} : T.IsSatisfiable ↔ T.IsFinitelySatisfiable

docstring:
A functor `F : J ⥤ GrpCat.{u}` has a limit iff `(F ⋙ forget GrpCat).sections` is
`u`-small.
name: GrpCat.hasLimit_iff_small_sections
statement_text: {J : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{w, u, v, u + 1} J GrpCat) : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimit F ↔ Small.{u, max u v} ↑(F.comp (CategoryTheory.forget GrpCat (FC := fun x1 x2 => ↑x1 →* ↑x2) (CC := GrpCat.carrier))).sections

docstring:
The main theorem of this file: given a precoverage `J` on `C`, a `Type*`-valued presheaf on `C` is
a sheaf for the associated Grothendieck topology if and only if it is a sheaf for all pullback
sieves of presieves in `J`.
name: CategoryTheory.Precoverage.isSheaf_toGrothendieck_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_3} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_3} C] {J : CategoryTheory.Precoverage.{u_2, u_3} C} (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_2, u_1, u_3, u_1 + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type u_1)) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf J.toGrothendieck P ↔ ∀ {X Y : C} {f : Y ⟶ X}, ∀ R ∈ J.coverings X, CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor P (CategoryTheory.Sieve.pullback f (CategoryTheory.Sieve.generate R)).arrows

docstring:
If `A` is a faithfully flat `R`-algebra, and `m` is a term of an `R`-module `M`,
then `1 ⊗ₜ[R] m = 0` if and only if `m = 0`.
name: Module.FaithfullyFlat.one_tmul_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [Module.FaithfullyFlat R A] (m : M) : 1 ⊗ₜ[R] m = 0 ↔ m = 0

docstring: `f = O(g)` if and only if `∀ᶠ x in l, ‖f x‖ ≤ c * ‖g x‖` for all sufficiently large `c`.
name: Asymptotics.isBigO_iff_eventually
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3} {F' : Type u_7} [Norm E] [SeminormedAddCommGroup F'] {f : α → E} {g' : α → F'} {l : Filter α} : f =O[l] g' ↔ ∀ᶠ (c : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ᶠ (x : α) in l, ‖f x‖ ≤ c * ‖g' x‖

docstring:
If `f` is meromorphic in normal form at `x`, then `f` has order zero iff it does not vanish at `x`.

See `AnalyticAt.order_eq_zero_iff` for an analogous statement about analytic functions.
name: MeromorphicNFAt.meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicNFAt f x) : meromorphicOrderAt f x = 0 ↔ f x ≠ 0

docstring:
In finite-dimensional spaces, a continuous linear map is positive iff it is equal to the sum
of rank-one positive operators.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff_eq_sum_rankOne
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {T : E →L[𝕜] E} : T.IsPositive ↔ ∃ m u, T = ∑ i : Fin m, ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜) (u i) : E →L⋆[𝕜] E →L[𝕜] E) (u i)

docstring:
`t` is in the upper shadow of `𝒜` iff `t` is exactly one element less than something from `𝒜`.

See also `Finset.mem_upShadow_iff_exists_sdiff`.
name: Finset.mem_upShadow_iff_exists_mem_card_add_one
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} : t ∈ 𝒜.upShadow ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, s ⊆ t ∧ t.card = s.card + 1

docstring:
if `f` is integrable, then `g + f` is integrable iff `g` is.
See `integrable_add_iff_integrable_left'` for the same statement with `fun x ↦ g x + f x` instead
of `g + f`.
name: MeasureTheory.integrable_add_iff_integrable_left
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [NormedAddCommGroup β] {f : α → β} {g : α → β} (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (g + f) μ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable g μ

docstring: Idempotent operators are equal iff their range and kernels are.
name: LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.ext_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module R E] {p : E →ₗ[R] E} {q : E →ₗ[R] E} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) (hq : IsIdempotentElem q) : p = q ↔ p.range = q.range ∧ p.ker = q.ker

docstring:
`t` is in the upper shadow of `𝒜` iff `t` is exactly one element more than something from `𝒜`.

See also `Finset.mem_upShadow_iff_exists_mem_card_add_one`.
name: Finset.mem_upShadow_iff_exists_sdiff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} : t ∈ 𝒜.upShadow ↔ ∃ s ∈ 𝒜, s ⊆ t ∧ (t \ s).card = 1

docstring:
If `f → a` and `g → b` along a nontrivial filter on the domain, valued in a
Hausdorff topological group, then `f / g → 1` if and only if `a = b`.
name: tendsto_div_nhds_one_iff_eq
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] {α : Type u_3} {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] [T2Space G] {f : α → G} {g : α → G} {a : G} {b : G} (hf : Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds a)) (hg : Filter.Tendsto g l (nhds b)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) l (nhds 1) ↔ a = b

docstring: A cone is a limit cone iff it is terminal.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.isLimitEquivIsTerminal
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {C : Type u₃} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone F) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal c

docstring:
If `f` is any function and `g` is analytic without zero on `U`, then `f` is meromorphic in normal
form on `U` iff `g • f` is meromorphic in normal form on `U`.
name: meromorphicNFOn_smul_iff_right_of_analyticOnNhd
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {U : Set 𝕜} {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (h₁g : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g U) (h₂g : ∀ u ∈ U, g u ≠ 0) : MeromorphicNFOn (g • f) U ↔ MeromorphicNFOn f U

docstring: The affine span of a set is nonempty if and only if that set is.
name: affineSpan_nonempty
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} : (↑(affineSpan k s)).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty

docstring:
When two left extensions `α₁ : LeftExtension L F₁` and `α₂ : LeftExtension L F₂`
are essentially the same via an isomorphism of functors `F₁ ≅ F₂`,
then `α₁` is universal iff `α₂` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.LeftExtension.isUniversalEquivOfIso₂
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {H : Type u_3} {D : Type u_5} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_3, u_3} H] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_5, u_5} D] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_5, u_1, u_5} C D} {F₁ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_3, u_1, u_3} C H} {F₂ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_3, u_1, u_3} C H} (α₁ : L.LeftExtension F₁) (α₂ : L.LeftExtension F₂) (e : F₁ ≅ F₂) (e' : CategoryTheory.StructuredArrow.right α₁ ≅ CategoryTheory.StructuredArrow.right α₂) (h : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.StructuredArrow.hom α₁) (L.whiskerLeft e'.hom) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e.hom (CategoryTheory.StructuredArrow.hom α₂)) : CategoryTheory.StructuredArrow.IsUniversal α₁ ≃ CategoryTheory.StructuredArrow.IsUniversal α₂

docstring:
If `k` is a perfect ring of characteristic `p`, a Witt vector `x : 𝕎 k` falls in ideal generated by
`p` if and only if its zeroth coefficient is `0`.
name: WittVector.mem_span_p_iff_coeff_zero_eq_zero
statement_text: {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {k : Type u_1} [CommRing k] [CharP k p] [PerfectRing k p] (x : WittVector p k) : Membership.mem (γ := Ideal (WittVector p k)) (Ideal.span {↑p}) x ↔ x.coeff 0 = 0

docstring:
