The order of an analytic function `f` at `z₀` is finite iff `f` can locally be written as `f z =
  (z - z₀) ^ analyticOrderNatAt f z₀ • g z`, where `g` is analytic and does not vanish at `z₀`.

See `MeromorphicNFAt.order_eq_zero_iff` for an analogous statement about meromorphic functions in
normal form.
name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_ne_top
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {z₀ : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) : analyticOrderAt f z₀ ≠ ⊤ ↔ ∃ g, AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z₀ ∧ g z₀ ≠ 0 ∧ f =ᶠ[nhds z₀] fun z => (z - z₀) ^ analyticOrderNatAt f z₀ • g z

docstring:
The smallest cardinality of a `(U, n)`-dynamical cover of `F`. Takes values in `ℕ∞`, and is
infinite if and only if `F` admits no finite dynamical cover.
name: Dynamics.coverMincard
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} (T : X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) : ℕ∞

docstring:
The composition in the opposite direction is equal to the identity if and only if `F` preserves
the biproduct, see `preservesBiproduct_of_monoBiproductComparison`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.biproductComparison'_comp_biproductComparison_assoc
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v₂, u₂} D] {J : Type w₁} (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) (f : J → C) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBiproduct.{w₁, v₁, u₁} f] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBiproduct.{w₁, v₂, u₂} (F.obj ∘ f)] [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms] {Z : D} (h : CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.{w₁, v₂, u₂} (F.obj ∘ f) ⟶ Z) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Y := F.obj (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.{w₁, v₁, u₁} f)) (F.biproductComparison' f) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.biproductComparison f) h) = h

docstring:
The commutator of `G` as a morphism. This is the map `(x, y) ↦ x + y + (-x) + (-y)`,
see `CategoryTheory.AddGrpObj.lift_commutator_eq_add_add_neg_neg`.
This morphism is constant with value `0` if and only if `G` is commutative
(see `CategoryTheory.isCommAddMonObj_iff_commutator_eq_toAddUnit_η`).
name: CategoryTheory.AddGrpObj.addCommutator
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] (G : C) [CategoryTheory.AddGrpObj G] : CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{v, u} (𝒞 := inst) G G ⟶ G

docstring:
**Thales' theorem**: For three distinct points, the angle at the second point
is a right angle if and only if the second point lies on the sphere having the first and third
points as diameter endpoints.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.angle_eq_pi_div_two_iff_mem_sphere_ofDiameter
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi / 2 ↔ Membership.mem (γ := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.ofDiameter p₁ p₃) p₂

docstring:
The minimal polynomial of an element of `E / F` of exponential characteristic `q` has
separable degree one if and only if the minimal polynomial is of the form
`Polynomial.expand F (q ^ n) (X - C y)` for some `n : ℕ` and `y : F`.
name: minpoly.natSepDegree_eq_one_iff_eq_expand_X_sub_C
statement_text: {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field F] [Ring E] [IsDomain E] [Algebra F E] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar F q] {x : E} : Polynomial.natSepDegree (minpoly F x) = 1 ↔ ∃ n y, Eq (α := Polynomial F) (minpoly F x) ((Polynomial.expand F (q ^ n)) (HSub.hSub (α := Polynomial F) (β := Polynomial F) Polynomial.X (Polynomial.C y : Polynomial F)))

docstring:
The rank is positive at all stalks if and only if the induced map on prime spectra is
surjective.
name: PrimeSpectrum.rankAtStalk_pos_iff_comap_surjective
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Module.Flat R S] [Module.Finite R S] : (∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum R), 0 < Module.rankAtStalk S p) ↔ Function.Surjective (α := PrimeSpectrum S) (β := PrimeSpectrum R) (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S))

docstring: The projection is `0` if and only if all the elements have norm `0`.
name: SeparationQuotient.normedMk_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup M] : SeparationQuotient.normedMk = 0 ↔ ∀ (x : M), ‖x‖ = 0

docstring:
Two nonzero vectors go to the same point in projective space if and only if one is
a scalar multiple of the other.
name: Projectivization.mk_eq_mk_iff'
statement_text: (K : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (v : V) (w : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) : Eq (α := Projectivization K V) (Projectivization.mk K v hv) (Projectivization.mk K w hw) ↔ ∃ a, a • w = v

docstring: A cocone is a colimit cocone iff its extension by an isomorphism is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.extendIsoEquiv
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {C : Type u₃} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} J C} {s : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F} {X : C} (i : s.pt ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.IsIso i] : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit s ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (s.extend i)

docstring:
Integrability in the change of variable formula for differentiable functions: if a real
function `f` is monotone and differentiable on a measurable set `s`, then a function
`g : ℝ → F` is integrable on `f '' s` if and only if `f' x • g ∘ f` is integrable on `s` .
name: MeasureTheory.integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_deriv_smul_of_monotoneOn
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {f' : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf' : ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) s x) (hf : MonotoneOn f s) (g : ℝ → F) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (mα := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace) g (f '' s) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.{0, u_1} (ε := F) (mα := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace) (fun x => f' x • g (f x)) s MeasureTheory.volume

docstring:
If $v$ and $w$ are two real absolute values on a field $F$, equivalent in the sense that
$v(x) \leq v(y)$ if and only if $w(x) \leq w(y)$, then $\frac{\log (v(a))}{\log (w(a))}$ is
constant for all $0 \neq a\in F$ with $v(a) \neq 1$.
name: AbsoluteValue.IsEquiv.log_div_log_eq_log_div_log
statement_text: {F : Type u_1} [Field F] {v : AbsoluteValue F ℝ} {w : AbsoluteValue F ℝ} (h : v.IsEquiv w) {a : F} (ha₀ : a ≠ 0) (ha₁ : v a ≠ 1) {b : F} (hb₀ : b ≠ 0) (hb₁ : v b ≠ 1) : Real.log (v b) / Real.log (w b) = Real.log (v a) / Real.log (w a)

docstring:
A set in a proper metric space admits a finite cover iff it is relatively compact.

[R. Vershynin, *High Dimensional Probability*][vershynin2018high], 4.2.3. Note that the print
edition incorrectly claims that this holds without the `ProperSpace X` assumption.
name: Metric.isCompact_closure_iff_exists_finite_isCover
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [MetricSpace X] [ProperSpace X] {ε : NNReal} {s : Set X} (hε : ε ≠ 0) : IsCompact (closure s) ↔ ∃ N ⊆ s, N.Finite ∧ Metric.IsCover ε s N

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous iff the function `swap 𝓕 : X → ι → α` is
continuous *when `ι → α` is equipped with the topology of uniform convergence*. This is
very useful for developing the equicontinuity API, but it should not be used directly for other
purposes.
name: equicontinuous_iff_continuous
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} : Equicontinuous F ↔ Continuous (Y := UniformFun ι α) (⇑UniformFun.ofFun ∘ Function.swap (φ := fun a a_1 => α) F)

docstring:
The inner product of two vectors, divided by the product of their
norms, has absolute value 1 if and only if they are nonzero and one is
a multiple of the other. One form of equality case for Cauchy-Schwarz.
name: norm_inner_div_norm_mul_norm_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (x : E) (y : E) : ‖inner 𝕜 x y / HMul.hMul (α := 𝕜) ↑‖x‖ ↑‖y‖‖ = 1 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ y = r • x

docstring: A function is $C^{k+(0)}$ at a point if and only if it is $C^k$ at the point.
name: ContDiffPointwiseHolderAt.zero_exponent_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {k : ℕ} {f : E → F} {a : E} : ContDiffPointwiseHolderAt k 0 f a ↔ ContDiffAt ℝ (↑k) f a

docstring: `legendreSym p a = -1` iff `a` is a nonsquare mod `p`.
name: legendreSym.eq_neg_one_iff
statement_text: (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℤ} : legendreSym p a = -1 ↔ ¬IsSquare (α := ZMod p) ↑a

docstring: A set is called **meagre** iff its complement is a residual (or comeagre) set.
name: IsMeagre
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] (s : Set X) : Prop

docstring:
A function `f : M → N` between `C^n` manifolds is `C^n` if and only if it is continuous
and its composition `φ ∘ f` with a `C^n` immersion `φ : N → N'` is `C^n`.
name: ContMDiff.iff_comp_isImmersionOfComplement
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {E''' : Type u_4} {E'' : Type u} {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E''] [NormedAddCommGroup E'''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'''] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {H : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace H] {G : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace G] {G' : Type u_10} [TopologicalSpace G'] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E'' G} {J' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E''' G'} {M : Type u_11} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {N : Type u_13} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {N' : Type u_14} [TopologicalSpace N'] [ChartedSpace G' N'] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : M → N} {φ : N → N'} (hφ : Manifold.IsImmersionOfComplement F J J' n φ) : ContMDiff I J n f ↔ Continuous f ∧ ContMDiff I J' n (φ ∘ f)

docstring:
`t` is in the upper shadow of `𝒜` iff we can remove an element from it so that the resulting
finset is in `𝒜`.
name: Finset.mem_upShadow_iff_erase_mem
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {t : Finset α} : t ∈ 𝒜.upShadow ↔ ∃ a ∈ t, t.erase a ∈ 𝒜

docstring: The cosine of the angle between three points is 0 if and only if the angle is π / 2.
name: EuclideanGeometry.cos_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃) = 0 ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = Real.pi / 2

docstring:
A field extension `E / F` is purely inseparable if and only if for every element `x` of `E`,
its minimal polynomial has separable degree one.
name: isPurelyInseparable_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one
statement_text: (F : Type u) {E : Type v} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] : IsPurelyInseparable F E ↔ ∀ (x : E), Polynomial.natSepDegree (minpoly F x) = 1

docstring: A binary bicone is a limit cone if and only if the corresponding bicone is a limit cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryBicone.toBiconeIsLimit
statement_text: {C : Type uC} [CategoryTheory.Category.{uC', uC} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{uC', uC} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (b : CategoryTheory.Limits.BinaryBicone.{uC', uC} X Y) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit b.toBicone.toCone ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit b.toCone

docstring:
A subset of `Gal(L/K)` is a member of `galBasis K L` if and only if it is the underlying set
of `Gal(L/E)` for some finite subextension `E/K`.
name: mem_galBasis_iff
statement_text: (K : Type u_1) (L : Type u_2) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] (U : Set Gal(L/K)) : Membership.mem (γ := FilterBasis Gal(L/K)) (galBasis K L) U ↔ Membership.mem (γ := Set (Set Gal(L/K))) ((fun (g : Subgroup Gal(L/K)) => g.carrier) '' fixedByFinite K L) U

docstring:
A set is preirreducible iff every nonempty open subset of a
preirreducible subspace is dense in the subspace.
name: isPreirreducible_iff_subset_closure_inter_open
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) : IsPreirreducible S ↔ ∀ (U : Set X), IsOpen U → (S ∩ U).Nonempty → S ⊆ closure (S ∩ U)

docstring:
An equivalence between topological spaces is a homeomorphism iff it is continuous in both
directions.
name: Equiv.isHomeomorph_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (e : X ≃ Y) : IsHomeomorph.{u_1, u_2} (X := X) (Y := Y) ⇑e ↔ Continuous.{u_1, u_2} (X := X) (Y := Y) ⇑e ∧ Continuous.{u_2, u_1} (X := Y) (Y := X) ⇑e.symm

docstring: A function to 𝕜 is meromorphic in normal form at a point iff its inverse is.
name: meromorphicNFAt_inv
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} : MeromorphicNFAt f⁻¹ x ↔ MeromorphicNFAt f x

docstring:
In a normed additive group, every absolutely convergent series converges in the
space iff the space is complete.
name: NormedAddCommGroup.summable_imp_tendsto_iff_completeSpace
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] : (∀ (u : ℕ → E), (Summable (α := ℝ) fun x => ‖u x‖) → ∃ a, Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, u i) Filter.atTop (nhds a)) ↔ CompleteSpace E

docstring: The iff version of `affineCombination_mem_shift` for affine independent points.
name: AffineIndependent.affineCombination_mem_shift_iff
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [AddTorsor V P] [_root_.Module k V] {ι : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] [Nontrivial ι] {p : ι → P} (h : AffineIndependent k p) (i : ι) {w : ι → k} (hw : ∑ i : ι, w i = 1) (c : k) : Membership.mem (α := P) (γ := AffineSubspace k P) (AffineSubspace.shift (affineSpan k (p '' {i}ᶜ)) (p i) c) ((Finset.affineCombination k Finset.univ p) w : P) ↔ w i = 1 - c

docstring: A topological space with discrete topology is separable iff it is countable.
name: TopologicalSpace.separableSpace_iff_countable
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] [DiscreteTopology α] : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace α ↔ Countable α

docstring: A module over a domain is torsion-free iff its torsion submodule is trivial.
name: Submodule.isTorsionFree_iff_torsion_eq_bot
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.IsTorsionFree R M ↔ Eq (α := Submodule R M) (Submodule.torsion R M) ⊥

docstring: `f` is Lipschitz iff it is Lipschitz on the entire space.
name: lipschitzOnWith_univ
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] {K : NNReal} {f : α → β} : LipschitzOnWith K f Set.univ ↔ LipschitzWith K f

docstring: The ring `R` is an integral domain iff its fraction ring `K` is a field.
name: IsFractionRing.isDomain_iff_isField
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {K : Type u_5} [CommRing K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] : IsDomain R ↔ IsField K

docstring:
The seminorm of an element in a product space is `≤ r` if and only if the norm of each
component is.
name: pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg'
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {G : ι → Type u_5} [Fintype ι] [(i : ι) → SeminormedGroup (G i)] {x : (i : ι) → G i} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : ‖x‖ ≤ r ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ‖x i‖ ≤ r

docstring: A family of seminorms is separating iff it induces a T₁ topology.
name: WithSeminorms.separating_iff_T1
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_2} {E : Type u_6} {ι : Type u_9} [NormedField 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace E] {p : SeminormFamily 𝕜 E ι} (hp : WithSeminorms p) : (∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, (p i) x ≠ 0) ↔ T1Space E

docstring:
`f : M → N` is called a **`C^n` local diffeomorphism at `x`** iff there exist
open sets `U ∋ x` and `V ∋ f x` and a diffeomorphism `Φ : U → V` such that `f = Φ` on `U`.
name: IsLocalDiffeomorphAt
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {H₁ : Type u_5} [TopologicalSpace H₁] {H₂ : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H₂] (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H₁) (J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 F H₂) {M : Type u_8} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H₁ M] {N : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace H₂ N] (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (f : M → N) (x : M) : Prop

docstring:
A line through `p` is tangent to the sphere at `p` if and only if the angle between the line and
the radius at `p` equals `π / 2`.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.IsTangentAt_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p : P} {q : P} (hp : p ∈ s) : s.IsTangentAt p line[ℝ, p, q] ↔ EuclideanGeometry.angle q p s.center = Real.pi / 2

docstring: A vector space with a nonzero vector `v` has dimension 1 iff `v` spans.
name: finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (v : V) (nz : v ≠ 0) : Module.finrank K V = 1 ↔ Eq (α := Submodule K V) (K ∙ v) ⊤

docstring: For prime `p`, `g` lies in the `p`-primary component iff its order is a power of `p`.
name: CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent_iff_orderOf
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [CommGroup G] {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := Subgroup G) (CommGroup.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ n, orderOf g = p ^ n

docstring:
Similarity holds if and only if all non-negative distances between points with different
indices are proportional.
name: similar_iff_exists_pairwise_nndist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ Pairwise fun (i₁ : ι) i₂ => nndist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = r * nndist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
**Equational criterion for vanishing**
[A. Altman and S. Kleiman, *A term of commutative algebra* (Lemma 8.16)][altman2021term].

Assume that the $m_i$ generate $M$. Then the expression $\sum_i m_i \otimes n_i$ vanishes
trivially if and only if it vanishes.
name: TensorProduct.vanishesTrivially_iff_sum_tmul_eq_zero
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {N : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R N] {ι : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] {m : ι → M} {n : ι → N} (hm : Eq (α := Submodule R M) (Submodule.span R (Set.range m)) ⊤) : TensorProduct.VanishesTrivially R m n ↔ ∑ i : ι, m i ⊗ₜ[R] n i = 0

docstring:
A (colimit) cocone over a diagram `F : J ⥤ C` is van Kampen if for every cocone `c'` over the
pullback of the diagram `F' : J ⥤ C'`, `c'` is colimiting iff `c'` is the pullback of `c`.

TODO: Show that this is iff the functor `C ⥤ Catᵒᵖ` sending `x` to `C/x` preserves it.
TODO: Show that this is iff the inclusion functor `C ⥤ Span(C)` preserves it.
name: CategoryTheory.IsVanKampenColimit
statement_text: {J : Type v'} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u', v'} J] {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u', v, v', u} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F) : Prop

docstring: A vector equals a rotation of that vector if and only if the vector or the angle is zero.
name: Orientation.eq_rotation_self_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) (x : V) (θ : Real.Angle) : x = (o.rotation θ) x ↔ x = 0 ∨ θ = 0

docstring: A ring is Dedekind-finite if and only if every element has at most one right inverse.
name: IsDedekindFiniteMonoid.iff_eq_of_mul_left_eq_one
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Ring α] : IsDedekindFiniteMonoid α ↔ ∀ (x y z : α), x * y = 1 → x * z = 1 → y = z

docstring:
A module `M` over a ring `R` is flat iff for all finitely generated ideals `I` of `R`, the
tensor product of the inclusion `I → R` and the identity `M → M` is injective. See
`iff_rTensor_injective'` to extend to all ideals `I`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_injective
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃I : Ideal R⦄, I.FG → Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R (↥I) M) (β := TensorProduct R R M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M (Submodule.subtype I))

docstring: An affine-independent subset `s` generates a finite-dimensional subspace iff `s` isfinite.
name: finiteDimensional_iff_setFinite
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set ι} {f : ↑s → P} (hi : AffineIndependent k f) : FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k ↥(vectorSpan k (Set.range f)) ↔ s.Finite

docstring:
A functor `F : J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w}` has a colimit if and only if `Colimits.Quot F` is
`w`-small.
name: AddCommGrpCat.hasColimit_iff_small_quot
statement_text: {J : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} J] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, w, u, w + 1} J AddCommGrpCat} [DecidableEq J] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimit F ↔ Small.{w, max u w} (AddCommGrpCat.Colimits.Quot F)

docstring: If `X` and `Y` are isomorphic, then `X` is initial iff `Y` is.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.equivOfIso
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.{v₁, u₁} X ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.{v₁, u₁} Y

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous at `x₀` within `S` iff the function
`swap 𝓕 : X → ι → α` is continuous at `x₀` within `S`
*when `ι → α` is equipped with the topology of uniform convergence*. This is very useful for
developing the equicontinuity API, but it should not be used directly for other purposes.
name: equicontinuousWithinAt_iff_continuousWithinAt
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {S : Set X} {x₀ : X} : EquicontinuousWithinAt F S x₀ ↔ ContinuousWithinAt (Y := UniformFun ι α) (⇑UniformFun.ofFun ∘ Function.swap (φ := fun a a_1 => α) F) S x₀

docstring:
The composition in the opposite direction is equal to the identity if and only if `F` preserves
the biproduct, see `preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_monoBiprodComparison`.
name: CategoryTheory.Functor.biprodComparison'_comp_biprodComparison_assoc
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{v₂, u₂} D] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) (X : C) (Y : C) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproduct.{v₁, u₁} X Y] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproduct.{v₂, u₂} (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)] [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms] {Z : D} (h : CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.{v₂, u₂} (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) ⟶ Z) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Y := F.obj (CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.{v₁, u₁} X Y)) (F.biprodComparison' X Y) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.biprodComparison X Y) h) = h

docstring:
A group is finitely presented if and only if it admits a presentation
with finitely many generators and finitely many relators.
name: Group.Presentation.isFinitelyPresented_iff_exists_finite_presentation
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] : Group.IsFinitelyPresented G ↔ ∃ n P, P.rel.Finite

docstring:
The comparison morphism from the image of a terminal object to the terminal object in the target
category.
This is an isomorphism iff `G` preserves terminal objects, see
`CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesTerminal.ofIsoComparison`.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.terminalComparison
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasTerminal.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasTerminal.{v₂, u₂} D] : G.obj (CategoryTheory.Limits.terminal.{v₁, u₁} C) ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.terminal.{v₂, u₂} D

docstring:
An additive subgroup has index two if and only if there exists `a` such that
for all `b`, exactly one of `b + a` and `b` belong to `H`.
name: AddSubgroup.index_eq_two_iff
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G} : H.index = 2 ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : G), Xor (b + a ∈ H) (b ∈ H)

docstring:
`G.killCopies H` has no effect on `G` if and only if `G` already contained no copies of `H`. See
`Free.killCopies_eq_left` for the reverse implication with no assumption on `H`.
name: SimpleGraph.killCopies_eq_left
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (hH : H ≠ ⊥) : G.killCopies H = G ↔ H.Free G

docstring:
An ideal equals its Jacobson radical iff it is the intersection of a set of maximal ideals.
Allowing the set to include ⊤ is equivalent, and is included only to simplify some proofs.
name: Ideal.eq_jacobson_iff_sInf_maximal
statement_text: {R : Type u} [Ring R] {I : Ideal R} : I.jacobson = I ↔ ∃ M, (∀ J ∈ M, J.IsMaximal ∨ J = ⊤) ∧ I = sInf M

docstring:
The point given by `secondInter` equals the original point if and only if the line is
orthogonal to the radius vector.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.secondInter_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p : P} {v : V} : s.secondInter p v = p ↔ inner ℝ v (p -ᵥ s.center) = 0

docstring:
If the constant sheaf functor is fully faithful, then a sheaf is constant if and only if the
counit of the constant sheaf adjunction applied to it is an isomorphism.
name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isConstant_iff_isIso_counit_app
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v_1, u_1} C) {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] [CategoryTheory.HasWeakSheafify.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} J D] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Faithful (CategoryTheory.constantSheaf J D)] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Full (CategoryTheory.constantSheaf J D)] (F : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} J D) {T : C} (hT : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal.{v_1, u_1} T) : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.IsConstant J F ↔ CategoryTheory.IsIso (X := CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.sheafSections J D) (Opposite.op T)) (CategoryTheory.constantSheaf J D)) F) (CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app (CategoryTheory.Adjunction.counit (CategoryTheory.constantSheafAdj J D hT)) F)

docstring:
A variant of `IsConjRoot.iff_eq_zero`, only assuming `IsDomain R`,
`IsTorsionFree R A` and `Function.Injective (algebraMap R A)` instead of `Field R`. `x` is a
conjugate root of `0` if and only if `x = 0`.
name: isConjRoot_zero_iff_eq_zero_of_injective
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsDomain S] [IsDomain R] {x : S} [Module.IsTorsionFree R S] (hf : Function.Injective.{u_1 + 1, u_4 + 1} (α := R) (β := S) ⇑(algebraMap R S)) : IsConjRoot R 0 x ↔ x = 0

docstring: A map is a homeomorphism iff it is continuous, closed and bijective.
name: isHomeomorph_iff_continuous_isClosedMap_bijective
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsHomeomorph f ↔ Continuous f ∧ IsClosedMap f ∧ Function.Bijective f

docstring:
A finite family of vectors `v i` is linear independent iff the linear map that sends
`c : ι → R` to `∑ i, c i • v i` is injective.
name: Fintype.linearIndependent_iff'ₛ
statement_text: {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] : LinearIndependent R v ↔ Function.Injective (α := ι → R) (β := M) ⇑((LinearMap.lsum R (fun x => R) ℕ) fun i => LinearMap.smulRight LinearMap.id (v i))

docstring:
The angle at `p₂` is at least `π / 2` if and only if the square of the opposite side is at
least the sum of the squares of the other two sides.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_add_dist_sq_le_dist_sq_iff_pi_div_two_le_angle
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : dist p₁ p₂ * dist p₁ p₂ + dist p₃ p₂ * dist p₃ p₂ ≤ dist p₁ p₃ * dist p₁ p₃ ↔ Real.pi / 2 ≤ EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃

docstring: Given `x, y : E ⊗ F`, `x = y` iff `⟪a ⊗ₜ b, x⟫ = ⟪a ⊗ₜ b, y⟫` for all `a, b`.
name: TensorProduct.ext_iff_inner_left
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] {x : TensorProduct 𝕜 E F} {y : TensorProduct 𝕜 E F} : x = y ↔ ∀ (a : E) (b : F), inner 𝕜 (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] b) x = inner 𝕜 (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] b) y

docstring: An element `x` lies in the span of `v` iff it can be written as sum `∑ cᵢ • vᵢ = x`.
name: Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [Fintype α] {x : R} {v : α → R} : Membership.mem (γ := Ideal R) (Ideal.span (Set.range v)) x ↔ ∃ c, ∑ i : α, c i * v i = x

docstring: If `g` is a topological embedding, then `f` is strongly measurable iff `g ∘ f` is.
name: Embedding.comp_stronglyMeasurable_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [TopologicalSpace β] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace β] [TopologicalSpace γ] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace γ] {g : β → γ} {f : α → β} (hg : Topology.IsEmbedding g) : (MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable.{u_1, u_3} (β := γ) fun (x : α) => g (f x)) ↔ MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable f

docstring:
The family `(k, l) : ℕ × ℕ ↦ f k * g l` is summable if and only if the family
`(n, k, l) : Σ (n : ℕ), antidiagonal n ↦ f k * g l` is summable.
name: summable_mul_prod_iff_summable_mul_sigma_antidiagonal
statement_text: {α : Type u_3} {A : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid A] [Finset.HasAntidiagonal A] [TopologicalSpace α] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] {f : A → α} {g : A → α} : (Summable.{u_3, u_4} (α := α) fun (x : A × A) => f x.1 * g x.2) ↔ Summable.{u_3, u_4} (α := α) fun (x : (n : A) × ↥(@Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal _ AddCommMagma.toAdd _ n)) => f (↑(x.snd (β := fun n => ↥(@Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal _ AddCommMagma.toAdd _ n)))).1 * g (↑(x.snd (β := fun n => ↥(@Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal _ AddCommMagma.toAdd _ n)))).2

docstring: A polynomial has zero separable degree if and only if it is constant.
name: Polynomial.natSepDegree_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} [Field F] (f : Polynomial F) : f.natSepDegree = 0 ↔ f.natDegree = 0

docstring: An ideal `I` is local iff its Jacobson radical is maximal.
name: Ideal.IsLocal
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) : Prop

docstring:
A monotone function is continuous to the left at a point if and only if its left limit
coincides with the value of the function.
name: Monotone.continuousWithinAt_Iio_iff_leftLim_eq
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] {f : α → β} (hf : Monotone f) {x : α} [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] : ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Iio x) x ↔ Function.leftLim f x = f x

docstring:
`G` is a commutative group object if and only if the commutator map `(x, y) ↦ x * y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹`
is constant.
name: CategoryTheory.isCommMonObj_iff_commutator_eq_toUnit_η
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] {G : C} [CategoryTheory.GrpObj G] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.IsCommMonObj.{v, u} G ↔ CategoryTheory.GrpObj.commutator G = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Y := CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit.{v, u} C (𝒞 := inst)) (CategoryTheory.SemiCartesianMonoidalCategory.toUnit (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{v, u} (𝒞 := inst) G G)) CategoryTheory.MonObj.one

docstring: `ZMod n` is reduced iff `n` is square-free (or `n=0`).
name: isReduced_zmod
statement_text: {n : ℕ} : IsReduced (ZMod n) ↔ Squarefree n ∨ n = 0

docstring:
Given `x, y : E ⊗ (F ⊗ G)`, `x = y` iff `⟪x, a ⊗ₜ (b ⊗ₜ c)⟫ = ⟪y, a ⊗ₜ (b ⊗ₜ c)⟫` for all
`a, b, c`.

See also `ext_iff_inner_right_threefold` for when `x, y : E ⊗ F ⊗ G`.
name: TensorProduct.ext_iff_inner_right_threefold'
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {G : Type u_4} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G] {x : TensorProduct 𝕜 E (TensorProduct 𝕜 F G)} {y : TensorProduct 𝕜 E (TensorProduct 𝕜 F G)} : x = y ↔ ∀ (a : E) (b : F) (c : G), inner 𝕜 x (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (b ⊗ₜ[𝕜] c)) = inner 𝕜 y (a ⊗ₜ[𝕜] (b ⊗ₜ[𝕜] c))

docstring: A pair belongs to `antidiagonal n` iff the sum of its components is equal to `n`.
name: Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} : ∀ {inst : Add A} [self : Finset.HasAntidiagonal A] {n : A} {a : A × A}, a ∈ @Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal _ inst _ n ↔ a.1 + a.2 = n

docstring:
If `α` is algebraic over `F`, then the separable degree of `F⟮α⟯ / F` is equal to the degree
of `F⟮α⟯ / F` if and only if `α` is a separable element.
name: IntermediateField.finSepDegree_adjoin_simple_eq_finrank_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] (α : E) (halg : IsAlgebraic F α) : Field.finSepDegree.{u, v} F ↥F⟮α⟯ = Module.finrank.{u, v} F ↥F⟮α⟯ ↔ IsSeparable F α

docstring:
An `R`-module `M` is faithfully flat iff it is flat and for all linear maps `f`, the map
`id ⊗ f = 0`, if and only if `f = 0`.
name: Module.FaithfullyFlat.iff_zero_iff_lTensor_zero
statement_text: (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.FaithfullyFlat R M ↔ Module.Flat R M ∧ ∀ {N : Type (max u v)} [inst_3 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_4 : _root_.Module R N] {N' : Type (max u v)} [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N'] (f : N →ₗ[R] N'), LinearMap.lTensor M f = 0 ↔ f = 0

docstring:
Two random variables `f, g` are conditionally independent given a third `k` iff the
conditional distribution of `f` given `k` and `g` is equal to the conditional distribution of `f`
given `k`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.condIndepFun_iff_condDistrib_prod_ae_eq_prodMkRight
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {β' : Type u_4} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [StandardBorelSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Ω → β} {g : Ω → β'} {γ : Type u_5} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mβ' : MeasurableSpace β'} [StandardBorelSpace β] [Nonempty β] [StandardBorelSpace β'] [Nonempty β'] (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) {k : Ω → γ} (hk : Measurable k) : ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun (MeasurableSpace.comap k inferInstance) ⋯ g f μ ↔ ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.condDistrib f (fun ω => (k ω, g ω)) μ) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => (k ω, g ω)) μ] ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkRight β' (ProbabilityTheory.condDistrib f k μ))

docstring: The affine span of a set is `⊥` if and only if that set is empty.
name: affineSpan_eq_bot
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {s : Set P} : Eq (α := AffineSubspace k P) (affineSpan k s) ⊥ ↔ s = ∅

docstring:
In the unit group of an integral domain, a unit is its own inverse iff the unit is one or
one's additive inverse.
name: Units.inv_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} [Ring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (u : Rˣ) : u⁻¹ = u ↔ u = 1 ∨ u = -1

docstring:
`P.rmatch x` is true if and only if `P` matches `x`. This is a computable definition equivalent
to `matches'`.
name: RegularExpression.rmatch
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] : RegularExpression α → List α → Bool

docstring:
Right multiplication is strictly monotone if and only if it is monotone and
right-cancellative.
name: mulRightStrictMono_iff_mulRightMono_and_isRightCancelMul
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [Mul α] [LinearOrder α] : MulRightStrictMono α ↔ MulRightMono α ∧ IsRightCancelMul α

docstring: The sum of a locally finite collection of sections is `C^k` at `x` iff each section is.
name: ContMDiffAt.sum_section_of_locallyFinite
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {F : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {V : M → Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace (Bundle.TotalSpace F V)] [(x : M) → TopologicalSpace (V x)] [FiberBundle F V] [(x : M) → AddCommGroup (V x)] [(x : M) → _root_.Module.{u_1, u_6} 𝕜 (V x)] [VectorBundle 𝕜 F V] {x₀ : M} {ι : Type u_7} {t : ι → (x : M) → V x} (ht : LocallyFinite.{u_7, u_4} (X := M) fun (i : ι) => {x | t i x ≠ 0}) (ht' : ∀ (i : ι), ContMDiffAt I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n (fun x => ⟨x, t i x⟩) x₀) : ContMDiffAt I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 F)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace F V) n (fun x => ⟨x, ∑' (i : ι), t i x⟩) x₀

docstring: A space is totally disconnected iff its connected components are subsingletons.
name: totallyDisconnectedSpace_iff_connectedComponent_subsingleton
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] : TotallyDisconnectedSpace α ↔ ∀ (x : α), (connectedComponent x).Subsingleton

docstring:
If `E / F` is algebraic, then an intermediate field of `E / F` is equal to the separable closure
of `F` in `E` if and only if it is separable over `F`, and `E` is purely inseparable
over it.
name: eq_separableClosure_iff
statement_text: (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (L : IntermediateField F E) : L = separableClosure F E ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable.{u, v} F ↥L ∧ IsPurelyInseparable (↥L) E

docstring:
The measure `μ` is Gaussian if and only if there
exist `m : E` and `f : StrongDual ℝ E →L[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ E →L[ℝ] ℝ`
satisfying `f.toBilinForm.IsPosSemidef` and `charFunDual μ L = exp (L m * I - f L L / 2)`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.isGaussian_iff_gaussian_charFunDual
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] : ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian μ ↔ ∃ m f, f.toBilinForm.IsPosSemidef ∧ ∀ (L : StrongDual ℝ E), MeasureTheory.charFunDual μ L = Complex.exp (↑(L m) * Complex.I - ↑((f L : StrongDual ℝ E →L[ℝ] ℝ) L) / 2)

docstring:
If the measure of the symmetric difference of two sets is finite,
then one has finite measure if and only if the other one does.
name: MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top_iff_of_symmDiff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {s : Set α} {t : Set α} (hμst : Ne (α := ENNReal) (μ (symmDiff s t) : ENNReal) (⊤ : ENNReal)) : Ne (α := ENNReal) (μ s : ENNReal) (⊤ : ENNReal) ↔ Ne (α := ENNReal) (μ t : ENNReal) (⊤ : ENNReal)

docstring:
A meromorphic function has normal form at `x` iff it is either analytic there, or if it has a pole
at `x` and takes the default value `0`.
name: meromorphicNFAt_iff_analyticAt_or
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} : MeromorphicNFAt f x ↔ AnalyticAt 𝕜 f x ∨ MeromorphicAt f x ∧ meromorphicOrderAt f x < 0 ∧ f x = 0

docstring:
The exponent is zero iff for all nonzero `n`, one can find a `g` such that
`n • g ≠ 0`.
name: AddMonoid.exponent_eq_zero_iff_forall
statement_text: {G : Type u} [AddMonoid G] : AddMonoid.exponent G = 0 ↔ ∀ n > 0, ∃ g, n • g ≠ 0

docstring: A set is complete iff its image under a uniform inducing map is complete.
name: isComplete_image_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] {m : α → β} {s : Set α} (hm : IsUniformInducing m) : IsComplete (m '' s) ↔ IsComplete s

docstring:
When `α` is complete, a set is Lower topology relative-open if and only if it is of the form
`(hull T a)ᶜ` for some `a` in `α`.
name: PrimitiveSpectrum.isOpen_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [CompleteLattice α] {T : Set α} [TopologicalSpace α] [Topology.IsLower α] (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, InfPrime p) (S : Set ↑T) : IsOpen S ↔ ∃ a, S = (PrimitiveSpectrum.hull T a)ᶜ

docstring: An element is in the kernel if and only if it maps to zero.
name: RingHom.mem_ker
statement_text: {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {F : Type u_1} [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [FunLike F R S] [RingHomClass F R S] {f : F} {r : R} : Membership.mem (γ := Ideal R) (RingHom.ker f) r ↔ f r = 0

docstring: A walk with its endpoints defeq is `Nil` if and only if it is equal to `nil`.
name: SimpleGraph.Walk.eq_nil_iff_nil
statement_text: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V} {p : G.Walk v v} : p = SimpleGraph.Walk.nil ↔ p.Nil

docstring: A set is codiscrete iff it is a punctured neighborhood of every point.
name: mem_codiscrete_iff_forall_mem_nhdsNE
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : s ∈ Filter.codiscrete X ↔ ∀ (x : X), s ∈ nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ

docstring: The continued fraction `GenContFract.of v` terminates if and only if `v ∈ ℚ`.
name: GenContFract.terminates_iff_rat
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [FloorRing K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] (v : K) : (GenContFract.of v).Terminates ↔ ∃ q, v = ↑q

docstring:
Suppose that `f` sends the complement to `s` to a single point `x`, and `l` is some filter.
Then `f` tends to `x` along `l` restricted to `s` if and only if it tends to `x` along `l`.
name: tendsto_inf_principal_nhds_iff_of_forall_eq
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {α : Type u_1} {x : X} {f : α → X} {l : Filter α} {s : Set α} (h : ∀ a ∉ s, f a = x) : Filter.Tendsto f (l ⊓ Filter.principal s) (nhds x) ↔ Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds x)

docstring: A set is Presburger definable in `ℕ` if and only if it is semilinear.
name: FirstOrder.Language.presburger.definable_iff_isSemilinearSet
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {A : Set ℕ} [Finite α] {s : Set (α → ℕ)} : A.Definable FirstOrder.Language.presburger s ↔ IsSemilinearSet s

docstring:
An `IdealFilter` on a ring `A` is uniform if and only if its ideals form a `RingFilterBasis`
for `A`.
name: IdealFilter.isUniform_iff_exists_ringFilterBasis
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] {F : IdealFilter A} : F.IsUniform ↔ ∃ B, Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := Set (Set A)) (FilterBasis.sets (@AddGroupFilterBasis.toFilterBasis _ AddGroupWithOne.toAddGroup _)) {x | ∃ I ∈ F, ↑I = x}

docstring:
A point equals its orthogonal projection if and only if it lies in
the subspace.
name: EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {s : AffineSubspace 𝕜 P} [Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} ↥s] [s.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] {p : P} : ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection s) p) = p ↔ p ∈ s

docstring:
An ordered monoid is `CanonicallyOrderedMul`
if the ordering coincides with the divisibility relation,
which is to say, `a ≤ b` iff there exists `c` with `b = a * c`.
Examples seem rare; it seems more likely that the `OrderDual`
of a naturally-occurring lattice satisfies this than the lattice
itself (for example, dual of the lattice of ideals of a PID or
Dedekind domain satisfy this; collections of all things ≤ 1 seem to
be more natural that collections of all things ≥ 1).
name: CanonicallyOrderedMul
statement_text: (α : Type u_1) [Mul α] [LE α] : Prop

docstring: The map of an empty cocone is a colimit iff the mapped object is initial.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.isColimitMapCoconeEmptyCoconeEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) (X : C) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (G.mapCocone (CategoryTheory.Limits.asEmptyCocone X)) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial.{v₂, u₂} (G.obj X)

docstring: A space is totally disconnected iff its connected components are singletons.
name: totallyDisconnectedSpace_iff_connectedComponent_singleton
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] : TotallyDisconnectedSpace α ↔ ∀ (x : α), connectedComponent x = {x}

docstring: A set of cardinals is bounded above iff it's small, i.e. it corresponds to a usual ZFC set.
name: Cardinal.bddAbove_iff_small
statement_text: {s : Set Cardinal.{u}} : BddAbove s ↔ Small.{u, u + 1} ↑s

docstring:
A predicate is true in a neighborhood of `x` iff it is true for all the points in an open set
containing `x`.
name: eventually_nhds_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} {p : X → Prop} : (∀ᶠ (y : X) in nhds x, p y) ↔ ∃ t, (∀ y ∈ t, p y) ∧ IsOpen t ∧ x ∈ t

docstring:
A function is `C^(n + 1)` on an open domain if and only if it is
differentiable there, and its derivative (expressed with `fderiv`) is `C^n`.
name: contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hs : IsOpen s) : ContDiffOn 𝕜 (n + 1) f s ↔ DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s ∧ (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f s) ∧ ContDiffOn 𝕜 (F := E →L[𝕜] F) n (fderiv 𝕜 f) s

docstring:
Given a submodule `N` in Smith normal form of a free ℤ-module, it has finite index as an
additive subgroup (i.e., `N.toAddSubgroup.index ≠ 0`) if and only if the submodule basis has as
many vectors as the basis for the module.
name: Module.Basis.SmithNormalForm.toAddSubgroup_index_ne_zero_iff
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {n : ℕ} [AddCommGroup M] [Fintype ι] {N : Submodule ℤ M} (snf : Module.Basis.SmithNormalForm N ι n) : N.toAddSubgroup.index ≠ 0 ↔ n = Fintype.card ι

docstring:
If `X` is a Jacobson scheme and `k` is a field,
`Spec(k) ⟶ X` is finite iff it is (locally) of finite type.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinite_iff_locallyOfFiniteType_of_jacobsonSpace
statement_text: {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ Y} [Subsingleton.{u + 1} ↥X] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced X] [JacobsonSpace.{u} ↥Y] : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite f ↔ AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f

docstring:
A correspondence `f : α → Set β` has open lower sections if and only if its *lower inverse*
(i.e., `b : β ↦ (f ⁻¹' Iic {b}ᶜ)ᶜ = {x | b ∈ f x}`) sends every point to an open set.
name: hasOpenLowerSections_iff_isOpen_compl_preimage_Iic_compl
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] {f : α → Set β} : HasOpenLowerSections f ↔ ∀ (b : β), IsOpen (f ⁻¹' Set.Iic {b}ᶜ)ᶜ

docstring:
If we have an adjunction `adj : F ⊣ G` of functors between preadditive categories,
and if `F` is additive, then the hom set equivalence upgrades to an `AddEquiv`.
Note that `F` is additive if and only if `G` is, by `Adjunction.right_adjoint_additive` and
`Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive`.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.homAddEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v₂, u₂} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} (adj : F ⊣ G) [F.Additive] (X : C) (Y : D) : AddEquiv.{v₂, v₁} (F.obj X ⟶ Y) (X ⟶ G.obj Y)

docstring:
Typeclass for purely inseparable field extensions: an algebraic extension `E / F` is purely
inseparable if and only if the minimal polynomial of every element of `E ∖ F` is not separable.

We define this for general (commutative) rings and only assume `F` and `E` are fields
if this is needed for a proof.
name: IsPurelyInseparable
statement_text: (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [CommRing F] [Ring E] [Algebra F E] : Prop

docstring: A set is dense iff it has non-trivial intersection with all basis sets.
name: TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis.dense_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u} [TopologicalSpace α] {b : Set (Set α)} (hb : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis b) {s : Set α} : Dense s ↔ ∀ o ∈ b, o.Nonempty → (o ∩ s).Nonempty

docstring:
A meromorphic function on `ℝ` or `ℂ` has infinite order at some point iff it vanishes outside a
discrete set, i.e. iff it is eventually zero along the codiscrete filter.
name: Meromorphic.exists_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff_eventually_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : Meromorphic f) : (∃ u, meromorphicOrderAt f u = ⊤) ↔ f =ᶠ[Filter.codiscrete 𝕜] 0

docstring:
`Cofork.ofπ π w` is a colimit cocone in `Cᵒᵖ` if and only if `Fork.ofι π'.unop w'` in `C` is
a limit cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.isColimitOfπEquivIsLimitUnop
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : Cᵒᵖ} {Y : Cᵒᵖ} {P : Cᵒᵖ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X ⟶ Y} (π : Y ⟶ P) (π' : Y ⟶ P) (w : Eq.{v₁ + 1} (α := X ⟶ P) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f π) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g π)) (w' : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp π'.unop f.unop = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp π'.unop g.unop) (h : π = π') : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.{0, v₁, 0, u₁} (C := Cᵒᵖ) (F := CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair f g) (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.ofπ π w) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι π'.unop w')

docstring:
An additive group of order `p ^ 2` is not cyclic if and only if its exponent is
`p`.
name: not_isAddCyclic_iff_exponent_eq_prime
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [AddGroup α] {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hα : Nat.card α = p ^ 2) : ¬IsAddCyclic α ↔ AddMonoid.exponent α = p

docstring: Two vector spaces are isomorphic if and only if they have the same dimension.
name: Module.nonempty_linearEquiv_iff_rank_eq
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {M₁ : Type v} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [_root_.Module R M₁] [Module.Free R M₁] [StrongRankCondition R] : Nonempty.{v + 1} (M ≃ₗ[R] M₁) ↔ Module.rank R M = Module.rank R M₁

docstring:
Two different points are equidistant from a third point if and only if that third point
equals some multiple of a `π / 2` rotation of the vector between those points, plus the midpoint
of those points.
name: EuclideanGeometry.dist_eq_iff_eq_smul_rotation_pi_div_two_vadd_midpoint
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p : P} (h : p₁ ≠ p₂) : dist p₁ p = dist p₂ p ↔ ∃ r, HSMul.hSMul (β := V) r ((Orientation.rotation EuclideanGeometry.o ↑(Real.pi / 2)) (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) : V) +ᵥ midpoint ℝ p₁ p₂ = p

docstring:
`y` has equal unoriented angles to `x` and `z` if and only if it has equal oriented angles
(bisects the angle) or `x` and `z` are on the same ray.
name: Orientation.angle_eq_iff_oangle_eq_or_sameRay
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} {z : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) : InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = InnerProductGeometry.angle y z ↔ o.oangle x y = o.oangle y z ∨ SameRay ℝ x z

docstring: An algebra is algebraic if and only if it is algebraic as a subalgebra.
name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A ↔ Subalgebra.IsAlgebraic.{u, v} (R := R) (A := A) ⊤

docstring:
A sieve belongs to the coherent topology if and only if it contains a finite
`EffectiveEpiFamily`.
name: CategoryTheory.coherentTopology.mem_sieves_iff_hasEffectiveEpiFamily
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Precoherent.{v_1, u_1} C] {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v_1, u_1} X) : S ∈ (CategoryTheory.coherentTopology C) X ↔ ∃ α, ∃ (_ : Finite α), ∃ Y π, CategoryTheory.EffectiveEpiFamily Y π ∧ ∀ (a : α), S.arrows (π a)

docstring:
The Bochner integral is linear. Note this requires `𝕜` to be a normed division ring, in order
to ensure that for `c ≠ 0`, the function `c • f` is integrable iff `f` is. For an analogous
statement for more general rings with an *a priori* integrability assumption on `f`, see
`MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_smul`.
name: MeasureTheory.integral_smul
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {𝕜 : Type u_4} [NormedDivisionRing 𝕜] {G : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [_root_.Module 𝕜 G] [NormSMulClass 𝕜 G] [SMulCommClass ℝ 𝕜 G] (c : 𝕜) (f : α → G) : ∫ (a : α), c • f a ∂μ = HSMul.hSMul (β := G) c (∫ (a : α), f a ∂μ)

docstring: A sieve is a cover for the regular topology if and only if it contains an `EffectiveEpi`.
name: CategoryTheory.regularTopology.mem_sieves_iff_hasEffectiveEpi
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Preregular.{v_1, u_1} C] {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v_1, u_1} X) : S ∈ (CategoryTheory.regularTopology C) X ↔ ∃ Y π, CategoryTheory.EffectiveEpi π ∧ S.arrows π

docstring:
An element is `M`-regular if and only if multiplying it on the left by an `M`-regular element
is `M`-regular.
name: IsSMulRegular.smul_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {a : R} [SMul R M] [SMul R S] [SMul S M] [IsScalarTower R S M] (b : S) (ha : IsSMulRegular M a) : IsSMulRegular M (a • b) ↔ IsSMulRegular M b

docstring:
A filter `l` is disjoint with the neighborhood filter of a compact set if and only if it is
disjoint with the neighborhood filter of each point of this set.
name: IsCompact.disjoint_nhdsSet_right
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter X} (hs : IsCompact s) : Disjoint l (nhdsSet s) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, Disjoint l (nhds x)

docstring: The oriented angle between two vectors is zero if and only if they are on the same ray.
name: Orientation.oangle_eq_zero_iff_sameRay
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) {x : V} {y : V} : o.oangle x y = 0 ↔ SameRay ℝ x y

docstring: A space is locally path-connected iff all path components of open subsets are neighbourhoods.
name: locallyPathConnectedSpace_iff_pathComponentIn_mem_nhds
statement_text: {X : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace X] : LocallyPathConnectedSpace X ↔ ∀ (x : X) (u : Set X), IsOpen u → x ∈ u → pathComponentIn u x ∈ nhds x

docstring:
The spans of two sets of points in a projective space are equal if and only if each set of
points is contained in the span of the other set.
name: Projectivization.Subspace.span_eq_span_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {S : Set (Projectivization K V)} {T : Set (Projectivization K V)} : Projectivization.Subspace.span S = Projectivization.Subspace.span T ↔ S ⊆ ↑(Projectivization.Subspace.span T) ∧ T ⊆ ↑(Projectivization.Subspace.span S)

docstring: A map is proper if and only if it is closed and its fibers are compact.
name: isProperMap_iff_isClosedMap_and_compact_fibers
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsProperMap f ↔ Continuous f ∧ IsClosedMap f ∧ ∀ (y : Y), IsCompact (f ⁻¹' {y})

docstring:
A set `A` is the compact coherentification is closed iff for all compact sets `K`,
the intersection `K ∩ A` is closed in `K`.
name: CompactCoherentification.isClosed_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : Set (CompactCoherentification X)} : IsClosed A ↔ ∀ (K : Set X), IsCompact K → IsClosed (X := ↑K) (Subtype.val (p := fun x => x ∈ K) ⁻¹' ⇑(CompactCoherentification.mk X) ⁻¹' A)

docstring:
A subgroup `H` has index two if and only if there exists `a ∉ H` such that for all `b`, one
of `a * b` and `b` belongs to `H`.
name: Subgroup.index_eq_two_iff_exists_notMem_and'
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [Group G] {H : Subgroup G} : H.index = 2 ↔ ∃ a ∉ H, ∀ (b : G), a * b ∈ H ∨ b ∈ H

docstring:
Two maps `f : M →* N` and `g : N →* P` are exact if and only if the induced maps
`MonoidHom.range f → N → MonoidHom.range g` are exact.
name: Function.MulExact.iff_monoidHom_rangeRestrict
statement_text: {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} {P : Type u_6} [Group M] [Group N] [Group P] {f : M →* N} {g : N →* P} : Function.MulExact.{u_2, u_4, u_6} (M := M) (N := N) (P := P) ⇑f ⇑g ↔ Function.MulExact.{u_4, u_4, u_6} (M := ↥f.range) (N := N) (P := ↥g.range) ⇑f.range.subtype ⇑g.rangeRestrict

docstring: A morphism in `Type` is an epimorphism if and only if it is surjective.
name: CategoryTheory.epi_iff_surjective
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : CategoryTheory.Epi f ↔ Function.Surjective (α := (fun (X : Type u) => X) X) (β := (fun (X : Type u) => X) Y) ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) f)

docstring:
This is a temporary definition, because we will prove in `code_is_ok` that it always holds.
It asserts that `c` is semantically correct; that is, for any `k` and `v`,
`eval (stepNormal c k v) = eval (Cfg.ret k (Code.eval c v))`, as an equality of partial values
(so one diverges iff the other does).

In particular, we can let `k = Cont.halt`, and then this asserts that `stepNormal c Cont.halt v`
evaluates to `Cfg.halt (Code.eval c v)`.
name: Turing.ToPartrec.Code.Ok
statement_text: (c : Turing.ToPartrec.Code) : Prop

docstring:
A lower block-triangular matrix is invertible iff both elements of its diagonal are.

This is a propositional form of `Matrix.fromBlocksZero₁₂InvertibleEquiv` forms an `iff`.
name: Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₁₂
statement_text: {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {α : Type u_4} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing α] {A : Matrix m m α} {C : Matrix n m α} {D : Matrix n n α} : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 C D) ↔ IsUnit A ∧ IsUnit D

docstring: A map is a homeomorphism iff it is a quotient map and injective.
name: isHomeomorph_iff_isQuotientMap_injective
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsHomeomorph f ↔ Topology.IsQuotientMap f ∧ Function.Injective f

docstring:
The image of an element `m : M` in `R[M]` belongs to the submodule generated by
`s : Set M` if and only if `m ∈ s`.
name: MonoidAlgebra.of_mem_span_of_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [MulOneClass M] {s : Set M} {m : M} [Nontrivial R] : Membership.mem (α := MonoidAlgebra R M) (γ := Submodule R (MonoidAlgebra R M)) (Submodule.span R (⇑(MonoidAlgebra.of R M) '' s)) ((MonoidAlgebra.of R M) m : MonoidAlgebra R M) ↔ m ∈ s

docstring: An operator is a symmetric projection if and only if it is an orthogonal projection.
name: LinearMap.isSymmetricProjection_iff_eq_coe_starProjection_range
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {p : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} : LinearMap.IsSymmetricProjection.{u_1, u_2} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) p ↔ ∃ (x : p.range.HasOrthogonalProjection), p = ↑p.range.starProjection

docstring: A meromorphic function has non-negative order iff there exists an analytic extension.
name: MeromorphicAt.meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt f x ↔ ∃ g, AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x ∧ f =ᶠ[nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ] g

docstring: A function is continuous on two closed sets iff it is also continuous on their union.
name: continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α} {t : Set α} {f : α → β} (hs : IsClosed s) (ht : IsClosed t) : ContinuousOn f (s ∪ t) ↔ ContinuousOn f s ∧ ContinuousOn f t

docstring:
`HasRingHomProperty P Q` is a type class asserting that `P` is local at the target and the source,
and for `f : Spec B ⟶ Spec A`, it is equivalent to the ring hom property `Q`.
To make the proofs easier, we state it instead as
1. `Q` is local (See `RingHom.PropertyIsLocal`)
2. `P f` if and only if `Q` holds for every `Γ(Y, U) ⟶ Γ(X, V)` for all affine `U`, `V`.
  See `HasRingHomProperty.iff_appLE`.
name: AlgebraicGeometry.HasRingHomProperty
statement_text: (P : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) (Q : outParam ({R S : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : CommRing S] → (R →+* S) → Prop)) : Prop

docstring:
One-sided martingale bound: If `f` is a submartingale which has uniformly bounded differences,
then for almost every `ω`, `f n ω` is bounded above (in `n`) if and only if it converges.
name: MeasureTheory.Submartingale.bddAbove_iff_exists_tendsto
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_2} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {R : NNReal} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hf : MeasureTheory.Submartingale f ℱ μ) (hbdd : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (i : ℕ), |f (i + 1) ω - f i ω| ≤ ↑R) : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, BddAbove (α := ℝ) (Set.range fun (n : ℕ) => f n ω) ↔ ∃ c, Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => f n ω) Filter.atTop (nhds c)

docstring: `M.vecMul` is surjective iff `M` has full column rank.
name: Matrix.vecMul_surjective_iff_rank_eq_card
statement_text: {m : Type um} {n : Type un} {R : Type uR} [Fintype n] [Field R] [Fintype m] {M : Matrix m n R} : (Function.Surjective (β := n → R) fun (v : m → R) => Matrix.vecMul v M) ↔ M.rank = Fintype.card n

docstring:
The principle of isolated zeros: If `f` is meromorphic at `x`, then `f` vanishes eventually in a
punctured neighborhood of `x` iff it vanishes frequently in punctured neighborhoods.

See `AnalyticAt.frequently_zero_iff_eventually_zero` for a stronger result in the analytic case.
name: MeromorphicAt.frequently_zero_iff_eventuallyEq_zero
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) : (∃ᶠ (z : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, f z = 0) ↔ f =ᶠ[nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ] 0

docstring:
A point lies in the closed interior of a 1-dimensional face of a simplex if and only if it lies
weakly between its vertices.
name: Affine.Simplex.mem_closedInterior_face_iff_wbtw
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_4} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module R V] [AddTorsor V P] [IsOrderedRing R] {n : ℕ} (s : Affine.Simplex R P n) {p : P} {i : Fin (n + 1)} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i ≠ j) : p ∈ (s.face (fs := {i, j}) ⋯).closedInterior ↔ Wbtw R (s.points i) p (s.points j)

docstring: `(fun x ↦ c) =O[l] f` if and only if `f` is bounded away from zero.
name: Asymptotics.isBigO_const_left_iff_pos_le_norm
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {E' : Type u_6} {E'' : Type u_9} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] {f' : α → E'} {l : Filter α} {c : E''} (hc : c ≠ 0) : Asymptotics.IsBigO.{u_1, u_9, u_6} (E := E'') l (fun _x => c) f' ↔ ∃ b, 0 < b ∧ ∀ᶠ (x : α) in l, b ≤ ‖f' x‖

docstring: A linear map is self-adjoint (with respect to the intrinsic star) iff it is star-preserving.
name: LinearMap.IntrinsicStar.isSelfAdjoint_iff_map_star
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [InvolutiveStar R] [AddCommMonoid E] [_root_.Module R E] [StarAddMonoid E] [StarModule R E] [AddCommMonoid F] [_root_.Module R F] [StarAddMonoid F] [StarModule R F] (f : WithConv (E →ₗ[R] F)) : IsSelfAdjoint f ↔ ∀ (x : E), Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := F) (f.ofConv (star x) : F) (star (f.ofConv x) : F)

docstring:
`ker f` is invariant under `T` if and only if `f ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ f = f ∘ₗ T`,
for idempotent `f`.
name: LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.ker_mem_invtSubmodule_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module R E] {T : E →ₗ[R] E} {f : E →ₗ[R] E} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : f.ker ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T ↔ f ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ f = f ∘ₗ T

docstring:
Two complementary submodules are topological complements if and only if the linear equivalence
`Submodule.quotientEquivOfIsCompl` is continuous.
name: Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_iff_continuous_quotientEquivOfIsCompl
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] {M : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {p : Submodule R M} {q : Submodule R M} [IsTopologicalAddGroup M] (h : IsCompl p q) : Submodule.IsTopCompl p q ↔ Continuous (X := M ⧸ p) (Y := ↥q) ⇑(p.quotientEquivOfIsCompl q h)

docstring: A type is terminal if and only if it contains exactly one element.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.isTerminalEquivUnique
statement_text: (X : Type u) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsTerminal X ≃ Unique X

docstring: Similarity holds iff pairwise distances are proportional with a positive ratio.
name: similar_iff_exists_pos_pairwise_dist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ Pairwise fun (i₁ : ι) i₂ => dist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = r * dist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
A function is `C^(n + 1)` on a domain with unique derivatives if and only if it is
differentiable there, and its derivative (formulated with `derivWithin`) is `C^n`.
name: contDiffOn_succ_iff_derivWithin
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : 𝕜 → F} {s : Set 𝕜} (hs : UniqueDiffOn 𝕜 s) : ContDiffOn 𝕜 (n + 1) f s ↔ DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s ∧ (n = ⊤ → AnalyticOn 𝕜 f s) ∧ ContDiffOn 𝕜 n (derivWithin f s) s

docstring:
For `p` prime, an element of `R` is a `p`-th root of unity if and only if it is either a
primitive `p`-th root of unity or `1`.
name: mem_nthRootsFinset_iff_of_prime
statement_text: {R : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) {η : R} : η ∈ Polynomial.nthRootsFinset p 1 ↔ IsPrimitiveRoot η p ∨ η = 1

docstring: A ring is a `ℚ`-algebra iff it has equal characteristic zero.
name: EqualCharZero.nonempty_algebraRat_iff
statement_text: (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] : Nonempty.{max (u_1 + 1) 1} (Algebra ℚ R) ↔ ∀ (I : Ideal R), I ≠ ⊤ → CharZero.{u_1} (R ⧸ I)

docstring:
Given `c = lineMap a b r`, `a < c`, the point `(c, f c)` is strictly above the
segment `[(a, f a), (b, f b)]` if and only if `slope f a b < slope f a c`.
name: lineMap_lt_map_iff_slope_lt_slope_left
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Field k] [LinearOrder k] [AddCommGroup E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [_root_.Module k E] [IsStrictOrderedModule k E] [PosSMulReflectLE k E] {f : k → E} {a : k} {b : k} {r : k} (h : 0 < r * (b - a)) : (AffineMap.lineMap (f a) (f b)) r < f ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r) ↔ slope f a b < slope f a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) r)

docstring:
`SignType.sign` as a `MonoidWithZeroHom` for a nontrivial ordered semiring. Note that linearity
is required; consider ℂ with the order `z ≤ w` iff they have the same imaginary part and
`z - w ≤ 0` in the reals; then `1 + I` and `1 - I` are incomparable to zero, and thus we have:
`0 * 0 = SignType.sign (1 + I) * SignType.sign (1 - I) ≠ SignType.sign 2 = 1`.
name: signHom
statement_text: {α : Type u} [Ring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] : α →*₀ SignType

docstring: The constant coefficient of the minimal polynomial of `x` is `0` if and only if `x = 0`.
name: minpoly.coeff_zero_eq_zero
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [Field A] [Ring B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra A B] {x : B} (hx : IsIntegral A x) : (Polynomial.coeff (minpoly A x)) 0 = 0 ↔ x = 0

docstring:
Two regular measures are equal iff they induce the same positive linear functional
on `C_c(X, ℝ)`.
name: RealRMK.integralPositiveLinearMap_inj
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure X} [LocallyCompactSpace X] [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular] : Eq (α := CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.integralPositiveLinearMap μ) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.integralPositiveLinearMap ν) ↔ μ = ν

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `- ⊗ M` is an exact functor. See
`Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_exact` to specialize the universe of `N, N', N''` to `Type (max u v)`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_exact'
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [Small.{v', u} R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' N'' : Type v'⦄ [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_6 : AddCommGroup N''] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_8 : _root_.Module R N'] [inst_9 : _root_.Module R N''] ⦃f : N →ₗ[R] N'⦄ ⦃g : N' →ₗ[R] N''⦄, Function.Exact (M := N) (N := N') (P := N'') ⇑f ⇑g → Function.Exact (M := TensorProduct R N M) (N := TensorProduct R N' M) (P := TensorProduct R N'' M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M g)

docstring:
`n + 1` points are affinely independent if and only if their
`vectorSpan` has dimension at least `n`.
name: affineIndependent_iff_le_finrank_vectorSpan
statement_text: (k : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [DivisionRing k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] [Fintype ι] (p : ι → P) {n : ℕ} (hc : Fintype.card ι = n + 1) : AffineIndependent k p ↔ n ≤ Module.finrank.{u_1, u_2} k ↥(vectorSpan k (Set.range p))

docstring:
**Local identity principle** for continuous maps: Two continuous maps into a Hausdorff space
agree in a punctured neighborhood of a non-isolated point iff they agree in a neighborhood.
name: ContinuousAt.eventuallyEq_nhds_iff_eventuallyEq_nhdsNE
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] {x : X} {f : X → Y} {g : X → Y} (hf : ContinuousAt f x) (hg : ContinuousAt g x) [(nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ).NeBot] : f =ᶠ[nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ] g ↔ f =ᶠ[nhds x] g

docstring: A presheaf is a sheaf after composing with a universe lift if and only if it is a sheaf.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.isSheafFor_comp_uliftFunctor_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, w, u, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)} {X : C} {R : CategoryTheory.Presieve.{v, u} X} : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor (P.comp CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{w', w}) R ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor P R

docstring:
In `Fin n`, all elements are odd for odd `n`,
otherwise an element is odd iff its `Fin.val` value is odd.
name: Fin.odd_iff
statement_text: {n : ℕ} {k : Fin n} [NeZero n] : Odd k ↔ Odd n ∨ Odd ↑k

docstring: A morphism in `Type _` is an epimorphism if and only if it is surjective.
name: CategoryTheory.ofHom_epi_iff_surjective
statement_text: {X : Type u} {Y : Type u} (f : X → Y) : CategoryTheory.Epi (TypeCat.ofHom f) ↔ Function.Surjective f

docstring: A (left) adjoint square has a lifting if and only if the original square has a lifting.
name: CategoryTheory.CommSq.left_adjoint_hasLift_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {A : C} {B : C} {X : D} {Y : D} {i : B ⟶ A} {p : Y ⟶ X} {u : X ⟶ G.obj A} {v : Y ⟶ G.obj B} (sq : CategoryTheory.CommSq v p (G.map i) u) (adj : F ⊣ G) : ⋯.HasLift ↔ sq.HasLift

docstring:
A real continuous linear map on the complex plane is conformal if and only if the map or its
conjugate is complex linear, and the map is nonvanishing.
name: isConformalMap_iff_is_complex_or_conj_linear
statement_text: {g : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ} : IsConformalMap g ↔ ((∃ map, ContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ map = g) ∨ ∃ map, ContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ map = g ∘SL ↑Complex.conjCLE) ∧ g ≠ 0

docstring:
A function is continuous on a set if and only if its composition with an open partial
homeomorphism on the right is continuous on the corresponding set.
name: OpenPartialHomeomorph.continuousOn_iff_continuousOn_comp_right
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace Z] (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X Y) {f : Y → Z} {s : Set Y} (h : s ⊆ e.target) : ContinuousOn f s ↔ ContinuousOn (f ∘ ↑e) (e.source ∩ ↑e ⁻¹' s)

docstring:
The neighborhood filter of a compact set is disjoint with a filter `l` if and only if the
neighborhood filter of each point of this set is disjoint with `l`.
name: IsCompact.disjoint_nhdsSet_left
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {l : Filter X} (hs : IsCompact s) : Disjoint (nhdsSet s) l ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, Disjoint (nhds x) l

docstring:
A presheaf is a sheaf for the Grothendieck topology generated by a union of coverages iff it is a
sheaf for the Grothendieck topology generated by each coverage separately.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.isSheaf_sup
statement_text: {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_2} C] (K : CategoryTheory.Coverage.{v_1, u_2} C) (L : CategoryTheory.Coverage.{v_1, u_2} C) (P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, u_1, u_2, u_1 + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type u_1)) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf (K ⊔ L).toGrothendieck P ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf K.toGrothendieck P ∧ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf L.toGrothendieck P

docstring: An idempotent operator is self-adjoint iff it is normal.
name: ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isStarNormal
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {T : E →L[𝕜] E} [CompleteSpace E] (hT : IsIdempotentElem T) : IsSelfAdjoint T ↔ IsStarNormal T

docstring: If `f` is an affine map, then its linear part is an open map iff `f` is an open map.
name: AffineMap.isOpenMap_linear_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} {Q : Type u_5} [AddCommGroup V] [TopologicalSpace V] [AddTorsor V P] [TopologicalSpace P] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor P] [AddCommGroup W] [TopologicalSpace W] [AddTorsor W Q] [TopologicalSpace Q] [IsTopologicalAddTorsor Q] [Ring R] [_root_.Module R V] [_root_.Module R W] {f : P →ᵃ[R] Q} : IsOpenMap.{u_2, u_4} (X := V) (Y := W) ⇑f.linear ↔ IsOpenMap.{u_3, u_5} (X := P) (Y := Q) ⇑f

docstring: `f` is homotopic to `g` iff `f - g` is homotopic to `0`.
name: Homotopy.equivSubZero
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {V : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.{v, u} V] {c : ComplexShape ι} {C : HomologicalComplex.{v, u, u_1} V c} {D : HomologicalComplex.{v, u, u_1} V c} {f : C ⟶ D} {g : C ⟶ D} : Homotopy f g ≃ Homotopy (f - g) 0

docstring: A substructure `S` includes `closure L s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.closure_le
statement_text: {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] {S : L.Substructure M} {s : Set M} : LowerAdjoint.toFun (FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.closure L) s ≤ S ↔ s ⊆ ↑S

docstring:
`extremalNumber (card V) H` is greater than `x` if and only if there exists a `H`-free simple
graph `G` with more than `x` edges.
name: SimpleGraph.lt_extremalNumber_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [Fintype V] (H : SimpleGraph W) (m : ℕ) : m < SimpleGraph.extremalNumber (Fintype.card V) H ↔ ∃ G x, H.Free G ∧ m < G.edgeFinset.card

docstring: `f : α →+* β` has a trivial codomain iff `f 1 = 0`.
name: RingHom.codomain_trivial_iff_map_one_eq_zero
statement_text: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} : ∀ {x : NonAssocSemiring α} {x_1 : NonAssocSemiring β} (f : α →+* β), 0 = 1 ↔ f 1 = 0

docstring: A set is meagre iff it is contained in a countable union of nowhere dense sets.
name: isMeagre_iff_countable_union_isNowhereDense
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : IsMeagre s ↔ ∃ S, (∀ t ∈ S, IsNowhereDense t) ∧ S.Countable ∧ s ⊆ ⋃₀ S

docstring: A sum is infinite iff one of the summands is infinite.
name: ENat.sum_eq_top
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℕ∞} : Eq (α := ℕ∞) (∑ x ∈ s, f x) ⊤ ↔ ∃ a ∈ s, f a = ⊤

docstring:
An analytic set is a set which is the continuous image of some Polish space. There are several
equivalent characterizations of this definition. For the definition, we pick one that avoids
universe issues: a set is analytic if and only if it is a continuous image of `ℕ → ℕ` (or if it
is empty). The above more usual characterization is given
in `analyticSet_iff_exists_polishSpace_range`.

Warning: these are analytic sets in the context of descriptive set theory (which is why they are
registered in the namespace `MeasureTheory`). They have nothing to do with analytic sets in the
context of complex analysis.
name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet
statement_text: {α : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace α] (s : Set α) : Prop

docstring:
The Lebesgue integral is zero iff the function is a.e. zero.

The measurability assumption is necessary, otherwise there are counterexamples: for instance, the
conclusion fails if `f` is the characteristic function of a Vitali set.
name: MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_zero_iff'
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → ENNReal} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) : ∫⁻ (a : α), f a ∂μ = 0 ↔ f =ᵐ[μ] 0

docstring:
The family of elements given by `x : FirstObj P S` is compatible iff `firstMap` and `secondMap`
map it to the same point.
name: CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Sieve.compatible_iff
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (P : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type (max v u))) {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v, u} X) (x : CategoryTheory.Equalizer.FirstObj P S.arrows) : CategoryTheory.Presieve.FamilyOfElements.Compatible (P := P) (R := S.arrows) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.firstObjEqFamily P S.arrows).hom) x) ↔ Eq (α := (fun (X : Type (max u v)) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Sieve.SecondObj P S)) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Sieve.firstMap P S)) x : (fun (X : Type (max u v)) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Sieve.SecondObj P S)) ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (FC := TypeCat.Fun) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Sieve.secondMap P S)) x : (fun (X : Type (max u v)) => X) (CategoryTheory.Equalizer.Sieve.SecondObj P S))

docstring:
A line through a point on a sphere is tangent if and only if the squared distance
from the external point to the tangent point equals the power of the point.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.isTangentAt_iff_dist_sq_eq_power
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {P : Type u_2} [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] {t : P} {p : P} {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} (ht : t ∈ s) : s.IsTangentAt t line[ℝ, p, t] ↔ dist p t ^ 2 = s.power p

docstring: A sum is finite iff all summands are finite.
name: ENat.sum_lt_top
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℕ∞} : LT.lt (α := ℕ∞) (∑ a ∈ s, f a) ⊤ ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, f a < ⊤

docstring:
An element is add-right-regular if and only if adding it on the right to
an add-right-regular element is add-right-regular.
name: add_isAddRightRegular_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [AddSemigroup R] {a : R} (b : R) (ha : IsAddRightRegular a) : IsAddRightRegular (b + a) ↔ IsAddRightRegular b

docstring: `CharacterModule M` is Baer iff `M` is flat.
name: Module.Flat.iff_characterModule_baer
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ Module.Baer.{u, v} R (CharacterModule M)

docstring: A rotation of a vector equals that vector if and only if the vector or the angle is zero.
name: Orientation.rotation_eq_self_iff
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2)) (x : V) (θ : Real.Angle) : (o.rotation θ) x = x ↔ x = 0 ∨ θ = 0

docstring: A sum is add-regular if and only if the summands are.
name: isAddRegular_add_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [AddCommSemigroup R] {a : R} {b : R} : IsAddRegular (a + b) ↔ IsAddRegular a ∧ IsAddRegular b

docstring:
The domination order on local subrings.
