`A` dominates `B` if and only if `B ≤ A` (as subrings) and `m_A ∩ B = m_B`.
name: LocalSubring.instPartialOrder
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] : PartialOrder (LocalSubring R)

docstring:
If `C` is finitely cocomplete, then `F : C ⥤ D` is representably coflat iff it preserves
finite colimits.
name: CategoryTheory.preservesFiniteColimits_iff_coflat
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteColimits.{v₁, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D) : CategoryTheory.RepresentablyCoflat F ↔ CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits F

docstring: If `p` is prime, then `J(a | p)` is `-1` iff `a` is not a square modulo `p`.
name: ZMod.nonsquare_iff_jacobiSym_eq_neg_one
statement_text: {a : ℤ} {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] : jacobiSym a p = -1 ↔ ¬IsSquare (α := ZMod p) ↑a

docstring: Fractional operation is valid iff nonempty.
name: FractionalOperation.IsValid
statement_text: {D : Type u_1} {m : ℕ} (ω : FractionalOperation D m) : Prop

docstring:
A function `f : M → N` between `C^n` manifolds is `C^n` if and only if it is continuous
and its composition `φ ∘ f` with a `C^n` immersion `φ : N → N'` is `C^n`.
name: ContMDiff.iff_comp_isImmersion
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {E''' : Type u_4} {E'' : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup E''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E''] [NormedAddCommGroup E'''] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'''] {H : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace H] {G : Type u_9} [TopologicalSpace G] {G' : Type u_10} [TopologicalSpace G'] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {J : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E'' G} {J' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E''' G'} {M : Type u_11} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {N : Type u_13} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace G N] {N' : Type u_14} [TopologicalSpace N'] [ChartedSpace G' N'] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {f : M → N} {φ : N → N'} (hφ : Manifold.IsImmersion J J' n φ) : ContMDiff I J n f ↔ Continuous f ∧ ContMDiff I J' n (φ ∘ f)

docstring: An additive character on `ZMod n` is nontrivial iff it takes a value `≠ 1` on `1`.
name: AddChar.zmod_char_ne_one_iff
statement_text: {C : Type v} [CommMonoid C] (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (ψ : AddChar (ZMod n) C) : ψ ≠ 1 ↔ ψ 1 ≠ 1

docstring:
A bicone over a pair is a limit cone if and only if the corresponding binary bicone is a limit
cone.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Bicone.toBinaryBiconeIsLimit
statement_text: {C : Type uC} [CategoryTheory.Category.{uC', uC} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{uC', uC} C] {X : C} {Y : C} (b : CategoryTheory.Limits.Bicone.{0, uC', uC} (CategoryTheory.Limits.pairFunction X Y)) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit b.toBinaryBicone.toCone ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit b.toCone

docstring: **Vieta's formula** for quadratics as an iff (`aroots` version).
name: Polynomial.aroots_quadratic_eq_pair_iff_of_ne_zero
statement_text: {T : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [CommRing T] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra T S] {a : T} {b : T} {c : T} {x1 : S} {x2 : S} (ha : (algebraMap T S) a ≠ 0) : (HAdd.hAdd (β := Polynomial T) (HMul.hMul (α := Polynomial T) (Polynomial.C a : Polynomial T) (HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial T) Polynomial.X 2) + HMul.hMul (α := Polynomial T) (β := Polynomial T) (Polynomial.C b : Polynomial T) Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.C c : Polynomial T)).aroots S = {x1, x2} ↔ (algebraMap T S) b = HMul.hMul (α := S) (-(algebraMap T S) a : S) (x1 + x2) ∧ (algebraMap T S) c = HMul.hMul (α := S) ((algebraMap T S) a : S) x1 * x2

docstring: When `f` is an isomorphism, `f ≫ g` is monic iff `g` is.
name: CategoryTheory.mono_comp_iff_of_isIso
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {X : C} {Y : C} {Z : C} (g : Z ⟶ Y) [CategoryTheory.IsIso g] (f : Y ⟶ X) : CategoryTheory.Mono (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g f) ↔ CategoryTheory.Mono f

docstring:
A function to a pseudo-metric-space is `1`-Lipschitz if and only if points in the same cylinder
of length `n` are sent to points within distance `(1/2)^n`.
name: PiNat.lipschitz_with_one_iff_forall_dist_image_le_of_mem_cylinder
statement_text: {E : ℕ → Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [PseudoMetricSpace α] {f : ((n : ℕ) → E n) → α} : (∀ (x y : (n : ℕ) → E n), dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist x y) ↔ ∀ (x y : (n : ℕ) → E n) (n : ℕ), y ∈ PiNat.cylinder (E := E) x n → dist (f x) (f y) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n

docstring: `g` lies in the additive `p`-primary component iff `p ^ k • g = 0` for some `k`.
name: AddCommMonoid.mem_primaryComponent
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid G] {p : ℕ} {g : G} : Membership.mem (γ := AddSubmonoid G) (AddCommMonoid.primaryComponent G p) g ↔ ∃ k, p ^ k • g = 0

docstring:
`p ∈ M` is an interior point of a manifold `M` if and only if its image in the extended chart
lies in the interior of the model space.
name: ModelWithCorners.IsInteriorPoint
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] (x : M) : Prop

docstring: An element of a product algebra is integral iff each component is integral.
name: IsIntegral.pair_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] {x : A × B} : IsIntegral R x ↔ IsIntegral R x.1 ∧ IsIntegral R x.2

docstring: The sine of the angle between two vectors is 1 if and only if the angle is π / 2.
name: InnerProductGeometry.sin_eq_one_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {x : V} {y : V} : Real.sin (InnerProductGeometry.angle x y) = 1 ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle x y = Real.pi / 2

docstring:
A subcanonical topology is a topology which is smaller than the canonical topology.
Equivalently, a topology is subcanonical iff every representable is a sheaf.
name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Subcanonical
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (J : CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.{v, u} C) : Prop

docstring:
**Converse Gibbs' inequality**: the Kullback-Leibler divergence between two finite measures is
zero if and only if the two measures are equal.
name: InformationTheory.klDiv_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] : InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν = 0 ↔ μ = ν

docstring: A polynomial of degree 2 or 3 is irreducible iff it doesn't have roots.
name: Polynomial.Monic.irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p.Monic) (hp2 : 2 ≤ p.natDegree) (hp3 : p.natDegree ≤ 3) : Irreducible p ↔ p.roots = 0

docstring:
A vector added to the second point lies in the affine span of two points if and only if it is
a multiple of their difference.
name: vadd_right_mem_affineSpan_pair
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {v : V} : Membership.mem (γ := AffineSubspace k P) line[k, p₁, p₂] (v +ᵥ p₂) ↔ ∃ r, r • (p₁ -ᵥ p₂) = v

docstring:
`G` is a commutative additive group object if and only if the commutator map
`(x, y) ↦ x + y + (-x) + (-y)` is constant.
name: CategoryTheory.isCommAddMonObj_iff_addCommutator_eq_toAddUnit_η
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{v, u} C] {G : C} [CategoryTheory.AddGrpObj G] [CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory.{v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.IsCommAddMonObj.{v, u} G ↔ CategoryTheory.AddGrpObj.addCommutator G = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Y := CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit.{v, u} C (𝒞 := inst)) (CategoryTheory.SemiCartesianMonoidalCategory.toUnit (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{v, u} (𝒞 := inst) G G)) CategoryTheory.AddMonObj.zero

docstring:
A self-map `f : X → X` of a preregular space `X` has compact fixed support if and only if `f`
fixes the complement of a compact set.
name: Function.HasCompactFixedSupport_iff
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : X → X} [R1Space X] : Function.HasCompactFixedSupport f ↔ ∃ K, IsCompact K ∧ (Function.fixedPoints f)ᶜ ⊆ K

docstring: A cocone is a colimit cocone iff it is initial.
name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.isColimitEquivIsInitial
statement_text: {J : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J] {C : Type u₃} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} J C} (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone F) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit c ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsInitial c

docstring:
`a` is in the down-compressed family iff it's in the original and its compression is in the
original, or it's not in the original but it's the compression of something in the original.
name: Down.mem_compression
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {s : Finset α} {a : α} : s ∈ Down.compression a 𝒜 ↔ s ∈ 𝒜 ∧ s.erase a ∈ 𝒜 ∨ s ∉ 𝒜 ∧ insert a s ∈ 𝒜

docstring:
An `R`-module `M` is flat iff for all ideals `I` of `R`, the tensor product of the
inclusion `I → R` and the identity `M → M` is injective. See `iff_rTensor_injective` to
restrict to finitely generated ideals `I`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_injective'

docstring:
Two random variables are conditionally independent iff they satisfy the almost sure equality
of conditional expectations `μ⟦f ⁻¹' s ∩ g ⁻¹' t | m'⟧ =ᵐ[μ] μ⟦f ⁻¹' s | m'⟧ * μ⟦g ⁻¹' t | m'⟧`
for all measurable sets `s` and `t` (see `condIndepFun_iff_condExp_inter_preimage_eq_mul`).
Here, this is phrased with Markov kernels associated to the conditional expectations.

For a random variable `f`, `(condExpKernel μ m').map f` is the law of the conditional expectation
of `f` given `m'`: almost surely, `(condExpKernel μ m').map f ω s = μ⟦f ⁻¹' s | m'⟧ ω`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.condIndepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {β' : Type u_4} {m' : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [StandardBorelSpace Ω] {hm' : m' ≤ mΩ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Ω → β} {g : Ω → β'} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mβ' : MeasurableSpace β'} [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated Ω (β × β')] (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) : ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun m' hm' f g μ ↔ ⇑((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map fun ω => (f ω, g ω)) =ᵐ[μ.trim hm'] ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prod ((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map f) ((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map g))

docstring: A function has finite integral for the counting measure iff its enorm has finite `tsum`.

statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {ε : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [ENorm ε] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {f : α → ε} : @MeasureTheory.HasFiniteIntegral _ _ _ m f MeasureTheory.Measure.count ↔ LT.lt (α := ENNReal) (∑' (x : α), ‖f x‖ₑ) ⊤

docstring:
Given a linear map `l : M → N` over a local ring `(R, 𝔪, k)`

statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [_root_.Module R M] [_root_.Module R N] [IsLocalRing R] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Free R N] (l : M →ₗ[R] N) : (∃ l', l' ∘ₗ l = LinearMap.id) ↔ Function.Injective (α := TensorProduct R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) M) (β := TensorProduct R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) N) ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) l)

docstring:
`a ≡ b [PMOD p]` means that `b` is congruent to `a` modulo `p`.

If `a`, `b` are elements of an additive group,
then `a ≡ b [PMOD p]` iff `m • p = b - a` for some `m : ℤ`, see `modEq_iff_zsmul` below.
For additive commutative monoid, the definition is given by `modEq_iff_nsmul`.

Equivalently (as shown in `Algebra.Order.ToIntervalMod`), `b` does not lie in the open interval
`(a, a + p)` modulo `p`, or `toIcoMod hp a` disagrees with `toIocMod hp a` at `b`, or
`toIcoDiv hp a` disagrees with `toIocDiv hp a` at `b`.
name: AddCommGroup.«term_≡_[PMOD_]»
statement_text: : TrailingParserDescr

docstring:
We call *occurrence set* for pattern `p` and position `g` the set of configurations
in which a pattern `p` occurs at position `g`.

This proves that it is exactly the cylinder corresponding to the
pattern obtained by translating `p` by `g`.

Equivalently, `p.occursInAt x g` iff on every translated site `g + w` (with `w ∈ p.support`)
the configuration `x` agrees with the translated pattern `Pattern.shift p g`.
name: SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.occursInAt_eq_cylinder
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [Inhabited A] {G : Type u_2} [AddMonoid G] [IsLeftCancelAdd G] (p : SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.Pattern A G) (g : G) : {x | p.occursInAt x g} = SymbolicDynamics.FullShift.cylinder (Finset.image (fun x => g + x) p.support) (p.shift g)

statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P} {i₁ : Fin 3} {i₂ : Fin 3} {i₃ : Fin 3} (h₁₂ : i₁ ≠ i₂) (h₁₃ : i₁ ≠ i₃) (h₂₃ : i₂ ≠ i₃) {p : P} : dist p ↑((Affine.Simplex.faceOpposite t i₃).orthogonalProjectionSpan p) = dist p ↑((Affine.Simplex.faceOpposite t i₂).orthogonalProjectionSpan p) ↔ 2 • EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.points i₂) (t.points i₁) p = 2 • EuclideanGeometry.oangle p (t.points i₁) (t.points i₃)

statement_text: {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (r : NNReal) (f : ℕ → E) : Eq.{u_1 + 1} (α := E) (∫ (n : ℕ), f n ∂ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) (∑' (n : ℕ), (Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial) • f n)

docstring:
In a finite-dimensional inner product space, the range of a sequence of measures
`μ : ℕ → Measure E` is tight if and only if the function
`r : ℝ ↦ limsup (fun n ↦ μ n {x | r < ‖⟪y, x⟫_𝕜‖}) atTop` tends to `0` at infinity for all `y`.
name: MeasureTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_iff_tendsto_limsup_inner
statement_text: {E : Type u_1} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (𝕜 : Type u_2) [RCLike 𝕜] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : ℕ → MeasureTheory.Measure E} [∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] : MeasureTheory.IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range μ) ↔ ∀ (y : E), Filter.Tendsto (fun (r : ℝ) => Filter.limsup (fun (n : ℕ) => (μ n) {x | r < ‖inner 𝕜 y x‖}) Filter.atTop) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

docstring:
A vector field on a vector space is `C^n` in the manifold sense iff it is `C^n` in the vector
space sense.
name: contMDiff_vectorSpace_iff_contDiff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {V : (x : E) → TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E) x} : (ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E) (ModelWithCorners.tangent (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E)) (M' := Bundle.TotalSpace (B := E) E (TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf 𝕜 E))) n fun (x : E) => ⟨x, V x⟩) ↔ ContDiff 𝕜 n V

docstring: A set is residual (comeagre) if and only if it includes a dense `Gδ` set.
name: mem_residual
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] [BaireSpace X] {s : Set X} : s ∈ residual X ↔ ∃ t ⊆ s, IsGδ t ∧ Dense t

docstring: An absolute value is equivalent to the trivial iff it is trivial itself.
name: AbsoluteValue.isEquiv_trivial_iff_eq_trivial
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [Field R] [Semifield S] [LinearOrder S] [DecidablePred fun (x : R) => x = 0] [NoZeroDivisors R] [IsStrictOrderedRing S] {f : AbsoluteValue R S} : f.IsEquiv AbsoluteValue.trivial ↔ f = AbsoluteValue.trivial

docstring:
If the index type has cardinality equal to the finite dimension, an orientation equals the
negation of another orientation if and only if they are not equal.
name: Orientation.ne_iff_eq_neg
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {ι : Type u_3} [Fintype ι] [FiniteDimensional R M] (x₁ : Orientation R M ι) (x₂ : Orientation R M ι) (h : Fintype.card ι = Module.finrank R M) : x₁ ≠ x₂ ↔ x₁ = -x₂

docstring:
An irreducible `a` divides the radical of `b` if and only if it divides `b` itself.
Note this generalises to radical elements `a`, see `UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_radical_iff`.
name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_radical_iff_of_irreducible
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [CommMonoidWithZero M] [NormalizationMonoid M] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid M] {a : M} {b : M} (ha : Irreducible a) (hb : b ≠ 0) : a ∣ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical b ↔ a ∣ b

docstring: The exponent is zero iff for all nonzero `n`, one can find a `g` such that `g ^ n ≠ 1`.
name: Monoid.exponent_eq_zero_iff_forall
statement_text: {G : Type u} [Monoid G] : Monoid.exponent G = 0 ↔ ∀ n > 0, ∃ g, g ^ n ≠ 1

docstring:
A finite and nontrivial graph is connected if and only if its diameter is not zero.
See also `connected_iff_ediam_ne_top` for the extended diameter version.
name: SimpleGraph.connected_iff_diam_ne_zero
statement_text: {α : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph α} [Finite α] [Nontrivial α] : G.Connected ↔ G.diam ≠ 0

docstring:
A space is simply connected if and only if it is path-connected and every loop
at any basepoint is null-homotopic (i.e., homotopic to the constant loop).
name: simply_connected_iff_loops_nullhomotopic
statement_text: {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace Y] : SimplyConnectedSpace Y ↔ PathConnectedSpace Y ∧ ∀ (x : Y) (γ : Path x x), γ.Homotopic (Path.refl x)

docstring: An element is in `spinGroup Q` if and only if it is in `pinGroup Q` and `even Q`.
name: spinGroup.mem_iff
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] {Q : QuadraticForm R M} {x : CliffordAlgebra Q} : x ∈ spinGroup Q ↔ x ∈ pinGroup Q ∧ x ∈ CliffordAlgebra.even Q

docstring:
A function `f` has derivative `f'` at `z` iff `conj ∘ f ∘ conj` has derivative `conj f'` at
`conj z`.
name: hasDerivAt_conj_conj_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [StarRing 𝕜] [NormedStarGroup 𝕜] {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {x : 𝕜} {f' : 𝕜} : HasDerivAt (⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜) ∘ f ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd 𝕜)) f' x ↔ HasDerivAt f ((starRingEnd 𝕜) f') ((starRingEnd 𝕜) x)

docstring: A set `B` is a `G`-block iff the sets of the form `g +ᵥ B` are pairwise equal or disjoint.
name: AddAction.IsBlock
statement_text: (G : Type u_1) {X : Type u_2} [VAdd G X] (B : Set X) : Prop

docstring:
A 2-square is Guitart exact iff it is so after replacing the top and bottom functors by
isomorphic functors.
name: CategoryTheory.TwoSquare.GuitartExact.whiskerHorizontal_iff
statement_text: {C₁ : Type u_1} {C₂ : Type u_2} {D₁ : Type u_4} {D₂ : Type u_5} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} C₂] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_4, u_4} D₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_5, u_5} D₂] {T : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_4, u_1, u_4} C₁ D₁} {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C₁ C₂} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_4, v_5, u_4, u_5} D₁ D₂} {B : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_5, u_2, u_5} C₂ D₂} (w : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare T L R B) {T' : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_4, u_1, u_4} C₁ D₁} {B' : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_5, u_2, u_5} C₂ D₂} (α : T ≅ T') (β : B ≅ B') : (w.whiskerHorizontal α.inv β.hom).GuitartExact ↔ w.GuitartExact

docstring:
If two functions differ only on a discrete set of an open, then one is meromorphic iff so is the
other.
name: meromorphicOn_congr_codiscreteWithin
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {U : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (h₁ : f =ᶠ[Filter.codiscreteWithin U] g) (h₂ : IsOpen U) : MeromorphicOn f U ↔ MeromorphicOn g U

docstring: `R` is integrally closed iff it is the integral closure of itself in its field of fractions.
name: isIntegrallyClosed_iff_isIntegralClosure
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (K : Type u_4) [CommRing K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] : IsIntegrallyClosed R ↔ IsIntegralClosure R R K

docstring:
A map is a strict map if and only if the canonical injection `Quotient (Setoid.ker f) → Y`
(`Setoid.kerLift f`) is an embedding.
name: Topology.isStrictMap_iff_isEmbedding_kerLift
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : Topology.IsStrictMap f ↔ Topology.IsEmbedding (Setoid.kerLift f)

docstring:
For unitary `U` in a star-monoid `R`, `x * U = y * U` if and only if `x = y`
for all `x` and `y` in `R`.
name: Unitary.mul_left_inj
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [Monoid R] [StarMul R] {x : R} {y : R} (U : ↥(unitary R)) : x * ↑U = y * ↑U ↔ x = y

docstring: A subfield `t` includes `closure s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: Subfield.closure_le
statement_text: {K : Type u} [DivisionRing K] {s : Set K} {t : Subfield K} : Subfield.closure s ≤ t ↔ s ⊆ ↑t

docstring: Two finite measures on a product are equal iff they are equal on products of sets.
name: MeasureTheory.Measure.ext_prod_iff
statement_text: {α : Type u_4} {β : Type u_5} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (α × β)} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (α × β)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] : μ = ν ↔ ∀ {s : Set α} {t : Set β}, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet t → Eq (α := ENNReal) (μ (s ×ˢ t) : ENNReal) (ν (s ×ˢ t) : ENNReal)

docstring:
`p` is a Taylor series of `f` up to `n+1` if and only if `p.shift` is a Taylor series up to `n`
for `p 1`, which is a derivative of `f`.
name: hasFTaylorSeriesUpTo_succ_nat_iff_right
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} {n : ℕ} : HasFTaylorSeriesUpTo (↑(n + 1)) f p ↔ (∀ (x : E), (p x 0).curry0 = f x) ∧ (∀ (x : E), HasFDerivAt (fun y => p y 0) ((p x 1).curryLeft (Ei := fun _i => E)) x) ∧ HasFTaylorSeriesUpTo (𝕜 := 𝕜) (F := E →L[𝕜] F) (↑n) (fun (x : E) => (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 𝕜 E F) (p x 1)) fun x => (p x).shift

docstring:
Formulation of `MeromorphicAt.frequently_zero_iff_eventuallyEq_zero` as an identity principle: If
`f` and `g` are meromorphic at `x`, then `f` and `g` agree eventually in a punctured neighborhood of
`x` iff they agree at points arbitrarily close to (but different from) `x`.
name: MeromorphicAt.frequently_eq_iff_eventuallyEq
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {x : 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → E} {g : 𝕜 → E} (hf : MeromorphicAt f x) (hg : MeromorphicAt g x) : (∃ᶠ (z : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, f z = g z) ↔ f =ᶠ[nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ] g

docstring:
A set of `ℕ` is semilinear if and only if it is ultimately periodic, i.e. periodic after some
number `k`.
name: Nat.isSemilinearSet_iff_ultimately_periodic
statement_text: {s : Set ℕ} : IsSemilinearSet s ↔ ∃ k, ∃ p > 0, ∀ x ≥ k, x ∈ s ↔ x + p ∈ s

docstring:
`E` and `F` are homotopy equivalent, then the multifork associated
to `E` is exact if and only if the multifork associated to `F` is exact.
name: CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.Homotopy.isLimitMultiforkEquiv
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {S : C} {E : CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.{w, v, u} S} {F : CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.{w', v, u} S} {A : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} A] (f : E.Hom F) (g : F.Hom E) (hfg : CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.Homotopy (f.comp g) (CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.Hom.id E)) (hgf : CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.Homotopy (g.comp f) (CategoryTheory.PreOneHypercover.Hom.id F)) {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v, v_1, u, u_1} Cᵒᵖ A} : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (E.multifork G) ≃ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (F.multifork G)

docstring: `span {a}` divides `span {b}` if and only if `a` divides `b`.
name: Ideal.span_singleton_dvd_span_singleton_iff_dvd
statement_text: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {a : R} {b : R} : Dvd.dvd (α := Ideal R) (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b}) ↔ a ∣ b

docstring:
Two random variables are conditionally independent with respect to `m'` iff the law of
`(id, f, g)` under `μ`, in which the identity is to the space with σ-algebra `m'`, can be written
as a product involving the conditional expectations of `f` and `g` given `m'`.

For a random variable `f`, `(condExpKernel μ m').map f` is the law of the conditional expectation
of `f` given `m'`: almost surely, `(condExpKernel μ m').map f ω s = μ⟦f ⁻¹' s | m'⟧ ω`.
name: ProbabilityTheory.condIndepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_comp_trim
statement_text: {Ω : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {β' : Type u_4} {m' : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [StandardBorelSpace Ω] {hm' : m' ≤ mΩ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Ω → β} {g : Ω → β'} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mβ' : MeasurableSpace β'} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) : ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun m' hm' f g μ ↔ Eq (α := MeasureTheory.Measure (Ω × β × β')) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => (ω, f ω, g ω)) μ) ((μ.trim hm').bind ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prod ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.id (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prod ((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map f) ((ProbabilityTheory.condExpKernel μ m').map g))))

docstring:
Given an affinely independent family of points, two affine combinations (with sum of weights 1)
are equal if and only if their weights are pointwise equal.
name: AffineIndependent.affineCombination_eq_iff_eq
statement_text: {k : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module k V] [AddTorsor V P] {ι : Type u_4} {p : ι → P} (ha : AffineIndependent k p) {w₁ : ι → k} {w₂ : ι → k} {s : Finset ι} (hw₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₁ i = 1) (hw₂ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₂ i = 1) : Eq.{u_3 + 1} (α := P) ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₁ : P) ((Finset.affineCombination k s p) w₂ : P) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, w₁ i = w₂ i

docstring: A set is ample iff its affine translation is.
name: AmpleSet.vadd_iff
statement_text: {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E] [ContinuousAdd E] {s : Set E} {y : E} : AmpleSet (y +ᵥ s) ↔ AmpleSet s

docstring:
A property holds along the codiscrete filter iff it holds along the punctured neighborhood of
every point.
name: eventually_codiscrete_iff_forall_eventually_nhdsNE
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace X] {p : X → Prop} : (∀ᶠ (x : X) in Filter.codiscrete X, p x) ↔ ∀ (x : X), ∀ᶠ (y : X) in nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ, p y

docstring: A module is Noetherian iff every nonempty set of submodules has a maximal submodule among them.
name: set_has_maximal_iff_noetherian
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] : (∀ (a : Set (Submodule R M)), a.Nonempty → ∃ M' ∈ a, ∀ I ∈ a, ¬M' < I) ↔ IsNoetherian R M

docstring:
The chromatic number of a graph is the minimal number of colors needed to color it.
This is `⊤` (infinity) iff `G` isn't colorable with finitely many colors.

If `G` is colorable, then `ENat.toNat G.chromaticNumber` is the `ℕ`-valued chromatic number.
name: SimpleGraph.chromaticNumber
statement_text: {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ∞

docstring:
For an adjoint triple `F ⊣ G ⊣ H` where `F` and `H` are fully faithful, the natural
transformation `F ⟶ H` is monic at `X` iff the unit of the adjunction `G ⊣ H` is monic
at `F.obj X`.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple.mono_leftToRight_app_iff_mono_adj₂_unit_app
statement_text: {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} D] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_1, u_2, u_1} D C} {H : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C D} (t : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple F G H) [F.Full] [F.Faithful] {X : C} : CategoryTheory.Mono (t.leftToRight.app X) ↔ CategoryTheory.Mono (X := CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{v_2, v_2, u_2, u_2} (CategoryTheory.Functor.id D) (F.obj X)) (t.adj₂.unit.app (F.obj X))

docstring:
A modular form is a cusp form if and only if it vanishes at every cusp. This is the
general characterization valid for any subgroup.
name: ModularForm.isCuspForm_iff
statement_text: {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} {k : ℤ} [Γ.HasDetOne] (f : ModularForm Γ k) : f.IsCuspForm ↔ ∀ {c : OnePoint ℝ}, IsCusp c Γ → c.IsZeroAt (⇑f) k

docstring: A function is differentiable on two open sets iff it is differentiable on their union.
name: mdifferentiableOn_union_iff_of_isOpen
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {E' : Type u_5} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] {H' : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace H'] {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'} {M' : Type u_7} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M'] {f : M → M'} {s : Set M} {t : Set M} (hs : IsOpen s) (ht : IsOpen t) : MDiff[s ∪ t] f ↔ MDiff[s] f ∧ MDiff[t] f

docstring: The `v`-adic valuation of `r : R` is less than 1 if and only if `v` divides the ideal `(r)`.
name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_lt_one_iff_dvd
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation K v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) ↑r < 1 ↔ v.asIdeal ∣ Ideal.span {r}

docstring:
A function `f : X → Y` between topological spaces is inducing if the topology on `X` is induced
by the topology on `Y` through `f`, meaning that a set `s : Set X` is open iff it is the preimage
under `f` of some open set `t : Set Y`.
name: Topology.IsInducing
statement_text: {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) : Prop

docstring: Two points are independent if and only if their underlying vectors are linearly independent.
name: Projectivization.independent_mk_iff_LinearIndependent
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] {u : V} {v : V} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) : Projectivization.Independent ![Projectivization.mk K u hu, Projectivization.mk K v hv] ↔ LinearIndependent K ![u, v]

docstring:
An idempotent operator is symmetric if and only if its range is
pairwise orthogonal to its kernel.
name: LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isSymmetric_iff_isOrtho_range_ker
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (hT : IsIdempotentElem T) : LinearMap.IsSymmetric.{u_1, u_2} (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) T ↔ T.range ⟂ T.ker

docstring:
In a field `F`, for any `t ∈ F` and `n > 0`, the polynomial `X ^ n - t` is separable
iff `↑n ≠ 0`. The assumption `n > 0` is needed, since for `n = 0` the polynomial `X ^ n - t`
is separable iff `t ≠ 1`.
name: Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_separable_iff
statement_text: {F : Type u} [Field F] {n : ℕ} {x : F} (hn : 0 < n) (hx : x ≠ 0) : (HSub.hSub (β := Polynomial F) (HPow.hPow (α := Polynomial F) Polynomial.X n) (Polynomial.C x : Polynomial F)).Separable ↔ ↑n ≠ 0

docstring:
`M` is flat if and only if `- ⊗ M` is an exact functor.
See `Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_exact'` to generalize the universe of
`N, N', N''` to any universe that is higher than `R` and `M`.
name: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_exact
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] : Module.Flat R M ↔ ∀ ⦃N N' N'' : Type (max u v)⦄ [inst_3 : AddCommGroup N] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup N'] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup N''] [inst_6 : _root_.Module R N] [inst_7 : _root_.Module R N'] [inst_8 : _root_.Module R N''] ⦃f : N →ₗ[R] N'⦄ ⦃g : N' →ₗ[R] N''⦄, Function.Exact (M := N) (N := N') (P := N'') ⇑f ⇑g → Function.Exact (M := TensorProduct R N M) (N := TensorProduct R N' M) (P := TensorProduct R N'' M) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M f) ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor M g)

docstring:
A family `𝓕 : ι → X → α` is equicontinuous on `S` iff the function `swap 𝓕 : X → ι → α` is
continuous on `S` *when `ι → α` is equipped with the topology of uniform convergence*. This is
very useful for developing the equicontinuity API, but it should not be used directly for other
purposes.
name: equicontinuousOn_iff_continuousOn
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {X : Type u_3} {α : Type u_6} [TopologicalSpace X] [UniformSpace α] {F : ι → X → α} {S : Set X} : EquicontinuousOn F S ↔ ContinuousOn (Y := UniformFun ι α) (⇑UniformFun.ofFun ∘ Function.swap (φ := fun a a_1 => α) F) S

docstring: The `n`th power of a fundamental solution is trivial if and only if `n = 0`.
name: Pell.IsFundamental.zpow_eq_one_iff
statement_text: {d : ℤ} {a : Pell.Solution₁ d} (h : Pell.IsFundamental a) (n : ℤ) : a ^ n = 1 ↔ n = 0

docstring: The projection into `U` from `V` is the zero map if and only if `U` and `V` are orthogonal.
name: Submodule.orthogonalProjectionOnto_comp_subtypeL_eq_zero_iff
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {U : Submodule 𝕜 E} {V : Submodule 𝕜 E} [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] : U.orthogonalProjectionOnto ∘SL V.subtypeL = 0 ↔ U ⟂ V

docstring: The power of a point is nonnegative if and only if the point lies outside or on the sphere.
name: EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.power_nonneg_iff_radius_le_dist_center
statement_text: {P : Type u_2} [MetricSpace P] {s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P} {p : P} (hr : 0 ≤ s.radius) : 0 ≤ s.power p ↔ s.radius ≤ dist p s.center

docstring:
An oriented angle is `π` if and only if the angle with the order of the points reversed is
`π`.
name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_pi_iff_oangle_rev_eq_pi
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} : EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = ↑Real.pi ↔ EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₃ p₂ p₁ = ↑Real.pi

docstring: Two vectors of the same norm are on the same ray if and only if they are equal.
name: sameRay_iff_of_norm_eq
statement_text: {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {x : F} {y : F} (h : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖) : SameRay ℝ x y ↔ x = y

docstring:
The base of a sieve `S` is a colimit of `S` iff all Yoneda-presheaves satisfy
the sheaf condition for `S`.
name: CategoryTheory.Sieve.forallYonedaIsSheaf_iff_colimit
statement_text: {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {X : C} (S : CategoryTheory.Sieve.{v, u} X) : (∀ (W : C), CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.yoneda W) S.arrows) ↔ Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit S.arrows.cocone)

docstring:
When all four functors in a square are left adjoints, the mates operation can be iterated:

```
         L₁                  R₁                  R₁
      C --→ D             C ←-- D             C ←-- D
   F₁ ↓  ↗  ↓  F₂      F₁ ↓  ↘  ↓ F₂       U₁ ↑  ↙  ↑ U₂
      E --→ F             E ←-- F             E ←-- F
         L₂                  R₂                  R₂
```

In this case the iterated mate equals the conjugate of the original transformation and is thus an
isomorphism if and only if the original transformation is. This explains why some Beck-Chevalley
natural transformations are natural isomorphisms.
name: CategoryTheory.iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv
statement_text: {A : Type u₁} {B : Type u₂} {C : Type u₃} {D : Type u₄} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} A] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} B] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₄, u₄} D] {F₁ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₃, u₁, u₃} A C} {U₁ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₁, u₃, u₁} C A} {F₂ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₄, u₂, u₄} B D} {U₂ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₄, v₂, u₄, u₂} D B} {L₁ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} A B} {R₁ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} B A} {L₂ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₃, v₄, u₃, u₄} C D} {R₂ : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₄, v₃, u₄, u₃} D C} (adj₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (adj₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (adj₃ : F₁ ⊣ U₁) (adj₄ : F₂ ⊣ U₂) (α : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare F₁ L₁ L₂ F₂) : Eq (α := CategoryTheory.TwoSquare U₂ R₂ R₁ U₁) ((CategoryTheory.mateEquiv adj₄ adj₃) ((CategoryTheory.mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂) α) : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare U₂ R₂ R₁ U₁) ((CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv (adj₁.comp adj₄) (adj₃.comp adj₂)) α : U₂.comp R₁ ⟶ R₂.comp U₁)

docstring: A polynomial splits if and only if it has as many roots as its degree.
name: Polynomial.splits_iff_card_roots
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {f : Polynomial R} [IsDomain R] : f.Splits ↔ f.roots.card = f.natDegree

docstring:
Let `L / K` be a normal field extension. For any two elements `x` and `y` in `L`, `y` is a
conjugate root of `x` if and only if `x` and `y` falls in the same orbit of the action of Galois
group.
name: isConjRoot_iff_orbitRel
statement_text: {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Normal K L] {x : L} {y : L} : IsConjRoot K x y ↔ (MulAction.orbitRel Gal(L/K) L) x y

docstring: Two vector spaces are isomorphic if and only if they have the same dimension.
name: Module.nonempty_linearEquiv_iff_lift_rank_eq
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {M' : Type v'} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [AddCommMonoid M'] [_root_.Module R M'] [Module.Free R M'] [StrongRankCondition R] : Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] M') ↔ Cardinal.lift.{v', v} (Module.rank R M) = Cardinal.lift.{v, v'} (Module.rank R M')

docstring:
An invertible module is free iff it is isomorphic to the ring, i.e. its class is trivial in
the Picard group.
name: Module.Invertible.free_iff_linearEquiv
statement_text: {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [_root_.Module R M] [Module.Invertible R M] : Module.Free R M ↔ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] R)

docstring: The graph with a single `s-t` edge. It is empty iff `s = t`.
name: SimpleGraph.edge
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} (s : V) (t : V) : SimpleGraph V

docstring: An idempotent element in a non-unital C⋆-algebra is self-adjoint iff it is normal.
name: IsIdempotentElem.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isStarNormal
statement_text: {A : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace A] [NonUnitalRing A] [StarRing A] [_root_.Module ℂ A] [IsScalarTower ℂ A A] [SMulCommClass ℂ A A] [NonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℂ A IsStarNormal] {p : A} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : IsSelfAdjoint p ↔ IsStarNormal p

docstring:
A morphism in `Truncated d` is a monomorphism if and only if it is a monomorphism in
`SimplexCategory`.
name: SimplexCategory.Truncated.mono_iff
statement_text: {d : ℕ} {a : SimplexCategory.Truncated d} {b : SimplexCategory.Truncated d} {f : a ⟶ b} : CategoryTheory.Mono f ↔ CategoryTheory.Mono f.hom

docstring:
A set is preperfect if and only if every stage of its iterated relative derived-set sequence
is equal to the original set.
name: CantorBendixson.iteratedDerivedSet_constant_iff_preperfect
statement_text: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} : Preperfect s ↔ ∀ (a : Ordinal.{u}), CantorBendixson.iteratedDerivedSet s a = s

docstring:
For an adjoint quadruple `L ⊣ F ⊣ G ⊣ R` where `F` (and hence also `R`) is fully faithful, all
components of the natural transformation `G ⟶ L` are epimorphisms iff all components of the natural
transformation `F ⟶ R` are monomorphisms.
name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple.epi_leftTriple_rightToLeft_app_iff_mono_rightTriple_leftToRight_app
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} D] {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C D} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₂, v₁, u₂, u₁} D C} (q : CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Quadruple L F G R) [F.Full] [F.Faithful] : (∀ (X : C), CategoryTheory.Epi (q.leftTriple.rightToLeft.app X)) ↔ ∀ (X : D), CategoryTheory.Mono (q.rightTriple.leftToRight.app X)

docstring: A block of a group action is invariant iff it is fixed.
name: AddAction.isInvariantBlock_iff_isFixedBlock
statement_text: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {X : Type u_2} [AddAction G X] {B : Set X} : AddAction.IsInvariantBlock G B ↔ AddAction.IsFixedBlock G B

docstring: If `R` is Bezout then an `R`-module is flat iff it has no torsion.
name: Module.Flat.flat_iff_torsion_eq_bot_of_isBezout
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] : Module.Flat R M ↔ Eq (α := Submodule R M) (Submodule.torsion R M) ⊥

docstring:
A 2-square is Guitart exact iff it is so after replacing the left and right functors by
isomorphic functors.
name: CategoryTheory.TwoSquare.GuitartExact.whiskerVertical_iff
statement_text: {C₁ : Type u_1} {C₂ : Type u_2} {D₁ : Type u_4} {D₂ : Type u_5} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_2, u_2} C₂] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_4, u_4} D₁] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_5, u_5} D₂] {T : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_4, u_1, u_4} C₁ D₁} {L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C₁ C₂} {R : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_4, v_5, u_4, u_5} D₁ D₂} {B : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_2, v_5, u_2, u_5} C₂ D₂} (w : CategoryTheory.TwoSquare T L R B) {L' : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_1, v_2, u_1, u_2} C₁ C₂} {R' : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v_4, v_5, u_4, u_5} D₁ D₂} (α : L ≅ L') (β : R ≅ R') : (w.whiskerVertical α.hom β.inv).GuitartExact ↔ w.GuitartExact

docstring: A finite rank torsion-free module has positive `finrank` iff it has a nonzero element.
name: Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module R M] [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Finite R M] [IsDomain R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] : 0 < Module.finrank R M ↔ ∃ x, x ≠ 0

docstring:
If the signs of two nondegenerate oriented angles between points are negations of each other,
the oriented angles are negations of each other if and only if the unoriented angles are equal.
name: EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_iff_oangle_eq_neg_of_sign_eq_neg
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] {p₁ : P} {p₂ : P} {p₃ : P} {p₄ : P} {p₅ : P} {p₆ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ≠ p₂) (hp₃ : p₃ ≠ p₂) (hp₄ : p₄ ≠ p₅) (hp₆ : p₆ ≠ p₅) (hs : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃).sign = -(EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₄ p₅ p₆).sign) : EuclideanGeometry.angle p₁ p₂ p₃ = EuclideanGeometry.angle p₄ p₅ p₆ ↔ EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₁ p₂ p₃ = -EuclideanGeometry.oangle p₄ p₅ p₆

docstring: Similarity holds if and only if all distances are proportional.
name: similar_iff_exists_dist_eq
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {P₁ : Type u_3} {P₂ : Type u_4} {v₁ : ι → P₁} {v₂ : ι → P₂} [PseudoMetricSpace P₁] [PseudoMetricSpace P₂] : Similar v₁ v₂ ↔ ∃ r, r ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (i₁ i₂ : ι), dist (v₁ i₁) (v₁ i₂) = ↑r * dist (v₂ i₁) (v₂ i₂)

docstring:
An `R`-algebra `S` has the going up property if and only if specializations lift
along `Spec S → Spec R`.
name: Algebra.HasGoingUp.iff_specializingMap_primeSpectrumComap
statement_text: {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] : Algebra.HasGoingUp R S ↔ SpecializingMap (X := PrimeSpectrum S) (Y := PrimeSpectrum R) (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S))

docstring: An integer is squarefree iff no prime square divides it.
name: Int.squarefree_iff_prime_sq_not_dvd
statement_text: {n : ℤ} : Squarefree n ↔ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ¬HPow.hPow (α := ℤ) (↑p) 2 ∣ n

docstring: A sum is finite iff all terms are finite.
name: WithTop.sum_ne_top
statement_text: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → WithTop M} : Ne.{u_2 + 1} (α := WithTop M) (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊤ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ ⊤

docstring:
`bipartiteDoubleCover G` has two vertices `inl v` and `inr v` for each vertex `v` in `G`
such that `inl v` (`inr v`) is adjacent to `inr w` (`inl w`) iff `v` is adjacent to `w` in `G`.
name: SimpleGraph.bipartiteDoubleCover
statement_text: {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V) : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ V)

docstring:
A submodule has dimension at most `1` if and only if there is a
single vector in the submodule such that the submodule is contained in
its span.
name: rank_submodule_le_one_iff
statement_text: {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Ring K] [StrongRankCondition K] [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module K V] (s : Submodule K V) [Module.Free.{u, v} K ↥s] : Module.rank K ↥s ≤ 1 ↔ ∃ v₀ ∈ s, s ≤ K ∙ v₀

docstring:
An a priori non-associative ring is associative iff the `AddMonoidHom` version of the
associator vanishes.
name: AddMonoidHom.associator_eq_zero_iff_associative
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] : AddMonoidHom.associator = 0 ↔ Std.Associative fun (x : R) y => x * y

docstring: `P` is a sheaf for `R` iff it is separated for `R` and there exists an amalgamation.
name: CategoryTheory.Presieve.isSeparatedFor_and_exists_isAmalgamation_iff_isSheafFor
statement_text: {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] {P : CategoryTheory.Functor.{v₁, w, u₁, w + 1} Cᵒᵖ (Type w)} {X : C} {R : CategoryTheory.Presieve.{v₁, u₁} X} : (CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSeparatedFor P R ∧ ∀ (x : CategoryTheory.Presieve.FamilyOfElements P R), x.Compatible (R := R) → ∃ t, x.IsAmalgamation (R := R) t) ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor P R

docstring:
A function is analytic at a point iff it is analytic after multiplication
with a non-vanishing analytic function.
name: analyticAt_iff_analytic_mul
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_2} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {𝕝 : Type u_8} [NormedDivisionRing 𝕝] [NormedAlgebra 𝕜 𝕝] {f : E → 𝕝} {g : E → 𝕝} {z : E} (h₁f : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z) (h₂f : f z ≠ 0) : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z ↔ AnalyticAt 𝕜 (f * g) z

docstring: A subsemigroup `S` includes `closure s` if and only if it includes `s`.
name: Subsemigroup.closure_le
statement_text: {M : Type u_1} [Mul M] {s : Set M} {S : Subsemigroup M} : Subsemigroup.closure s ≤ S ↔ s ⊆ ↑S

docstring:
For any two charts `e`, `e'` around a point `x` in a C¹ manifold, `e` maps `x` to the interior
of the model space iff `e'` does. - in other words, the notion of interior points does not
depend on any choice of charts.
name: ModelWithCorners.mem_interior_range_iff_of_mem_atlas
statement_text: {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M : Type u_4} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [IsManifold I n M] {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H} {e' : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H} {x : M} (hn : n ≠ 0) (he : Membership.mem (γ := Set (OpenPartialHomeomorph M H)) (atlas H M) e) (he' : Membership.mem (γ := Set (OpenPartialHomeomorph M H)) (atlas H M) e') (hex : x ∈ e.source) (hex' : x ∈ e'.source) : ↑(e.extend I) x ∈ interior (e.extend I).target ↔ ↑(e'.extend I) x ∈ interior (e'.extend I).target

docstring: `q - p` is a star projection iff `q * p = p`.
name: IsStarProjection.sub_iff_mul_eq_right
statement_text: {R : Type u_1} [NonUnitalRing R] [StarRing R] [HasUniqueDiv R] {p : R} {q : R} (hp : IsStarProjection p) (hq : IsStarProjection q) : IsStarProjection (q - p) ↔ q * p = p
